name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.rawRoute01LengthOne_isPath
statement:
private theorem rawRoute01LengthOne_isPath (H : PentagramEarHull G) :
    (rawRoute01LengthOne H).IsPath
proof:
:= by
  apply (SimpleGraph.Walk.isPath_def _).mpr
  change List.Nodup
    [H.vertex (.inr (.inr 0)), H.vertex (.inr (.inl 0)),
      H.vertex (.inl 0), H.vertex (.inl 1), H.vertex (.inl 2),
      H.vertex (.inl 3), H.vertex (.inr (.inl 3)),
      H.vertex (.inr (.inr 1))]
  have hxs : ([.inr (.inr 0), .inr (.inl 0), .inl 0, .inl 1,
      .inl 2, .inl 3, .inr (.inl 3), .inr (.inr 1)] :
      List (Sum (Fin 5) (Sum (Fin 5) (Fin 5)))).Nodup := by decide
  exact List.Nodup.map H.vertex_injective hxs

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.range_comp_bijective
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨e i, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := he.2 i
    exact ⟨j, by simpa only [hj] using hi⟩

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.hull_reflectHull
statement:
theorem hull_reflectHull (H : PentagramEarHull G) (k : Fin 5) :
    hull (reflectHull H k) = hull H
proof:
:= by
  change
    (Set.range (fun i => H.cVertex (reflect5 k i)) ∪
      Set.range (fun i => H.aVertex (reflect5 k i))) ∪
      Set.range (fun i => H.bVertex (reflect5Shifted k i)) =
    (Set.range H.cVertex ∪ Set.range H.aVertex) ∪ Set.range H.bVertex
  rw [range_comp_bijective H.cVertex (reflect5 k) (reflect5_bijective k),
    range_comp_bijective H.aVertex (reflect5 k) (reflect5_bijective k),
    range_comp_bijective H.bVertex (reflect5Shifted k)
      (reflect5Shifted_bijective k)]

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.exists_globalEdgeMinimalCounterexample
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.exists_globalEdgeMinimalCounterexample
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (minimalCounterexample : MinimalCounterexample G) :
    ∃ (W : Type u) (H : SimpleGraph W) (_ : Fintype W)
      (_ : DecidableRel H.Adj),
      GlobalEdgeMinimalCounterexample H ∧ Fintype.card W = Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let P : ℕ → Prop := fun n =>
    ∃ (W : Type u) (H : SimpleGraph W) (_ : Fintype W)
      (_ : DecidableRel H.Adj),
      Fintype.card W = Fintype.card V ∧ IsCounterexample H ∧
        H.edgeSet.ncard = n
  have hP : ∃ n, P n := by
    exact ⟨G.edgeSet.ncard, V, G, inferInstance, inferInstance,
      rfl, minimalCounterexample.isCounterexample, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨W, H, hW, hD, hcard, hcounter, hedges⟩ := Nat.find_spec hP
  let : Fintype W := hW
  let : DecidableRel H.Adj := hD
  refine ⟨W, H, hW, hD, ?_, hcard⟩
  refine
    { vertexMinimal :=
        { isCounterexample := hcounter
          minimal := ?_ }
      edgeCountMinimal := ?_ }
  · intro X K _ _ hK
    rw [hcard]
    exact minimalCounterexample.minimal X K hK
  · intro X K hX hKdec hK hXcard
    rw [hedges]
    apply Nat.find_min' hP
    exact ⟨X, K, hX, hKdec, hXcard.trans hcard, hK, rfl⟩

name: Erdos64.exists_globalEdgeMinimalCounterexample
statement:
theorem exists_globalEdgeMinimalCounterexample
    (hnot : ¬ Conjecture.{u}) :
    ∃ (V : Type u) (G : SimpleGraph V) (_ : Fintype V)
      (_ : DecidableRel G.Adj), GlobalEdgeMinimalCounterexample G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, G, hV, hD, hminimal⟩ := exists_minimalCounterexample hnot
  let : Fintype V := hV
  let : DecidableRel G.Adj := hD
  obtain ⟨W, H, hW, hH, hglobal, _⟩ :=
    hminimal.exists_globalEdgeMinimalCounterexample
  exact ⟨W, H, hW, hH, hglobal⟩

name: Erdos64.GlobalEdgeMinimalCounterexample.toEdgeMinimalCounterexample
statement:
theorem GlobalEdgeMinimalCounterexample.toEdgeMinimalCounterexample
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (minimalCounterexample : GlobalEdgeMinimalCounterexample G) :
    EdgeMinimalCounterexample G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine
    { vertexMinimal := minimalCounterexample.vertexMinimal
      edgeMinimal := ?_ }
  intro H _ hH hHG
  have hcard : G.edgeSet.ncard ≤ H.edgeSet.ncard :=
    minimalCounterexample.edgeCountMinimal V H hH rfl
  apply SimpleGraph.edgeSet_inj.mp
  exact Set.eq_of_subset_of_ncard_le (SimpleGraph.edgeSet_mono hHG) hcard

name: Erdos64.externalComponent_bridge_or_rootedBranch_residual
statement:
theorem externalComponent_bridge_or_rootedBranch_residual
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (m : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G)
    {s : V} {C : G.Walk s s} (hC : C.IsCycle)
    (hG : G.Connected) {x : V} (hx : x ∉ C.support) :
    (∃ bridge : CycleBridgePath G C, True) ∨
      ∃ B : RootedBranchCarrier G,
        B.root ∈ C.support ∧
        (∀ v, v ∈ B.carrier → v ∉ C.support) ∧
        internalDegree G (Finset.univ \ B.carrier) B.root ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases externalComponent_bridge_or_unique_root hC hG hx with hbridge | hroot
  · exact Or.inl hbridge
  · rcases hroot with ⟨r, hr, hroot⟩
    rcases externalComponent_exists_rootedBranchCarrier hx hr hroot with
      ⟨B, _, hBroot, houtside, _⟩
    right
    refine ⟨B, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [hBroot] using hr
    · exact houtside
    · exact B.root_internalDegree_le_two
        m.vertexMinimal.isSubgraphCritical
        m.vertexMinimal.isCounterexample.1

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.one_defect_small_has_dyadic_cycle
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.one_defect_small_has_dyadic_cycle
    {V W : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] [DecidableRel H.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (y : W)
    (hy : 2 ≤ H.degree y)
    (hother : ∀ w, w ≠ y → 3 ≤ H.degree w)
    (hsize : 2 * Fintype.card W - 1 < Fintype.card V) :
    HasPowerOfTwoCycle H
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hno
  let K := rootedDoubleGraph H y
  let : Nonempty (RootedDoubleVertex W y) := ⟨none⟩
  have hmin : 3 ≤ K.minDegree := by
    apply SimpleGraph.le_minDegree_of_forall_le_degree (G := K) 3
    intro z
    cases z with
    | none =>
        change 3 ≤ (rootedDoubleGraph H y).degree none
        rw [rootedDouble_root_degree_doubling]
        omega
    | some z =>
        rcases z with ⟨b, w⟩
        change 3 ≤ (rootedDoubleGraph H y).degree (some (b, w))
        rw [rootedDouble_nonroot_degree_preservation]
        exact hother w.1 w.2
  have hKno : ¬HasPowerOfTwoCycle K := by
    rintro ⟨k, z, c, hk, hc, hlen⟩
    obtain ⟨hc', hlen'⟩ := rootedDouble_cycle_localization_projection c hc
    exact hno ⟨k, rootedDoubleProjectionHom z,
      c.map rootedDoubleProjectionHom, hk, hc', hlen'.trans hlen⟩
  apply M.not_exists_strictly_smaller (H := K)
  refine ⟨⟨hmin, hKno⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [rootedDouble_card]
  exact hsize

name: Erdos64.boundaryRoot_root_cycle_path
statement:
theorem boundaryRoot_root_cycle_path
    {W : Type u} {H : SimpleGraph W} {B : Finset W}
    (c : (boundaryRootGraph H B).Walk none none) (hc : c.IsCycle) :
    ∃ a b : W, ∃ p : H.Walk a b,
      a ∈ B ∧ b ∈ B ∧ a ≠ b ∧ p.IsPath ∧ p.length + 2 = c.length
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let R := boundaryRootGraph H B
  cases c with
  | nil => exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.not_isCycle_nil hc).elim
  | @cons u v w h q =>
    have hqnotnil : ¬q.Nil := SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_of_isCycle_cons hc
    have hqpath : q.IsPath := by simpa using hc.isPath_tail
    have hdropnone : ∀ z, z ∈ q.dropLast.support → z ≠ none := by
      intro z hz hzn
      have hnodup : (q.dropLast.support ++ [none]).Nodup := by
        rw [q.support_dropLast_concat hqnotnil]
        exact hqpath.support_nodup
      exact (List.disjoint_left.mp (List.disjoint_of_nodup_append hnodup))
        hz (by simp [hzn])
    let S : Set (Option W) := {z | z ≠ none}
    let qi := q.dropLast.induce S hdropnone
    let e := boundaryRootDeletedIso H B
    let emb : R.induce S ↪g R := SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce S
    have hmap : qi.map emb.toHom = q.dropLast := q.dropLast.map_induce hdropnone
    have hqi : qi.IsPath := by
      apply (SimpleGraph.Walk.isPath_map_iff_of_injective
        (p := qi) (f := emb.toHom) emb.injective).mp
      rw [hmap]
      exact hqpath.dropLast
    let p := qi.map e.toHom
    have hp : p.IsPath := hqi.map e.injective
    have hplen : p.length = q.dropLast.length := by
      have hind := congrArg SimpleGraph.Walk.length hmap
      rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map] at hind
      exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map e.toHom qi).trans hind
    have hboundary : ∀ z : {z : Option W // z ≠ none},
        R.Adj none z.1 → e z ∈ B := by
      rintro ⟨z, hz⟩ hadj
      cases z with
      | none => exact (hz rfl).elim
      | some a => simpa [e, R] using hadj
    have ha := hboundary ⟨v, hdropnone v q.dropLast.start_mem_support⟩ h
    have hb := hboundary ⟨q.penultimate, hdropnone _ q.dropLast.end_mem_support⟩
      (q.adj_penultimate hqnotnil).symm
    have hlen : p.length + 2 = (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons h q).length := by
      rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons, ← q.length_dropLast_add_one hqnotnil]
      omega
    have hpositive : 0 < p.length := by
      have hthree := hc.three_le_length
      omega
    have hab : e ⟨v, hdropnone v q.dropLast.start_mem_support⟩ ≠
        e ⟨q.penultimate, hdropnone _ q.dropLast.end_mem_support⟩ := by
      intro heq
      exact (Nat.ne_of_gt hpositive) (hp.nil_iff_eq.mpr heq).length_eq_zero
    exact ⟨_, _, p, ha, hb, hab, hp, hlen⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.boundaryRoot_small_two_defect_path
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.boundaryRoot_small_two_defect_path
    {V W : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] [DecidableRel H.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (B : Finset W) (t : W)
    (hB : 2 ≤ B.card)
    (ht : 2 ≤ (boundaryRootGraph H B).degree (some t))
    (hothers : ∀ w, w ≠ t → 3 ≤ (boundaryRootGraph H B).degree (some w))
    (hsize : 2 * Fintype.card W + 1 < Fintype.card V)
    (hno : ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle H) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : W, ∃ p : H.Walk a b,
      1 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ B ∧ b ∈ B ∧ a ≠ b ∧ p.IsPath ∧
      (p.length + 2 = 2 ^ k ∨ p.length + 2 = 2 ^ k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let R := boundaryRootGraph H B
  by_cases hyes : HasPowerOfTwoCycle R
  · obtain ⟨k, a, b, p, hk, ha, hb, hab, hp, hlen⟩ :=
      boundaryRoot_dyadic_cycle_path B hno hyes
    exact ⟨k, a, b, p, by omega, ha, hb, hab, hp, Or.inl hlen⟩
  have hroot : R.degree none = 2 := by
    rw [boundaryRootGraph_degree_none]
    by_contra hne
    have hthree : 3 ≤ B.card := by omega
    have hrest : ∀ v, v ≠ some t → 3 ≤ R.degree v := by
      intro v hv
      cases v with
      | none =>
        change 3 ≤ (boundaryRootGraph H B).degree none
        rw [boundaryRootGraph_degree_none]
        exact hthree
      | some w => exact hothers w (fun h => hv (congrArg some h))
    have horder : 2 * Fintype.card (Option W) - 1 < Fintype.card V := by
      simp only [Fintype.card_option]
      omega
    exact hyes (M.one_defect_small_has_dyadic_cycle (some t) ht hrest horder)
  have hrest : ∀ v, v ≠ none → v ≠ some t → 3 ≤ R.degree v := by
    intro v hv0 hvt
    cases v with
    | none => exact (hv0 rfl).elim
    | some w => exact hothers w (fun h => hvt (congrArg some h))
  have horder : 2 * Fintype.card (Option W) - 3 < Fintype.card V := by
    simp only [Fintype.card_option]
    omega
  obtain ⟨k, c, hk, hc, hlen⟩ :=
    M.two_defect_port_dyadic_successor_cycle none (some t) (by simp)
      hroot ht hrest hyes horder
  obtain ⟨a, b, p, ha, hb, hab, hp, hplen⟩ := boundaryRoot_root_cycle_path c hc
  exact ⟨k, a, b, p, hk, ha, hb, hab, hp, Or.inr (hplen.trans hlen)⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.small_carrier_mixed_ear_avoiding_attachment
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.small_carrier_mixed_ear_avoiding_attachment
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (K : Finset V) (S : Set V)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ v, v ∈ K → v ∉ S)
    (hboundary : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj v w → w ∈ S)
    (hB : 3 ≤ (carrierBoundaryVertices G K).card)
    (hsize : 2 * K.card + 1 < Fintype.card V)
    (hattachments : ∀ w, w ∈ S → ∀ a, a ∈ K → ∀ b, b ∈ K →
      G.Adj a w → G.Adj b w → a = b)
    (s : V) (hs : s ∈ S) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : V, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      1 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ S ∧ b ∈ S ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      ear.IsPath ∧ (ear.length = 2 ^ k ∨ ear.length = 2 ^ k + 1) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v = a ∨ v = b ∨ v ∈ K) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ S → v = a ∨ v = b) ∧
      s ∉ ear.support
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hK : K.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨v, _⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp
      (show 0 < (carrierBoundaryVertices G K).card by omega)
    exact ⟨v.1, v.2⟩
  obtain ⟨t, hunique⟩ : ∃ t : {v : V // v ∈ K},
      ∀ v, v ∈ K → G.Adj v s → v = t.1 := by
    by_cases hattach : ∃ t, t ∈ K ∧ G.Adj t s
    · obtain ⟨t, ht, hts⟩ := hattach
      exact ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, fun v hv hvs => hattachments s hs v hv t ht hvs hts⟩
    · obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hK
      exact ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, fun v hv hvs => (hattach ⟨v, hv, hvs⟩).elim⟩
  have hsK : s ∉ K := fun h => hdisjoint s h hs
  have hne : ∀ v, v ∈ K → v ≠ s := by
    intro v hv hvs
    exact hsK (hvs ▸ hv)
  let L := G.deleteIncidenceSet s
  have hLadj : ∀ {v w}, L.Adj v w ↔ G.Adj v w ∧ v ≠ s ∧ w ≠ s :=
    fun {_ _} => SimpleGraph.deleteIncidenceSet_adj
  have hle : L ≤ G := G.deleteIncidenceSet_le s
  by_cases htwo : ∃ v ∈ K, ∃ a, a ∉ K ∧ ∃ b, b ∉ K ∧
      a ≠ b ∧ L.Adj v a ∧ L.Adj v b
  · obtain ⟨v, hv, a, haK, b, hbK, hab, hva, hvb⟩ := htwo
    have hva' := (hLadj.mp hva).1
    have hvb' := (hLadj.mp hvb).1
    let ear : G.Walk a b := .cons hva'.symm (.cons hvb' .nil)
    have hear : ear.IsPath := by
      apply SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.cons
      · exact SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.of_adj hvb'
      · simp [hva'.ne.symm, hab]
    have hsupport : ∀ w, w ∈ ear.support → w = a ∨ w = b ∨ w ∈ K := by
      intro w hw
      simp only [ear, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil,
        List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hw
      rcases hw with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr hv)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
    refine ⟨1, a, b, ear, by omega, hboundary v hv a haK hva',
      hboundary v hv b hbK hvb', hab, hear, Or.inl rfl, hsupport, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro w hw hwS
      rcases hsupport w hw with h | h | h
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr h
      · exact (hdisjoint w h hwS).elim
    · intro h
      rcases hsupport s h with h | h | h
      · exact (hLadj.mp hva).2.2 h.symm
      · exact (hLadj.mp hvb).2.2 h.symm
      · exact hsK h
  have hsingle : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ a, a ∉ K → ∀ b, b ∉ K →
      L.Adj v a → L.Adj v b → a = b := by
    intro v hv a ha b hb hva hvb
    by_contra hab
    exact htwo ⟨v, hv, a, ha, b, hb, hab, hva, hvb⟩
  have hneighbors : ∀ v, v ∈ K →
      L.neighborFinset v = (G.neighborFinset v).erase s := by
    intro v hv
    ext w
    simp [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, hLadj, hne v hv, and_comm]
  have htdegree : 2 ≤ L.degree t.1 := by
    have hmin := degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G M.isCounterexample.1 t.1
    rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hneighbors t.1 t.2]
    by_cases hst : s ∈ G.neighborFinset t.1
    · rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hst, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
      omega
    · rw [Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem hst, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
      omega
  have hothers : ∀ v, v ∈ K → v ≠ t.1 → 3 ≤ L.degree v := by
    intro v hv hvt
    have hnot : s ∉ G.neighborFinset v := by
      intro h
      exact hvt (hunique v hv ((G.mem_neighborFinset v s).mp h))
    rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hneighbors v hv,
      Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem hnot, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
    exact degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G M.isCounterexample.1 v
  let B := carrierBoundaryVertices L K
  have hBsub : (carrierBoundaryVertices G K).erase t ⊆ B := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨hvt, hvB⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hv
    obtain ⟨w, hwK, hvw⟩ := (mem_carrierBoundaryVertices G K v).mp hvB
    have hws : w ≠ s := by
      intro h
      subst w
      exact hvt (Subtype.ext (hunique v.1 v.2 hvw))
    exact (mem_carrierBoundaryVertices L K v).mpr
      ⟨w, hwK, hLadj.mpr ⟨hvw, hne v.1 v.2, hws⟩⟩
  have hBtwo : 2 ≤ B.card := by
    have hc := Finset.card_le_card hBsub
    by_cases htB : t ∈ carrierBoundaryVertices G K
    · rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem htB] at hc
      omega
    · rw [Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem htB] at hc
      omega
  let H := L.induce (↑K : Set V)
  let R := boundaryRootGraph H B
  have hdegree : ∀ v, R.degree (some v) = L.degree v.1 := by
    intro v
    rw [boundaryRootGraph_degree_some]
    exact carrier_degree_add_boundary_indicator K hsingle v
  have htroot : 2 ≤ R.degree (some t) := by
    rw [hdegree]
    exact htdegree
  have hrest : ∀ v, v ≠ t → 3 ≤ R.degree (some v) := by
    intro v hv
    rw [hdegree]
    exact hothers v.1 v.2 (fun h => hv (Subtype.ext h))
  have horder : 2 * Fintype.card (↑K : Set V) + 1 < Fintype.card V := by
    simpa using hsize
  let e : H →g G :=
    { toFun := Subtype.val
      map_rel' := fun h => hle h }
  have hno : ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle H := by
    rintro ⟨k, v, c, hk, hc, hlen⟩
    exact M.isCounterexample.2 ⟨k, e v, c.map e, hk,
      hc.map Subtype.val_injective, by simpa using hlen⟩
  obtain ⟨k, a, b, q, hk, ha, hb, hab, hq, hlen⟩ :=
    M.boundaryRoot_small_two_defect_path B t hBtwo htroot hrest horder hno
  obtain ⟨aOut, haOut, haaL⟩ := (mem_carrierBoundaryVertices L K a).mp ha
  obtain ⟨bOut, hbOut, hbbL⟩ := (mem_carrierBoundaryVertices L K b).mp hb
  have haa := hle haaL
  have hbb := hle hbbL
  have haS := hboundary a.1 a.2 aOut haOut haa
  have hbS := hboundary b.1 b.2 bOut hbOut hbb
  let p : G.Walk a.1 b.1 := q.map e
  have hp : p.IsPath := hq.map Subtype.val_injective
  have hpK : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ K := by
    intro v hv
    change v ∈ (q.map e).support at hv
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map] at hv
    obtain ⟨w, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hv
    exact w.2
  have hplen : p.length + 2 = 2 ^ k ∨ p.length + 2 = 2 ^ k + 1 := by
    change (q.map e).length + 2 = 2 ^ k ∨ (q.map e).length + 2 = 2 ^ k + 1
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map]
    exact hlen
  have haavoid : aOut ∉ p.support := fun h => haOut (hpK aOut h)
  have hbavoid : bOut ∉ p.support := fun h => hbOut (hpK bOut h)
  have habOut : aOut ≠ bOut := by
    intro heq
    subst bOut
    exact hab (Subtype.ext (hattachments aOut haS a.1 a.2 b.1 b.2 haa hbb))
  let ear : G.Walk aOut bOut := .cons haa.symm (p.concat hbb)
  have hear : ear.IsPath := by
    apply SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.cons (hp.concat hbavoid hbb)
    simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_concat, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton]
    exact fun h => h.elim haavoid habOut
  have hsupport : ∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v = aOut ∨ v = bOut ∨ v ∈ K := by
    intro v hv
    simp only [ear, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_concat,
      List.mem_cons, List.mem_append, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hv
    rcases hv with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (hpK v h))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
  refine ⟨k, aOut, bOut, ear, by omega, haS, hbS, habOut, hear, ?_, hsupport, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [ear, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_concat]
    rcases hplen with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (by omega)
    · exact Or.inr (by omega)
  · intro v hv hvS
    rcases hsupport v hv with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr h
    · exact (hdisjoint v h hvS).elim
  · intro h
    rcases hsupport s h with h | h | h
    · exact (hLadj.mp haaL).2.2 h.symm
    · exact (hLadj.mp hbbL).2.2 h.symm
    · exact hsK h

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_side_mixed_ear_avoiding_vertex_of_cubic_path
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_side_mixed_ear_avoiding_vertex_of_cubic_path
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hinside : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (E : (G.induce {v : V | v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      v ∉ p.support}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hB : 3 ≤ (carrierBoundaryVertices G
      (offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E)).card)
    (hcubic : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → G.degree v = 3)
    (s : V) (hs : s ∈ p.support) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : V, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      1 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ p.support ∧ b ∈ p.support ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      ear.IsPath ∧ (ear.length = 2 ^ k ∨ ear.length = 2 ^ k + 1) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v = a ∨ v = b ∨
        v ∈ offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ p.support → v = a ∨ v = b) ∧
      s ∉ ear.support ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K := offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E
  obtain ⟨_, hKdata, hboundary, hsize⟩ :=
    cut_side_offPath_carrier_data M r C D hCD hxy hrx hry p hinside E
  have hattachments : ∀ w, w ∈ p.support → ∀ a, a ∈ K → ∀ b, b ∈ K →
      G.Adj a w → G.Adj b w → a = b := by
    intro w hw a ha b hb haw hbw
    exact cut_side_port_path_external_neighbors_eq r C hxy hrx hry p hp hinside
      K hKdata w hw (hcubic w hw) a ha b hb haw.symm hbw.symm
  obtain ⟨k, a, b, ear, hk, ha, hb, hab, hear, hlen, hsupport, hfresh, hsavoid⟩ :=
    M.small_carrier_mixed_ear_avoiding_attachment K {v | v ∈ p.support}
      (fun v hv => (hKdata v hv).2) hboundary hB hsize hattachments s hs
  refine ⟨k, a, b, ear, hk, ha, hb, hab, hear, hlen, hsupport, hfresh, hsavoid, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  rcases hsupport v hv with hva | hvb | hvK
  · subst v
    exact hinside a ha
  · subst v
    exact hinside b hb
  · exact (hKdata v hvK).1

name: Erdos64.rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_path_no_dyadic_closure
statement:
theorem rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_path_no_dyadic_closure
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hno : ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle G) (r : V)
    (C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hcard : (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card = 2) :
    ∃ a b : V, ∃ p : G.Walk a b,
      a ≠ b ∧
      a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      b ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      G.Adj r a ∧ G.Adj r b ∧
      p.IsPath ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) ∧
      r ∉ p.support ∧ 0 < p.length ∧
      (∀ k, 2 ≤ k → p.length + 2 ≠ 2 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, p, hab, ha, hb, hra, hrb, hp, hinside, hroot, hpos⟩ :=
    rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_path r C hcard
  refine ⟨a, b, p, hab, ha, hb, hra, hrb, hp, hinside, hroot, hpos, ?_⟩
  intro k hk hlen
  by_cases hlong : 1 < p.length
  · have hne := twoPort_path_length_ne_pow_two_sub_two hno hp hroot hra hrb
      hab hlong hk
    apply hne
    have hpow : 4 ≤ 2 ^ k := four_le_pow_two hk
    omega
  · have hple : p.length = 1 := by omega
    have hpow : 4 ≤ 2 ^ k := four_le_pow_two hk
    omega

name: Erdos64.rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_nonadjacent_path_no_dyadic_closure
statement:
theorem rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_nonadjacent_path_no_dyadic_closure
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hno : ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle G) (r : V)
    (C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hcard : (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card = 2)
    (hnonadj : ∀ a b,
      a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      b ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      G.Adj r a → G.Adj r b → a ≠ b → ¬ G.Adj a b) :
    ∃ a b : V, ∃ p : G.Walk a b,
      a ≠ b ∧
      a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      b ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      G.Adj r a ∧ G.Adj r b ∧
      p.IsPath ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) ∧
      r ∉ p.support ∧ 1 < p.length ∧
      (∀ k, 2 ≤ k → p.length + 2 ≠ 2 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, p, hab, ha, hb, hra, hrb, hp, hinside, hroot, hlong⟩ :=
    rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_path_of_nonadjacent r C hcard hnonadj
  refine ⟨a, b, p, hab, ha, hb, hra, hrb, hp, hinside, hroot, hlong, ?_⟩
  intro k hk hlen
  have hne := twoPort_path_length_ne_pow_two_sub_two hno hp hroot hra hrb
    hab hlong hk
  apply hne
  have hpow : 4 ≤ 2 ^ k := four_le_pow_two hk
  omega

name: Erdos64.cutComponent_to_leafBlockCarrier
statement:
theorem cutComponent_to_leafBlockCarrier
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (K R : Finset V) (r : V)
    (hKnonempty : K.Nonempty)
    (hrR : r ∈ R)
    (hpartition : K ∪ R = (Finset.univ : Finset V))
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint K R)
    (hRother : ∃ z, z ∈ R ∧ z ≠ r)
    (hblockconn :
      (G.induce (↑({r} ∪ K) : Set V)).Connected)
    (hnoncross :
      ∀ x, x ∈ K → ∀ y, y ∈ R → y ≠ r → ¬G.Adj x y) :
    ∃ S : Finset V,
      S = {r} ∪ K ∧
      S.Nonempty ∧
      S ≠ (Finset.univ : Finset V) ∧
      r ∈ S ∧
      (∃ x, x ∈ S ∧ x ≠ r) ∧
      (G.induce (↑S : Set V)).Connected ∧
      (∀ x, x ∈ S → ∀ y, y ∉ S → G.Adj x y → x = r) ∧
      (∀ x, x ∈ S → x ≠ r → ∀ y, G.Adj x y → y ∈ S)
proof:
:= by
  have hboundary :
      ∀ x, x ∈ ({r} ∪ K : Finset V) →
        ∀ y, y ∉ ({r} ∪ K : Finset V) → G.Adj x y → x = r := by
    intro x hxS y hyS hxy
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hxS with hxr | hxK
    · exact Finset.mem_singleton.mp hxr
    · have hyR : y ∈ R := by
        have hyU : y ∈ K ∪ R := by
          rw [hpartition]
          exact Finset.mem_univ y
        rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hyU with hyK | hyR
        · exact (hyS (Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr hyK))).elim
        · exact hyR
      have hyr : y ≠ r := by
        intro hyr
        subst y
        exact hyS (Finset.mem_union.mpr
          (Or.inl (Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)))
      exact (hnoncross x hxK y hyR hyr hxy).elim
  have hclosure :
      ∀ x, x ∈ ({r} ∪ K : Finset V) → x ≠ r →
        ∀ y, G.Adj x y → y ∈ ({r} ∪ K : Finset V) := by
    intro x hxS hxr y hxy
    by_contra hyS
    exact hxr (hboundary x hxS y hyS hxy)
  refine ⟨{r} ∪ K, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hblockconn, hboundary, hclosure⟩
  · exact ⟨r, by simp⟩
  · obtain ⟨z, hzR, hzr⟩ := hRother
    intro hS
    have hzS : z ∈ ({r} ∪ K : Finset V) := by
      rw [hS]
      exact Finset.mem_univ z
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hzS with hzroot | hzK
    · exact hzr (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hzroot)
    · exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint hzK hzR)
  · simp
  · obtain ⟨x, hxK⟩ := hKnonempty
    refine ⟨x, Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr hxK), ?_⟩
    intro hxr
    exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint hxK (hxr ▸ hrR)).elim

name: Erdos64.common_neighbor_eq_of_no_four_cycle
statement:
theorem common_neighbor_eq_of_no_four_cycle
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (hfour : ∀ v (c : G.Walk v v), c.IsCycle → c.length ≠ 4)
    {a b u v : V} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hau : G.Adj a u) (hav : G.Adj a v)
    (hbu : G.Adj b u) (hbv : G.Adj b v) : u = v
proof:
:= by
  by_contra huv
  let q : G.Walk u v := .cons hau.symm (.cons hav .nil)
  have hq : q.IsPath := by
    apply SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.cons (SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.of_adj hav)
    simp [hau.ne.symm, huv]
  have hb : b ∉ q.support := by
    simp [q, hbu.ne, hbv.ne, hab.symm]
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hlen⟩ := endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate hq hbu hbv hb huv (by simp [q])
  exact hfour u c hc (by simpa [q] using hlen)

name: Erdos64.neighbor_edge_unique_of_degree_le_three
statement:
theorem neighbor_edge_unique_of_degree_le_three
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hfour : ∀ v (c : G.Walk v v), c.IsCycle → c.length ≠ 4)
    {u a b c d : V} (hdegree : G.degree u ≤ 3)
    (hua : G.Adj u a) (hub : G.Adj u b)
    (huc : G.Adj u c) (hud : G.Adj u d)
    (hab : G.Adj a b) (hcd : G.Adj c d) : s(a, b) = s(c, d)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hac : a = c
  · subst c
    have hbd := common_neighbor_eq_of_no_four_cycle hfour hua.ne hub hud hab hcd
    exact Sym2.eq_iff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, hbd⟩)
  by_cases had : a = d
  · subst d
    have hbc := common_neighbor_eq_of_no_four_cycle hfour hua.ne hub huc hab hcd.symm
    exact Sym2.eq_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, hbc⟩)
  by_cases hbc : b = c
  · subst c
    have had := common_neighbor_eq_of_no_four_cycle hfour hub.ne hua hud hab.symm hcd
    exact Sym2.eq_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨had, rfl⟩)
  by_cases hbd : b = d
  · subst d
    have hac := common_neighbor_eq_of_no_four_cycle hfour hub.ne hua huc hab.symm hcd.symm
    exact Sym2.eq_iff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨hac, rfl⟩)
  have hsub : ({a, b, c, d} : Finset V) ⊆ G.neighborFinset u := by
    intro w hw
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hw
    rcases hw with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
      exact (G.mem_neighborFinset _ _).mpr (by assumption)
  have hcard : ({a, b, c, d} : Finset V).card = 4 := by
    simp [hab.ne, hac, had, hbc, hbd, hcd.ne]
  have hle := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  rw [hcard, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] at hle
  omega

name: Erdos64.path_triangle_insertion_index_unique
statement:
theorem path_triangle_insertion_index_unique
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hfour : ∀ v (c : G.Walk v v), c.IsCycle → c.length ≠ 4)
    {x y u : V} (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hdegree : G.degree u ≤ 3) {i j : ℕ}
    (hi : i < p.length) (hj : j < p.length)
    (hui : G.Adj u (p.getVert i)) (hui' : G.Adj u (p.getVert (i + 1)))
    (huj : G.Adj u (p.getVert j)) (huj' : G.Adj u (p.getVert (j + 1))) :
    i = j
proof:
:= by
  have he := neighbor_edge_unique_of_degree_le_three hfour hdegree
    hui hui' huj huj' (p.adj_getVert_succ hi) (p.adj_getVert_succ hj)
  rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp he with h | h
  · exact hp.getVert_injOn (by change i ≤ p.length; omega)
      (by change j ≤ p.length; omega) h.1
  · have h₁ := hp.getVert_injOn (by change i ≤ p.length; omega)
      (by change j + 1 ≤ p.length; omega) h.1
    have h₂ := hp.getVert_injOn (by change i + 1 ≤ p.length; omega)
      (by change j ≤ p.length; omega) h.2
    omega

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.cubic_path_triangle_insertion_index_unique
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.cubic_path_triangle_insertion_index_unique
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) {x y u : V}
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath) (hcubic : G.degree u = 3)
    {i j : ℕ} (hi : i < p.length) (hj : j < p.length)
    (hui : G.Adj u (p.getVert i)) (hui' : G.Adj u (p.getVert (i + 1)))
    (huj : G.Adj u (p.getVert j)) (huj' : G.Adj u (p.getVert (j + 1))) :
    i = j
proof:
:= by
  apply path_triangle_insertion_index_unique (p := p) (hp := hp) ?_
    (by omega : G.degree u ≤ 3) hi hj hui hui' huj huj'
  intro v c hc hlen
  exact M.isCounterexample.2 ⟨2, v, c, by omega, hc, by simpa using hlen⟩

name: Erdos64.StrictRootedSideCertificate.rootedDouble_degree_order
statement:
theorem StrictRootedSideCertificate.rootedDouble_degree_order
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (side : StrictRootedSideCertificate G) :
    (∀ (b : Bool) (v : {v : (↑side.S : Set V) // v ≠ side.root}),
      3 ≤ (rootedDoubleGraph (G.induce (↑side.S : Set V)) side.root).degree
        (some (b, v))) ∧
    4 ≤ (rootedDoubleGraph (G.induce (↑side.S : Set V)) side.root).degree none ∧
    Fintype.card (RootedDoubleVertex (↑side.S : Set V) side.root) =
      2 * side.S.card - 1 ∧
    Fintype.card (RootedDoubleVertex (↑side.S : Set V) side.root) <
      Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  exact rootedDouble_degree_order_interface side.S side.root
    side.nonroot_closed side.root_internal_degree side.side_degree
    side.strict_order

name: Erdos64.not_two_same_color_exchange_edges
statement:
private theorem not_two_same_color_exchange_edges
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] {G H K : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hHG : H ≤ G) (hKG : K ≤ G) (hK : K.IsCycles)
    {v w w' : V} (hdegree : G.degree v ≤ 3)
    (hKnonempty : (K.neighborSet v).Nonempty) (hww' : w ≠ w')
    (hw : (H \ K).Adj v w) (hw' : (H \ K).Adj v w') : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hKnonempty
  obtain ⟨d, hcd, hd⟩ := hK.other_adj_of_adj hc
  have hwc : w ≠ c := by rintro rfl; exact hw.2 hc
  have hwd : w ≠ d := by rintro rfl; exact hw.2 hd
  have hw'c : w' ≠ c := by rintro rfl; exact hw'.2 hc
  have hw'd : w' ≠ d := by rintro rfl; exact hw'.2 hd
  have hsub : ({w, w', c, d} : Finset V) ⊆ G.neighborFinset v := by
    intro z hz
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hz
    apply (G.mem_neighborFinset v z).mpr
    rcases hz with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact hHG hw.1
    · exact hHG hw'.1
    · exact hKG hc
    · exact hKG hd
  have hcard : ({w, w', c, d} : Finset V).card = 4 := by
    simp [hww', hwc, hwd, hw'c, hw'd, hcd]
  have hle := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  rw [hcard, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] at hle
  omega

name: Erdos64.cycle_exchange_alternates_at_common_support
statement:
theorem cycle_exchange_alternates_at_common_support
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] {G H K : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hHG : H ≤ G) (hKG : K ≤ G) (hH : H.IsCycles) (hK : K.IsCycles)
    {v w w' : V} (hdegree : G.degree v ≤ 3)
    (hagree : (H.neighborSet v).Nonempty ↔ (K.neighborSet v).Nonempty)
    (hww' : w ≠ w') (hw : (H ∆ K).Adj v w) (hw' : (H ∆ K).Adj v w') :
    H.Adj v w ↔ ¬H.Adj v w'
proof:
:= by
  change (H.Adj v w ∧ ¬K.Adj v w) ∨ (K.Adj v w ∧ ¬H.Adj v w) at hw
  change (H.Adj v w' ∧ ¬K.Adj v w') ∨ (K.Adj v w' ∧ ¬H.Adj v w') at hw'
  constructor
  · intro hvw hvw'
    have h₁ : (H \ K).Adj v w := by tauto
    have h₂ : (H \ K).Adj v w' := by tauto
    exact not_two_same_color_exchange_edges hHG hKG hK hdegree
      (hagree.mp ⟨w, hvw⟩) hww' h₁ h₂
  · intro hvw'
    by_contra hvw
    have h₁ : (K \ H).Adj v w := by tauto
    have h₂ : (K \ H).Adj v w' := by tauto
    exact not_two_same_color_exchange_edges hKG hHG hH hdegree
      (hagree.mpr ⟨w, h₁.1⟩) hww' h₁ h₂

name: Erdos64.cycle_exchange_triangle_has_support_defect
statement:
theorem cycle_exchange_triangle_has_support_defect
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] {H K : SimpleGraph V}
    (hH : H.IsCycles) (hK : K.IsCycles)
    (hdegree : ∀ v, (H ⊔ K).degree v ≤ 3)
    {x y z : V} (hxy : (H ∆ K).Adj x y) (hyz : (H ∆ K).Adj y z)
    (hzx : (H ∆ K).Adj z x) :
    ¬((H.neighborSet x).Nonempty ↔ (K.neighborSet x).Nonempty) ∨
      ¬((H.neighborSet y).Nonempty ↔ (K.neighborSet y).Nonempty) ∨
      ¬((H.neighborSet z).Nonempty ↔ (K.neighborSet z).Nonempty)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  have hx := cycle_exchange_alternates_at_common_support
    (G := H ⊔ K) (H := H) (K := K) le_sup_left le_sup_right hH hK
    (hdegree x) h.1 hyz.ne hxy hzx.symm
  have hy := cycle_exchange_alternates_at_common_support
    (G := H ⊔ K) (H := H) (K := K) le_sup_left le_sup_right hH hK
    (hdegree y) h.2.1 hzx.ne.symm hxy.symm hyz
  have hz := cycle_exchange_alternates_at_common_support
    (G := H ⊔ K) (H := H) (K := K) le_sup_left le_sup_right hH hK
    (hdegree z) h.2.2 hxy.ne.symm hyz.symm hzx
  rw [H.adj_comm y x] at hy
  rw [H.adj_comm z y, H.adj_comm z x] at hz
  tauto

name: Erdos64.cycle_exchange_no_triangles_of_support_defects
statement:
theorem cycle_exchange_no_triangles_of_support_defects
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] {G H K : SimpleGraph V}
    (hHG : H ≤ G) (hKG : K ≤ G) (hH : H.IsCycles) (hK : K.IsCycles)
    (hdegree : ∀ v, (H ⊔ K).degree v ≤ 3)
    (hdefect : ∀ v, ¬((H.neighborSet v).Nonempty ↔ (K.neighborSet v).Nonempty) →
      ∀ a b, G.Adj v a → G.Adj a b → G.Adj b v → False)
    {v : V} (p : (H ∆ K).Walk v v) (_hp : p.IsCycle) : p.length ≠ 3
proof:
:= by
  intro hlen
  have hxy : (H ∆ K).Adj v (p.getVert 1) := by
    simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_zero] using
      p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega : 0 < p.length)
  have hyz : (H ∆ K).Adj (p.getVert 1) (p.getVert 2) :=
    p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega : 1 < p.length)
  have hzx : (H ∆ K).Adj (p.getVert 2) v := by
    have h := p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega : 2 < p.length)
    change (H ∆ K).Adj (p.getVert 2) (p.getVert 3) at h
    rw [← hlen, SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_length] at h
    exact h
  have hle : H ∆ K ≤ G := symmDiff_le_sup.trans (sup_le hHG hKG)
  rcases cycle_exchange_triangle_has_support_defect hH hK hdegree hxy hyz hzx with
    hx | hy | hz
  · exact hdefect v hx _ _ (hle hxy) (hle hyz) (hle hzx)
  · exact hdefect (p.getVert 1) hy _ _ (hle hyz) (hle hzx) (hle hxy)
  · exact hdefect (p.getVert 2) hz _ _ (hle hzx) (hle hxy) (hle hyz)

name: Erdos64.hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_eight_edge_exchange_triangle_free_defects
statement:
theorem hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_eight_edge_exchange_triangle_free_defects
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] {G H K : SimpleGraph V}
    (hHG : H ≤ G) (hKG : K ≤ G) (hH : H.IsCycles) (hK : K.IsCycles)
    (hdegree : ∀ v, (H ⊔ K).degree v ≤ 3)
    (hedges : (H ∆ K).edgeFinset.card = 8)
    (hdefect : ∀ v, ¬((H.neighborSet v).Nonempty ↔ (K.neighborSet v).Nonempty) →
      ∀ a b, G.Adj v a → G.Adj a b → G.Adj b v → False) :
    HasPowerOfTwoCycle G
proof:
:= by
  exact hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_eight_edge_cycle_exchange hHG hKG hH hK hdegree hedges
    (cycle_exchange_no_triangles_of_support_defects hHG hKG hH hK hdegree hdefect)

name: Erdos64.hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_eight_edge_exchange_same_support
statement:
theorem hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_eight_edge_exchange_same_support
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] {G H K : SimpleGraph V}
    (hHG : H ≤ G) (hKG : K ≤ G) (hH : H.IsCycles) (hK : K.IsCycles)
    (hdegree : ∀ v, (H ⊔ K).degree v ≤ 3)
    (hedges : (H ∆ K).edgeFinset.card = 8)
    (hagree : ∀ v, (H.neighborSet v).Nonempty ↔ (K.neighborSet v).Nonempty) :
    HasPowerOfTwoCycle G
proof:
:= by
  apply hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_eight_edge_exchange_triangle_free_defects
    hHG hKG hH hK hdegree hedges
  intro v hv
  exact (hv (hagree v)).elim

name: Erdos64.mem_offPathComponentCarrier_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_offPathComponentCarrier_iff
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (A : Finset V) {x y : V} (p : G.Walk x y)
    (E : (G.induce {v : V | v ∈ A ∧ v ∉ p.support}).ConnectedComponent) (v : V) :
    v ∈ offPathComponentCarrier G A p E ↔
      ∃ hv : v ∈ A ∧ v ∉ p.support,
        (⟨v, hv⟩ : {w : V // w ∈ A ∧ w ∉ p.support}) ∈ E.supp
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [offPathComponentCarrier]

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_side_component_dyadic_ear
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_side_component_dyadic_ear
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (p : G.Walk x y)
    (hinside : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (E : (G.induce {v : V | v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      v ∉ p.support}).ConnectedComponent) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : V, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      1 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ p.support ∧ b ∈ p.support ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      ear.IsPath ∧ ear.length = 2 ^ k ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v = a ∨ v = b ∨
        v ∈ offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ p.support → v = a ∨ v = b) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
  let A := rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C
  let K := offPathComponentCarrier G A p E
  have hKdata : ∀ v, v ∈ K → v ∈ A ∧ v ∉ p.support := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨hv, _⟩ := (mem_offPathComponentCarrier_iff G A p E v).mp hv
    exact hv
  have hK : K.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, hvE⟩ := E.nonempty_supp
    exact ⟨v, (mem_offPathComponentCarrier_iff G A p E v).mpr ⟨hv, hvE⟩⟩
  have hcard : (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card = 2 :=
    (M.rootDeleted_two_components_exact_balanced r C D hCD).2.2.1
  have hxA : x ∈ A := hinside x p.start_mem_support
  have hyA : y ∈ A := hinside y p.end_mem_support
  have hpair : ({x, y} : Finset V) = rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C := by
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
    · intro a ha
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at ha
      rcases ha with hax | hay
      · subst a
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(G.mem_neighborFinset r x).mpr hrx, hxA⟩
      · subst a
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(G.mem_neighborFinset r y).mpr hry, hyA⟩
    · simp [hcard, hxy]
  have hports : ∀ v, v ∈ A → G.Adj v r → v ∈ p.support := by
    intro v hv hvr
    have hvB : v ∈ rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C :=
      Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(G.mem_neighborFinset r v).mpr hvr.symm, hv⟩
    rw [← hpair] at hvB
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hvB with h | h
    · simpa only [h] using p.start_mem_support
    · have h : v = y := Finset.mem_singleton.mp h
      simpa only [h] using p.end_mem_support
  have hboundary : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj v w → w ∈ p.support := by
    intro v hv w hw hvw
    by_contra hwp
    obtain ⟨hvA, hvp⟩ := hKdata v hv
    have hwA : w ∈ A := by
      rcases (rootDeletedComponent_boundary r M.isConnected C).1 v hvA w hvw with
        hwA | hwr
      · exact hwA
      · have hvr : G.Adj v r := hwr ▸ hvw
        exact (hvp (hports v hvA hvr)).elim
    obtain ⟨hv', hvE⟩ := (mem_offPathComponentCarrier_iff G A p E v).mp hv
    have hEadj : (G.induce {z : V | z ∈ A ∧ z ∉ p.support}).Adj
        ⟨v, hv'⟩ ⟨w, ⟨hwA, hwp⟩⟩ := hvw
    exact hw ((mem_offPathComponentCarrier_iff G A p E w).mpr
      ⟨⟨hwA, hwp⟩, E.mem_supp_of_adj_mem_supp hvE hEadj⟩)
  have hKlt : K.card < A.card := by
    apply Finset.card_lt_card
    apply Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr
    refine ⟨fun v hv => (hKdata v hv).1, ?_⟩
    intro hKA
    have hxK : x ∈ K := hKA.symm ▸ hxA
    exact (hKdata x hxK).2 p.start_mem_support
  have horder := M.rootDeleted_two_components_order r C D hCD
  have hsize : 2 * K.card + 1 < Fintype.card V := by
    change 2 * A.card + 1 = Fintype.card V at horder
    omega
  obtain ⟨k, a, b, ear, hk, ha, hb, hab, hear, hlen, hsupport, hfresh⟩ :=
    M.small_carrier_dyadic_ear K {v | v ∈ p.support} hK
      (fun v hv => (hKdata v hv).2) hboundary hsize
  refine ⟨k, a, b, ear, hk, ha, hb, hab, hear, hlen, hsupport, hfresh, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  rcases hsupport v hv with hva | hvb | hvK
  · subst v
    exact hinside a ha
  · subst v
    exact hinside b hb
  · exact (hKdata v hvK).1

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_side_dyadic_ear_of_external_vertex
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_side_dyadic_ear_of_external_vertex
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (p : G.Walk x y)
    (hinside : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (w : V) (hw : w ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) (hwp : w ∉ p.support) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : V, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      1 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ p.support ∧ b ∈ p.support ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      ear.IsPath ∧ ear.length = 2 ^ k ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ p.support → v = a ∨ v = b) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
proof:
:= by
  let E := (G.induce {v : V | v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
    v ∉ p.support}).connectedComponentMk ⟨w, ⟨hw, hwp⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨k, a, b, ear, hk, ha, hb, hab, hear, hlen, _, hfresh, hside⟩ :=
    M.rootDeleted_cut_side_component_dyadic_ear r C D hCD hxy hrx hry p hinside E
  exact ⟨k, a, b, ear, hk, ha, hb, hab, hear, hlen, hfresh, hside⟩

name: Erdos64.SimpleGraph.Walk.exists_cycle_of_positive_marked_root_path
statement:
theorem exists_cycle_of_positive_marked_root_path
    {r a b : V} {q : G.Walk a b}
    (hq : q.IsPath)
    (hroot : r ∉ q.support)
    (hra : G.Adj r a)
    (hrb : G.Adj r b)
    (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hpositive : 0 < q.length) :
    ∃ c : G.Walk a a, c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = q.length + 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hlong : 1 < q.length
  · obtain ⟨c, hc, hlen⟩ := endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate
      hq hra hrb hroot hab hlong
    exact ⟨c, hc, hlen⟩
  · have hlen : q.length = 1 := by omega
    cases q with
    | nil => simp at hpositive
    | cons h p =>
      cases p with
      | nil =>
        have hra_ne : r ≠ a := by
          intro hra_eq
          apply hroot
          simpa [hra_eq]
        have hrb_ne : r ≠ b := by
          intro hrb_eq
          apply hroot
          simpa [hrb_eq]
        refine ⟨SimpleGraph.Walk.cons h
          (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hrb.symm (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hra
            SimpleGraph.Walk.nil)), ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isCycle_iff]
          constructor
          · apply (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff hrb.symm _).2
            refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
            · apply (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff hra _).2
              exact ⟨SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.nil, by simp [hra_ne]⟩
            · intro hb
              simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons,
                SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil, List.mem_cons,
                List.mem_singleton] at hb
              rcases hb with rfl | rfl | hb
              · exact hrb_ne rfl
              · exact hab rfl
              · simp at hb
          · intro hedge
            simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.edges_cons,
              SimpleGraph.Walk.edges_nil, List.mem_cons] at hedge
            simp only [Sym2.eq_iff] at hedge
            rcases hedge with h₁ | h₂ | h₃
            · rcases h₁ with h₁ | h₁
              · exact hab h₁.1
              · exact hra_ne h₁.1.symm
            · rcases h₂ with h₂ | h₂
              · exact hra_ne h₂.1.symm
              · exact hrb_ne h₂.2.symm
            · simp at h₃
        · simp [hlen]
      | cons h₂ p₂ =>
        simp at hlen

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.connectedOnePortCarrier_internalDegree_le_two
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.connectedOnePortCarrier_internalDegree_le_two
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (K : Finset V) (root : V)
    (hKconn : (G.induce (↑K : Set V)).Connected)
    (hKnonempty : K.Nonempty)
    (hKproper : K ≠ (Finset.univ : Finset V))
    (hroot : root ∈ K)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ x, x ∈ K → ∀ y, y ∉ K → G.Adj x y → x = root) :
    internalDegree G K root ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  exact leafBlock_articulation_internalDegree_le_two K root hKconn
    hKnonempty hKproper hroot hboundary
    (fun v _ _ => degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G
      M.isCounterexample.1 v)
    M.isSubgraphCritical

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.connectedOnePortCarrier_cubic_port_degree_split
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.connectedOnePortCarrier_cubic_port_degree_split
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (K : Finset V) (root : V)
    (hKconn : (G.induce (↑K : Set V)).Connected)
    (hKnonempty : K.Nonempty)
    (hKproper : K ≠ (Finset.univ : Finset V))
    (hroot : root ∈ K)
    (hnonroot : ∃ x, x ∈ K ∧ x ≠ root)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ x, x ∈ K → ∀ y, y ∉ K → G.Adj x y → x = root)
    (hdegree : G.degree root = 3) :
    1 ≤ (K.filter (G.Adj root)).card ∧
      (K.filter (G.Adj root)).card ≤ 2 ∧
      1 ≤ internalDegree G (Finset.univ \ K.erase root) root ∧
      internalDegree G (Finset.univ \ K.erase root) root ≤ 2 ∧
      internalDegree G (Finset.univ \ K.erase root) root +
          (K.filter (G.Adj root)).card = 3
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B := rootedBranchCarrier_of_onePort K root hnonroot hboundary
  have hcarrier_defect : internalDegree G K root ≤ 2 :=
    M.connectedOnePortCarrier_internalDegree_le_two K root hKconn
      hKnonempty hKproper hroot hboundary
  have hsum := B.internalDegree_add_carrierNeighbor_card_eq_degree
  have hfilter :
      (K.erase root).filter (G.Adj root) = K.filter (G.Adj root) := by
    ext x
    by_cases hx : x = root
    · subst x
      simp
    · simp [hx]
  have hsum' :
      internalDegree G (Finset.univ \ K.erase root) root +
          (K.filter (G.Adj root)).card = 3 := by
    change internalDegree G (Finset.univ \ K.erase root) root +
        ((K.erase root).filter (G.Adj root)).card = G.degree root at hsum
    rw [hfilter, hdegree] at hsum
    exact hsum
  have hcomplement_defect :
      internalDegree G (Finset.univ \ K.erase root) root ≤ 2 :=
    by
      exact B.root_internalDegree_le_two M.isSubgraphCritical
        M.isCounterexample.1
  have hcarrier_eq : internalDegree G K root =
      (K.filter (G.Adj root)).card := rfl
  omega

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.connectedOnePortCarrier_complement_minDegree_le_two
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.connectedOnePortCarrier_complement_minDegree_le_two
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (K : Finset V) (root : V)
    (hnonroot : ∃ x, x ∈ K ∧ x ≠ root)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ x, x ∈ K → ∀ y, y ∉ K → G.Adj x y → x = root) :
    (G.induce (↑(Finset.univ \ K.erase root) : Set V)).minDegree ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B := rootedBranchCarrier_of_onePort K root hnonroot hboundary
  let vr : (↑(Finset.univ \ K.erase root) : Set V) :=
    ⟨root, Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_univ root, by simp⟩⟩
  have hroot_degree :
      (G.induce (↑(Finset.univ \ K.erase root) : Set V)).degree vr ≤ 2 := by
    rw [degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree G vr]
    exact B.root_internalDegree_le_two M.isSubgraphCritical
      M.isCounterexample.1
  exact le_trans
    ((G.induce (↑(Finset.univ \ K.erase root) : Set V)).minDegree_le_degree vr)
    hroot_degree

name: Erdos64.terminalQuotient_minDegree_ge_three_of_common_degree_ge_four
statement:
theorem terminalQuotient_minDegree_ge_three_of_common_degree_ge_four
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] {a b : V}
    (hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3) (_hab : a ≠ b) (hnadj : ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hcommon4 : ∀ z, z ≠ a → z ≠ b →
      (G.Adj a z ∧ G.Adj b z) → 4 ≤ G.degree z) :
    (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).minDegree ≥ 3
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : DecidableRel (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Adj :=
    quotient_decidableRel G a b
  letI : Nonempty (QuotientVertex a b) := ⟨none⟩
  apply SimpleGraph.le_minDegree_of_forall_le_degree
    (terminalQuotientGraph G a b) 3
  intro q
  cases q with
  | none =>
      rw [quotient_root_degree]
      let T := {v : V // v ≠ a ∧ v ≠ b ∧ (G.Adj a v ∨ G.Adj b v)}
      let f : G.neighborSet a → T := fun x =>
        ⟨x.1, by
          have hax : G.Adj a x.1 := (G.mem_neighborSet a x.1).mp x.2
          have hxa : x.1 ≠ a := by
            intro h
            exact G.loopless.irrefl a (by simpa [h] using hax)
          have hxb : x.1 ≠ b := by
            intro h
            exact hnadj (by simpa [h] using hax)
          exact ⟨hxa, hxb, Or.inl hax⟩⟩
      have hf : Function.Injective f := by
        intro x y hxy
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact congrArg (fun z : T => z.1) hxy
      have hcard : Fintype.card (G.neighborSet a) ≤ Fintype.card T :=
        Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf
      rw [SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree] at hcard
      exact (degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hmin a).trans hcard
  | some v =>
      let fFull : G.neighborSet v.1 →
          (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).neighborSet (some v) := fun x =>
        if hx : x.1 = a ∨ x.1 = b then
          ⟨none, by
            rcases hx with hxa | hxb
            · exact Or.inl (by simpa [hxa] using x.2)
            · exact Or.inr (by simpa [hxb] using x.2)⟩
        else
          ⟨some ⟨x.1, by
            exact ⟨fun h => hx (Or.inl h), fun h => hx (Or.inr h)⟩⟩,
            x.2⟩
      have hfFull : ∀ hnot : ¬ (G.Adj a v.1 ∧ G.Adj b v.1),
          Function.Injective fFull := by
        intro hnot x y hxy
        by_cases hx : x.1 = a ∨ x.1 = b
        · by_cases hy : y.1 = a ∨ y.1 = b
          · rcases hx with hxa | hxb <;> rcases hy with hya | hyb
            · apply Subtype.ext
              exact hxa.trans hya.symm
            · exfalso
              apply hnot
              have hax : G.Adj a v.1 := by
                simpa [hxa] using x.2.symm
              have hby : G.Adj b v.1 := by
                simpa [hyb] using y.2.symm
              exact ⟨hax, hby⟩
            · exfalso
              apply hnot
              have hay : G.Adj a v.1 := by
                simpa [hya] using y.2.symm
              have hbx : G.Adj b v.1 := by
                simpa [hxb] using x.2.symm
              exact ⟨hay, hbx⟩
            · apply Subtype.ext
              exact hxb.trans hyb.symm
          · have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
            simp [fFull, hx, hy] at hval
        · by_cases hy : y.1 = a ∨ y.1 = b
          · have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
            simp [fFull, hx, hy] at hval
          · have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
            simp [fFull, hx, hy] at hval
            apply Subtype.ext
            exact hval
      have hdeg : 3 ≤ G.degree v.1 :=
        degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hmin v.1
      have hcardN : Fintype.card (G.neighborSet v.1) = G.degree v.1 :=
        SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree G v.1
      by_cases hboth : G.Adj v.1 a ∧ G.Adj v.1 b
      · let S := {x : G.neighborSet v.1 // x.1 ≠ a}
        let f : S → (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).neighborSet (some v) :=
          fun x =>
            if hx : x.1.1 = a ∨ x.1.1 = b then
              ⟨none, by
                rcases hx with hxa | hxb
                · exact Or.inl (by simpa [hxa] using x.1.2)
                · exact Or.inr (by simpa [hxb] using x.1.2)⟩
            else
              ⟨some ⟨x.1.1, by
                exact ⟨fun h => hx (Or.inl h), fun h => hx (Or.inr h)⟩⟩,
                x.1.2⟩
        have hf : Function.Injective f := by
          intro x y hxy
          by_cases hx : x.1.1 = b
          · by_cases hy : y.1.1 = b
            · apply Subtype.ext
              apply Subtype.ext
              exact hx.trans hy.symm
            · have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
              exfalso
              simpa [f, hx, hy, x.2, y.2] using hval
          · by_cases hy : y.1.1 = b
            · have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
              exfalso
              simpa [f, hx, hy, x.2, y.2] using hval
            · have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
              simp [f, hx, hy, x.2, y.2] at hval
              apply Subtype.ext
              apply Subtype.ext
              exact hval
        have hcardS : Fintype.card S ≤
            Fintype.card ((terminalQuotientGraph G a b).neighborSet (some v)) :=
          Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf
        rw [SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree] at hcardS
        have hcardS_eq : Fintype.card S =
            Fintype.card (G.neighborSet v.1) -
              Fintype.card {x : G.neighborSet v.1 // x.1 = a} := by
          simpa [S] using
            (Fintype.card_subtype_compl
              (fun x : G.neighborSet v.1 => x.1 = a))
        have hcardA : Fintype.card {x : G.neighborSet v.1 // x.1 = a} = 1 := by
          apply (Fintype.card_eq_one_iff.mpr)
          refine ⟨⟨⟨a, (G.mem_neighborSet v.1 a).mpr hboth.1⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
          intro x
          apply Subtype.ext
          apply Subtype.ext
          exact x.2
        rw [hcardS_eq, hcardA, hcardN] at hcardS
        have hhigh : 4 ≤ G.degree v.1 := by
          apply hcommon4 v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2
          exact ⟨hboth.1.symm, hboth.2.symm⟩
        omega
      · have hnot : ¬ (G.Adj a v.1 ∧ G.Adj b v.1) := by
          intro h
          exact hboth ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.symm⟩
        have hcardFull : Fintype.card (G.neighborSet v.1) ≤
            Fintype.card ((terminalQuotientGraph G a b).neighborSet (some v)) :=
          Fintype.card_le_of_injective fFull (hfFull hnot)
        rw [SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree] at hcardFull
        have hqdeg :
            Fintype.card ((terminalQuotientGraph G a b).neighborSet (some v)) =
              (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).degree (some v) :=
          SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree _ _
        rw [hqdeg] at hcardFull
        exact hdeg.trans hcardFull

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.terminalQuotient_hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_common_degree_ge_four
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.terminalQuotient_hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_common_degree_ge_four
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) {a b : V}
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hnadj : ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hcommon4 : ∀ z, z ≠ a → z ≠ b →
      (G.Adj a z ∧ G.Adj b z) → 4 ≤ G.degree z) :
    HasPowerOfTwoCycle (terminalQuotientGraph G a b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : DecidableRel (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Adj :=
    quotient_decidableRel G a b
  by_contra hno
  have hsmall :
      IsStrictlySmallerCounterexample G (terminalQuotientGraph G a b) := by
    refine ⟨⟨terminalQuotient_minDegree_ge_three_of_common_degree_ge_four
        M.isCounterexample.1 hab hnadj hcommon4, hno⟩, ?_⟩
    exact terminalQuotient_card_lt hab
  exact M.not_exists_strictly_smaller hsmall

proof:
:= by

  have hnil : ¬ K.path.Nil := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length]
    rcases hK with hK | hK <;> omega
  have hnodup := K.isPath.support_nodup

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.two_twoPort_sides_balanced
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.two_twoPort_sides_balanced
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D E : Finset V) (r : V)
    (xD yD xE yE : V)
    (hrD : r ∉ D) (hrE : r ∉ E)
    (hdisj : Disjoint D E)
    (hcover : insert r (D ∪ E) = Finset.univ)
    (hboundaryD :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hboundaryE :
      ∀ v, v ∈ E → ∀ w, w ∉ E → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hportsD :
      xD ∈ D ∧ yD ∈ D ∧ xD ≠ yD ∧ G.Adj r xD ∧ G.Adj r yD)
    (hportsE :
      xE ∈ E ∧ yE ∈ E ∧ xE ≠ yE ∧ G.Adj r xE ∧ G.Adj r yE) :
    D.card = E.card
proof:
:= by
  have hDbound := M.two_port_side_card_bound D r xD yD hrD hportsD hboundaryD
  have hEbound := M.two_port_side_card_bound E r xE yE hrE hportsE hboundaryE
  have hrU : r ∉ D ∪ E := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_union, not_or]
    exact ⟨hrD, hrE⟩
  have hcard : (insert r (D ∪ E)).card = D.card + E.card + 1 := by
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hrU,
      Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj]
  have htotal : Fintype.card V = D.card + E.card + 1 := by
    calc
      Fintype.card V = (Finset.univ : Finset V).card :=
        (Finset.card_univ).symm
      _ = (insert r (D ∪ E)).card := by rw [hcover]
      _ = D.card + E.card + 1 := hcard
  omega

statement:
private theorem connector03_snd_ne_a0
    (H : PentagramEarHull G) (K : Connector H 0 3) :
    K.path.snd ≠ aVertex H 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hnil : ¬ K.path.Nil := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length]
    rcases K.length_one_to_three with hlen | hlen | hlen <;> omega
  have hne : K.path.snd ≠ bVertex H 3 := by
    intro he
    have hi := H.vertex_injective (h.symm.trans he)
    simp at hi
  have hinter := connector03_tail_interior H K
    (K.path.snd_mem_tail_support hnil) hne
  apply K.interior_disjoint _ hinter
  rw [h]
  exact Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨0, rfl⟩)

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.connector03_route_disjoint
statement:
private theorem connector03_route_disjoint
    (H : PentagramEarHull G) (K : Connector H 0 3)
    (route : G.Walk (bVertex H 0) (bVertex H 3))
    (hroute : route.IsPath)
    (hsupp : ∀ v, v ∈ route.support → v ∈ hull H) :
    (K.path.take K.path.length).support.tail.Disjoint
      (route.take route.length).reverse.support.tail
proof:
:= by
  have hend : bVertex H 3 ∉ route.reverse.support.tail := by
    have hnodup : (bVertex H 3 :: route.reverse.support.tail).Nodup := by
      rw [route.reverse.cons_tail_support]
      exact hroute.reverse.support_nodup
    exact (List.nodup_cons.mp hnodup).1
  rw [K.path.take_of_length_le (Nat.le_refl _),
    route.take_of_length_le (Nat.le_refl _)]
  simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_copy]
  apply List.disjoint_left.2
  intro v hvK hvR
  have hvR0 : v ∈ route.reverse.support.tail := by
    simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_reverse,
      SimpleGraph.Walk.support_copy] using hvR
  have hv3 : v ≠ bVertex H 3 := by
    intro hv
    exact hend (hv ▸ hvR0)
  have hvroute : v ∈ route.support := by
    simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_reverse, List.mem_reverse] using
      (List.mem_of_mem_tail hvR0)
  exact K.interior_disjoint v
    (connector03_tail_interior H K hvK hv3) (hsupp v hvroute)

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.cycle8_of_connector_03_length_one
statement:
theorem cycle8_of_connector_03_length_one
    (H : PentagramEarHull G) (K : Connector H 0 3)
    (hK : K.path.length = 1) :
    ∃ c : G.Walk (bVertex H 0) (bVertex H 0),
      c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = 8
proof:
:= by
  exact cycle8_of_hull_return H 0 3 K
    (hullReturn_of_connector_03_length_one H K hK)

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.cycle8_of_connector_03_length_two
statement:
theorem cycle8_of_connector_03_length_two
    (H : PentagramEarHull G) (K : Connector H 0 3)

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.connector_length_three_interior
statement:
private theorem connector_length_three_interior
    (H : PentagramEarHull G) (K : Connector H 0 1)
    (hK : K.path.length = 3) {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ K.path.support.tail) (hv1 : v ≠ bVertex H 1) :
    v ∈ K.path.support.tail.dropLast
proof:
:= by
  apply List.mem_dropLast_of_mem_of_ne_getLast hv
  grind [K.path.length_support, K.path.getLast_support]

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.connector_length_three_not_first_hull
statement:
private theorem connector_length_three_not_first_hull
    (H : PentagramEarHull G) (K : Connector H 0 1)
    (hK : K.path.length = 3) :
    K.path.snd ≠ aVertex H 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hnil : ¬ K.path.Nil := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length]
    omega
  have hnodup := K.isPath.support_nodup
  have h1 : 1 < K.path.support.length := by
    simp [K.path.length_support, hK]
  have h3 : 3 < K.path.support.length := by
    simp [K.path.length_support, hK]
  have hne_b : K.path.snd ≠ bVertex H 1 := by
    intro hb
    have heq : K.path.support[1]'h1 = K.path.support[3]'h3 := by
      rw [← K.path.snd_eq_support_getElem_one hnil]
      have hlast : K.path.support[3]'h3 = bVertex H 1 := by
        simpa [hK] using K.path.support_getElem_length
      exact hb.trans hlast.symm
    have hidx := (List.Nodup.getElem_inj_iff hnodup).mp heq
    omega
  have hsnd : K.path.snd ∈ K.path.support.tail := K.path.snd_mem_tail_support hnil
  have hinter : K.path.snd ∈ K.path.support.tail.dropLast :=
    connector_length_three_interior H K hK hsnd hne_b
  exact K.interior_disjoint _ hinter (by
    rw [h]
    exact Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨0, rfl⟩))

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.cycle8_of_connector_01_length_three
statement:
theorem cycle8_of_connector_01_length_three

    ∃ c : G.Walk (bVertex H 0) (bVertex H 0),
      c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = 8
proof:
:= by
  exact cycle8_of_hull_return H 0 1 K
    (hullReturn_of_connector_01_length_three H K hK)

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.small_carrier_dyadic_ear_avoiding_unique_attachment
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.small_carrier_dyadic_ear_avoiding_unique_attachment
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (K : Finset V) (S : Set V)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ v, v ∈ K → v ∉ S)
    (hboundary : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj v w → w ∈ S)
    (hB : 4 ≤ (carrierBoundaryVertices G K).card)
    (hsize : 2 * K.card + 1 < Fintype.card V)
    (t : {v : V // v ∈ K}) (s : V) (hs : s ∈ S)
    (hunique : ∀ v, v ∈ K → G.Adj v s → v = t.1) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : V, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      1 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ S ∧ b ∈ S ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      ear.IsPath ∧ ear.length = 2 ^ k ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v = a ∨ v = b ∨ v ∈ K) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ S → v = a ∨ v = b) ∧
      s ∉ ear.support
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsK : s ∉ K := fun h => hdisjoint s h hs
  have hne : ∀ v, v ∈ K → v ≠ s := by
    intro v hv hvs
    exact hsK (hvs ▸ hv)
  let L := G.deleteIncidenceSet s
  have hLadj : ∀ {v w}, L.Adj v w ↔ G.Adj v w ∧ v ≠ s ∧ w ≠ s :=
    fun {_ _} => SimpleGraph.deleteIncidenceSet_adj
  have hle : L ≤ G := G.deleteIncidenceSet_le s
  by_cases htwo : ∃ v ∈ K, ∃ a, a ∉ K ∧ ∃ b, b ∉ K ∧
      a ≠ b ∧ L.Adj v a ∧ L.Adj v b
  · obtain ⟨v, hv, a, haK, b, hbK, hab, hva, hvb⟩ := htwo
    have hva' := (hLadj.mp hva).1
    have hvb' := (hLadj.mp hvb).1
    let ear : G.Walk a b := .cons hva'.symm (.cons hvb' .nil)
    have hear : ear.IsPath := by
      apply SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.cons
      · exact SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.of_adj hvb'
      · simp [hva'.ne.symm, hab]
    have hsupport : ∀ w, w ∈ ear.support → w = a ∨ w = b ∨ w ∈ K := by
      intro w hw
      simp only [ear, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil,
        List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hw
      rcases hw with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr hv)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
    refine ⟨1, a, b, ear, by omega, hboundary v hv a haK hva',
      hboundary v hv b hbK hvb', hab, hear, rfl, hsupport, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro w hw hwS
      rcases hsupport w hw with h | h | h
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr h
      · exact (hdisjoint w h hwS).elim
    · intro h
      rcases hsupport s h with h | h | h
      · exact (hLadj.mp hva).2.2 h.symm
      · exact (hLadj.mp hvb).2.2 h.symm
      · exact hsK h
  have hsingle : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ a, a ∉ K → ∀ b, b ∉ K →
      L.Adj v a → L.Adj v b → a = b := by
    intro v hv a ha b hb hva hvb
    by_contra hab
    exact htwo ⟨v, hv, a, ha, b, hb, hab, hva, hvb⟩
  have hneighbors : ∀ v, v ∈ K →
      L.neighborFinset v = (G.neighborFinset v).erase s := by
    intro v hv
    ext w
    simp [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, hLadj, hne v hv, and_comm]
  have htdegree : 2 ≤ L.degree t.1 := by
    have hmin := degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G M.isCounterexample.1 t.1
    rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hneighbors t.1 t.2]
    by_cases hst : s ∈ G.neighborFinset t.1
    · rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hst, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
      omega
    · rw [Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem hst, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
      omega
  have hothers : ∀ v, v ∈ K → v ≠ t.1 → 3 ≤ L.degree v := by
    intro v hv hvt
    have hnot : s ∉ G.neighborFinset v := by
      intro h
      exact hvt (hunique v hv ((G.mem_neighborFinset v s).mp h))
    rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hneighbors v hv,
      Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem hnot, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
    exact degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G M.isCounterexample.1 v
  let B := carrierBoundaryVertices L K
  have hBsub : (carrierBoundaryVertices G K).erase t ⊆ B := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨hvt, hvB⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hv
    obtain ⟨w, hwK, hvw⟩ := (mem_carrierBoundaryVertices G K v).mp hvB
    have hws : w ≠ s := by
      intro h
      subst w
      exact hvt (Subtype.ext (hunique v.1 v.2 hvw))
    exact (mem_carrierBoundaryVertices L K v).mpr
      ⟨w, hwK, hLadj.mpr ⟨hvw, hne v.1 v.2, hws⟩⟩
  have hBthree : 3 ≤ B.card := by
    have hc := Finset.card_le_card hBsub
    by_cases htB : t ∈ carrierBoundaryVertices G K
    · rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem htB] at hc
      omega
    · rw [Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem htB] at hc
      omega
  let H := L.induce (↑K : Set V)
  let R := boundaryRootGraph H B
  have hdegree : ∀ v, R.degree (some v) = L.degree v.1 := by
    intro v
    rw [boundaryRootGraph_degree_some]
    exact carrier_degree_add_boundary_indicator K hsingle v
  have htroot : 2 ≤ R.degree (some t) := by
    rw [hdegree]
    exact htdegree
  have hrest : ∀ v, v ≠ some t → 3 ≤ R.degree v := by
    intro v hv
    cases v with
    | none =>
      rw [boundaryRootGraph_degree_none]
      exact hBthree
    | some v =>
      rw [hdegree]
      exact hothers v.1 v.2 (fun h => hv (congrArg some (Subtype.ext h)))
  have horder : 2 * Fintype.card (Option (↑K : Set V)) - 1 < Fintype.card V := by
    simpa using (show 2 * (K.card + 1) - 1 < Fintype.card V by omega)
  have hyes := M.one_defect_small_has_dyadic_cycle (some t) htroot hrest horder
  let e : H →g G :=
    { toFun := Subtype.val
      map_rel' := fun h => hle h }
  have hno : ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle H := by
    rintro ⟨k, v, c, hk, hc, hlen⟩
    exact M.isCounterexample.2 ⟨k, e v, c.map e, hk,
      hc.map Subtype.val_injective, by simpa using hlen⟩
  obtain ⟨k, a, b, q, hk, ha, hb, hab, hq, hlen⟩ :=
    boundaryRoot_dyadic_cycle_path B hno hyes
  obtain ⟨aOut, haOut, haaL⟩ := (mem_carrierBoundaryVertices L K a).mp ha
  obtain ⟨bOut, hbOut, hbbL⟩ := (mem_carrierBoundaryVertices L K b).mp hb
  have haa := hle haaL
  have hbb := hle hbbL
  have haS := hboundary a.1 a.2 aOut haOut haa
  have hbS := hboundary b.1 b.2 bOut hbOut hbb
  let p : G.Walk a.1 b.1 := q.map e
  have hp : p.IsPath := hq.map Subtype.val_injective
  have hpK : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ K := by
    intro v hv
    change v ∈ (q.map e).support at hv
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map] at hv
    obtain ⟨w, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hv
    exact w.2
  have hplen : p.length + 2 = 2 ^ k := by
    change (q.map e).length + 2 = 2 ^ k
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map]
    exact hlen
  have haavoid : aOut ∉ p.support := fun h => haOut (hpK aOut h)
  have hbavoid : bOut ∉ p.support := fun h => hbOut (hpK bOut h)
  have habOut : aOut ≠ bOut := by
    intro heq
    subst bOut
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hclen⟩ := cycle_based_at_fresh_vertex p hp
      (fun h => hab (Subtype.ext h)) haa.symm hbb.symm haavoid
    exact M.isCounterexample.2 ⟨k, aOut, c, hk, hc, hclen.trans hplen⟩
  let ear : G.Walk aOut bOut := .cons haa.symm (p.concat hbb)
  have hear : ear.IsPath := by
    apply SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.cons (hp.concat hbavoid hbb)
    simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_concat, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton]
    exact fun h => h.elim haavoid habOut
  have hsupport : ∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v = aOut ∨ v = bOut ∨ v ∈ K := by
    intro v hv
    simp only [ear, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_concat,
      List.mem_cons, List.mem_append, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hv
    rcases hv with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (hpK v h))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
  refine ⟨k, aOut, bOut, ear, by omega, haS, hbS, habOut, hear, ?_, hsupport, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [ear, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_concat]
    omega
  · intro v hv hvS
    rcases hsupport v hv with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr h
    · exact (hdisjoint v h hvS).elim
  · intro h
    rcases hsupport s h with h | h | h
    · exact (hLadj.mp haaL).2.2 h.symm
    · exact (hLadj.mp hbbL).2.2 h.symm
    · exact hsK h

name: Erdos64.ExternalReachable.refl
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨SimpleGraph.Walk.nil, ?_⟩
  simpa using hx

name: Erdos64.ExternalReachable.symm
statement:
theorem ExternalReachable.symm
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {s : V} {C : G.Walk s s}
    {x y : V} (hxy : ExternalReachable G C x y) :
    ExternalReachable G C y x
proof:
:= by
  rcases hxy with ⟨p, hp⟩
  refine ⟨p.reverse, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  apply hp v
  simpa [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_reverse] using hv

name: Erdos64.ExternalReachable.trans
statement:
theorem ExternalReachable.trans
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {s : V} {C : G.Walk s s}
    {x y z : V} (hxy : ExternalReachable G C x y)
    (hyz : ExternalReachable G C y z) :
    ExternalReachable G C x z
proof:
:= by
  rcases hxy with ⟨p, hp⟩
  rcases hyz with ⟨q, hq⟩
  refine ⟨p.append q, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_append] at hv
  rcases List.mem_append.mp hv with hv | hv
  · exact hp v hv
  · exact hq v (List.mem_of_mem_tail hv)

name: Erdos64.mem_externalComponent_self
statement:
theorem mem_externalComponent_self
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {s : V} {C : G.Walk s s}
    {x : V} (hx : x ∉ C.support) :
    x ∈ externalComponent G C x hx
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨hx, ExternalReachable.refl hx⟩

name: Erdos64.externalComponent_adj_closure
statement:
theorem externalComponent_adj_closure
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {s : V} {C : G.Walk s s}
    {x u v : V} (hx : x ∉ C.support)
    (hu : u ∈ externalComponent G C x hx) (huv : G.Adj u v) :
    v ∈ C.support ∨ v ∈ externalComponent G C x hx
proof:
:= by
  rcases hu with ⟨huC, ⟨p, hp⟩⟩
  by_cases hvC : v ∈ C.support
  · exact Or.inl hvC
  · right
    refine ⟨hvC, ?_⟩
    refine ⟨p.append (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons huv SimpleGraph.Walk.nil), ?_⟩
    intro z hz
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_append] at hz
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hz with hz | hz
    · exact hp z hz
    · have hzv : z = v := by simpa using hz
      simpa [hzv] using hvC

name: Erdos64.exists_adj_mem_of_mem_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem exists_adj_mem_of_mem_of_not_mem
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {S : Set V}
    (hG : G.Connected) {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ S) (hy : y ∉ S) :
    ∃ u v, u ∈ S ∧ v ∉ S ∧ G.Adj u v
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hno
  have hnocross : ∀ {u v : V}, u ∈ S → v ∉ S → ¬G.Adj u v := by
    intro u v hu hv huv
    exact hno ⟨u, v, hu, hv, huv⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hG.exists_isPath x y
  have hstay : ∀ {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v), u ∈ S → v ∈ S := by
    intro u v p
    induction p with
    | nil =>
        intro hu
        exact hu
    | @cons u v w huv q ih =>
        intro hu
        have hv : v ∈ S := by
          by_contra hv
          exact hnocross hu hv huv
        exact ih hv
  exact hy (hstay p hx)

name: Erdos64.externalComponent_exists_boundary
statement:
theorem externalComponent_exists_boundary
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {s : V} {C : G.Walk s s}
    (_hC : C.IsCycle) (hG : G.Connected) {x : V} (hx : x ∉ C.support) :
    ∃ u, u ∈ externalComponent G C x hx ∧
      ∃ v, v ∈ C.support ∧ G.Adj u v
proof:
:= by
  have hxK : x ∈ externalComponent G C x hx :=
    mem_externalComponent_self hx
  have hsnotK : s ∉ externalComponent G C x hx := by
    intro hsK
    exact hsK.1 C.start_mem_support
  obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, huv⟩ :=
    exists_adj_mem_of_mem_of_not_mem hG hxK hsnotK
  rcases externalComponent_adj_closure hx hu huv with hvc | hvK
  · exact ⟨u, hu, v, hvc, huv⟩
  · exact (hv hvK).elim

name: Erdos64.externalComponent_mem_of_mem_support
statement:
theorem externalComponent_mem_of_mem_support
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {s : V} {C : G.Walk s s}
    {x a b : V} (hx : x ∉ C.support)
    (ha : a ∈ externalComponent G C x hx)
    (p : G.Walk a b)
    (hp : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∉ C.support)
    {z : V} (hz : z ∈ p.support) :
    z ∈ externalComponent G C x hx
proof:
:= by
  have aux :
      ∀ {a b : V} (p : G.Walk a b),
        a ∈ externalComponent G C x hx →
        (∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∉ C.support) →
        ∀ {z}, z ∈ p.support → z ∈ externalComponent G C x hx := by
    intro a b p
    induction p with
    | nil =>
        intro ha hp z hz
        rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil] at hz
        have hz' : z = _ := List.mem_singleton.mp hz
        cases hz'
        exact ha
    | @cons a b c hab q ih =>
        intro ha hp z hz
        have hbmem : b ∈ (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hab q).support := by
          rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons]
          exact List.mem_of_mem_tail q.start_mem_support
        have hb : b ∈ externalComponent G C x hx := by
          rcases externalComponent_adj_closure hx ha hab with hbc | hbK
          · exact (hp b hbmem hbc).elim
          · exact hbK
        rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons] at hz
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hz with hza | hzq
        · simpa [hza] using ha
        · apply ih hb
          · intro v hv
            exact hp v (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hv)
          · exact hzq
  exact aux p ha hp hz

name: Erdos64.externalComponent_induced_connected
statement:
theorem externalComponent_induced_connected
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {s : V} {C : G.Walk s s}
    {x : V} (hx : x ∉ C.support) :
    (G.induce (externalComponent G C x hx)).Connected
proof:
:= by
  letI : Nonempty (externalComponent G C x hx) :=
    ⟨⟨x, mem_externalComponent_self hx⟩⟩
  refine { preconnected := ?_ }
  intro u v
  rcases (ExternalReachable.symm u.property.2).trans v.property.2 with ⟨p, hp⟩
  have hpK : ∀ z, z ∈ p.support → z ∈ externalComponent G C x hx := by
    intro z hz
    exact externalComponent_mem_of_mem_support hx u.property p hp hz
  exact ⟨p.induce (externalComponent G C x hx) hpK⟩

name: Erdos64.externalComponent_two_attachments_or_unique_root
statement:
theorem externalComponent_two_attachments_or_unique_root
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {s : V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {C : G.Walk s s} (hC : C.IsCycle) (hG : G.Connected)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∉ C.support) :
    (∃ a b u v, a ∈ C.support ∧ b ∈ C.support ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      u ∈ externalComponent G C x hx ∧
      v ∈ externalComponent G C x hx ∧ G.Adj a u ∧ G.Adj b v) ∨
      ∃ r, r ∈ C.support ∧
        ∀ b, b ∈ C.support →
          ((∃ v, v ∈ externalComponent G C x hx ∧ G.Adj b v) ↔ b = r)
proof:
:= by
  let K : Set V := externalComponent G C x hx
  have hKconn : (G.induce K).Connected := by
    simpa [K] using externalComponent_induced_connected hx
  have hK_external : ∀ v, v ∈ K → v ∉ C.support := by
    intro v hv
    exact hv.1
  have hattach : ∃ a, a ∈ C.support ∧ ∃ u, u ∈ K ∧ G.Adj a u := by
    rcases externalComponent_exists_boundary hC hG hx with
      ⟨u, hu, v, hv, huv⟩
    exact ⟨v, hv, u, by simpa [K] using hu, huv.symm⟩
  simpa [K] using
    (external_carrier_two_attachments_or_unique_root hC K hKconn
      hK_external hattach)

name: Erdos64.externalComponent_exists_rootedBranchCarrier
statement:
theorem externalComponent_exists_rootedBranchCarrier
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} [Fintype V]
    {s : V} {C : G.Walk s s} {x r : V}
    (hx : x ∉ C.support) (hr : r ∈ C.support)
    (hroot : ∀ b, b ∈ C.support →
      ((∃ v, v ∈ externalComponent G C x hx ∧ G.Adj b v) ↔ b = r)) :
    let K : Set V := externalComponent G C x hx
    ∃ B : RootedBranchCarrier G,
      B.carrier = K.toFinset ∧ B.root = r ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ B.carrier → v ∉ C.support) ∧
      (∀ u, u ∈ K → ∀ v, v ∉ K → G.Adj u v → v = r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B := RootedBranchCarrier.of_externalComponent_unique_root hx hr hroot
  refine ⟨B, rfl, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v hv
    have hvK : v ∈ externalComponent G C x hx := Set.mem_toFinset.mp hv
    exact hvK.1
  · intro u hu v hv huv
    have huB : u ∈ B.carrier := Set.mem_toFinset.mpr hu
    have hvB : v ∉ B.carrier := by
      intro hvB
      exact hv (Set.mem_toFinset.mp hvB)
    exact B.boundary_root u huB v hvB huv

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_port_side_pow_two_sub_one_path
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_port_side_pow_two_sub_one_path
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D) (hx : x ∈ D) (hy : y ∈ D)
    (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (hnadj : ¬ G.Adj x y)
    (hboundary : ∀ a, a ∈ D → ∀ b, b ∉ D → G.Adj a b → b = r)
    (hports : ∀ a, a ∈ D → G.Adj a r → a = x ∨ a = y) :
    ∃ j : ℕ, ∃ p : G.Walk x y,
      2 ≤ j ∧ p.IsPath ∧ p.length + 1 = 2 ^ j ∧
      (∀ a, a ∈ p.support → a ∈ D) ∧ r ∉ p.support
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hexact : ∀ a, a ∈ D → (G.Adj a r ↔ a = x ∨ a = y) := by
    intro a ha
