    refine ⟨hports a ha, ?_⟩
    rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact hrx.symm
    · exact hry.symm
  have hyes := M.two_port_edge_completion_has_dyadic_cycle
    D r x y hr hx hy hxy hnadj hboundary hexact
  have hno : ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle (G.induce (↑D : Set V)) :=
    not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle_induce_of_not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle M.isCounterexample.2
  obtain ⟨j, p, hj, hp, hlen⟩ := added_edge_dyadic_cycle_path hno hyes
  let e : G.induce (↑D : Set V) ↪g G := SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce (↑D : Set V)
  let q : G.Walk x y := p.map e.toHom
  have hq : q.IsPath := hp.map e.injective
  have hinside : ∀ a, a ∈ q.support → a ∈ D := by
    intro a ha
    change a ∈ (p.map e.toHom).support at ha
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map] at ha
    obtain ⟨z, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ha
    exact z.property
  refine ⟨j, q, hj, hq, ?_, hinside, fun hroot => hr (hinside r hroot)⟩
  change (p.map e.toHom).length + 1 = 2 ^ j
  rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map]
  exact hlen

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_port_side_distinct_routes
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_port_side_distinct_routes
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D) (hx : x ∈ D) (hy : y ∈ D)
    (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (hnadj : ¬ G.Adj x y)
    (hroot_degree : 4 ≤ G.degree r)
    (hboundary : ∀ a, a ∈ D → ∀ b, b ∉ D → G.Adj a b → b = r)
    (hports : ∀ a, a ∈ D → G.Adj a r → a = x ∨ a = y) :
    ∃ j k : ℕ, ∃ p q : G.Walk x y,
      2 ≤ j ∧ 2 ≤ k ∧ p.IsPath ∧ q.IsPath ∧
      p.length + 1 = 2 ^ j ∧ q.length = 2 ^ k ∧
      Odd p.length ∧ Even q.length ∧ p.length ≠ q.length ∧ p ≠ q ∧
      (∀ a, a ∈ p.support → a ∈ D) ∧
      (∀ a, a ∈ q.support → a ∈ D) ∧ r ∉ p.support ∧ r ∉ q.support
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, p, hj, hp, hplen, hpinside, hpr⟩ :=
    M.exact_two_port_side_pow_two_sub_one_path
      D r x y hr hx hy hrx hry hxy hnadj hboundary hports
  obtain ⟨k, q, hk, hq, hqlen, hqinside, hqr⟩ :=
    M.exact_two_port_side_dyadic_path
      D r x y hr hx hy hrx hry hxy hnadj hroot_degree hboundary hports
  obtain ⟨hodd, heven, hlength_ne, hpq, _⟩ :=
    twoPort_routes_parity_of_dyadic_completion p q hj hk hplen hqlen
  exact ⟨j, k, p, q, hj, hk, hp, hq, hplen, hqlen, hodd, heven,
    hlength_ne, hpq, hpinside, hqinside, hpr, hqr⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_port_side_not_isBipartite
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_port_side_not_isBipartite
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D) (hx : x ∈ D) (hy : y ∈ D)
    (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (hnadj : ¬ G.Adj x y)
    (hroot_degree : 4 ≤ G.degree r)
    (hboundary : ∀ a, a ∈ D → ∀ b, b ∉ D → G.Adj a b → b = r)
    (hports : ∀ a, a ∈ D → G.Adj a r → a = x ∨ a = y) :
    ¬ (G.induce (↑D : Set V)).IsBipartite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, k, p, q, hj, hk, _, _, hplen, hqlen, _, _, _, _,
      hpinside, hqinside, _, _⟩ :=
    M.exact_two_port_side_distinct_routes
      D r x y hr hx hy hrx hry hxy hnadj hroot_degree hboundary hports
  let p' := p.induce (↑D : Set V) hpinside
  let q' := q.induce (↑D : Set V) hqinside
  have hp'len : p'.length = p.length := by
    have h := congrArg (fun w : G.Walk x y => w.length) (p.map_induce hpinside)
    exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map
      (SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce (↑D : Set V)).toHom p').symm.trans h
  have hq'len : q'.length = q.length := by
    have h := congrArg (fun w : G.Walk x y => w.length) (q.map_induce hqinside)
    exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map
      (SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce (↑D : Set V)).toHom q').symm.trans h
  exact (twoPort_routes_parity_of_dyadic_completion p' q' hj hk
    (hp'len ▸ hplen) (hq'len ▸ hqlen)).2.2.2.2

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_nonadjacent_side_not_isBipartite
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_nonadjacent_side_not_isBipartite
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hCD : C ≠ D)
    (hnonadj : ∀ a b,
      a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      b ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      G.Adj r a → G.Adj r b → a ≠ b → ¬ G.Adj a b) :
    ¬ (G.induce (↑(rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) : Set V)).IsBipartite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
  obtain ⟨_, _, hcard, _, hdegree⟩ :=
    M.rootDeleted_two_components_exact_balanced r C D hCD
  obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hxy, hrx, hry, hports⟩ :=
    rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_attachment_exact r C hcard
  have hboundary : ∀ a, a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      ∀ b, b ∉ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C → G.Adj a b → b = r := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    rcases (rootDeletedComponent_boundary r M.isConnected C).1 a ha b hab with
      hbC | hbr
    · exact (hb hbC).elim
    · exact hbr
  exact M.exact_two_port_side_not_isBipartite
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) r x y
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C).2
    hx hy hrx hry hxy (hnonadj x y hx hy hrx hry hxy)
    (by omega) hboundary hports

name: Erdos64.rootedDouble_cycle_common_tag
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Adj := (rootedDoubleGraph G r).Adj
  have tag_chain : ∀ (l : List (RootedDoubleVertex V r)),
      l.IsChain Adj → (∀ z ∈ l, z ≠ none) →
        ∃ b : Bool, ∀ z ∈ l,
          ∃ v : {v : V // v ≠ r}, z = some (b, v) := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil =>
        intro _ _
        exact ⟨false, by simp⟩
    | cons a l ih =>
        intro hchain hnon
        cases l with
        | nil =>
            have ha : a ≠ none := hnon a (by simp)
            cases a with
            | none => exact (ha rfl).elim
            | some av =>
                refine ⟨av.1, ?_⟩
                intro z hz
                simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hz
                subst z
                exact ⟨av.2, rfl⟩
        | cons c l =>
            have hac : Adj a c := by
              cases hchain with
              | cons_cons h _ => exact h
            have hchain_tail : (c :: l).IsChain Adj := by
              cases hchain with
              | cons_cons _ h => exact h
            have hnon_tail : ∀ z ∈ c :: l, z ≠ none := by
              intro z hz
              exact hnon z (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hz)
            obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ih hchain_tail hnon_tail
            have ha : a ≠ none := hnon a (by simp)
            cases a with
            | none => exact (ha rfl).elim
            | some av =>
                obtain ⟨cv, hcv⟩ := hb c (by simp)
                have htag : av.1 = b := by
                  cases c with
                  | none =>
                      cases hcv
                  | some cw =>
                      have hac' : av.1 = cw.1 := by
                        simpa [Adj, rootedDoubleGraph,
                          rootedDoubleCompatible] using hac.2
                      have hcb : cw.1 = b := by
                        exact congrArg Prod.fst (Option.some.inj hcv)
                      exact hac'.trans hcb
                refine ⟨av.1, ?_⟩
                intro z hz
                simp only [List.mem_cons] at hz
                rcases hz with rfl | hz
                · exact ⟨av.2, rfl⟩
                · obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hb z (by simp [hz])
                  exact ⟨v, by rw [hv, htag]⟩
  have rooted_cycle : ∀ {c : (rootedDoubleGraph G r).Walk none none},
      c.IsCycle →
        ∃ b : Bool, ∀ z, z ∈ c.support → z ≠ none →
          ∃ v : {v : V // v ≠ r}, z = some (b, v) := by
    intro c hc
    have hcnil : ¬ c.Nil := hc.not_nil
    have htail_eq : c.support.tail = c.tail.support :=
      (c.support_tail_of_not_nil hcnil).symm
    have htailne : c.support.tail ≠ [] := by
      rw [htail_eq]
      simp
    have htail_chain : c.support.tail.IsChain Adj := by
      exact (c.isChain_adj_support).tail
    have hdrop_chain : c.support.tail.dropLast.IsChain Adj := by
      exact htail_chain.dropLast
    have hlast : c.support.tail.getLast htailne = none := by
      simpa only [htail_eq] using c.tail.getLast_support
    have hdrop_nodup : (c.support.tail.dropLast ++
        [c.support.tail.getLast htailne]).Nodup := by
      rw [List.dropLast_append_getLast htailne]
      exact hc.support_nodup
    have hdrop_nonroot : ∀ z ∈ c.support.tail.dropLast, z ≠ none := by
      intro z hz hznone
      have hdj : List.Disjoint c.support.tail.dropLast
          [c.support.tail.getLast htailne] :=
        List.Nodup.disjoint hdrop_nodup
      exact (List.disjoint_left.mp hdj hz) (by simp [hlast, hznone])
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := tag_chain _ hdrop_chain hdrop_nonroot
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    intro z hz hzne
    have hztail : z ∈ c.support.tail := by
      rw [c.mem_support_iff] at hz
      rcases hz with rfl | hz
      · exact (hzne rfl).elim
      · exact hz
    have hzlast : z ≠ c.support.tail.getLast htailne := by
      simpa [hlast] using hzne
    exact hb z (List.mem_dropLast_of_mem_of_ne_getLast hztail hzlast)
  by_cases hroot : none ∈ p.support
  · let c := p.rotate none hroot
    obtain ⟨b, hc⟩ := rooted_cycle (c := c) (hp.rotate hroot)
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    intro z hz hzne
    apply hc z ?_ hzne
    exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_rotate_iff p none hroot).mpr hz
  · have hnon : ∀ z ∈ p.support, z ≠ none := by
      intro z hz
      exact fun hznone => hroot (hznone ▸ hz)
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := tag_chain p.support p.isChain_adj_support hnon
    exact ⟨b, fun z hz _ => hb z hz⟩

name: Erdos64.adjacent_exact_two_ports_have_internal_third_neighbors
statement:
theorem adjacent_exact_two_ports_have_internal_third_neighbors
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D) (hports : x ∈ D ∧ y ∈ D ∧ x ≠ y)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hexact :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y))
    (hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3) (hxy : G.Adj x y) :
    ∃ z w, z ∈ D ∧ w ∈ D ∧
      z ≠ r ∧ z ≠ x ∧ z ≠ y ∧ G.Adj x z ∧
      w ≠ r ∧ w ≠ x ∧ w ≠ y ∧ G.Adj y w
proof:
:= by
  have hxr : G.Adj x r := (hexact x hports.1).2 (Or.inl rfl)
  have hyr : G.Adj y r := (hexact y hports.2.1).2 (Or.inr rfl)
  have hxaccount := internalDegree_add_root_indicator_eq_degree
    D r hr hboundary hports.1
  have hyaccount := internalDegree_add_root_indicator_eq_degree
    D r hr hboundary hports.2.1
  have hxdeg : 3 ≤ G.degree x := degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hmin x
  have hydeg : 3 ≤ G.degree y := degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hmin y
  have hxinternal : 2 ≤ internalDegree G D x := by
    simp [hxr] at hxaccount
    omega
  have hyinternal : 2 ≤ internalDegree G D y := by
    simp [hyr] at hyaccount
    omega
  have hyx : y ∈ D.filter (G.Adj x) :=
    Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hports.2.1, hxy⟩
  have hxy' : x ∈ D.filter (G.Adj y) :=
    Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hports.1, hxy.symm⟩
  have hxpos : 0 < ((D.filter (G.Adj x)).erase y).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hyx]
    have hxgt : 1 < internalDegree G D x := by omega
    simpa [internalDegree] using hxgt
  have hypos : 0 < ((D.filter (G.Adj y)).erase x).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hxy']
    have hygt : 1 < internalDegree G D y := by omega
    simpa [internalDegree] using hygt
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp hxpos
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp hypos
  have hz' := Finset.mem_erase.mp hz
  have hw' := Finset.mem_erase.mp hw
  have hzD : z ∈ D := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz'.2).1
  have hzx : G.Adj x z := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz'.2).2
  have hwD : w ∈ D := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hw'.2).1
  have hwy : G.Adj y w := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hw'.2).2
  have hzr : z ≠ r := fun h => hr (h ▸ hzD)
  have hwr : w ≠ r := fun h => hr (h ▸ hwD)
  have hzx_ne : z ≠ x := by
    intro h
    exact G.loopless.irrefl x (h ▸ hzx)
  have hwy_ne : w ≠ y := by
    intro h
    exact G.loopless.irrefl y (h ▸ hwy)
  exact ⟨z, w, hzD, hwD, hzr, hzx_ne, hz'.1, hzx,
    hwr, hw'.1, hwy_ne, hwy⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.exact_cubic_two_port_case_split
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.exact_cubic_two_port_case_split
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D) (hports : x ∈ D ∧ y ∈ D ∧ x ≠ y)
    (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hexact :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y))
    (hcubic : G.degree x = 3 ∧ G.degree y = 3)
    (hroot_degree : 4 ≤ G.degree r) :
    (G.Adj x y ∧
        ∃ (z w : V) (p : G.Walk z w),
          z ∈ D ∧ w ∈ D ∧ z ≠ w ∧ ¬G.Adj z w ∧
          G.Adj x z ∧ G.Adj y w ∧ p.IsPath ∧
          (∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ≠ r ∧ v ≠ x ∧ v ≠ y) ∧
          (∀ k, 2 ≤ k → p.length + 3 ≠ 2 ^ k) ∧
          (∀ k, 2 ≤ k → p.length + 4 ≠ 2 ^ k)) ∨
      (¬G.Adj x y ∧
        ∃ (k : ℕ) (q : G.Walk x y),
          2 ≤ k ∧ q.IsPath ∧ q.length = 2 ^ k ∧
          (∀ v, v ∈ q.support → v ∈ D) ∧ r ∉ q.support)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxy : G.Adj x y
  · left
    exact ⟨hxy, M.adjacent_cubic_two_ports_path_no_dyadic
      D r x y hr hports hboundary hexact hcubic hxy⟩
  · right
    exact ⟨hxy, M.exact_two_port_side_dyadic_path
      D r x y hr hports.1 hports.2.1 hrx hry hports.2.2 hxy
      hroot_degree hboundary (fun v hv => (hexact v hv).mp)⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_twoPort_component_cubic_case_split
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_twoPort_component_cubic_case_split
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hcard : (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card = 2)
    (hroot_degree : 4 ≤ G.degree r)
    (hcubic : ∀ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      G.Adj v r → G.degree v = 3) :
    (∃ x y : V, ∃ z w : V, ∃ p : G.Walk z w,
        x ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
        y ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
        x ≠ y ∧ G.Adj r x ∧ G.Adj r y ∧ G.Adj x y ∧
        z ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
        w ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧ z ≠ w ∧ ¬G.Adj z w ∧
        G.Adj x z ∧ G.Adj y w ∧ p.IsPath ∧
        (∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ≠ r ∧ v ≠ x ∧ v ≠ y) ∧
        (∀ k, 2 ≤ k → p.length + 3 ≠ 2 ^ k) ∧
        (∀ k, 2 ≤ k → p.length + 4 ≠ 2 ^ k)) ∨
      (∃ x y : V, ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ q : G.Walk x y,
        x ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
        y ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧ x ≠ y ∧
        G.Adj r x ∧ G.Adj r y ∧ ¬G.Adj x y ∧
        2 ≤ k ∧ q.IsPath ∧ q.length = 2 ^ k ∧
        (∀ v, v ∈ q.support →
          v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) ∧ r ∉ q.support)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hxy, hrx, hry, hports⟩ :=
    rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_attachment_exact r C hcard
  have hboundary :
      ∀ a, a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
        ∀ b, b ∉ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
          G.Adj a b → b = r := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    rcases (rootDeletedComponent_boundary r M.isConnected C).1 a ha b hab with
      hbC | hbr
    · exact (hb hbC).elim
    · exact hbr
  have hexact :
      ∀ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
        (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y) := by
    intro v hv
    constructor
    · exact hports v hv
    · intro hvxy
      rcases hvxy with rfl | rfl
      · exact hrx.symm
      · exact hry.symm
  have hcase := M.exact_cubic_two_port_case_split
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) r x y
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C).2
    ⟨hx, hy, hxy⟩ hrx hry hboundary hexact
    ⟨hcubic x hx hrx.symm, hcubic y hy hry.symm⟩ hroot_degree
  rcases hcase with hcase | hcase
  · left
    rcases hcase with ⟨hxy_adj, z, w, p, hz, hw, hzw, hzw_adj,
        hxz, hyw, hp, havoid, hno3, hno4⟩
    exact ⟨x, y, z, w, p, hx, hy, hxy, hrx, hry, hxy_adj,
      hz, hw, hzw, hzw_adj, hxz, hyw, hp, havoid, hno3, hno4⟩
  · right
    rcases hcase with ⟨hnadj, k, q, hk, hq, hqlen, hinside, hroot⟩
    exact ⟨x, y, k, q, hx, hy, hxy, hrx, hry, hnadj, hk, hq, hqlen,
      hinside, hroot⟩

name: Erdos64.SimpleGraph.Walk.isCycle_append_cross_defect_paths
statement:
theorem isCycle_append_cross_defect_paths
    {a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : V} {p : G.Walk a₁ b₁} {q : G.Walk a₂ b₂}
    (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hq : q.IsPath)
    (hab : a₁ ≠ b₁)
    (hcd : a₂ ≠ b₂)
    (hdis : p.support.Disjoint q.support)
    (h₁ : G.Adj b₁ b₂)
    (h₂ : G.Adj a₁ a₂) :
    ∃ c : G.Walk a₁ a₁, c.IsCycle ∧
      c.length = p.length + q.length + 2
proof:
:= by
  let r : G.Walk b₁ a₁ :=
    SimpleGraph.Walk.cons h₁
      (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons h₂ q).reverse
  have ha₁_not_q : a₁ ∉ q.support := by
    rw [List.disjoint_left] at hdis
    intro ha₁q
    exact hdis p.start_mem_support ha₁q
  have hb₁_not_q : b₁ ∉ q.support := by
    rw [List.disjoint_left] at hdis
    intro hb₁q
    exact hdis p.end_mem_support hb₁q
  have hb₁_not_qpath : b₁ ∉ (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons h₂ q).support := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons]
    intro hb₁mem
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hb₁mem with hb₁a₁ | hb₁q
    · exact hab hb₁a₁.symm
    · exact hb₁_not_q hb₁q
  have hb₁_not_return : b₁ ∉
      (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons h₂ q).reverse.support := by
    simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_reverse, List.mem_reverse] using
      hb₁_not_qpath
  have hleft : (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons h₂ q).IsPath := by
    exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff h₂ q).2 ⟨hq, ha₁_not_q⟩
  have hreturn : r.IsPath := by
    dsimp [r]
    exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff h₁ _).2
      ⟨hleft.reverse, hb₁_not_return⟩
  have ha₁_not_tail : a₁ ∉ p.support.tail := by
    have hnodup : (a₁ :: p.support.tail).Nodup := by
      rw [p.cons_tail_support]
      exact hp.support_nodup
    exact (List.nodup_cons.mp hnodup).1
  have htails : p.support.tail.Disjoint r.support.tail := by
    rw [List.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzp hzr
    have hzreturn : z ∈ (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons h₂ q).reverse.support := by
      simpa [r] using hzr
    have hzreturn' : z ∈ (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons h₂ q).support := by
      simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_reverse, List.mem_reverse] using
        hzreturn
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons] at hzreturn'
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hzreturn' with hza₁ | hzq
    · subst z
      exact (ha₁_not_tail hzp).elim
    · exact (List.disjoint_left.mp hdis
        (List.mem_of_mem_tail hzp) hzq).elim
  refine ⟨p.append r, hp.isCycle_append hreturn htails (Or.inr ?_), ?_⟩
  · simp [r, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons,
      SimpleGraph.Walk.length_reverse]
  · simp [r, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_append,
      SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_reverse,
      Nat.add_assoc]

name: Erdos64.SimpleGraph.Walk.exists_triangle_of_marked_root_adjacencies
statement:
theorem exists_triangle_of_marked_root_adjacencies
    {r a b : V}
    (hra : G.Adj r a)
    (hrb : G.Adj r b)
    (hab : G.Adj a b) :
    ∃ c : G.Walk a a, c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = 3
proof:
:= by
  let q : G.Walk b a :=
    SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hrb.symm
      (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hra SimpleGraph.Walk.nil)
  have hq : q.IsPath := by
    dsimp [q]
    refine (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff _ _).2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact
        (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff _ _).2
          ⟨SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.nil, by simp [hra.ne]⟩
    · simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil,
        List.mem_cons]
      intro hba
      rcases hba with hba | hba
      · exact (hrb.ne.symm hba).elim
      · rcases hba with hba | hba
        · exact (hab.ne hba.symm).elim
        · simp at hba
  have hnot_edge : s(a, b) ∉ q.edges := by
    dsimp [q]
    simp [Sym2.eq_iff, hra.ne, hra.ne.symm, hrb.ne, hrb.ne.symm,
      hab.ne, hab.ne.symm]
  refine ⟨SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hab q,
    (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isCycle_iff q hab).2 ⟨hq, hnot_edge⟩, ?_⟩
  simp [q, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons]

name: Erdos64.terminal_path_length_not_dyadic_of_no_powerOfTwoCycle
statement:
theorem terminal_path_length_not_dyadic_of_no_powerOfTwoCycle
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {r a b : V}
    {p : G.Walk a b}
    (hno : ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle G)
    (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hroot : r ∉ p.support)
    (hra : G.Adj r a)
    (hrb : G.Adj r b)
    (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hlong : 1 < p.length)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≥ 2) :
    p.length + 2 ≠ 2 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  intro hlen
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hclen⟩ :=
    endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate hp hra hrb hroot hab hlong
  apply hno
  refine ⟨k, a, c, hk, hc, ?_⟩
  exact hclen.trans hlen

name: Erdos64.two_le_internalDegree_of_neighbors
statement:
private theorem two_le_internalDegree_of_neighbors
    (S : Finset V) (v a b : V) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (ha : a ∈ S) (hb : b ∈ S)
    (hva : G.Adj v a) (hvb : G.Adj v b) :
    2 ≤ internalDegree G S v
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : ({a, b} : Finset V) ⊆ S.filter (G.Adj v) := by
    intro w hw
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hw
    rcases hw with rfl | rfl
    · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨ha, hva⟩
    · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hb, hvb⟩
  simpa [internalDegree, hab] using Finset.card_le_card hsub

name: Erdos64.three_le_internalDegree_of_neighbors
statement:
private theorem three_le_internalDegree_of_neighbors
    (S : Finset V) (v a b c : V)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hac : a ≠ c) (hbc : b ≠ c)
    (ha : a ∈ S) (hb : b ∈ S) (hc : c ∈ S)
    (hva : G.Adj v a) (hvb : G.Adj v b) (hvc : G.Adj v c) :
    3 ≤ internalDegree G S v
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : ({a, b, c} : Finset V) ⊆ S.filter (G.Adj v) := by
    intro w hw
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hw
    rcases hw with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨ha, hva⟩
    · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hb, hvb⟩
    · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hc, hvc⟩
  simpa [internalDegree, hab, hac, hbc] using Finset.card_le_card hsub

name: Erdos64.private_b_of_closed_exterior
statement:
theorem private_b_of_closed_exterior
    (H : PentagramEarHull G)
    (hmin : 3 ≤ G.minDegree)
    (hcrit : IsSubgraphCritical G)
    (D : Finset V) (hD : D.Nonempty)
    (hext : ∀ v, v ∈ D → v ∉ H.hull)
    (hclosed : ∀ x, x ∈ D → ∀ y,
      G.Adj x y → y ∈ D ∨ y ∈ H.hull) :
    ∃ i : Fin 5,
      internalDegree G (Finset.univ \ D) (H.bVertex i) = 2 ∧
      (∀ w, G.Adj (H.bVertex i) w →
        w = H.aVertex i ∨ w = H.aVertex (i + 2) ∨ w ∈ D) ∧
      (∃ w, w ∈ D ∧ G.Adj (H.bVertex i) w)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let U : Finset V := Finset.univ.filter (fun v => v ∈ H.hull)
  have hU_iff (v : V) : v ∈ U ↔ v ∈ H.hull := by
    simp only [U, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  have hc_mem (i : Fin 5) : H.cVertex i ∈ U :=
    (hU_iff _).mpr (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩))
  have ha_mem (i : Fin 5) : H.aVertex i ∈ U :=
    (hU_iff _).mpr (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩))
  have hb_mem (i : Fin 5) : H.bVertex i ∈ U :=
    (hU_iff _).mpr (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  have hca_ne (i j : Fin 5) : H.cVertex i ≠ H.aVertex j := by
    intro h
    have he := H.vertex_injective h
    cases he
  have hcb_ne (i j : Fin 5) : H.cVertex i ≠ H.bVertex j := by
    intro h
    have he := H.vertex_injective h
    cases he
  have haa_ne (i : Fin 5) : H.aVertex i ≠ H.aVertex (i + 2) := by
    intro h
    have he := H.aVertex_injective h
    have hn : i ≠ i + 2 := by fin_cases i <;> decide
    exact hn he
  have hc_degree (i : Fin 5) : 3 ≤ internalDegree G U (H.cVertex i) := by
    have hnext : i + 4 + 1 = i := by fin_cases i <;> decide
    have hprev : G.Adj (H.cVertex i) (H.cVertex (i + 4)) := by
      simpa only [PentagramEarHull.cVertex, hnext] using
        G.adj_symm (H.c_adj (i + 4))
    have hcc : H.cVertex (i + 1) ≠ H.cVertex (i + 4) := by
      intro h
      have he := H.cVertex_injective h
      have hn : i + 1 ≠ i + 4 := by fin_cases i <;> decide
      exact hn he
    exact three_le_internalDegree_of_neighbors U (H.cVertex i)
      (H.cVertex (i + 1)) (H.cVertex (i + 4)) (H.aVertex i)
      hcc (hca_ne _ _) (hca_ne _ _)
      (hc_mem _) (hc_mem _) (ha_mem _) (H.c_adj i) hprev (H.ca_adj i)
  have ha_degree (i : Fin 5) : 3 ≤ internalDegree G U (H.aVertex i) := by
    have hnext : i + 3 + 2 = i := by fin_cases i <;> decide
    have hshift : G.Adj (H.aVertex i) (H.bVertex (i + 3)) := by
      simpa only [PentagramEarHull.aVertex, PentagramEarHull.bVertex, hnext] using
        H.shifted_ab_adj (i + 3)
    have hbb : H.bVertex i ≠ H.bVertex (i + 3) := by
      intro h
      have he := H.bVertex_injective h
      have hn : i ≠ i + 3 := by fin_cases i <;> decide
      exact hn he
    exact three_le_internalDegree_of_neighbors U (H.aVertex i)
      (H.cVertex i) (H.bVertex i) (H.bVertex (i + 3))
      (hcb_ne _ _) (hcb_ne _ _) hbb
      (hc_mem _) (hb_mem _) (hb_mem _)
      (G.adj_symm (H.ca_adj i)) (H.ab_adj i) hshift
  have hb_degree (i : Fin 5) : 2 ≤ internalDegree G U (H.bVertex i) :=
    two_le_internalDegree_of_neighbors U (H.bVertex i)
      (H.aVertex i) (H.aVertex (i + 2)) (haa_ne i)
      (ha_mem _) (ha_mem _) (G.adj_symm (H.ab_adj i))
      (G.adj_symm (H.shifted_ab_adj i))
  have hU_degree : ∀ v, v ∈ U → 2 ≤ internalDegree G U v := by
    intro v hv
    rcases (hU_iff v).mp hv with (⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl⟩) | ⟨i, rfl⟩
    · exact le_trans (by decide : 2 ≤ 3) (hc_degree i)
    · exact le_trans (by decide : 2 ≤ 3) (ha_degree i)
    · exact hb_degree i
  have hmin_finset : ∀ v, 3 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (G.Adj v)).card := by
    intro v
    have heq : Finset.univ.filter (G.Adj v) = G.neighborFinset v := by
      ext w
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
        SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]
    rw [heq, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
    exact degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hmin v
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint U D := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro v hvU hvD
    exact hext v hvD ((hU_iff v).mp hvU)
  have hseparated : ∀ x, x ∉ U → x ∉ D →
      ∀ y, y ∈ D → ¬G.Adj x y := by
    intro x hxU hxD y hyD hxy
    rcases hclosed y hyD x (G.adj_symm hxy) with hx | hx
    · exact hxD hx
    · exact hxU ((hU_iff x).mpr hx)
  obtain ⟨v, hvU, _, hvlow, hvD⟩ :=
    exists_deficient_boundary_vertex G hmin_finset hcrit
      ⟨H.cVertex 0, hc_mem 0⟩ hD hdisjoint hU_degree hseparated
  have hUS : U ⊆ Finset.univ \ D := by
    intro w hw
    exact Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ w,
      fun hwD => hext w hwD ((hU_iff w).mp hw)⟩
  have hmono (w : V) : internalDegree G U w ≤
      internalDegree G (Finset.univ \ D) w := by
    apply Finset.card_le_card
    intro z hz
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      ⟨hUS (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz).1, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz).2⟩
  rcases (hU_iff v).mp hvU with (⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl⟩) | ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · have hthree := le_trans (hc_degree i) (hmono (H.cVertex i))
    omega
  · have hthree := le_trans (ha_degree i) (hmono (H.aVertex i))
    omega
  · have htwo := le_trans (hb_degree i) (hmono (H.bVertex i))
    refine ⟨i, le_antisymm hvlow htwo, ?_, hvD⟩
    intro w hw
    by_cases hwa : w = H.aVertex i
    · exact Or.inl hwa
    by_cases hwb : w = H.aVertex (i + 2)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hwb)
    apply Or.inr
    apply Or.inr
    by_contra hwD
    have hthree := three_le_internalDegree_of_neighbors (Finset.univ \ D)
      (H.bVertex i) (H.aVertex i) (H.aVertex (i + 2)) w
      (haa_ne i) (Ne.symm hwa) (Ne.symm hwb)
      (hUS (ha_mem i)) (hUS (ha_mem (i + 2)))
      (Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ w, hwD⟩)
      (G.adj_symm (H.ab_adj i)) (G.adj_symm (H.shifted_ab_adj i)) hw
    omega

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.cycle8_of_explicit_hull_route
statement:
theorem cycle8_of_explicit_hull_route
    (H : PentagramEarHull G) (i₀ j₀ : Fin 5)
    (K : PentagramEarHull.Connector (G := G) H i₀ j₀)
    (R : ExplicitHullRoute H i₀ j₀ K) :
    ∃ c : G.Walk
        (PentagramEarHull.bVertex (G := G) H i₀)
        (PentagramEarHull.bVertex (G := G) H i₀),
      c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = 8
proof:
:= by
  exact cycle8_of_hull_return H i₀ j₀ K R.toHullReturn

name: Erdos64.exact_two_port_spanning_path_matching
statement:
theorem exact_two_port_spanning_path_matching
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V) (hr : r ∉ D)
    (hx : x ∈ D) (hy : y ∈ D) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hboundary : ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hexact : ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y))
    (hcubic : ∀ v, v ∈ D → G.degree v = 3)
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hinside : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ D)
    (hspan : ∀ v, v ∈ D → v ∈ p.support) :
    Odd p.length ∧
      ∃ q : (G.induce (↑D : Set V)).Walk ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩,
        q.map (SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce (↑D : Set V)).toHom = p ∧
        q.IsPath ∧ (∀ v, v ∈ q.support) ∧
        ((G.induce (↑D : Set V)).toSubgraph
          ((G.induce (↑D : Set V)) \ q.toSubgraph.spanningCoe) sdiff_le).IsPerfectMatching
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H := G.induce (↑D : Set V)
  let q : H.Walk ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ := p.induce (↑D : Set V) hinside
  let e : H ↪g G := SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce (↑D : Set V)
  have hmap : q.map e.toHom = p := SimpleGraph.Walk.map_induce p hinside
  have hq : q.IsPath := by
    apply (SimpleGraph.Walk.isPath_map_iff_of_injective (f := e.toHom) e.injective).mp
    rwa [hmap]
  have hqspan : ∀ v, v ∈ q.support := by
    intro v
    have hv : v.1 ∈ (q.map e.toHom).support := by
      rw [hmap]
      exact hspan v.1 v.2
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map] at hv
    obtain ⟨w, hw, heq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hv
    have hweq : w = v := e.injective heq
    exact hweq ▸ hw
  have hqdeg : ∀ v : (↑D : Set V),
      H.degree v = if v = ⟨x, hx⟩ ∨ v = ⟨y, hy⟩ then 2 else 3 := by
    intro v
    have haccount := internalDegree_add_root_indicator_eq_degree D r hr hboundary v.2
    rw [hcubic v.1 v.2] at haccount
    rw [degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree]
    by_cases hv : v = (⟨x, hx⟩ : (↑D : Set V)) ∨ v = ⟨y, hy⟩
    · have hroot : G.Adj v.1 r := (hexact v.1 v.2).mpr
        (hv.elim (fun h => Or.inl (congrArg Subtype.val h))
          (fun h => Or.inr (congrArg Subtype.val h)))
      simp only [hroot, ↓reduceIte] at haccount
      rw [if_pos hv]
      omega
    · have hroot : ¬G.Adj v.1 r := by
        intro h
        apply hv
        exact ((hexact v.1 v.2).mp h).elim
          (fun h => Or.inl (Subtype.ext h)) (fun h => Or.inr (Subtype.ext h))
      simp only [hroot, ↓reduceIte, Nat.add_zero] at haccount
      simpa only [if_neg hv] using haccount
  have hne : (⟨x, hx⟩ : (↑D : Set V)) ≠ ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
    fun h => hxy (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  have hodd := spanning_two_port_path_length_odd q hq hne hqspan hqdeg
  have hlen : q.length = p.length := by
    have h := congrArg (fun w : G.Walk x y => w.length) hmap
    exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map e.toHom q).symm.trans h
  refine ⟨hlen ▸ hodd, q, hmap, hq, hqspan, ?_⟩
  exact spanning_two_port_path_complement_isPerfectMatching q hq hne hqspan hqdeg

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_spanning_cubic_path_matching
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_spanning_cubic_path_matching
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hinside : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (hspan : ∀ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C → v ∈ p.support)
    (hcubic : ∀ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C → G.degree v = 3) :
    Odd p.length ∧
      ∃ q : (G.induce (↑(rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) : Set V)).Walk
          ⟨x, hinside x p.start_mem_support⟩ ⟨y, hinside y p.end_mem_support⟩,
        q.map (SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce
          (↑(rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) : Set V)).toHom = p ∧
        q.IsPath ∧ (∀ v, v ∈ q.support) ∧
        ((G.induce (↑(rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) : Set V)).toSubgraph
          ((G.induce (↑(rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) : Set V)) \
            q.toSubgraph.spanningCoe) sdiff_le).IsPerfectMatching
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
  have hx := hinside x p.start_mem_support
  have hy := hinside y p.end_mem_support
  have hcard := (M.rootDeleted_two_components_exact_balanced r C D hCD).2.2.1
  have hports := rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_attachment_exact r C hcard
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hra, hrb, hexact⟩ := hports
  have hroot : ∀ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y) := by
    intro v hv
    constructor
    · intro hvr
      have hvab := hexact v hv hvr
      have hxab := hexact x hx hrx.symm
      have hyab := hexact y hy hry.symm
      rcases hvab with rfl | rfl <;>
        rcases hxab with hxa | hxb <;> rcases hyab with hya | hyb <;>
        first | exact Or.inl hxa.symm | exact Or.inr hya.symm |
          exact Or.inl hxb.symm | exact Or.inr hyb.symm |
          exact (hxy (hxa.trans hya.symm)).elim |
          exact (hxy (hxb.trans hyb.symm)).elim
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact hrx.symm
      · exact hry.symm
  have hboundary : ∀ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      ∀ w, w ∉ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C → G.Adj v w → w = r := by
    intro v hv w hw hvw
    exact ((rootDeletedComponent_boundary r M.isConnected C).1 v hv w hvw).resolve_left hw
  exact exact_two_port_spanning_path_matching
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) r x y
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C).2 hx hy hxy
    hboundary hroot hcubic p hp hinside hspan

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.exists_b_neighbor_outside_two_attachments
statement:
theorem exists_b_neighbor_outside_two_attachments
    (H : PentagramEarHull G)
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3) (i : Fin 5) :
    ∃ w, G.Adj (H.bVertex i) w ∧
      w ≠ H.aVertex i ∧ w ≠ H.aVertex (i + 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let v : V := H.bVertex i
  let x : V := H.aVertex i
  let y : V := H.aVertex (i + 2)
  have hdeg : 3 ≤ (G.neighborFinset v).card := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
    exact degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hmin v
  by_contra hnone
  push Not at hnone
  have hsub : G.neighborFinset v ⊆ ({x, y} : Finset V) := by
    intro w hw
    have hwAdj : G.Adj v w := (G.mem_neighborFinset v w).1 hw
    have hcases := hnone w hwAdj
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    by_cases hwx : w = x
    · exact Or.inl hwx
    · exact Or.inr (hcases hwx)
  have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  have hpair : ({x, y} : Finset V).card ≤ 2 := by
    by_cases hxy : x = y
    · simp [hxy]
    · simp [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem, hxy]
  omega

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.two_port_side_card_bound
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.two_port_side_card_bound
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D)
    (hports : x ∈ D ∧ y ∈ D ∧ x ≠ y ∧ G.Adj r x ∧ G.Adj r y)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r) :
    Fintype.card V ≤ 2 * D.card + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Finset V := insert r D
  let root : {v : V // v ∈ S} := ⟨r, Finset.mem_insert_self r D⟩
  have hclosed : ∀ v, v ∈ S → v ≠ root.val →
      ∀ w, G.Adj v w → w ∈ S := by
    intro v hv hvr w hvw
    have hvD : v ∈ D := by
      exact (Finset.mem_insert.mp hv).resolve_left hvr
    by_cases hwD : w ∈ D
    · exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr hwD)
    · exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inl (hboundary v hvD w hwD hvw))
  have hpair : ({x, y} : Finset V) ⊆ S.filter (G.Adj r) := by
    intro v hv
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
    rcases hv with rfl | rfl
    · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        ⟨Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr hports.1), hports.2.2.2.1⟩
    · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        ⟨Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr hports.2.1), hports.2.2.2.2⟩
  have hroot : 2 ≤ internalDegree G S root.val := by
    have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hpair
    have hpaircard : ({x, y} : Finset V).card = 2 := by
      simp [hports.2.2.1]
    simpa [root, S, internalDegree, hpaircard] using hcard
  by_contra hbound
  have hsize : 2 * S.card - 1 < Fintype.card V := by
    have hScard : S.card = D.card + 1 := by
      simp [S, hr]
    rw [hScard]
    omega
  exact M.not_exists_strictly_smaller
    (strict_double_of_closed_side M.isCounterexample S root
      hclosed hroot hsize)

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_two_components_balanced
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_two_components_balanced
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hCD : C ≠ D) :
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C).card =
        (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D).card ∧
      insert r (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∪
        rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D) = Finset.univ
proof:
:= by
  have hC := rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C
  have hD := rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r D
  have hdisj :
      Disjoint (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
        (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D) := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro v hvC hvD
    obtain ⟨hvne, hvCsupp⟩ :=
      (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r C v).1 hvC
    obtain ⟨_, hvDsupp⟩ :=
      (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r D v).1 hvD
    have hmkC :
        (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, hvne⟩ = C :=
      (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff C ⟨v, hvne⟩).mp hvCsupp
    have hmkD :
        (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, hvne⟩ = D :=
      (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff D ⟨v, hvne⟩).mp hvDsupp
    exact hCD (hmkC.symm.trans hmkD)
  have hboundaryC :
      ∀ u, u ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
        ∀ v, v ∉ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
          G.Adj u v → v = r := by
    intro u hu v hv huv
    rcases (rootDeletedComponent_boundary r M.isConnected C).1 u hu v huv with
      hvC | hvr
    · exact (hv hvC).elim
    · exact hvr
  have hboundaryD :
      ∀ u, u ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D →
        ∀ v, v ∉ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D →
          G.Adj u v → v = r := by
    intro u hu v hv huv
    rcases (rootDeletedComponent_boundary r M.isConnected D).1 u hu v huv with
      hvD | hvr
    · exact (hv hvD).elim
    · exact hvr
  exact M.two_onePort_sides_balanced
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D) r
    hC.1 hD.1 hC.2 hD.2 hdisj hboundaryC hboundaryD

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_two_components_exact_balanced
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_two_components_exact_balanced
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    [Fintype ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)]
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hCD : C ≠ D) :
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C).card =
        (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D).card ∧
      insert r (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∪
        rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D) = Finset.univ ∧
      (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card = 2 ∧
      (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D).card = 2 ∧
      G.degree r = 4
proof:
:= by
  have hbal := M.rootDeleted_two_components_balanced r C D hCD
  have hC := rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C
  have hD := rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r D
  have hdisj :
      Disjoint (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
        (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D) := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro v hvC hvD
    obtain ⟨hvne, hvCsupp⟩ :=
      (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r C v).1 hvC
    obtain ⟨_, hvDsupp⟩ :=
      (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r D v).1 hvD
    have hmkC :
        (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, hvne⟩ = C :=
      (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff C ⟨v, hvne⟩).mp hvCsupp
    have hmkD :
        (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, hvne⟩ = D :=
      (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff D ⟨v, hvne⟩).mp hvDsupp
    exact hCD (hmkC.symm.trans hmkD)
  have hboundaryC :
      ∀ u, u ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
        ∀ v, v ∉ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
          G.Adj u v → v = r := by
    intro u hu v hv huv
    rcases (rootDeletedComponent_boundary r M.isConnected C).1 u hu v huv with
      hvC | hvr
    · exact (hv hvC).elim
    · exact hvr
  have hboundaryD :
      ∀ u, u ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D →
        ∀ v, v ∉ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D →
          G.Adj u v → v = r := by
    intro u hu v hv huv
    rcases (rootDeletedComponent_boundary r M.isConnected D).1 u hu v huv with
      hvD | hvr
    · exact (hv hvD).elim
    · exact hvr
  have hdegree := two_closed_sides_root_degree_four M
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D) r
    hC.1 hD.1 hC.2 hD.2 hdisj hbal.2 hboundaryC hboundaryD
  have hattachC :
      rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C =
        (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C).filter (G.Adj r) := by
    ext v
    simp [rootDeletedComponentAttachments,
      SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_eq_filter, and_comm]
  have hattachD :
      rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D =
        (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D).filter (G.Adj r) := by
    ext v
    simp [rootDeletedComponentAttachments,
      SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_eq_filter, and_comm]
  refine ⟨hbal.1, hbal.2, ?_, ?_, hdegree.2.2⟩
  · rw [hattachC]
    exact hdegree.1
  · rw [hattachD]
    exact hdegree.2.1

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_two_components_exact_balanced_cubic
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_two_components_exact_balanced_cubic
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    [Fintype ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)]
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hCD : C ≠ D) :
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C).card =
        (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D).card ∧
      insert r (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∪
        rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D) = Finset.univ ∧
      (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card = 2 ∧
      (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D).card = 2 ∧
      G.degree r = 4 ∧
      (∀ v, G.Adj r v → G.degree v = 3)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcard, hcover, hCports, hDports, hdegree⟩ :=
    M.vertexMinimal.rootDeleted_two_components_exact_balanced r C D hCD
  have hcubic : ∀ v, G.Adj r v → G.degree v = 3 := by
    intro v hrv
    exact M.neighbor_degree_eq_three_of_degree_ge_four (by omega) hrv
  exact ⟨hcard, hcover, hCports, hDports, hdegree, hcubic⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_two_components_exactly
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_two_components_exactly
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    [Fintype ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)]
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hCD : C ≠ D) :
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C).card =
        (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D).card ∧
      insert r (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∪
        rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D) = Finset.univ ∧
      (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card = 2 ∧
      (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D).card = 2 ∧
      G.degree r = 4 ∧
      (∀ E : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent,
        E = C ∨ E = D)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcard, hcover, hCports, hDports, hdegree⟩ :=
    M.rootDeleted_two_components_exact_balanced r C D hCD
  have honly :
      ∀ E : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent,
        E = C ∨ E = D := by
    intro E
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ :=
      (rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r E).1
    have hvr : v ≠ r := by
      intro hvr
      subst v
      exact (rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r E).2 hv
    have hvcover :
        v ∈ insert r (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∪
          rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D) := by
      rw [hcover]
      exact Finset.mem_univ v
    have hvCD : v ∈
        rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∪
          rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D := by
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hvcover with hroot | hvCD
      · exact (hvr hroot).elim
      · exact hvCD
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hvCD with hvC | hvD
    · left
      obtain ⟨hvne, hvEsupp⟩ :=
        (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r E v).1 hv
      obtain ⟨_, hvCsupp⟩ :=
        (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r C v).1 hvC
      have hmkE :=
        (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff E ⟨v, hvne⟩).mp hvEsupp
      have hmkC :=
        (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff C ⟨v, hvne⟩).mp hvCsupp
      exact hmkE.symm.trans hmkC
    · right
      obtain ⟨hvne, hvEsupp⟩ :=
        (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r E v).1 hv
      obtain ⟨_, hvDsupp⟩ :=
        (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r D v).1 hvD
      have hmkE :=
        (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff E ⟨v, hvne⟩).mp hvEsupp
      have hmkD :=
        (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff D ⟨v, hvne⟩).mp hvDsupp
      exact hmkE.symm.trans hmkD
  exact ⟨hcard, hcover, hCports, hDports, hdegree, honly⟩

name: Erdos64.carrier_external_degree_sum_odd
statement:
theorem carrier_external_degree_sum_odd
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (K : Finset V) (hKodd : Odd K.card)
    (hodddegrees : ∀ v, v ∈ K → Odd (G.degree v)) :
    Odd (∑ v : (↑K : Set V),
      ((G.neighborFinset v.1).filter (fun w => w ∉ K)).card)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H := G.induce (↑K : Set V)
  have hdegree : ∀ v : (↑K : Set V),
      H.degree v + ((G.neighborFinset v.1).filter (fun w => w ∉ K)).card =
        G.degree v.1 := by
    intro v
    have hinside : (G.neighborFinset v.1).filter (fun w => w ∈ K) =
        K.filter (G.Adj v.1) := by
      ext w
      simp [and_comm]
    have hsplit := (G.neighborFinset v.1).card_filter_add_card_filter_not
      (fun w => w ∈ K)
    rw [hinside] at hsplit
    simpa only [H, degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree, internalDegree,
      SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] using hsplit
  have hfilter : Finset.univ.filter (fun v : (↑K : Set V) =>
      Odd (G.degree v.1)) = Finset.univ := by
    ext v
    simp [hodddegrees v.1 v.2]
  have hsumodd : Odd (∑ v : (↑K : Set V), G.degree v.1) := by
    apply (Finset.odd_sum_iff_odd_card_odd _).mpr
    rw [hfilter, Finset.card_univ]
    simpa using hKodd
  have hsum := Finset.sum_congr (s₁ := Finset.univ) (s₂ := Finset.univ) (by rfl)
    (fun v _ => hdegree v)
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, H.sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges] at hsum
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hsumodd
  exact ⟨k - H.edgeFinset.card, by omega⟩

name: Erdos64.odd_carrier_external_degree_sum_ne_two
statement:
theorem odd_carrier_external_degree_sum_ne_two
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (K : Finset V) (hKodd : Odd K.card)
    (hodddegrees : ∀ v, v ∈ K → Odd (G.degree v)) :
    (∑ v : (↑K : Set V),
      ((G.neighborFinset v.1).filter (fun w => w ∉ K)).card) ≠ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := carrier_external_degree_sum_odd K hKodd hodddegrees
  omega

name: Erdos64.carrier_boundary_card_odd_of_single_external_neighbor
statement:
theorem carrier_boundary_card_odd_of_single_external_neighbor
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (K : Finset V) (hKodd : Odd K.card)
    (hodddegrees : ∀ v, v ∈ K → Odd (G.degree v))
    (hsingle : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ a, a ∉ K → ∀ b, b ∉ K →
      G.Adj v a → G.Adj v b → a = b) :
    Odd (carrierBoundaryVertices G K).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H := G.induce (↑K : Set V)
  let B := carrierBoundaryVertices G K
  have hfilter : Finset.univ.filter (fun v : (↑K : Set V) =>
      Odd (G.degree v.1)) = Finset.univ := by
    ext v
    simp [hodddegrees v.1 v.2]
  have hsumodd : Odd (∑ v : (↑K : Set V), G.degree v.1) := by
    apply (Finset.odd_sum_iff_odd_card_odd _).mpr
    rw [hfilter, Finset.card_univ]
    simpa using hKodd
  have hsum : (∑ v : (↑K : Set V), (H.degree v +
      (if v ∈ B then 1 else 0))) = ∑ v : (↑K : Set V), G.degree v.1 := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro v _
    exact carrier_degree_add_boundary_indicator K hsingle v
  have hsumB : (∑ v : (↑K : Set V), if v ∈ B then 1 else 0) = B.card := by
    exact (Finset.card_eq_sum_ite (Finset.subset_univ B)).symm
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hsumB, H.sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges] at hsum
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hsumodd
  change Odd B.card
  exact ⟨k - H.edgeFinset.card, by omega⟩

name: Erdos64.odd_carrier_even_boundary_fork
statement:
theorem odd_carrier_even_boundary_fork
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (K : Finset V) (hKodd : Odd K.card)
    (hodddegrees : ∀ v, v ∈ K → Odd (G.degree v))
    (hB : Even (carrierBoundaryVertices G K).card) :
    ∃ v ∈ K, ∃ a, a ∉ K ∧ ∃ b, b ∉ K ∧
      a ≠ b ∧ G.Adj v a ∧ G.Adj v b
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hfork
  have hsingle : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ a, a ∉ K → ∀ b, b ∉ K →
      G.Adj v a → G.Adj v b → a = b := by
    intro v hv a ha b hb hva hvb
    by_contra hab
    exact hfork ⟨v, hv, a, ha, b, hb, hab, hva, hvb⟩
  exact (Nat.not_odd_iff_even.mpr hB)
    (carrier_boundary_card_odd_of_single_external_neighbor K hKodd hodddegrees hsingle)

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.small_odd_carrier_low_boundary_fork
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.small_odd_carrier_low_boundary_fork
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (K : Finset V) (hKodd : Odd K.card)
    (hodddegrees : ∀ v, v ∈ K → Odd (G.degree v))
    (hsize : 2 * K.card + 1 < Fintype.card V)
    (hB : (carrierBoundaryVertices G K).card ≤ 2) :
    ∃ v ∈ K, ∃ a, a ∉ K ∧ ∃ b, b ∉ K ∧
      a ≠ b ∧ G.Adj v a ∧ G.Adj v b
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hfork
  have hsingle : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ a, a ∉ K → ∀ b, b ∉ K →
      G.Adj v a → G.Adj v b → a = b := by
    intro v hv a ha b hb hva hvb
    by_contra hab
    exact hfork ⟨v, hv, a, ha, b, hb, hab, hva, hvb⟩
  have hBtwo := M.small_carrier_boundary_card_ge_two K
    (Finset.card_pos.mp hKodd.pos) hsingle hsize
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ :=
    carrier_boundary_card_odd_of_single_external_neighbor K hKodd hodddegrees hsingle
  omega

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_odd_low_boundary_component_two_edge_ear
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_odd_low_boundary_component_two_edge_ear
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (p : G.Walk x y)
    (hinside : ∀ z, z ∈ p.support → z ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (E : (G.induce {z : V | z ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      z ∉ p.support}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hKodd : Odd (offPathComponentCarrier G
      (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E).card)
    (hodddegrees : ∀ v, v ∈ offPathComponentCarrier G
      (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E → Odd (G.degree v))
    (hB : (carrierBoundaryVertices G
      (offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E)).card ≤ 2) :
    let K := offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E
    ∃ u a b : V, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      u ∈ K ∧ a ∈ p.support ∧ b ∈ p.support ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      G.Adj u a ∧ G.Adj u b ∧ ear.IsPath ∧ ear.length = 2 ∧
      (∀ z, z ∈ ear.support → z = a ∨ z = b ∨ z ∈ K) ∧
      (∀ z, z ∈ ear.support → z ∈ p.support → z = a ∨ z = b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K := offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E
  obtain ⟨_, hKdata, hboundary, hsize⟩ :=
    cut_side_offPath_carrier_data M r C D hCD hxy hrx hry p hinside E
  obtain ⟨u, hu, a, ha, b, hb, hab, hua, hub⟩ :=
    M.small_odd_carrier_low_boundary_fork K hKodd hodddegrees hsize hB
  let ear : G.Walk a b := .cons hua.symm (.cons hub .nil)
  have hear : ear.IsPath := by
    apply SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.cons (SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.of_adj hub)
    simp [hua.ne.symm, hab]
  have hsupport : ∀ z, z ∈ ear.support → z = a ∨ z = b ∨ z ∈ K := by
    intro z hz
    simp only [ear, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil,
      List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hz
    rcases hz with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (h ▸ hu))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
  refine ⟨u, a, b, ear, hu, hboundary u hu a ha hua,
    hboundary u hu b hb hub, hab, hua, hub, hear, rfl, hsupport, ?_⟩
  intro z hz hzp
  rcases hsupport z hz with h | h | h
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr h
  · exact ((hKdata z h).2 hzp).elim

name: Erdos64.equal_cut_root_balanced_excess
statement:
theorem equal_cut_root_balanced_excess
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (minimalCounterexample : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G)
    (A B : Finset V) (r : V)
    (hpartition : A ∪ B = Finset.univ)
    (hinter : A ∩ B = ({r} : Finset V))
    (hrootA : r ∈ A) (hrootB : r ∈ B)
    (hclosedA : ∀ x, x ∈ A → x ≠ r →
      ∀ y, G.Adj x y → y ∈ A)
    (hclosedB : ∀ x, x ∈ B → x ≠ r →
      ∀ y, G.Adj x y → y ∈ B)
    (hnocross : ∀ x, x ∈ A → x ≠ r →
      ∀ y, y ∈ B → y ≠ r → ¬ G.Adj x y)
    (hrootDegreeA : 2 ≤ internalDegree G A r)
    (hrootDegreeB : 2 ≤ internalDegree G B r)
    (hcard : A.card = B.card)
    (hedges :
      (G.induce (↑A : Set V)).edgeFinset.card =
        (G.induce (↑B : Set V)).edgeFinset.card) :
    internalDegree G A r = 2 ∧
      internalDegree G B r = 2 ∧
      G.degree r = 4 ∧
      (∀ v, G.Adj r v → G.degree v = 3) ∧
      nonrootDegreeExcess G A r = nonrootDegreeExcess G B r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3 :=
    minimalCounterexample.vertexMinimal.isCounterexample.1
  have hside_proper : ∀ S T : Finset V,
      S ∩ T = {r} → 2 ≤ internalDegree G T r → S ≠ Finset.univ := by
    intro S T hST hT hfull
    have hnonempty : (T.filter (G.Adj r)).Nonempty := by
      apply Finset.card_pos.mp
      change 0 < internalDegree G T r
      omega
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hnonempty
    obtain ⟨hvT, hrv⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hv
    have hvS : v ∈ S := by
      rw [hfull]
      exact Finset.mem_univ v
    have hvST : v ∈ S ∩ T := Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hvS, hvT⟩
    have hvr : v = r := by
      simpa only [hST, Finset.mem_singleton] using hvST
    exact hrv.ne hvr.symm
  have hproperA := hside_proper A B hinter hrootDegreeB
  have hproperB := hside_proper B A
    (by simpa only [Finset.inter_comm] using hinter) hrootDegreeA
  have hnonroot_degree : ∀ S : Finset V,
      (∀ x, x ∈ S → x ≠ r → ∀ y, G.Adj x y → y ∈ S) →
      ∀ x, x ∈ S → x ≠ r → internalDegree G S x = G.degree x := by
    intro S hclosed x hx hxr
    have hneighbors : S.filter (G.Adj x) = G.neighborFinset x := by
      ext y
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]
      exact ⟨And.right, fun hxy => ⟨hclosed x hx hxr y hxy, hxy⟩⟩
    rw [internalDegree, hneighbors, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
  have hroot_eq : ∀ S : Finset V, r ∈ S → S ≠ Finset.univ →
      (∀ x, x ∈ S → x ≠ r → ∀ y, G.Adj x y → y ∈ S) →
      2 ≤ internalDegree G S r → internalDegree G S r = 2 := by
    intro S hrS hproper hclosed htwo
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hlow⟩ :=
      minimalCounterexample.vertexMinimal.isSubgraphCritical S ⟨r, hrS⟩ hproper
    by_cases hvr : v = r
    · subst v
      omega
    · rw [hnonroot_degree S hclosed v hv hvr] at hlow
      have hdegree := degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hmin v
      omega
  have hrootEqA := hroot_eq A hrootA hproperA hclosedA hrootDegreeA
  have hrootEqB := hroot_eq B hrootB hproperB hclosedB hrootDegreeB
  have hdisj : Disjoint (A.filter (G.Adj r)) (B.filter (G.Adj r)) := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro v hvA hvB
    have hvAB : v ∈ A ∩ B :=
      Finset.mem_inter.mpr
        ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp hvA).1, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hvB).1⟩
    have hvr : v = r := by
      simpa only [hinter, Finset.mem_singleton] using hvAB
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hvA).2.ne hvr.symm
  have hneighbors :
      G.neighborFinset r = A.filter (G.Adj r) ∪ B.filter (G.Adj r) := by
    ext v
    simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter]
    constructor
    · intro hrv
      have hvAB : v ∈ A ∪ B := by
        rw [hpartition]
        exact Finset.mem_univ v
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hvAB with hvA | hvB
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hvA, hrv⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hvB, hrv⟩
    · rintro (⟨_, hrv⟩ | ⟨_, hrv⟩) <;> exact hrv
  have hdegree : G.degree r = 4 := by
    have hcount := Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj
    rw [← hneighbors, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] at hcount
    change G.degree r = internalDegree G A r + internalDegree G B r at hcount
    omega
  have hhand : ∀ S : Finset V, r ∈ S →
      (∀ x, x ∈ S → x ≠ r → ∀ y, G.Adj x y → y ∈ S) →
      internalDegree G S r + (S.erase r).sum (fun v => G.degree v) =
        2 * (G.induce (↑S : Set V)).edgeFinset.card := by
    intro S hrS hclosed
    let H : SimpleGraph (↑S : Set V) := G.induce (↑S : Set V)
    have hsum_bij :
        S.sum (fun v => internalDegree G S v) =
          (Finset.univ : Finset (↑S : Set V)).sum (fun v => H.degree v) := by
      refine Finset.sum_bij (fun a ha => ⟨a, ?_⟩) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · exact ha
      · simp
      · intro a₁ ha₁ a₂ ha₂ h
        exact congrArg Subtype.val h
      · intro b hb
        exact ⟨b.1, b.2, Subtype.ext rfl⟩
      · intro a ha
        simpa only [H] using
          (degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree G ⟨a, ha⟩).symm
    have hsum :
        S.sum (fun v => internalDegree G S v) = 2 * H.edgeFinset.card :=
      hsum_bij.trans H.sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges
    have hnonroot_sum :
        (S.erase r).sum (fun v => internalDegree G S v) =
          (S.erase r).sum (fun v => G.degree v) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro v hv
      exact hnonroot_degree S hclosed v
        (Finset.mem_erase.mp hv).2 (Finset.mem_erase.mp hv).1
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase S (fun v => internalDegree G S v) hrS,
      hnonroot_sum] at hsum
    exact hsum
  have hsumA := hhand A hrootA hclosedA
  have hsumB := hhand B hrootB hclosedB
  rw [hrootEqA, hedges] at hsumA
  rw [hrootEqB] at hsumB
  have hsum_eq :
      (A.erase r).sum (fun v => G.degree v) =
        (B.erase r).sum (fun v => G.degree v) := by omega
  refine ⟨hrootEqA, hrootEqB, hdegree, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v hrv
    exact minimalCounterexample.neighbor_degree_eq_three_of_degree_ge_four
      (by omega) hrv
  · unfold nonrootDegreeExcess
    rw [hsum_eq, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hrootA,
      Finset.card_erase_of_mem hrootB, hcard]

name: Erdos64.endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate_of_pos
statement:
theorem endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate_of_pos
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {a b v : V} {q : G.Walk a b}
    (hq : q.IsPath)
    (hva : G.Adj v a)
    (hvb : G.Adj v b)
    (hva_not_mem : v ∉ q.support)
    (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hqlen : 0 < q.length) :
    ∃ c : G.Walk a a, c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = q.length + 2
proof:
:= by
  let r : G.Walk b a :=
    SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hvb.symm (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hva SimpleGraph.Walk.nil)
  have hr : r.IsPath := by
    dsimp [r]
    refine (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff _ _).2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact
        (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff _ _).2
          ⟨SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.nil, by simp [hva.ne]⟩
    · simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil,
        List.mem_cons]
      intro hba
      rcases hba with hba | hba
      · exact (hvb.ne.symm hba).elim
      · rcases hba with hba | hba
        · exact (hab hba.symm).elim
        · simp at hba
  have hq_nil : ¬q.Nil := by
    intro hnil
    have hzero : q.length = 0 := by simp [hnil]
    omega
  have ha_not_mem_tail : a ∉ q.support.tail := by
    have hsupp : a :: q.support.tail = q.support := by
      calc
        a :: q.support.tail = a :: q.tail.support := by
          rw [q.support_tail_of_not_nil hq_nil]
        _ = q.support := q.cons_support_tail hq_nil
    have hnodup : (a :: q.support.tail).Nodup := by
      rw [hsupp]
      exact hq.support_nodup
    exact (List.nodup_cons.mp hnodup).1
  have hdis : q.support.tail.Disjoint r.support.tail := by
    dsimp [r]
    simp only [List.disjoint_left, List.mem_cons]
    intro x hxq hxr
    rcases hxr with rfl | hxr
    · exact (hva_not_mem (List.mem_of_mem_tail hxq)).elim
    · rcases hxr with hxr | hxr
      · exact (ha_not_mem_tail (hxr ▸ hxq)).elim
      · simp at hxr
  refine ⟨q.append r, hq.isCycle_append hr hdis (Or.inr ?_), ?_⟩
  · simp [r]
  · rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_append]
    simp [r, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons]

name: Erdos64.cross_residual_root_internal_excursion_cycles
statement:
theorem cross_residual_root_internal_excursion_cycles
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {r x y u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v}
    (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (hp : p.IsPath)
    (havoid : ∀ w, w ∈ p.support → w ≠ x ∧ w ≠ y)
    (hru : u ≠ r) (hrv : v ≠ r)
    (hrp : r ∈ p.support)
    (hadj : (G.Adj x u ∧ G.Adj y v) ∨
      (G.Adj y u ∧ G.Adj x v)) :
    ∃ a : G.Walk u r, ∃ b : G.Walk r v,
      a.IsPath ∧ b.IsPath ∧ a.append b = p ∧
      a.support ⊆ p.support ∧ b.support ⊆ p.support ∧
      a.length + b.length = p.length ∧
      0 < a.length ∧ 0 < b.length ∧
      r ∉ a.support.dropLast ∧ r ∉ b.support.tail ∧
      (∃ c : G.Walk u u, c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = a.length + 2) ∧
      (∃ c : G.Walk v v, c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = b.length + 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hasub, hbsub, hlen, hapos, hbpos,
      hroota, hrootb⟩ := residual_path_root_internal_split hp hru hrv hrp
  have hxa : x ∉ a.support := by
    intro hx
    exact (havoid x (hasub hx)).1 rfl
  have hya : y ∉ a.support := by
    intro hy
    exact (havoid y (hasub hy)).2 rfl
  have hxb : x ∉ b.support := by
    intro hx
    exact (havoid x (hbsub hx)).1 rfl
  have hyb : y ∉ b.support := by
    intro hy
    exact (havoid y (hbsub hy)).2 rfl
  have hxb' : x ∉ b.reverse.support := by
    simpa [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_reverse] using hxb
  have hyb' : y ∉ b.reverse.support := by
    simpa [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_reverse] using hyb
  rcases hadj with ⟨hxu, hyv⟩ | ⟨hyu, hxv⟩
  · refine ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hasub, hbsub, hlen, hapos, hbpos,
      hroota, hrootb, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate_of_pos ha hxu hrx.symm hxa hru hapos
    · obtain ⟨c, hc, hclen⟩ := endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate_of_pos
        hb.reverse hyv hry.symm hyb' hrv (by simpa using hbpos)
      exact ⟨c, hc, by simpa [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_reverse] using hclen⟩
  · refine ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hasub, hbsub, hlen, hapos, hbpos,
      hroota, hrootb, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate_of_pos ha hyu hry.symm hya hru hapos
    · obtain ⟨c, hc, hclen⟩ := endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate_of_pos
        hb.reverse hxv hrx.symm hxb' hrv (by simpa using hbpos)
      exact ⟨c, hc, by simpa [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_reverse] using hclen⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.cross_residual_root_internal_excursions_nondyadic
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.cross_residual_root_internal_excursions_nondyadic
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    {r x y u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v}
    (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (hp : p.IsPath)
    (havoid : ∀ w, w ∈ p.support → w ≠ x ∧ w ≠ y)
    (hru : u ≠ r) (hrv : v ≠ r)
    (hrp : r ∈ p.support)
    (hadj : (G.Adj x u ∧ G.Adj y v) ∨
      (G.Adj y u ∧ G.Adj x v)) :
    ∃ a : G.Walk u r, ∃ b : G.Walk r v,
      a.IsPath ∧ b.IsPath ∧ a.append b = p ∧
      a.support ⊆ p.support ∧ b.support ⊆ p.support ∧
      a.length + b.length = p.length ∧
      0 < a.length ∧ 0 < b.length ∧
      r ∉ a.support.dropLast ∧ r ∉ b.support.tail ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, 2 ≤ j → a.length + 2 ≠ 2 ^ j) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, 2 ≤ j → b.length + 2 ≠ 2 ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hasub, hbsub, hlen, hapos, hbpos,
      hroota, hrootb, hca, hcb⟩ :=
    cross_residual_root_internal_excursion_cycles
      hrx hry hp havoid hru hrv hrp hadj
  refine ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hasub, hbsub, hlen, hapos, hbpos,
    hroota, hrootb, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j hj hpow
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hclen⟩ := hca
    apply M.isCounterexample.2
    exact ⟨j, u, c, hj, hc, hclen.trans hpow⟩
  · intro j hj hpow
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hclen⟩ := hcb
    apply M.isCounterexample.2
    exact ⟨j, v, c, hj, hc, hclen.trans hpow⟩

name: Erdos64.internalDegree_eq_degree_of_boundary_root_of_no_root_neighbor
statement:
theorem internalDegree_eq_degree_of_boundary_root_of_no_root_neighbor
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (K : Finset V) (r : V)
    (hboundary : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hnoroot : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ¬ G.Adj v r)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ K) :
    internalDegree G K v = G.degree v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfilter : K.filter (G.Adj v) = G.neighborFinset v := by
    ext w
    constructor
    · intro hw
      exact (G.mem_neighborFinset v w).2 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hw).2
    · intro hw
      have hvw : G.Adj v w := (G.mem_neighborFinset v w).1 hw
      refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, hvw⟩
      by_contra hwK
      have hwr : w = r := hboundary v hv w hwK hvw
      subst w
      exact (hnoroot v hv) hvw
  change (K.filter (G.Adj v)).card = G.degree v
  rw [hfilter]
  exact SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree G v

name: Erdos64.induced_minDegree_ge_three_of_boundary_root_of_no_root_neighbor
statement:
theorem induced_minDegree_ge_three_of_boundary_root_of_no_root_neighbor
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (K : Finset V) (r : V) (hK : K.Nonempty)
    (hboundary : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hnoroot : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ¬ G.Adj v r)
    (hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3) :
    (G.induce (↑K : Set V)).minDegree ≥ 3
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty (↑K : Set V) := by
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hK
    exact ⟨⟨v, hv⟩⟩
  apply SimpleGraph.le_minDegree_of_forall_le_degree
    (G := G.induce (↑K : Set V)) 3
  intro v
  rw [degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree G v]
  rw [internalDegree_eq_degree_of_boundary_root_of_no_root_neighbor
    K r hboundary hnoroot v.2]
  exact degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hmin v.1

name: Erdos64.adjacent_cubic_two_ports_have_internal_third_neighbors
statement:
theorem adjacent_cubic_two_ports_have_internal_third_neighbors
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D)
    (hports : x ∈ D ∧ y ∈ D ∧ x ≠ y)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hexact :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y))
    (hcubic : G.degree x = 3 ∧ G.degree y = 3)
    (hxy : G.Adj x y) :
    ∃ z w, z ∈ D ∧ w ∈ D ∧
      z ≠ r ∧ z ≠ x ∧ z ≠ y ∧ G.Adj x z ∧
      w ≠ r ∧ w ≠ x ∧ w ≠ y ∧ G.Adj y w
proof:
:= by
  have haccount := two_cubic_ports_boundary_accounting D r x y hr hports
    hboundary hexact hcubic
  have hyx : y ∈ D.filter (G.Adj x) :=
    Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hports.2.1, hxy⟩
  have hxy' : x ∈ D.filter (G.Adj y) :=
    Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hports.1, hxy.symm⟩
  have hxcard : (D.filter (G.Adj x)).card = 2 := by
    simpa [internalDegree] using haccount.1
  have hycard : (D.filter (G.Adj y)).card = 2 := by
    simpa [internalDegree] using haccount.2.1
  have hxpos : 0 < ((D.filter (G.Adj x)).erase y).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hyx, hxcard]
    omega
  have hypos : 0 < ((D.filter (G.Adj y)).erase x).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hxy', hycard]
    omega
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp hxpos
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp hypos
  have hz' := Finset.mem_erase.mp hz
  have hw' := Finset.mem_erase.mp hw
  have hzD : z ∈ D := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz'.2).1
  have hzx : G.Adj x z := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz'.2).2
  have hwD : w ∈ D := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hw'.2).1
  have hwy : G.Adj y w := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hw'.2).2
  have hzr : z ≠ r := by
    intro hzr
    exact hr (hzr ▸ hzD)
  have hwr : w ≠ r := by
    intro hwr
    exact hr (hwr ▸ hwD)
  have hzx_ne : z ≠ x := by
    intro hzx_ne
    exact G.loopless.irrefl x (hzx_ne ▸ hzx)
  have hwy_ne : w ≠ y := by
    intro hwy_ne
    exact G.loopless.irrefl y (hwy_ne ▸ hwy)
  exact ⟨z, w, hzD, hwD, hzr, hzx_ne, hz'.1, hzx,
    hwr, hw'.1, hwy_ne, hwy⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_component_nested_in_other_root_component
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_component_nested_in_other_root_component
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r x : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hCD : C ≠ D)
    (hxC : x ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (A : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ x}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hrA : r ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G x A) :
    ∀ d, d ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D →
      d ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G x A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hxr : x ≠ r := by
    intro h
    subst x
    exact (rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C).2 hxC
  have hxD : x ∉ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D := by
    intro hxD
    obtain ⟨hxne, hxCs⟩ :=
      (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r C x).mp hxC
    obtain ⟨_, hxDs⟩ :=
      (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r D x).mp hxD
    have hC :
        (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hxne⟩ = C :=
      (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff C ⟨x, hxne⟩).mp hxCs
    have hD :
        (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hxne⟩ = D :=
      (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff D ⟨x, hxne⟩).mp hxDs
    exact hCD (hC.symm.trans hD)
  intro d hdD
  obtain ⟨hdne, hdDs⟩ :=
    (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r D d).mp hdD
  obtain ⟨a, haD, har⟩ :=
    (rootDeletedComponent_boundary r M.isConnected D).2
  obtain ⟨hane, haDs⟩ :=
    (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r D a).mp haD
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := D.connected_toSimpleGraph.exists_isPath
    (⟨⟨a, hane⟩, haDs⟩ : D) (⟨⟨d, hdne⟩, hdDs⟩ : D)
  let H : SimpleGraph {v : V // v ≠ x} := G.induce {v : V | v ≠ x}
  have hDsub :
      ∀ (v : {v : V // v ≠ r}), v ∈ D.supp →
        v.1 ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D := by
    intro v hv
    exact (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r D v.1).2 ⟨v.2, hv⟩
  have hDavoid :
      ∀ (v : {v : V // v ≠ r}), v ∈ D.supp → v.1 ≠ x := by
    intro v hv h
    exact hxD (h ▸ hDsub v hv)
  have hax : a ≠ x := hDavoid ⟨a, hane⟩ haDs
  have hdx : d ≠ x := hDavoid ⟨d, hdne⟩ hdDs
  have hrootx : r ≠ x := hxr.symm
  let e : D.toSimpleGraph →g H :=
    { toFun := fun v => ⟨v.1.1, hDavoid v.1 v.2⟩
      map_rel' := by
        intro u v huv
        exact huv }
  let q0 : H.Walk ⟨a, hax⟩ ⟨d, hdx⟩ := q.map e
  let q1 : H.Walk ⟨r, hrootx⟩ ⟨d, hdx⟩ :=
    SimpleGraph.Walk.cons
      (show H.Adj ⟨r, hrootx⟩ ⟨a, hax⟩ from har.symm) q0
  have hreach : H.Reachable ⟨r, hrootx⟩ ⟨d, hdx⟩ := q1.reachable
  have hcompR : H.connectedComponentMk ⟨r, hrootx⟩ = A := by
    exact (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff A ⟨r, hrootx⟩).mp
      (by
        simpa only [hrootx] using
          (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G x A r).mp hrA |>.2)
  have hcompD : H.connectedComponentMk ⟨d, hdx⟩ = A := by
    rw [← hcompR]
    exact (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.eq).mpr hreach.symm
  exact (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G x A d).2
    ⟨hdx,
      (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff A ⟨d, hdx⟩).mpr hcompD⟩

name: Erdos64.carrier_eq_singleton_of_connected_vertex_deletion
statement:
theorem carrier_eq_singleton_of_connected_vertex_deletion
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableEq V]
    (K : Finset V) (t : V) (ht : t ∈ K)
    (z : V) (hz : z ∉ K)
    (hconn : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ t}).Connected)
    (hboundary : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj v w → v = t) :
    K = {t}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hall : ∀ v, v ∈ K → v = t := by
    intro v hv
    by_contra hvt
    have hzt : z ≠ t := fun h => hz (h ▸ ht)
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hconn.exists_isPath ⟨v, hvt⟩ ⟨z, hzt⟩
    let e : G.induce {v : V | v ≠ t} ↪g G := SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce _
    let p : G.Walk v z := q.map e.toHom
    have hp : p.IsPath := hq.map e.injective
    have hav : t ∉ p.support := by
      intro h
      change t ∈ (q.map e.toHom).support at h
      rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map] at h
      obtain ⟨w, _, hw⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
      exact w.2 hw
    have hstart : v ∈ K.erase t := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hvt, hv⟩
    have hexit : ∀ a, a ∈ K.erase t → ∀ b, b ∉ K.erase t → G.Adj a b → b = t := by
      intro a ha b hb hab
      by_cases hbK : b ∈ K
      · by_contra hbt
        exact hb (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hbt, hbK⟩)
      · exact ((Finset.mem_erase.mp ha).1
          (hboundary a (Finset.mem_erase.mp ha).2 b hbK hab)).elim
    have hzinside := SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.support_subset_of_boundary_avoiding_root
      hp hstart hav hexit z p.end_mem_support
    exact hz (Finset.mem_erase.mp hzinside).2
  ext v
  simp only [Finset.mem_singleton]
  exact ⟨hall v, fun h => h ▸ ht⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.carrier_singleton_of_boundary_card_le_one
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.carrier_singleton_of_boundary_card_le_one
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (hcut : ∃ C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent, C ≠ D)
    (K : Finset V) (hK : K.Nonempty) (hrK : r ∉ K)
    (hB : (carrierBoundaryVertices G K).card ≤ 1) :
    ∃ t : V, K = {t}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B := carrierBoundaryVertices G K
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : {v : V // v ∈ K}, ∀ v, v ∈ B → v = t := by
    by_cases hne : B.Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hne
      exact ⟨t, fun v hv => (Finset.card_le_one.mp hB) v hv t ht⟩
    · obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hK
      exact ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, fun v hv => (hne ⟨v, hv⟩).elim⟩
  have htr : t.1 ≠ r := fun h => hrK (h ▸ t.2)
  refine ⟨t.1, carrier_eq_singleton_of_connected_vertex_deletion K t.1 t.2 r hrK
    (M.rootDeleted_connected_away_from_cut r t.1 hcut htr) ?_⟩
  intro v hv w hw hvw
  have hvB : (⟨v, hv⟩ : {v : V // v ∈ K}) ∈ B :=
    (mem_carrierBoundaryVertices G K ⟨v, hv⟩).mpr ⟨w, hw, hvw⟩
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (ht ⟨v, hv⟩ hvB)

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_one_boundary_component_three_attachment_fan
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_one_boundary_component_three_attachment_fan
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (p : G.Walk x y)
    (hinside : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (E : (G.induce {v : V | v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      v ∉ p.support}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hB : (carrierBoundaryVertices G
      (offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E)).card ≤ 1) :
    ∃ t a b c : V,
      offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E = {t} ∧
      t ∉ p.support ∧ a ∈ p.support ∧ b ∈ p.support ∧ c ∈ p.support ∧
      a ≠ b ∧ a ≠ c ∧ b ≠ c ∧ G.Adj t a ∧ G.Adj t b ∧ G.Adj t c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K := offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E
  obtain ⟨hK, hKdata, hboundary, _⟩ :=
    cut_side_offPath_carrier_data M r C D hCD hxy hrx hry p hinside E
  have hrK : r ∉ K := fun h =>
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C).2 (hKdata r h).1
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := M.carrier_singleton_of_boundary_card_le_one r ⟨C, D, hCD⟩
    K hK hrK hB
  have htK : t ∈ K := by simp [ht]
  have hdegree : 2 < (G.neighborFinset t).card := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
    have h := degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G M.isCounterexample.1 t
    omega
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, c, hc, hab, hac, hbc⟩ := Finset.two_lt_card.mp hdegree
  have hta := (G.mem_neighborFinset t a).mp ha
  have htb := (G.mem_neighborFinset t b).mp hb
  have htc := (G.mem_neighborFinset t c).mp hc
  have hout : ∀ w, G.Adj t w → w ∉ K := by
    intro w htw hw
    rw [ht, Finset.mem_singleton] at hw
    exact htw.ne hw.symm
  exact ⟨t, a, b, c, ht, (hKdata t htK).2,
    hboundary t htK a (hout a hta) hta,
    hboundary t htK b (hout b htb) htb,
    hboundary t htK c (hout c htc) htc, hab, hac, hbc, hta, htb, htc⟩

name: Erdos64.path_incident_neighbors_card_le
statement:
theorem path_incident_neighbors_card_le
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b : V} (p : G.Walk a b) (hp : p.IsPath) (v : V) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => s(v, w) ∈ p.edges)).card ≤
      if v = a then 1 else 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction p generalizing v with
  | nil => simp
  | @cons a b c hab p ih =>
    have hp' := (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff hab p).mp hp
    by_cases hva : v = a
    · subst v
      have hfilter :
          Finset.univ.filter (fun w => s(a, w) ∈ (p.cons hab).edges) = {b} := by
        ext w
        have htail : s(a, w) ∉ p.edges := by
          intro hw
          exact hp'.2 (p.fst_mem_support_of_mem_edges hw)
        simp [SimpleGraph.Walk.edges_cons, htail, hab.ne]
      rw [hfilter]
      simp
    · by_cases hvb : v = b
      · subst v
        have hsub :
            Finset.univ.filter (fun w => s(b, w) ∈ (p.cons hab).edges) ⊆
              insert a (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => s(b, w) ∈ p.edges)) := by
          intro w hw
          have hm : s(b, w) = s(a, b) ∨ s(b, w) ∈ p.edges := by
            simpa only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
              SimpleGraph.Walk.edges_cons, List.mem_cons] using hw
          rcases hm with heq | he
          · have hwa : w = a := by
              rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp heq with h | h
              · exact (hab.ne h.1.symm).elim
              · exact h.2
            exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inl hwa)
          · exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr (Finset.mem_filter.mpr
              ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, he⟩))
        have hle := (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans
          (Finset.card_insert_le _ _)
        have htail := ih hp'.1 b
        simp only [ite_true] at htail
        simp only [if_neg hva]
        omega
      · have hfilter :
            Finset.univ.filter (fun w => s(v, w) ∈ (p.cons hab).edges) =
              Finset.univ.filter (fun w => s(v, w) ∈ p.edges) := by
          ext w
          simp [SimpleGraph.Walk.edges_cons, hva, hvb]
        rw [hfilter]
        simpa [hva, hvb] using ih hp'.1 v

name: Erdos64.path_incident_neighbors_card_le_two
