theorem path_incident_neighbors_card_le_two
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b : V} (p : G.Walk a b) (hp : p.IsPath) (v : V) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => s(v, w) ∈ p.edges)).card ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := path_incident_neighbors_card_le p hp v
  split_ifs at h <;> omega

name: Erdos64.exists_adj_not_mem_path_edges
statement:
theorem exists_adj_not_mem_path_edges
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] {a b v : V}
    (p : G.Walk a b) (hp : p.IsPath) (hdegree : 3 ≤ G.degree v) :
    ∃ w, G.Adj v w ∧ s(v, w) ∉ p.edges
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra h
  have hused : ∀ w, G.Adj v w → s(v, w) ∈ p.edges := by
    intro w hvw
    by_contra hnot
    exact h ⟨w, hvw, hnot⟩
  have hsub : G.neighborFinset v ⊆
      Finset.univ.filter (fun w => s(v, w) ∈ p.edges) := by
    intro w hw
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,
      hused w ((G.mem_neighborFinset v w).mp hw)⟩
  have hle := (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans
    (path_incident_neighbors_card_le_two p hp v)
  rw [SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] at hle
  omega

proof:

  change List.Nodup
    [H.vertex (.inr (.inr 0)), H.vertex (.inr (.inl 0)),
      H.vertex (.inl 0), H.vertex (.inl 1),
      H.vertex (.inr (.inl 1)), H.vertex (.inr (.inr 1))]
  let xs : List (Sum (Fin 5) (Sum (Fin 5) (Fin 5))) :=
    [.inr (.inr 0), .inr (.inl 0), .inl 0, .inl 1,
      .inr (.inl 1), .inr (.inr 1)]
  have hxs : xs.Nodup := by
    decide
  exact List.Nodup.map H.vertex_injective hxs

name: Erdos64.boundaryRootGraph_adj_some_some
statement:
@[simp] theorem boundaryRootGraph_adj_some_some
    {W : Type u} (H : SimpleGraph W) (B : Finset W) (v w : W) :
    (boundaryRootGraph H B).Adj (some v) (some w) ↔ H.Adj v w
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Erdos64.boundaryRootGraph_adj_none_some
statement:
@[simp] theorem boundaryRootGraph_adj_none_some
    {W : Type u} (H : SimpleGraph W) (B : Finset W) (w : W) :
    (boundaryRootGraph H B).Adj none (some w) ↔ w ∈ B
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Erdos64.boundaryRootGraph_adj_some_none
statement:
@[simp] theorem boundaryRootGraph_adj_some_none
    {W : Type u} (H : SimpleGraph W) (B : Finset W) (w : W) :
    (boundaryRootGraph H B).Adj (some w) none ↔ w ∈ B

name: Erdos64.boundaryRootGraph_degree_some
statement:
theorem boundaryRootGraph_degree_some
    {W : Type u} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (H : SimpleGraph W) [DecidableRel H.Adj] (B : Finset W) (w : W) :
    (boundaryRootGraph H B).degree (some w) =
      H.degree w + if w ∈ B then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hw : w ∈ B
  · have hfin : (boundaryRootGraph H B).neighborFinset (some w) =
        insert none ((H.neighborFinset w).map Function.Embedding.some) := by
      ext v
      cases v <;> simp [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, hw]
    rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hfin,
      Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (by simp), Finset.card_map,
      SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
    simp [hw]
  · have hfin : (boundaryRootGraph H B).neighborFinset (some w) =
        (H.neighborFinset w).map Function.Embedding.some := by
      ext v
      cases v <;> simp [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, hw]
    rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hfin, Finset.card_map,
      SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
    simp [hw]

name: Erdos64.boundaryRootGraph_degree_none
statement:
theorem boundaryRootGraph_degree_none
    {W : Type u} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (H : SimpleGraph W) [DecidableRel H.Adj] (B : Finset W) :
    (boundaryRootGraph H B).degree none = B.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfin : (boundaryRootGraph H B).neighborFinset none =
      B.map Function.Embedding.some := by
    ext v
    cases v <;> simp [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]
  rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hfin, Finset.card_map]

name: Erdos64.boundaryRootDeletedIso_some
statement:
@[simp] theorem boundaryRootDeletedIso_some
    {W : Type u} (H : SimpleGraph W) (B : Finset W) (w : W) :
    boundaryRootDeletedIso H B ⟨some w, by simp⟩ = w
proof: := rfl

name: Erdos64.boundaryRoot_cycle_avoiding_root
statement:
theorem boundaryRoot_cycle_avoiding_root
    {W : Type u} {H : SimpleGraph W} {B : Finset W} {v : Option W}
    (c : (boundaryRootGraph H B).Walk v v) (hc : c.IsCycle)
    (havoid : none ∉ c.support) :
    ∃ w, ∃ q : H.Walk w w, q.IsCycle ∧ q.length = c.length
proof:
:= by
  have hinside : ∀ z, z ∈ c.support → z ∈ {z : Option W | z ≠ none} := by
    intro z hz hzn
    exact havoid (hzn ▸ hz)
  let c' := c.induce {z : Option W | z ≠ none} hinside
  have hc' : c'.IsCycle := by
    apply SimpleGraph.Walk.IsCycle.of_map (f :=
      (SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce {z : Option W | z ≠ none}).toHom)
    have hmap := hc
    rw [← c.map_induce hinside] at hmap
    exact hmap
  let e := boundaryRootDeletedIso H B
  refine ⟨_, c'.map e.toHom, hc'.map e.injective, ?_⟩
  rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map]
  have hlen := congrArg SimpleGraph.Walk.length (c.map_induce hinside)
  exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map
    (SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce {z : Option W | z ≠ none}).toHom c').symm.trans hlen

name: Erdos64.strict_size_of_disjoint_remainder
statement:
theorem strict_size_of_disjoint_remainder
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (D E : Finset V)
    (hD : D.Nonempty)
    (hpartition : D ∪ E = Finset.univ)
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint D E)
    (hsmall : D.card ≤ E.card) :
    2 * D.card - 1 < Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : Fintype.card V = D.card + E.card := by
    rw [← Finset.card_univ, ← hpartition]
    exact Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisjoint
  have hDcard : 1 ≤ D.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr hD
  omega

name: Erdos64.cycle_support_index_lt
statement:
private theorem cycle_support_index_lt
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {r a : V}
    (c : G.Walk r r) (hc : c.IsCycle) (ha : a ∈ c.support) :
    ∃ i, i < c.length ∧ c.getVert i = a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hile⟩ := SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_iff_exists_getVert.mp ha
  by_cases hil : i = c.length
  · refine ⟨0, by have := hc.three_le_length; omega, ?_⟩
    simpa [hil] using hi
  · exact ⟨i, by omega, hi⟩

name: Erdos64.cycle_idxOf_getVert
statement:
private theorem cycle_idxOf_getVert
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableEq V] {r : V}
    (c : G.Walk r r) (hc : c.IsCycle) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < c.length) :
    c.support.idxOf (c.getVert i) = i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_zero]
    have h := c.length_takeUntil c.start_mem_support
    simpa using h.symm
  have hne : c.getVert i ≠ r := by
    intro h
    have heq := hc.getVert_injOn' (x₁ := i) (x₂ := 0)
      (by change i ≤ c.length - 1; omega)
      (by change 0 ≤ c.length - 1; omega)
      (by simpa using h)
    exact hi0 heq
  have hlt := c.length_takeUntil_lt_length (c.getVert_mem_support i) hne
  have hindex := hc.getVert_injOn'
    (x₁ := (c.takeUntil (c.getVert i) (c.getVert_mem_support i)).length) (x₂ := i)
    (by change _ ≤ c.length - 1; omega)
    (by change i ≤ c.length - 1; omega)
    (c.getVert_length_takeUntil (c.getVert_mem_support i))
  rwa [c.length_takeUntil] at hindex

name: Erdos64.cycle_rotate_getVert_add
proof:
:= by
  have hidx := cycle_idxOf_getVert c hc hi
  simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.rotate, SimpleGraph.Walk.dropUntil_eq_drop,
    SimpleGraph.Walk.takeUntil_eq_take, SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_append,
    SimpleGraph.Walk.length_copy, SimpleGraph.Walk.drop_length, hidx]
  rw [if_pos (by omega)]
  simp [hidx]

name: Erdos64.cycle_fan_index_lengths
statement:
private theorem cycle_fan_index_lengths
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableEq V] {r w : V}
    (c : G.Walk r r) (hc : c.IsCycle) {i j : ℕ}
    (hij : i < j) (hj : j < c.length)
    (hwi : G.Adj w (c.getVert i)) (hwj : G.Adj w (c.getVert j))
    (hw : w ∉ c.support)
    (hgap : 1 < j - i) (hother : 1 < c.length - (j - i)) :
    HasSimpleCycleOfLength G (j - i + 2) ∧
      HasSimpleCycleOfLength G (c.length - (j - i) + 2)
proof:
:= by
  let q := c.rotate (c.getVert i) (c.getVert_mem_support i)
  have hq : q.IsCycle := hc.rotate (c.getVert_mem_support i)
  have hqlen : q.length = c.length := c.length_rotate _ _
  have hget : q.getVert (j - i) = c.getVert j := by
    have h := cycle_rotate_getVert_add c hc (i := i) (j := j - i)
      (by omega) (by omega)
    simpa only [show i + (j - i) = j by omega] using h
  have hwiq : G.Adj w (q.getVert (j - i)) := by simpa only [hget] using hwj
  have hneq : c.getVert i ≠ q.getVert (j - i) := by
    rw [hget]
    intro h
    have := hc.getVert_injOn' (x₁ := i) (x₂ := j)
      (by change i ≤ c.length - 1; omega)
      (by change j ≤ c.length - 1; omega) h
    omega
  have hwq : w ∉ q.support := by
    intro h
    exact hw ((c.mem_support_rotate_iff _ _).mp h)
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨d, hd, hlen⟩ := endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate
      (hq.isPath_take (n := j - i) (by omega)) hwi hwiq
      (fun h => hwq ((q.isSubwalk_take (j - i)).support_subset h)) hneq
      (by simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.take_length]; omega)
    refine ⟨_, d, hd, ?_⟩
    simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.take_length,
      Nat.min_eq_left (show j - i ≤ q.length by omega)] using hlen
  · obtain ⟨d, hd, hlen⟩ := endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate
      (hq.isPath_drop (n := j - i) (by omega)) hwiq hwi
      (fun h => hwq ((q.isSubwalk_drop (j - i)).support_subset h)) hneq.symm
      (by simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.drop_length, hqlen] using hother)
    refine ⟨_, d, hd, ?_⟩
    simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.drop_length, hqlen] using hlen

name: Erdos64.small_cycle_even_index_fan
statement:
private theorem small_cycle_even_index_fan
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableEq V] {r w : V}
    (c : G.Walk r r) (hc : c.IsCycle)
    (hlen : c.length = 6 ∨ c.length = 10) {i j : ℕ}
    (hi : i < c.length) (hj : j < c.length) (hne : i ≠ j)
    (hparity : i % 2 = j % 2)
    (hwi : G.Adj w (c.getVert i)) (hwj : G.Adj w (c.getVert j))
    (hw : w ∉ c.support) : HasPowerOfTwoCycle G
proof:
:= by
  suffices hordered : ∀ a b : ℕ, a < b → b < c.length → a % 2 = b % 2 →
      G.Adj w (c.getVert a) → G.Adj w (c.getVert b) → HasPowerOfTwoCycle G by
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
    · exact hordered i j h hj hparity hwi hwj
    · exact hordered j i h hi hparity.symm hwj hwi
  intro a b hab hb hmod hwa hwb
  have hgap : 1 < b - a := by omega
  have hother : 1 < c.length - (b - a) := by omega
  obtain ⟨hfirst, hsecond⟩ := cycle_fan_index_lengths c hc hab hb hwa hwb hw hgap hother
  have hcases : b - a + 2 = 4 ∨ b - a + 2 = 8 ∨
      c.length - (b - a) + 2 = 4 ∨ c.length - (b - a) + 2 = 8 := by omega
  rcases hcases with h4 | h8 | h4 | h8
  · obtain ⟨v, d, hd, hlength⟩ := hfirst
    exact ⟨2, v, d, by omega, hd, by omega⟩
  · obtain ⟨v, d, hd, hlength⟩ := hfirst
    exact ⟨3, v, d, by omega, hd, by omega⟩
  · obtain ⟨v, d, hd, hlength⟩ := hsecond
    exact ⟨2, v, d, by omega, hd, by omega⟩
  · obtain ⟨v, d, hd, hlength⟩ := hsecond
    exact ⟨3, v, d, by omega, hd, by omega⟩

name: Erdos64.hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_three_attachments_to_six_or_ten_cycle
statement:
theorem hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_three_attachments_to_six_or_ten_cycle
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableEq V] {r w a b d : V}
    (c : G.Walk r r) (hc : c.IsCycle) (hlen : c.length = 6 ∨ c.length = 10)
    (ha : a ∈ c.support) (hb : b ∈ c.support) (hd : d ∈ c.support)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (had : a ≠ d) (hbd : b ≠ d)
    (hwa : G.Adj w a) (hwb : G.Adj w b) (hwd : G.Adj w d)
    (hw : w ∉ c.support) : HasPowerOfTwoCycle G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hia⟩ := cycle_support_index_lt c hc ha
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hjb⟩ := cycle_support_index_lt c hc hb
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hkd⟩ := cycle_support_index_lt c hc hd
  have hij : i ≠ j := by intro h; exact hab (hia.symm.trans (h ▸ hjb))
  have hik : i ≠ k := by intro h; exact had (hia.symm.trans (h ▸ hkd))
  have hjk : j ≠ k := by intro h; exact hbd (hjb.symm.trans (h ▸ hkd))
  have hwi : G.Adj w (c.getVert i) := by simpa only [hia] using hwa
  have hwj : G.Adj w (c.getVert j) := by simpa only [hjb] using hwb
  have hwk : G.Adj w (c.getVert k) := by simpa only [hkd] using hwd
  have hparity : i % 2 = j % 2 ∨ i % 2 = k % 2 ∨ j % 2 = k % 2 := by omega
  rcases hparity with h | h | h
  · exact small_cycle_even_index_fan c hc hlen hi hj hij h hwi hwj hw
  · exact small_cycle_even_index_fan c hc hlen hi hk hik h hwi hwk hw
  · exact small_cycle_even_index_fan c hc hlen hj hk hjk h hwj hwk hw

name: Erdos64.hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_three_attachments_to_small_port_path
statement:
theorem hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_three_attachments_to_small_port_path
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableEq V] {r w x y a b d : V}
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath) (hlen : p.length = 4 ∨ p.length = 8)
    (hrp : r ∉ p.support) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (ha : a ∈ p.support) (hb : b ∈ p.support) (hd : d ∈ p.support)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (had : a ≠ d) (hbd : b ≠ d)
    (hwa : G.Adj w a) (hwb : G.Adj w b) (hwd : G.Adj w d)
    (hwp : w ∉ p.support) (hwr : w ≠ r) : HasPowerOfTwoCycle G
proof:
:= by
  let c : G.Walk r r := SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hrx (p.concat hry.symm)
  have hc : c.IsCycle := by
    apply SimpleGraph.Walk.isCycle_iff_isPath_tail_and_le_length.mpr
    constructor
    · change ((SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hrx (p.concat hry.symm)).tail).IsPath
      rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.tail_cons]
      exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.isPath_copy _ _ _).mpr (hp.concat hrp hry.symm)
    · simp only [c, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_concat]
      omega
  have hclen : c.length = 6 ∨ c.length = 10 := by
    simp only [c, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_concat]
    omega
  have hsupp (v : V) : v ∈ c.support ↔ v = r ∨ v ∈ p.support := by
    simp only [c, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_concat,
      List.mem_cons, List.mem_append]
    tauto
  exact hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_three_attachments_to_six_or_ten_cycle c hc hclen
    ((hsupp a).mpr (Or.inr ha)) ((hsupp b).mpr (Or.inr hb))
    ((hsupp d).mpr (Or.inr hd)) hab had hbd hwa hwb hwd
    (by rw [hsupp]; exact fun h => h.elim hwr hwp)

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_small_port_path_two_le_component_boundary
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_small_port_path_two_le_component_boundary
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath) (hlen : p.length = 4 ∨ p.length = 8)
    (hinside : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (E : (G.induce {v : V | v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      v ∉ p.support}).ConnectedComponent) :
    2 ≤ (carrierBoundaryVertices G
      (offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hnot
  obtain ⟨t, a, b, d, ht, htp, ha, hb, hd, hab, had, hbd, hta, htb, htd⟩ :=
    M.rootDeleted_one_boundary_component_three_attachment_fan r C D hCD
      hxy hrx hry p hinside E (by omega)
  have hrC : r ∉ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C :=
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C).2
  have hrp : r ∉ p.support := fun h => hrC (hinside r h)
  have htK : t ∈ offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E := by
    rw [ht]
    simp
  have htr : t ≠ r := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨htC, _⟩ :=
      (mem_offPathComponentCarrier_iff G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E t).mp htK
    exact hrC (h ▸ htC.1)
  exact M.isCounterexample.2
    (hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_three_attachments_to_small_port_path p hp hlen hrp hrx hry
      ha hb hd hab had hbd hta htb htd htp htr)

name: Erdos64.rootDeleted_degree_four_exact_two_components
statement:
theorem rootDeleted_degree_four_exact_two_components
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] (r : V)
    [Fintype ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)]
    (hconn : G.Connected) (hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3)
    (hcritical : IsSubgraphCritical G) (hdegree : G.degree r = 4)
    (hcomponents :
      2 ≤ Fintype.card ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)) :
    Fintype.card ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) = 2 ∧
      ∀ C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent,
        (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card = 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Comp := (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent
  have htwo : ∀ C : Comp,
      2 ≤ (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card := by
    intro C
    have hcarrier := rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C
    have hboundary :
        ∀ x, x ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
          ∀ y, y ∉ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
            G.Adj x y → y = r := by
      intro x hx y hy hxy
      rcases (rootDeletedComponent_boundary r hconn C).1 x hx y hxy with
        hyC | hyr
      · exact (hy hyC).elim
      · exact hyr
    have hlower := component_attachment_lower_bound hconn hmin hcritical
      (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) r hcarrier.1 hcarrier.2 hboundary
    have hattach :
        rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C =
          (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C).filter (G.Adj r) := by
      ext x
      simp [rootDeletedComponentAttachments,
        SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_eq_filter, and_comm]
    have hdegreebound :
        G.degree r ≤
          (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card + 2 := by
      simpa [hattach] using hlower.2
    omega
  have hpair :
      ((Finset.univ : Finset Comp) : Set Comp).PairwiseDisjoint
        (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r) := by
    intro C _ D _ hCD
    exact rootDeletedComponentAttachments_pairwise_disjoint r hCD
  have hbi :
      (Finset.univ : Finset Comp).biUnion
          (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r) = G.neighborFinset r := by
    have hbi₀ := rootDeletedComponentAttachments_biUnion (G := G) r
    rw [show (Finset.univ : Finset Comp) =
        (@Finset.univ Comp (Fintype.ofFinite _)) by
          ext x
          simp]
    exact hbi₀
  have hsum :
      (∑ C : Comp, (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card) = 4 := by
    calc
      (∑ C : Comp, (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card) =
          ((Finset.univ : Finset Comp).biUnion
            (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r)).card := by
        rw [Finset.card_biUnion hpair]
      _ = (G.neighborFinset r).card := by rw [hbi]
      _ = 4 := by
        simpa [SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] using hdegree
  have hsumlower : 2 * Fintype.card Comp ≤
      ∑ C : Comp, (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card := by
    calc
      2 * Fintype.card Comp = ∑ _C : Comp, 2 := by
        simp [Nat.mul_comm]
      _ ≤ ∑ C : Comp, (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card := by
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun C _ => htwo C)
  have hcard : Fintype.card Comp = 2 := by
    rw [hsum] at hsumlower
    have hcomponentsComp : 2 ≤ Fintype.card Comp := by
      simpa [Comp] using hcomponents
    omega
  have hattach_two : ∀ C : Comp,
      (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card = 2 := by
    intro C
    have hsplit :
        (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card +
            (∑ D ∈ (Finset.univ.erase C),
              (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D).card) =
          ∑ D : Comp, (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D).card := by
      exact (Finset.univ : Finset Comp).add_sum_erase
        (fun D => (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D).card)
        (Finset.mem_univ C)
    have hcarderase : (Finset.univ.erase C : Finset Comp).card = 1 := by
      rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ C)]
      simp [hcard]
    have hrest : 2 ≤
      (∑ D ∈ (Finset.univ.erase C),
          (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D).card) := by
      calc
        2 = ∑ _D ∈ (Finset.univ.erase C), 2 := by
          simp [hcarderase]
        _ ≤ ∑ D ∈ (Finset.univ.erase C),
            (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D).card := by
          exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun D _ => htwo D)
    rw [hsum] at hsplit
    have hle : (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card ≤ 2 := by
      omega
    exact le_antisymm hle (htwo C)
  constructor
  · simpa [Comp] using hcard
  · intro C
    simpa [Comp] using hattach_two C

name: Erdos64.rootDeleted_degree_four_exact_two_components_of_distinct
statement:
theorem rootDeleted_degree_four_exact_two_components_of_distinct
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] (r : V)
    [Fintype ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)]
    (hconn : G.Connected) (hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3)
    (hcritical : IsSubgraphCritical G) (hdegree : G.degree r = 4)
    (hcomponents : ∃ C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent,
      C ≠ D) :
    Fintype.card ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) = 2 ∧
      ∀ C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent,
        (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card = 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcard :
      2 ≤ Fintype.card ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) := by
    obtain ⟨C, D, hCD⟩ := hcomponents
    have hsub :
        ({C, D} : Finset ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)) ⊆
          Finset.univ := by
      simp
    have hle := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    have hpair :
        ({C, D} : Finset ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)).card =
          2 := by
      simp [hCD]
    rw [hpair] at hle
    exact hle
  exact rootDeleted_degree_four_exact_two_components r hconn hmin hcritical
    hdegree hcard

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.two_closed_sides_root_degree_four
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.two_closed_sides_root_degree_four
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D E : Finset V) (r : V)
    (hD : D.Nonempty) (hE : E.Nonempty)
    (hrD : r ∉ D) (hrE : r ∉ E)
    (hdisj : Disjoint D E)
    (hcover : insert r (D ∪ E) = Finset.univ)
    (hboundaryD :
      ∀ u, u ∈ D → ∀ v, v ∉ D → G.Adj u v → v = r)
    (hboundaryE :
      ∀ u, u ∈ E → ∀ v, v ∉ E → G.Adj u v → v = r) :
    (D.filter (G.Adj r)).card = 2 ∧
      (E.filter (G.Adj r)).card = 2 ∧
      G.degree r = 4
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have exists_root_neighbor : ∀ (K : Finset V), K.Nonempty →
      (r ∉ K) →
      (∀ u, u ∈ K → ∀ v, v ∉ K → G.Adj u v → v = r) →
      ∃ z, z ∈ K ∧ G.Adj r z := by
    intro K hK hrK hboundary
    by_contra hnone
    have hclosed : ∀ u, u ∈ K → ∀ v, G.Adj u v → v ∈ K := by
      intro u hu v huv
      by_contra hv
      have hvr := hboundary u hu v hv huv
      exact hnone ⟨u, hu, by simpa only [hvr] using huv.symm⟩
    have hwalk : ∀ {a b : V}, G.Walk a b → a ∈ K → b ∈ K := by
      intro a b p
      induction p with
      | nil => exact fun ha => ha
      | cons hab p ih => exact fun ha => ih (hclosed _ ha _ hab)
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hK
    obtain ⟨p⟩ := M.isConnected.preconnected a r
    exact hrK (hwalk p ha)
  have two_attach : ∀ (K : Finset V), K.Nonempty →
      (r ∉ K) →
      (∀ u, u ∈ K → ∀ v, v ∉ K → G.Adj u v → v = r) →
      2 ≤ (K.filter (G.Adj r)).card := by
    intro K hK hrK hboundary
    obtain ⟨z, hzK, hrz⟩ := exists_root_neighbor K hK hrK hboundary
    obtain ⟨t, htK, hrt, htz⟩ :=
      M.exists_second_onePort_neighbor K r z hrK hzK hrz hboundary
    have hpair : ({z, t} : Finset V) ⊆ K.filter (G.Adj r) := by
      intro v hv
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
      rcases hv with rfl | rfl
      · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hzK, hrz⟩
      · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨htK, hrt⟩
    have hpaircard : ({z, t} : Finset V).card = 2 := by
      simp [htz.symm]
    exact hpaircard ▸ Finset.card_le_card hpair
  have root_lower_D : 2 ≤ (D.filter (G.Adj r)).card :=
    two_attach D hD hrD hboundaryD
  have root_lower_E : 2 ≤ (E.filter (G.Adj r)).card :=
    two_attach E hE hrE hboundaryE
  have houtsideD : ∃ e, e ∉ insert r D := by
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hE
    refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert]
    intro hor
    rcases hor with her | heD
    · exact hrE (her ▸ he)
    · exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisj) heD he
  have houtsideE : ∃ d, d ∉ insert r E := by
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hD
    refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert]
    intro hor
    rcases hor with hdr | hdE
    · exact hrD (hdr ▸ hd)
    · exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisj) hd hdE
  have side_root_le_two : ∀ (K : Finset V), K.Nonempty →
      (r ∉ K) →
      (∀ u, u ∈ K → ∀ v, v ∉ K → G.Adj u v → v = r) →
      (∃ e, e ∉ insert r K) →
      (K.filter (G.Adj r)).card ≤ 2 := by
    intro K hK hrK hboundary houtside
    let S : Finset V := insert r K
    have hS_nonempty : S.Nonempty := by
      exact ⟨r, Finset.mem_insert_self r K⟩
    have hS_proper : S ≠ (Finset.univ : Finset V) := by
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := houtside
      intro hS
      have heS : e ∈ S := by
        rw [hS]
        exact Finset.mem_univ e
      exact he (by simpa [S] using heS)
    have hclosed : ∀ x, x ∈ S → x ≠ r →
        ∀ y, G.Adj x y → y ∈ S := by
      intro x hx hxr y hxy
      have hxK : x ∈ K := (Finset.mem_insert.mp hx).resolve_left hxr
      by_cases hyK : y ∈ K
      · exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr hyK)
      · exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inl (hboundary x hxK y hyK hxy))
    obtain ⟨v, hvS, hvle⟩ := M.isSubgraphCritical S hS_nonempty hS_proper
    by_cases hvr : v = r
    · subst v
      have hfilter : S.filter (G.Adj r) = K.filter (G.Adj r) := by
        ext y
        constructor
        · intro hy
          rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hy with ⟨hyS, hry⟩
          rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hyS with hyr | hyK
          · exact (hry.ne hyr.symm).elim
          · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hyK, hry⟩
        · intro hy
          exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨
            Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).1),
            (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2⟩
      rw [internalDegree, hfilter] at hvle
      exact hvle
    · have hv_internal : internalDegree G S v = G.degree v := by
        have hneighbors : S.filter (G.Adj v) = G.neighborFinset v := by
          ext y
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]
          exact ⟨And.right, fun hvy =>
            ⟨hclosed v hvS hvr y hvy, hvy⟩⟩
        rw [internalDegree, hneighbors,
          SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
      have hmin : 3 ≤ G.degree v :=
        degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G
          M.isCounterexample.1 v
      rw [hv_internal] at hvle
      omega
  have root_upper_D : (D.filter (G.Adj r)).card ≤ 2 :=
    side_root_le_two D hD hrD hboundaryD houtsideD
  have root_upper_E : (E.filter (G.Adj r)).card ≤ 2 :=
    side_root_le_two E hE hrE hboundaryE houtsideE
  have hrootD : (D.filter (G.Adj r)).card = 2 := by omega
  have hrootE : (E.filter (G.Adj r)).card = 2 := by omega
  have hdisj_filter : Disjoint (D.filter (G.Adj r)) (E.filter (G.Adj r)) := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro v hvD hvE
    exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisj)
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hvD).1 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hvE).1
  have hneighbors : G.neighborFinset r =
      D.filter (G.Adj r) ∪ E.filter (G.Adj r) := by
    ext v
    simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, Finset.mem_union,
      Finset.mem_filter]
    constructor
    · intro hrv
      have hvcover : v ∈ insert r (D ∪ E) := by
        rw [hcover]
        exact Finset.mem_univ v
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hvcover with hvr | hvDE
      · exact (hrv.ne hvr.symm).elim
      · rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hvDE with hvD | hvE
        · exact Or.inl ⟨hvD, hrv⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨hvE, hrv⟩
    · rintro (⟨_, hrv⟩ | ⟨_, hrv⟩) <;> exact hrv
  have hcount := Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj_filter
  rw [← hneighbors, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] at hcount
  refine ⟨hrootD, hrootE, ?_⟩
  omega

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.two_closed_sides_root_degree_four_cubic
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.two_closed_sides_root_degree_four_cubic
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G)
    (D E : Finset V) (r : V)
    (hD : D.Nonempty) (hE : E.Nonempty)
    (hrD : r ∉ D) (hrE : r ∉ E)
    (hdisj : Disjoint D E)
    (hcover : insert r (D ∪ E) = Finset.univ)
    (hboundaryD :
      ∀ u, u ∈ D → ∀ v, v ∉ D → G.Adj u v → v = r)
    (hboundaryE :
      ∀ u, u ∈ E → ∀ v, v ∉ E → G.Adj u v → v = r) :
    (D.filter (G.Adj r)).card = 2 ∧
      (E.filter (G.Adj r)).card = 2 ∧
      G.degree r = 4 ∧
      (∀ v, G.Adj r v → G.degree v = 3)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hDtwo, hEtwo, hroot⟩ :=
    M.vertexMinimal.two_closed_sides_root_degree_four D E r hD hE hrD hrE
      hdisj hcover hboundaryD hboundaryE
  refine ⟨hDtwo, hEtwo, hroot, ?_⟩
  intro v hrv
  exact M.neighbor_degree_eq_three_of_degree_ge_four
    (by omega) hrv

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.boundary_root_has_dyadic_cycle_of_three_boundary
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.boundary_root_has_dyadic_cycle_of_three_boundary
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (K : Finset V)
    (hsingle : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ a, a ∉ K → ∀ b, b ∉ K →
      G.Adj v a → G.Adj v b → a = b)
    (hboundary : 3 ≤ (carrierBoundaryVertices G K).card)
    (hsize : K.card + 1 < Fintype.card V) :
    HasPowerOfTwoCycle
      (boundaryRootGraph (G.induce (↑K : Set V)) (carrierBoundaryVertices G K))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H := G.induce (↑K : Set V)
  let B := carrierBoundaryVertices G K
  let R := boundaryRootGraph H B
  have hdeg : ∀ v, R.degree (some v) = G.degree v.1 := by
    intro v
    rw [boundaryRootGraph_degree_some]
    exact carrier_degree_add_boundary_indicator K hsingle v
  have hmin : 3 ≤ R.minDegree := by
    apply R.le_minDegree_of_forall_le_degree
    intro v
    cases v with
    | none =>
        rw [boundaryRootGraph_degree_none]
        exact hboundary
    | some v =>
        rw [hdeg]
        exact degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G M.isCounterexample.1 v.1
  by_contra hno
  apply M.not_exists_strictly_smaller (H := R)
  refine ⟨⟨hmin, hno⟩, ?_⟩
  simpa using hsize

name: Erdos64.path_start_not_mem_tail
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (a :: p.support.tail).Nodup := by
    rw [p.cons_tail_support]
    exact hp.support_nodup
  exact (List.nodup_cons.mp hn).1

name: Erdos64.terminal_path_reroute_of_fresh_ear
statement:
theorem terminal_path_reroute_of_fresh_ear
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b x y : V}
    (pre : G.Walk a x) (segment : G.Walk x y)
    (suffix : G.Walk y b) (ear : G.Walk x y)
    (horiginal : ((pre.append segment).append suffix).IsPath)
    (hear : ear.IsPath) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hfresh : ∀ z, z ∈ ear.support →
      z ∈ ((pre.append segment).append suffix).support → z = x ∨ z = y)
    (hlong : 1 < segment.length ∨ 1 < ear.length) :
    ((pre.append ear).append suffix).IsPath ∧
      (segment.append ear.reverse).IsCycle
proof:
:= by
  have hpreseg := horiginal.of_append_left
  have hpre := hpreseg.of_append_left
  have hsegment := hpreseg.of_append_right
  have hsuffix := horiginal.of_append_right
  have hps : pre.support.Disjoint segment.support.tail := by
    have hn := hpreseg.support_nodup
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_append] at hn
    exact List.disjoint_of_nodup_append hn
  have hpss : (pre.append segment).support.Disjoint suffix.support.tail := by
    have hn := horiginal.support_nodup
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_append] at hn
    exact List.disjoint_of_nodup_append hn
  have hpe : pre.support.Disjoint ear.support.tail := by
    rw [List.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzpre hzear
    have hzorig : z ∈ ((pre.append segment).append suffix).support := by
      simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_append_iff]
      exact Or.inl (Or.inl hzpre)
    rcases hfresh z (List.mem_of_mem_tail hzear) hzorig with rfl | rfl
    · exact path_start_not_mem_tail hear hzear
    · exact (List.disjoint_left.mp hps hzpre)
        (segment.end_mem_tail_support_of_ne hxy)
  have hpes : (pre.append ear).support.Disjoint suffix.support.tail := by
    rw [List.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzpreear hzsuf
    rcases (SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_append_iff pre ear).mp hzpreear with
      hzpre | hzear
    · exact (List.disjoint_left.mp hpss
        ((SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_append_iff pre segment).mpr (Or.inl hzpre)))
        hzsuf
    · have hzorig : z ∈ ((pre.append segment).append suffix).support := by
        exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_append_iff _ _).mpr
          (Or.inr (List.mem_of_mem_tail hzsuf))
      rcases hfresh z hzear hzorig with rfl | rfl
      · exact (List.disjoint_left.mp hpss
          ((SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_append_iff pre segment).mpr
            (Or.inl pre.end_mem_support))) hzsuf
      · exact path_start_not_mem_tail hsuffix hzsuf
  have hse : segment.support.tail.Disjoint ear.reverse.support.tail := by
    rw [List.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzseg hzear
    have hzorig : z ∈ ((pre.append segment).append suffix).support := by
      simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_append_iff]
      exact Or.inl (Or.inr (List.mem_of_mem_tail hzseg))
    have hzear' : z ∈ ear.support := by
      simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_reverse, List.mem_reverse] using
        List.mem_of_mem_tail hzear
    rcases hfresh z hzear' hzorig with rfl | rfl
    · exact path_start_not_mem_tail hsegment hzseg
    · exact path_start_not_mem_tail hear.reverse hzear
  have hpreear : (pre.append ear).IsPath := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.isPath_def, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_append]
    exact List.Nodup.append hpre.support_nodup hear.support_nodup.tail hpe
  refine ⟨?_, hsegment.isCycle_append hear.reverse hse ?_⟩
  · rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.isPath_def, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_append]
    exact List.Nodup.append hpreear.support_nodup hsuffix.support_nodup.tail hpes
  · simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_reverse] using hlong

name: Erdos64.hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_two_edge_shortening_ear
statement:
theorem hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_two_edge_shortening_ear
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {r a b x y : V}
    (pre : G.Walk a x) (segment : G.Walk x y)
    (suffix : G.Walk y b) (ear : G.Walk x y)
    (horiginal : ((pre.append segment).append suffix).IsPath)
    (hear : ear.IsPath)
    (hfresh : ∀ z, z ∈ ear.support →
      z ∈ ((pre.append segment).append suffix).support → z = x ∨ z = y)
    (hroot : r ∉ ((pre.append segment).append suffix).support)
    (hrootear : r ∉ ear.support)
    (hra : G.Adj r a) (hrb : G.Adj r b)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (hdyadic : ((pre.append segment).append suffix).length = 2 ^ k)
    (hshorten : ear.length + 2 = segment.length) :
    HasPowerOfTwoCycle G
proof:
:= by
  have hsegment := horiginal.of_append_left.of_append_right
  have hxy : x ≠ y := by
    intro hxy
    have hzero := SimpleGraph.Walk.length_eq_zero_iff.mpr
      (hsegment.nil_iff_eq.mpr hxy)
    omega
  have hab : a ≠ b := by
    intro hab
    have hzero := SimpleGraph.Walk.length_eq_zero_iff.mpr
      (horiginal.nil_iff_eq.mpr hab)
    have hpow := four_le_pow_two hk
    omega
  have hroute := (terminal_path_reroute_of_fresh_ear pre segment suffix ear
    horiginal hear hxy hfresh (Or.inl (by omega))).1
  have hreroot : r ∉ ((pre.append ear).append suffix).support := by
    simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_append_iff] at hroot ⊢
    tauto
  have hlength : ((pre.append ear).append suffix).length + 2 = 2 ^ k := by
    simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_append] at hdyadic ⊢
    omega
  have hlong : 1 < ((pre.append ear).append suffix).length := by
    have hpow := four_le_pow_two hk
    omega
  obtain ⟨cycle, hcycle, hcyclelength⟩ :=
    endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate hroute hra hrb hreroot hab hlong
  exact ⟨k, a, cycle, hk, hcycle, hcyclelength.trans hlength⟩

name: Erdos64.hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_dyadic_fresh_ear
statement:
theorem hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_dyadic_fresh_ear
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b x y : V}
    (pre : G.Walk a x) (segment : G.Walk x y)
    (suffix : G.Walk y b) (ear : G.Walk x y)
    (horiginal : ((pre.append segment).append suffix).IsPath)
    (hear : ear.IsPath) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hfresh : ∀ z, z ∈ ear.support →
      z ∈ ((pre.append segment).append suffix).support → z = x ∨ z = y)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (hdyadic : segment.length + ear.length = 2 ^ k) :
    HasPowerOfTwoCycle G
proof:
:= by
  have hpow := four_le_pow_two hk
  have hlong : 1 < segment.length ∨ 1 < ear.length := by omega
  have hcycle := (terminal_path_reroute_of_fresh_ear pre segment suffix ear
    horiginal hear hxy hfresh hlong).2
  refine ⟨k, x, segment.append ear.reverse, hk, hcycle, ?_⟩
  simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_append, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_reverse] using
    hdyadic

name: Erdos64.cut_side_offPath_carrier_data
statement:
theorem cut_side_offPath_carrier_data
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (p : G.Walk x y)
    (hinside : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (E : (G.induce {v : V | v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      v ∉ p.support}).ConnectedComponent) :
    let K := offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E
    K.Nonempty ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ K → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧ v ∉ p.support) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj v w → w ∈ p.support) ∧
      2 * K.card + 1 < Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
  let A := rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C
  let K := offPathComponentCarrier G A p E
  have hKdata : ∀ v, v ∈ K → v ∈ A ∧ v ∉ p.support := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨hv, _⟩ := (mem_offPathComponentCarrier_iff G A p E v).mp hv
    exact hv
  have hK : K.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, hvE⟩ := E.nonempty_supp
    exact ⟨v, (mem_offPathComponentCarrier_iff G A p E v).mpr ⟨hv, hvE⟩⟩
  have hcard : (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card = 2 :=
    (M.rootDeleted_two_components_exact_balanced r C D hCD).2.2.1
  have hxA : x ∈ A := hinside x p.start_mem_support
  have hyA : y ∈ A := hinside y p.end_mem_support
  have hpair : ({x, y} : Finset V) = rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C := by
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
    · intro a ha
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at ha
      rcases ha with hax | hay
      · subst a
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(G.mem_neighborFinset r x).mpr hrx, hxA⟩
      · subst a
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(G.mem_neighborFinset r y).mpr hry, hyA⟩
    · simp [hcard, hxy]
  have hports : ∀ v, v ∈ A → G.Adj v r → v ∈ p.support := by
    intro v hv hvr
    have hvB : v ∈ rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C :=
      Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(G.mem_neighborFinset r v).mpr hvr.symm, hv⟩
    rw [← hpair] at hvB
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hvB with h | h
    · simpa only [h] using p.start_mem_support
    · have h : v = y := Finset.mem_singleton.mp h
      simpa only [h] using p.end_mem_support
  have hboundary : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj v w → w ∈ p.support := by
    intro v hv w hw hvw
    by_contra hwp
    obtain ⟨hvA, hvp⟩ := hKdata v hv
    have hwA : w ∈ A := by
      rcases (rootDeletedComponent_boundary r M.isConnected C).1 v hvA w hvw with
        hwA | hwr
      · exact hwA
      · have hvr : G.Adj v r := hwr ▸ hvw
        exact (hvp (hports v hvA hvr)).elim
    obtain ⟨hv', hvE⟩ := (mem_offPathComponentCarrier_iff G A p E v).mp hv
    have hEadj : (G.induce {z : V | z ∈ A ∧ z ∉ p.support}).Adj
        ⟨v, hv'⟩ ⟨w, ⟨hwA, hwp⟩⟩ := hvw
    exact hw ((mem_offPathComponentCarrier_iff G A p E w).mpr
      ⟨⟨hwA, hwp⟩, E.mem_supp_of_adj_mem_supp hvE hEadj⟩)
  have hKlt : K.card < A.card := by
    apply Finset.card_lt_card
    apply Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr
    refine ⟨fun v hv => (hKdata v hv).1, ?_⟩
    intro hKA
    have hxK : x ∈ K := hKA.symm ▸ hxA
    exact (hKdata x hxK).2 p.start_mem_support
  have horder := M.rootDeleted_two_components_order r C D hCD
  have hsize : 2 * K.card + 1 < Fintype.card V := by
    change 2 * A.card + 1 = Fintype.card V at horder
    omega
  exact ⟨hK, hKdata, hboundary, hsize⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_side_dyadic_ear_avoiding_cubic_path_vertex
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_side_dyadic_ear_avoiding_cubic_path_vertex
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hinside : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (E : (G.induce {v : V | v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      v ∉ p.support}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hB : 4 ≤ (carrierBoundaryVertices G
      (offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E)).card)
    (s : V) (hs : s ∈ p.support) (hsdeg : G.degree s = 3) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : V, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      1 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ p.support ∧ b ∈ p.support ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      ear.IsPath ∧ ear.length = 2 ^ k ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v = a ∨ v = b ∨
        v ∈ offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ p.support → v = a ∨ v = b) ∧
      s ∉ ear.support ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K := offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E
  obtain ⟨hK, hKdata, hboundary, hsize⟩ :=
    cut_side_offPath_carrier_data M r C D hCD hxy hrx hry p hinside E
  obtain ⟨t, hunique⟩ : ∃ t : {v : V // v ∈ K},
      ∀ v, v ∈ K → G.Adj v s → v = t.1 := by
    by_cases hattach : ∃ t, t ∈ K ∧ G.Adj t s
    · obtain ⟨t, ht, hts⟩ := hattach
      refine ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, ?_⟩
      intro v hv hvs
      exact cut_side_port_path_external_neighbors_eq r C hxy hrx hry p hp hinside
        K hKdata s hs hsdeg v hv t ht hvs.symm hts.symm
    · obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hK
      refine ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, ?_⟩
      intro v hv hvs
      exact (hattach ⟨v, hv, hvs⟩).elim
  obtain ⟨k, a, b, ear, hk, ha, hb, hab, hear, hlen, hsupport, hfresh, hsavoid⟩ :=
    M.small_carrier_dyadic_ear_avoiding_unique_attachment K {v | v ∈ p.support}
      (fun v hv => (hKdata v hv).2) hboundary hB hsize t s hs hunique
  refine ⟨k, a, b, ear, hk, ha, hb, hab, hear, hlen, hsupport, hfresh, hsavoid, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  rcases hsupport v hv with hva | hvb | hvK
  · subst v
    exact hinside a ha
  · subst v
    exact hinside b hb
  · exact (hKdata v hvK).1

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.false_of_unequal_cut_root_partition
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.false_of_unequal_cut_root_partition
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (minimalCounterexample : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G)
    (A B : Finset V) (r : V)
    (hpartition : A ∪ B = Finset.univ)
    (hinter : A ∩ B = ({r} : Finset V))
    (hnocross : ∀ x, x ∈ A → x ≠ r →
      ∀ y, y ∈ B → y ≠ r → ¬G.Adj x y)
    (hrootA : 2 ≤ internalDegree G A r)
    (hrootB : 2 ≤ internalDegree G B r)
    (hAB : A.card < B.card) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, root, hclosed, hroot, hsize⟩ :=
    exists_unequal_cut_root_side
      minimalCounterexample.vertexMinimal.isSubgraphCritical
      A B r hpartition hinter hnocross hrootA hrootB hAB
  have hside : ∀ v, v ∈ S → 3 ≤ G.degree v := by
    intro v hv
    exact degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G
      minimalCounterexample.vertexMinimal.isCounterexample.1 v
  have horder := rootedDouble_degree_order_interface
    (G := G) S root hclosed hroot hside hsize
  let W := RootedDoubleVertex (↑S : Set V) root
  let H : SimpleGraph W :=
    rootedDoubleGraph (G.induce (↑S : Set V)) root
  letI : Fintype W := inferInstance
  letI : DecidableRel H.Adj := inferInstance
  letI : Nonempty W := ⟨none⟩
  have hHmin : H.minDegree ≥ 3 := by
    apply SimpleGraph.le_minDegree_of_forall_le_degree (G := H) 3
    intro z
    cases z with
    | none =>
        have hrootdeg := horder.2.1
        simpa [H, W] using (show 3 ≤
          (rootedDoubleGraph (G.induce (↑S : Set V)) root).degree none by omega)
    | some z =>
        rcases z with ⟨b, v⟩
        simpa [H, W] using horder.1 b v
  have hHno : ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle H := by
    intro hcycle
    rcases hcycle with ⟨k, z, c, hk, hc, hlen⟩
    obtain ⟨hproj, hproj_len⟩ :=
      rootedDouble_cycle_localization_projection
        (G := G.induce (↑S : Set V)) (r := root) c hc
    let e : G.induce (↑S : Set V) ↪g G :=
      SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce (G := G) (↑S : Set V)
    have hambient : ((c.map rootedDoubleProjectionHom).map e.toHom).IsCycle :=
      hproj.map e.injective
    have hambient_len :
        ((c.map rootedDoubleProjectionHom).map e.toHom).length = 2 ^ k := by
      rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map]
      exact hlen
    apply minimalCounterexample.vertexMinimal.isCounterexample.2
    exact ⟨k, e (rootedDoubleProjectionHom z),
      (c.map rootedDoubleProjectionHom).map e.toHom, hk, hambient,
      hambient_len⟩
  have hsmall : IsStrictlySmallerCounterexample G H :=
    ⟨⟨hHmin, hHno⟩, by simpa [H, W] using horder.2.2.2⟩
  exact minimalCounterexample.vertexMinimal.not_exists_strictly_smaller hsmall

name: Erdos64.degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree
statement:
theorem degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree
    {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) [Fintype V]
    [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {S : Finset V} (v : (↑S : Set V)) :
    (G.induce (↑S : Set V)).degree v = internalDegree G S v.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change ((G.induce (↑S : Set V)).neighborFinset v).card =
    (S.filter (G.Adj v.1)).card
  have hfin :
      (((G.induce (↑S : Set V)).neighborFinset v).map
          (.subtype (· ∈ (↑S : Set V)))) =
        G.neighborFinset v ∩ (↑S : Set V).toFinset := by
    ext w
    simp [SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_eq_filter]
  have hcardmap := congrArg Finset.card hfin
  have hinter :
      G.neighborFinset v ∩ (↑S : Set V).toFinset =
        S.filter (G.Adj v.1) := by
    ext w
    simp [SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_eq_filter, and_comm]
  calc
    ((G.induce (↑S : Set V)).neighborFinset v).card =
        (((G.induce (↑S : Set V)).neighborFinset v).map
          (.subtype (· ∈ (↑S : Set V)))).card := by
            rw [Finset.card_map]
    _ = (G.neighborFinset v ∩ (↑S : Set V).toFinset).card := hcardmap
    _ = (S.filter (G.Adj v.1)).card := congrArg Finset.card hinter

name: Erdos64.RootedBranchCarrier.internalDegree_compl_eq_degree_of_ne_root
statement:
theorem internalDegree_compl_eq_degree_of_ne_root
    (B : RootedBranchCarrier G) {v : V}
    (hv : v ∉ B.carrier) (hvroot : v ≠ B.root) :
    internalDegree G (Finset.univ \ B.carrier) v = G.degree v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfin :
      (Finset.univ \ B.carrier).filter (G.Adj v) = G.neighborFinset v := by
    ext w
    constructor
    · intro hw
      exact (G.mem_neighborFinset v w).2 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hw).2
    · intro hw
      have hvw : G.Adj v w := (G.mem_neighborFinset v w).1 hw
      refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        ⟨Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ w, ?_⟩, hvw⟩
      intro hwK
      exact hvroot (B.boundary_root w hwK v hv hvw.symm)
  change ((Finset.univ \ B.carrier).filter (G.Adj v)).card = G.degree v
  rw [hfin]
  exact SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree G v

name: Erdos64.RootedBranchCarrier.degree_induce_compl_eq_degree_of_ne_root
statement:
theorem degree_induce_compl_eq_degree_of_ne_root
    (B : RootedBranchCarrier G)
    (v : (↑(Finset.univ \ B.carrier) : Set V))
    (hvroot : v.1 ≠ B.root) :
    (G.induce (↑(Finset.univ \ B.carrier) : Set V)).degree v =
      G.degree v.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree G v]
  exact B.internalDegree_compl_eq_degree_of_ne_root
    (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp v.2).2 hvroot

name: Erdos64.RootedBranchCarrier.root_internalDegree_le_two
statement:
theorem root_internalDegree_le_two
    (B : RootedBranchCarrier G)
    (hcritical : IsSubgraphCritical G) (hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3) :
    internalDegree G (Finset.univ \ B.carrier) B.root ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hS_nonempty : (Finset.univ \ B.carrier).Nonempty :=
    ⟨B.root, Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_univ B.root, B.root_not_mem⟩⟩
  have hS_proper : Finset.univ \ B.carrier ≠ (Finset.univ : Finset V) := by
    intro hS
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := B.carrier_nonempty
    have hxS : x ∈ Finset.univ \ B.carrier := by
      rw [hS]
      exact Finset.mem_univ x
    exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hxS).2 hx
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvlow⟩ := hcritical _ hS_nonempty hS_proper
  by_cases hvroot : v = B.root
  · simpa only [hvroot] using hvlow
  · have heq := B.internalDegree_compl_eq_degree_of_ne_root
      (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hv).2 hvroot
    have hvmin : 3 ≤ G.degree v :=
      degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hmin v
    rw [heq] at hvlow
    omega

name: Erdos64.RootedBranchCarrier.internalDegree_add_carrierNeighbor_card_eq_degree
statement:
theorem internalDegree_add_carrierNeighbor_card_eq_degree
    (B : RootedBranchCarrier G) :
    internalDegree G (Finset.univ \ B.carrier) B.root +
        (B.carrier.filter (G.Adj B.root)).card = G.degree B.root
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hunion :
      (Finset.univ \ B.carrier).filter (G.Adj B.root) ∪
          B.carrier.filter (G.Adj B.root) = G.neighborFinset B.root := by
    ext w
    by_cases hw : w ∈ B.carrier <;>
      simp [SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_eq_filter, hw]
  have hdisjoint :
      Disjoint ((Finset.univ \ B.carrier).filter (G.Adj B.root))
        (B.carrier.filter (G.Adj B.root)) := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.2
    intro w hwS hwK
    exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hwS).1).2
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hwK).1
  have hcard := congrArg Finset.card hunion
  rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisjoint,
    SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] at hcard
  exact hcard

name: Erdos64.RootedBranchCarrier.exists_carrier_neighbor_of_degree_eq_three_of_root_internalDegree_le_two
statement:
theorem exists_carrier_neighbor_of_degree_eq_three_of_root_internalDegree_le_two
    (B : RootedBranchCarrier G)
    (hdeg : G.degree B.root = 3)
    (hroot : internalDegree G (Finset.univ \ B.carrier) B.root ≤ 2) :
    ∃ w, w ∈ B.carrier ∧ G.Adj B.root w
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := B.internalDegree_add_carrierNeighbor_card_eq_degree
  rw [hdeg] at hsum
  have hpositive :
      0 < (B.carrier.filter (G.Adj B.root)).card := by
    omega
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp hpositive
  exact ⟨w, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hw).1, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hw).2⟩

name: Erdos64.RootedBranchCarrier.one_le_carrierNeighbor_card_of_degree_eq_three_of_root_internalDegree_le_two
statement:
theorem one_le_carrierNeighbor_card_of_degree_eq_three_of_root_internalDegree_le_two
    (B : RootedBranchCarrier G)
    (hdeg : G.degree B.root = 3)
    (hroot : internalDegree G (Finset.univ \ B.carrier) B.root ≤ 2) :
    1 ≤ (B.carrier.filter (G.Adj B.root)).card ∧
      (B.carrier.filter (G.Adj B.root)).card ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := B.internalDegree_add_carrierNeighbor_card_eq_degree
  rw [hdeg] at hsum
  omega

name: Erdos64.RootedBranchCarrier.exists_carrier_neighbor_of_degree_eq_three
statement:
theorem exists_carrier_neighbor_of_degree_eq_three
    (B : RootedBranchCarrier G)
    (hcritical : IsSubgraphCritical G) (hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3)
    (hdeg : G.degree B.root = 3) :
    ∃ w, w ∈ B.carrier ∧ G.Adj B.root w
proof:
:=
  B.exists_carrier_neighbor_of_degree_eq_three_of_root_internalDegree_le_two
    hdeg (B.root_internalDegree_le_two hcritical hmin)

name: Erdos64.RootedBranchCarrier.complement_minDegree_ge_three
statement:
theorem complement_minDegree_ge_three
    (B : RootedBranchCarrier G) (hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3)
    (hroot : 3 ≤ internalDegree G (Finset.univ \ B.carrier) B.root) :
    (G.induce (↑(Finset.univ \ B.carrier) : Set V)).minDegree ≥ 3
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty (↑(Finset.univ \ B.carrier) : Set V) :=
    ⟨⟨B.root, Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_univ B.root, B.root_not_mem⟩⟩⟩
  apply SimpleGraph.le_minDegree_of_forall_le_degree
    (G := G.induce (↑(Finset.univ \ B.carrier) : Set V)) 3
  intro v
  rw [degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree G v]
  by_cases hvroot : v.1 = B.root
  · simpa only [hvroot] using hroot
  · rw [B.internalDegree_compl_eq_degree_of_ne_root
      (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp v.2).2 hvroot]
    exact degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hmin v.1

name: Erdos64.RootedBranchCarrier.complement_card_lt
statement:
theorem complement_card_lt (B : RootedBranchCarrier G) :
    Fintype.card (↑(Finset.univ \ B.carrier) : Set V) < Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := B.carrier_nonempty
  have hxnot : x ∉ (↑(Finset.univ \ B.carrier) : Set V) := by
    intro hxS
    exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hxS).2 hx
  exact Fintype.card_subtype_lt hxnot

name: Erdos64.RootedBranchCarrier.isStrictlySmallerCounterexample_compl
statement:
theorem isStrictlySmallerCounterexample_compl
    (B : RootedBranchCarrier G) (hcounter : IsCounterexample G)
    (hroot : 3 ≤ internalDegree G (Finset.univ \ B.carrier) B.root) :
    IsStrictlySmallerCounterexample G
      (G.induce (↑(Finset.univ \ B.carrier) : Set V))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨⟨B.complement_minDegree_ge_three hcounter.1 hroot, ?_⟩,
    B.complement_card_lt⟩
  intro hpow
  rcases hpow with ⟨k, v, c, hk, hc, hlen⟩
  let e := (SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce (G := G)
    (s := (↑(Finset.univ \ B.carrier) : Set V))).toHom
  refine hcounter.2 ⟨k, e v, c.map e, hk, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hc.map Subtype.val_injective
  · exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map e c).trans hlen

name: Erdos64.RootedBranchCarrier.attachmentSet_two_or_singleton
proof:
:= by
  by_cases htwo : ∃ a b, a ∈ attachmentSet G C K ∧
      b ∈ attachmentSet G C K ∧ a ≠ b
  · exact Or.inl htwo
  · right
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hattach
    refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
    ext a
    constructor
    · intro ha
      have har : a = r := by
        by_contra hne
        exact htwo ⟨a, r, ha, hr, hne⟩
      exact Finset.mem_singleton.mpr har
    · intro ha
      rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at ha
      simpa [ha] using hr

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.adjacent_cubic_two_ports_path_cycle
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.adjacent_cubic_two_ports_path_cycle
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D)
    (hports : x ∈ D ∧ y ∈ D ∧ x ≠ y)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ t, t ∉ D → G.Adj v t → t = r)
    (hexact :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y))
    (hcubic : G.degree x = 3 ∧ G.degree y = 3)
    (hxy : G.Adj x y) :
    ∃ (z w : V) (p : G.Walk z w) (c : G.Walk x x),
      z ∈ D ∧ w ∈ D ∧ z ≠ w ∧ ¬G.Adj z w ∧
      G.Adj x z ∧ G.Adj y w ∧ p.IsPath ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ≠ r ∧ v ≠ x ∧ v ≠ y) ∧
      c.IsCycle ∧ r ∈ c.support ∧ c.length = p.length + 4
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨z, w, hzD, hwD, hzr, hzx, hzy, hxz, hwr, hwx, hwy, hyw⟩ :=
    adjacent_cubic_two_ports_have_internal_third_neighbors D r x y
      hr hports hboundary hexact hcubic hxy
  have hxr : G.Adj x r := (hexact x hports.1).2 (Or.inl rfl)
  have hyr : G.Adj y r := (hexact y hports.2.1).2 (Or.inr rfl)
  have hno : ¬(z = w ∨ G.Adj z w) := by
    intro hcase
    exact M.isCounterexample.2
      (hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_adjacent_two_port_third_neighbors
        hports.2.2 hxr.symm hyr.symm hxy
        hzr hzx hzy hxz hwr hwx hwy hyw hcase)
  have hzw : z ≠ w := fun h => hno (Or.inl h)
  have hzw_adj : ¬G.Adj z w := fun h => hno (Or.inr h)
  rcases separated_third_neighbor_component_split D r x y z w
      hr hports hboundary hexact hcubic hxy
      ⟨hzD, hzr, hzx, hzy, hxz⟩ ⟨hwD, hwr, hwx, hwy, hyw⟩
      hzw hzw_adj with
    ⟨C, hzC, hwC⟩ |
    ⟨K, hzK, hKD, _hKproper, _hwK, hxK, hyK, _hKconn, hboundaryK⟩
  · have hroot :
        ∀ v, v ∈ (↑(D.erase x |>.erase y) : Set V) → v ≠ r := by
      intro v hv hvr
      have hvD : v ∈ D :=
        (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hv).2).2
      exact hr (hvr ▸ hvD)
    have havoidxy :
        ∀ v, v ∈ (↑(D.erase x |>.erase y) : Set V) →
          v ≠ x ∧ v ≠ y := by
      intro v hv
      exact ⟨(Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hv).2).1,
        (Finset.mem_erase.mp hv).1⟩
    obtain ⟨p, hp, havoid⟩ :=
      separated_third_neighbor_path hroot havoidxy C
        (by simp [hzD, hzx, hzy]) (by simp [hwD, hwx, hwy]) hzC hwC
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hrc, hlength⟩ :=
      separated_third_neighbor_cycle hp havoid hports.2.2
        hxr.symm hyr.symm hxz hyw
    exact ⟨z, w, p, c, hzD, hwD, hzw, hzw_adj, hxz, hyw,
      hp, havoid, hc, hrc, hlength⟩
  · obtain ⟨t, htK, hxt, htz⟩ :=
      M.exists_second_onePort_neighbor K x z hxK hzK hxz hboundaryK
    have hyr_ne : y ≠ r := fun h => hr (h ▸ hports.2.1)
    have htr : t ≠ r := fun h => hr (h ▸ hKD htK)
    have hyt : y ≠ t := fun h => hyK (h.symm ▸ htK)
    have hfour : ({r, y, z, t} : Finset V).card = 4 := by
      simp [hyr_ne.symm, hzr.symm, htr.symm, hzy.symm, hyt, htz.symm]
    have hsubset : ({r, y, z, t} : Finset V) ⊆ G.neighborFinset x := by
      intro v hv
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
      rcases hv with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · simpa only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset] using hxr
      · simpa only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset] using hxy
      · simpa only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset] using hxz
      · simpa only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset] using hxt
    have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsubset
    rw [hfour, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hcubic.1] at hcard
    omega

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.adjacent_cubic_two_ports_two_cycles
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.adjacent_cubic_two_ports_two_cycles
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D)
    (hports : x ∈ D ∧ y ∈ D ∧ x ≠ y)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ t, t ∉ D → G.Adj v t → t = r)
    (hexact :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y))
    (hcubic : G.degree x = 3 ∧ G.degree y = 3)
    (hxy : G.Adj x y) :
    ∃ (z w : V) (p : G.Walk z w) (c3 c4 : G.Walk x x),
      z ∈ D ∧ w ∈ D ∧ z ≠ w ∧ ¬G.Adj z w ∧
      G.Adj x z ∧ G.Adj y w ∧ p.IsPath ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ≠ r ∧ v ≠ x ∧ v ≠ y) ∧
      c3.IsCycle ∧ c3.length = p.length + 3 ∧
      c4.IsCycle ∧ c4.length = p.length + 4
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, w, p, c4, hzD, hwD, hzw, hzw_adj, hxz, hyw, hp, havoid,
      hc4, hrc4, hlength4⟩ :=
    M.adjacent_cubic_two_ports_path_cycle D r x y hr hports hboundary
      hexact hcubic hxy
  have havoidxy : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ≠ x ∧ v ≠ y := by
    intro v hv
    exact ⟨(havoid v hv).2.1, (havoid v hv).2.2⟩
  obtain ⟨c3, hc3, hlength3⟩ :=
    connector_path_edge_cycle hp havoidxy hports.2.2 hxz hyw.symm hzw hxy
  exact ⟨z, w, p, c3, c4, hzD, hwD, hzw, hzw_adj, hxz, hyw, hp,
    havoid, hc3, hlength3, hc4, hlength4⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.adjacent_cubic_two_ports_path_no_dyadic
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.adjacent_cubic_two_ports_path_no_dyadic
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D)
    (hports : x ∈ D ∧ y ∈ D ∧ x ≠ y)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ t, t ∉ D → G.Adj v t → t = r)
    (hexact :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y))
    (hcubic : G.degree x = 3 ∧ G.degree y = 3)
    (hxy : G.Adj x y) :
    ∃ (z w : V) (p : G.Walk z w),
      z ∈ D ∧ w ∈ D ∧ z ≠ w ∧ ¬G.Adj z w ∧
      G.Adj x z ∧ G.Adj y w ∧ p.IsPath ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ≠ r ∧ v ≠ x ∧ v ≠ y) ∧
      (∀ k, 2 ≤ k → p.length + 3 ≠ 2 ^ k) ∧
      (∀ k, 2 ≤ k → p.length + 4 ≠ 2 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, w, p, c3, c4, hzD, hwD, hzw, hzw_adj, hxz, hyw, hp,
      havoid, hc3, hlength3, hc4, hlength4⟩ :=
    M.adjacent_cubic_two_ports_two_cycles D r x y hr hports hboundary
      hexact hcubic hxy
  have hno3 : ∀ k, 2 ≤ k → p.length + 3 ≠ 2 ^ k := by
    intro k hk hlen
    apply M.isCounterexample.2
    exact ⟨k, x, c3, hk, hc3, hlength3.trans hlen⟩
  have hno4 : ∀ k, 2 ≤ k → p.length + 4 ≠ 2 ^ k := by
    intro k hk hlen
    apply M.isCounterexample.2
    exact ⟨k, x, c4, hk, hc4, hlength4.trans hlen⟩
  exact ⟨z, w, p, hzD, hwD, hzw, hzw_adj, hxz, hyw, hp, havoid,
    hno3, hno4⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.common_neighbor_eq_root_of_nonadjacent_ports
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.common_neighbor_eq_root_of_nonadjacent_ports
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    {r x y z : V}
    (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hxz : G.Adj x z) (hyz : G.Adj y z)
    (hzx : z ≠ x) (hzy : z ≠ y) :
    z = r
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hzroot
  let q : G.Walk r z :=
    SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hry (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hyz
      SimpleGraph.Walk.nil)
  have hq : q.IsPath := by
    have hq' : q.IsPath := by
      dsimp [q]
      refine (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff hry _).2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff hyz _).2
          ⟨SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.nil, by
            simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil, List.mem_singleton] using
              (Ne.symm hzy)⟩
      · simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil,
          List.mem_cons]
        intro hrq
        rcases hrq with hrq | hrq
        · exact hry.ne hrq
        · rcases hrq with hrq | hrq
          · exact (Ne.symm hzroot) hrq
          · simp at hrq
    simpa using hq'
  have hxnot : x ∉ q.support := by
    intro hxq
    simpa [q, hrx.ne.symm, hxy, hzx.symm] using hxq
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hclen⟩ := endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate
    hq hrx.symm hxz hxnot (Ne.symm hzroot) (by simp [q])
  apply M.isCounterexample.2
  refine ⟨2, r, c, by omega, hc, ?_⟩
  calc
    c.length = q.length + 2 := hclen
    _ = 4 := by rfl
    _ = 2 ^ 2 := by rfl

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.shared_root_quotient_residual_path
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.shared_root_quotient_residual_path
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    {r x y : V}
    (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (hnadj : ¬ G.Adj x y)
    (hroot_degree : 4 ≤ G.degree r) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ u v : V, ∃ p : G.Walk u v,
      k ≥ 2 ∧
      p.IsPath ∧
      (∀ w, w ∈ p.support → w ≠ x ∧ w ≠ y) ∧
      p.length + 2 = 2 ^ k ∧
      ((G.Adj x u ∧ G.Adj y v ∧ u ≠ r ∧ v ≠ r) ∨
        (G.Adj y u ∧ G.Adj x v ∧ u ≠ r ∧ v ≠ r))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcommon4 : ∀ z, z ≠ x → z ≠ y →
      (G.Adj x z ∧ G.Adj y z) → 4 ≤ G.degree z := by
    intro z hzx hzy hz
    have hzroot := M.common_neighbor_eq_root_of_nonadjacent_ports
      hrx hry hxy hz.1 hz.2 hzx hzy
    subst z
    exact hroot_degree
  obtain ⟨k, u, v, p, hk, hp, havoid, hlen, hadj⟩ :=
    M.nonadjacent_terminal_cross_path_of_common_degree_ge_four
      hxy hnadj hcommon4
  have hne : u ≠ v := by
    intro huv
    have hget : p.getVert 0 = p.getVert p.length := by
      simpa [huv]
    have hidx := hp.getVert_injOn
      (x₁ := 0) (x₂ := p.length)
      (show 0 ≤ p.length by exact Nat.zero_le _)
      (show p.length ≤ p.length by exact le_rfl) hget
    have hpow : 4 ≤ 2 ^ k := four_le_pow_two hk
    omega
  have hlong : 1 < p.length := by
    have hpow : 4 ≤ 2 ^ k := four_le_pow_two hk
    omega
  rcases hadj with ⟨hxu, hyv⟩ | ⟨hyu, hxv⟩
  · by_cases hur : u = r
    · exfalso
      subst u
      have hyavoid : y ∉ p.support := by
        intro hy
        exact (havoid y hy).2 rfl
      have hcycle : HasPowerOfTwoCycle G := by
        obtain ⟨c, hc, hclen⟩ := endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate
          hp hry.symm hyv hyavoid hne hlong
        refine ⟨k, r, c, hk, hc, ?_⟩
        exact hclen.trans hlen
      exact M.isCounterexample.2 hcycle
    · by_cases hvr : v = r
      · exfalso
        subst v
        have hxavoid : x ∉ p.support := by
          intro hx
          exact (havoid x hx).1 rfl
        have hcycle : HasPowerOfTwoCycle G := by
          obtain ⟨c, hc, hclen⟩ := endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate
            hp hxu hrx.symm hxavoid hne hlong
          refine ⟨k, u, c, hk, hc, ?_⟩
          exact hclen.trans hlen
        exact M.isCounterexample.2 hcycle
      · exact ⟨k, u, v, p, hk, hp, havoid, hlen,
          Or.inl ⟨hxu, hyv, hur, hvr⟩⟩
  · by_cases hvr : v = r
    · exfalso
      subst v
      have hyavoid : y ∉ p.support := by
        intro hy
        exact (havoid y hy).2 rfl
      have hcycle : HasPowerOfTwoCycle G := by
        obtain ⟨c, hc, hclen⟩ := endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate
          hp hyu hry.symm hyavoid hne hlong
        refine ⟨k, u, c, hk, hc, ?_⟩
        exact hclen.trans hlen
      exact M.isCounterexample.2 hcycle
    · by_cases hur : u = r
      · exfalso
        subst u
        have hxavoid : x ∉ p.support := by
          intro hx
          exact (havoid x hx).1 rfl
        have hcycle : HasPowerOfTwoCycle G := by
          obtain ⟨c, hc, hclen⟩ := endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate
            hp hrx.symm hxv hxavoid hne hlong
          refine ⟨k, r, c, hk, hc, ?_⟩
          exact hclen.trans hlen
        exact M.isCounterexample.2 hcycle
      · exact ⟨k, u, v, p, hk, hp, havoid, hlen,
          Or.inr ⟨hyu, hxv, hur, hvr⟩⟩

name: Erdos64.separated_third_neighbor_cycle
statement:
theorem separated_third_neighbor_cycle
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {r x y z w : V} {p : G.Walk z w}
    (hp : p.IsPath)
    (havoid : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support →
      v ≠ r ∧ v ≠ x ∧ v ≠ y)
    (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hrx : G.Adj r x)
    (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (hxz : G.Adj x z)
    (hyw : G.Adj y w) :
    ∃ c : G.Walk x x, c.IsCycle ∧ r ∈ c.support ∧
      c.length = p.length + 4
proof:
:= by
  have hzavoid := havoid z p.start_mem_support
  have hwavoid := havoid w p.end_mem_support
  let q : G.Walk x y :=
    SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hxz
      (p.append (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hyw.symm SimpleGraph.Walk.nil))
  have htail :
      (p.append (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hyw.symm SimpleGraph.Walk.nil)).IsPath := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.isPath_def, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_append]
    simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil,
      List.tail_cons]
    apply List.nodup_append.mpr
    refine ⟨hp.support_nodup, by simp, ?_⟩
    intro v hv b hb
    simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hb
    subst b
    exact (havoid v hv).2.2
  have hq : q.IsPath := by
    dsimp [q]
    apply (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff hxz _).2
    refine ⟨htail, ?_⟩
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_append]
    simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil,
      List.tail_cons, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton]
    intro hxmem
    rcases hxmem with hxmem | rfl
    · exact (havoid x hxmem).2.1 rfl
    · exact hxy rfl
  let ret : G.Walk y x :=
    SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hry.symm
      (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hrx SimpleGraph.Walk.nil)
  have hret : ret.IsPath := by
    dsimp [ret]
    apply (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff hry.symm _).2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · apply (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff hrx _).2
      exact ⟨SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.nil, by
        simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil, List.mem_singleton] using hrx.ne⟩
    · simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil,
        List.mem_cons]
      intro hy
      rcases hy with hy | hy
      · exact hry.ne.symm hy
      · rcases hy with hy | hy
        · exact hxy.symm hy
        · simp at hy
  have hdis : q.support.tail.Disjoint ret.support.tail := by
    dsimp [q, ret]
    simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_append,
      SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil, List.tail_cons]
    rw [List.disjoint_left]
    intro v hv hu
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hv with hv | hv
    · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hu with hu | hu
      · exact (havoid v hv).1 hu
      · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hu
        exact (havoid v hv).2.1 hu
    · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hv
      subst v
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hu with hu | hu
      · exact hry.ne hu.symm
      · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hu
        exact hxy hu.symm
  let c := q.append ret
  have hqLength : 1 < q.length := by
    simp [q, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_append]
  have hc : c.IsCycle := by
    dsimp [c]
    exact hq.isCycle_append hret hdis (Or.inl hqLength)
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp [c, ret]
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_append]
    simp [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil,
      List.tail_cons]
  · simp [c, q, ret, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_append,
      SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons]

name: Erdos64.four_le_pow_two
statement: theorem four_le_pow_two {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) : 4 ≤ 2 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero => omega
  | succ k =>
    cases k with
    | zero => omega
    | succ k =>
      rw [Nat.pow_succ]
      have hpos : 0 < 2 ^ (Nat.succ k) := by positivity
      omega

name: Erdos64.exists_pow_two_le_and_lt_succ_pow_two
statement:
theorem exists_pow_two_le_and_lt_succ_pow_two {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, 2 ^ k ≤ n ∧ n < 2 ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hnzero : n = 0
    · subst n
      exact ⟨0, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
    · obtain ⟨k, hlo, hhi⟩ := ih (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hnzero)
      by_cases hnext : n + 1 < 2 ^ (k + 1)
      · exact ⟨k, by omega, hnext⟩
      · have heq : n + 1 = 2 ^ (k + 1) := by omega
        refine ⟨k + 1, ?_, ?_⟩
        · exact heq.ge
        · calc
            n + 1 = 2 ^ (k + 1) := heq
            _ < 2 ^ (k + 1) * 2 := by
              have hpos : 0 < 2 ^ (k + 1) := by positivity
              omega
            _ = 2 ^ (k + 1 + 1) := (Nat.pow_succ 2 (k + 1)).symm

name: Erdos64.exists_dyadic_point_of_interval
statement:
theorem exists_dyadic_point_of_interval
    {m M : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hM : 4 ≤ M) (hreaches : 2 * m ≤ M) :
    ∃ k t : ℕ, 2 ≤ k ∧
      m + t = 2 ^ k ∧ m + t ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm4 : 4 ≤ m
  · obtain ⟨k, hlo, hhi⟩ :=
      exists_pow_two_le_and_lt_succ_pow_two hm
    have hk : 2 ≤ k := by
      by_contra hk'
      have hklt : k < 2 := by omega
      interval_cases k <;> norm_num at hhi <;> omega
    have hmnext : m ≤ 2 ^ (k + 1) := by omega
    have hnext_le : 2 ^ (k + 1) ≤ M := by
      calc
        2 ^ (k + 1) = 2 ^ k * 2 := by rw [Nat.pow_succ]
        _ ≤ m * 2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right 2 hlo
        _ = 2 * m := by omega
        _ ≤ M := hreaches
    refine ⟨k + 1, 2 ^ (k + 1) - m, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · omega
    · exact Nat.add_sub_of_le hmnext
    · rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le hmnext]
      exact hnext_le
  · have hm_le : m ≤ 4 := by omega
    refine ⟨2, 4 - m, by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Nat.add_sub_of_le hm_le
    · rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le hm_le]
      exact hM

name: Erdos64.SevenLengthArithmetic.mem_lengths_iff
statement:
theorem SevenLengthArithmetic.mem_lengths_iff
    (s : SevenLengthArithmetic) (x : ℕ) :
    x ∈ s.lengths ↔
      x = s.n ∨
      x = s.p + s.alpha + s.beta ∨
      x = s.p + s.gamma + s.delta ∨
      x = s.q + s.beta + s.gamma ∨
      x = s.q + s.delta + s.alpha ∨
      x = s.p + s.q + s.gamma + s.alpha ∨
      x = s.p + s.q + s.beta + s.delta
proof:
:= by
  simp [SevenLengthArithmetic.lengths, or_comm]

name: Erdos64.SevenLengthArithmetic.exists_dyadic_entry
statement:
theorem SevenLengthArithmetic.exists_dyadic_entry
    (s : SevenLengthArithmetic)
    (h : ∃ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k ∧ 2 ^ k ∈ s.lengths) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k ∧
      (s.n = 2 ^ k ∨
        s.p + s.alpha + s.beta = 2 ^ k ∨
        s.p + s.gamma + s.delta = 2 ^ k ∨
        s.q + s.beta + s.gamma = 2 ^ k ∨
        s.q + s.delta + s.alpha = 2 ^ k ∨
        s.p + s.q + s.gamma + s.alpha = 2 ^ k ∨
        s.p + s.q + s.beta + s.delta = 2 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hm⟩ := h
  have hm' := (s.mem_lengths_iff (2 ^ k)).mp hm
  refine ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
  rcases hm' with h | h | h | h | h | h | h
  · exact Or.inl h.symm
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h.symm)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl h.symm))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl h.symm)))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl h.symm))))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl h.symm)))))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr h.symm)))))

name: Erdos64.hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_realized_step
statement:
theorem hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_realized_step
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {m g M : ℕ}
    (hrealize :
      ∀ t : ℕ, m + g * t ≤ M →
        HasSimpleCycleOfLength G (m + g * t))
    (hdyadic :
      ∃ k t : ℕ, 2 ≤ k ∧
        m + g * t = 2 ^ k ∧ m + g * t ≤ M) :
    HasPowerOfTwoCycle G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, t, hk, hlength, hbound⟩ := hdyadic
  exact hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_simpleCycleOfLength
    (hrealize t hbound) hk hlength

name: Erdos64.exists_step_of_dyadic_residue
statement:
theorem exists_step_of_dyadic_residue
    {m g M k : ℕ}
    (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (hlo : m ≤ 2 ^ k)
    (hhi : 2 ^ k ≤ M)
    (hres : g ∣ 2 ^ k - m) :
    ∃ t : ℕ, m + g * t = 2 ^ k ∧ m + g * t ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  rcases hres with ⟨t, ht⟩
  refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_⟩
  · omega
  · omega

name: Erdos64.hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_realized_step_of_residue
statement:
theorem hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_realized_step_of_residue
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {m g M : ℕ}
    (hrealize :
      ∀ t : ℕ, m + g * t ≤ M →
        HasSimpleCycleOfLength G (m + g * t))
    (hdyadic :
      ∃ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k ∧ m ≤ 2 ^ k ∧ 2 ^ k ≤ M ∧
        g ∣ 2 ^ k - m) :
    HasPowerOfTwoCycle G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hlo, hhi, hres⟩ := hdyadic
  obtain ⟨t, hlength, hbound⟩ :=
    exists_step_of_dyadic_residue hk hlo hhi hres
  exact hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_realized_step hrealize
    ⟨k, t, hk, hlength, hbound⟩

name: Erdos64.residual_path_root_internal_split
statement:
theorem residual_path_root_internal_split
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {r u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v}
    (hp : p.IsPath) (hru : u ≠ r) (hrv : v ≠ r)
    (hrp : r ∈ p.support) :
    ∃ (a : G.Walk u r) (b : G.Walk r v),
      a.IsPath ∧ b.IsPath ∧
      a.append b = p ∧
      a.support ⊆ p.support ∧ b.support ⊆ p.support ∧
      a.length + b.length = p.length ∧
      0 < a.length ∧ 0 < b.length ∧
      r ∉ a.support.dropLast ∧ r ∉ b.support.tail
proof:
:= by
  let a : G.Walk u r := p.takeUntil r hrp
  let b : G.Walk r v := p.dropUntil r hrp
  have hab : a.append b = p := by
    dsimp [a, b]
    exact p.take_spec hrp
  have ha : a.IsPath := by
    dsimp [a]
    exact hp.takeUntil hrp
  have hb : b.IsPath := by
    dsimp [b]
    exact hp.dropUntil hrp
  have hnodup : (a.support.dropLast ++ b.support).Nodup := by
    rw [← SimpleGraph.Walk.support_append_eq_support_dropLast_append, hab]
    exact hp.support_nodup
  have hdisj₁ : a.support.dropLast.Disjoint b.support :=
    List.disjoint_of_nodup_append hnodup
  have hnodup' : (a.support ++ b.support.tail).Nodup := by
    rw [← SimpleGraph.Walk.support_append, hab]
    exact hp.support_nodup
  have hdisj₂ : a.support.Disjoint b.support.tail :=
    List.disjoint_of_nodup_append hnodup'
  have hra : r ∈ b.support := by simp [b]
  have hraa : r ∈ a.support := by simp [a]
  have hasub : a.support ⊆ p.support := by
    dsimp [a]
    exact p.support_takeUntil_subset_support hrp
  have hbsub : b.support ⊆ p.support := by
    dsimp [b]
    exact p.support_dropUntil_subset_support hrp
  have ha_nil : ¬ a.Nil := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.nil_takeUntil]
    exact hru
  have hb_nil : ¬ b.Nil := by
    intro hnil
    exact hrv ((SimpleGraph.Walk.Nil.eq hnil).symm)
  have ha_pos : 0 < a.length := SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.mp ha_nil
  have hb_pos : 0 < b.length := SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.mp hb_nil
  refine ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hasub, hbsub, ?_, ha_pos, hb_pos, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← SimpleGraph.Walk.length_append, hab]
  · intro h
    exact (List.disjoint_left.mp hdisj₁ h hra).elim
  · intro h
    exact (List.disjoint_left.mp hdisj₂ hraa h).elim

name: Erdos64.SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.support_subset_of_boundary_avoiding_root
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil =>
      intro z hz
      simp at hz
      subst z
      exact hstart
  | @cons a b d h q ih =>
      intro z hz
      simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, List.mem_cons] at hz
      rcases hz with rfl | hz
      · exact hstart
      · have hqpath : q.IsPath := hp.of_cons
        have hbD : b ∈ D := by
          by_contra hbD
          have hbr : b = r := hboundary a hstart b hbD h
          apply hroot
          have hbmem : b ∈ (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons h q).support := by
            simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, List.mem_cons]
            exact Or.inr q.start_mem_support
          simpa [hbr] using hbmem
        have hrootq : r ∉ q.support := by
          intro hrq
          apply hroot
          simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, List.mem_cons]
          exact Or.inr hrq
        exact ih hqpath hbD hrootq z hz

name: Erdos64.SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.dropLast_support_subset_of_boundary
statement:
theorem SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.dropLast_support_subset_of_boundary
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {D : Finset V} {r u : V} {a : G.Walk u r}
    (ha : a.IsPath) (hpos : 0 < a.length) (hstart : u ∈ D)
    (hroot : r ∉ a.support.dropLast)
    (hboundary : ∀ x, x ∈ D → ∀ y, y ∉ D → G.Adj x y → y = r) :
    ∀ z, z ∈ a.support.dropLast → z ∈ D
proof:
:= by
  have hnil : ¬ a.Nil := SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.mpr hpos
  have hdrop : r ∉ a.dropLast.support := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_dropLast hnil]
    exact hroot
  have hsubset := SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.support_subset_of_boundary_avoiding_root
    ha.dropLast hstart hdrop hboundary
  intro z hz
  apply hsubset z
  rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_dropLast hnil]
  exact hz

name: Erdos64.SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.tail_support_subset_of_boundary
statement:
theorem SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.tail_support_subset_of_boundary
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {D : Finset V} {r v : V} {b : G.Walk r v}
    (hb : b.IsPath) (hpos : 0 < b.length) (hend : v ∈ D)
    (hroot : r ∉ b.support.tail)
    (hboundary : ∀ x, x ∈ D → ∀ y, y ∉ D → G.Adj x y → y = r) :
    ∀ z, z ∈ b.support.tail → z ∈ D
proof:
:= by
  have hnil : ¬ b.Nil := SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.mpr hpos
  have hdrop : r ∉ b.reverse.dropLast.support := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_dropLast]
    · simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_reverse, List.dropLast_reverse]
      intro hz
      apply hroot
      simpa using hz
    · simpa using hnil
  have hsubset := SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.support_subset_of_boundary_avoiding_root
    hb.reverse.dropLast hend hdrop hboundary
  intro z hz
  have hzrev : z ∈ b.reverse.dropLast.support := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_dropLast]
    · simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_reverse, List.dropLast_reverse]
      simpa only [List.mem_reverse] using hz
    · simpa using hnil
  exact hsubset z hzrev

name: Erdos64.SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.cycle_of_first_reunion
statement:
theorem SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.cycle_of_first_reunion
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {w z : V}
    (p q : G.Walk w z) (hp : p.IsPath) (hq : q.IsPath)
    (hfirst : p.snd ≠ q.snd) {i j : ℕ}
    (hi_pos : 0 < i) (hi_le : i ≤ p.length)
    (hj_pos : 0 < j) (hj_le : j ≤ q.length)
    (hmeet : p.getVert i = q.getVert j)
    (hdisjoint :
