name: Erdos64.ShortestCycleCertificate.exists_degree_three_bridge_or_excursion
statement:
theorem ShortestCycleCertificate.exists_degree_three_bridge_or_excursion
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (certificate : ShortestCycleCertificate G)
    (minimalCounterexample : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G)
    (hconn : G.Connected)
    (hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ certificate.cycle.support)
    (hvhigh : 4 ≤ G.degree v) :
    ∃ w, G.Adj v w ∧ w ∉ certificate.cycle.support ∧
      G.degree w = 3 ∧
      ((∃ bridge : CycleBridgePath G certificate.cycle,
          bridge.left = v) ∨
       (∃ (p : G.Walk w v) (i : ℕ),
          p.IsPath ∧ 0 < i ∧ i ≤ p.length ∧
            p.getVert i = v ∧
            (p.take i).support.dropLast.Disjoint certificate.cycle.support ∧
            ((∃ c : G.Walk v v, c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = i + 1) ∨
              i = 1)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hvw, hw, hwdeg, hcase⟩ :=
    certificate.exists_degree_three_bridge_or_same_return
      minimalCounterexample hconn hmin hv hvhigh
  rcases hcase with hbridge | ⟨p, i, hp, hi_pos, hi_le, hreturn, hinterior⟩
  · exact ⟨w, hvw, hw, hwdeg, Or.inl hbridge⟩
  · obtain hcycle | hi_one :=
      SimpleGraph.Walk.same_attachment_excursion hvw p hp
        hi_pos hi_le hreturn
    · exact ⟨w, hvw, hw, hwdeg, Or.inr
        ⟨p, i, hp, hi_pos, hi_le, hreturn, hinterior, Or.inl hcycle⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨w, hvw, hw, hwdeg, Or.inr
        ⟨p, i, hp, hi_pos, hi_le, hreturn, hinterior, Or.inr hi_one⟩⟩

name: Erdos64.exists_two_other_neighbors_of_degree_three
statement:
theorem exists_two_other_neighbors_of_degree_three
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v w : V} (hvw : G.Adj v w) (hw : G.degree w = 3) :
    ∃ x y, x ≠ y ∧ G.Adj w x ∧ G.Adj w y ∧ x ≠ v ∧ y ≠ v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hvw' : G.Adj w v := hvw.symm
  have hv_mem : v ∈ G.neighborFinset w := by
    simpa [SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_eq_filter] using hvw'
  let N := (G.neighborFinset w).erase v
  have hNcard : N.card = 2 := by
    dsimp [N]
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hv_mem,
      SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hw]
  have hNone : 1 < N.card := by omega
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.mp hNone
  have hx' : x ≠ v ∧ x ∈ G.neighborFinset w :=
    Finset.mem_erase.mp hx
  have hy' : y ≠ v ∧ y ∈ G.neighborFinset w :=
    Finset.mem_erase.mp hy
  have hxadj : G.Adj w x := by
    simpa [SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_eq_filter] using hx'.2
  have hyadj : G.Adj w y := by
    simpa [SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_eq_filter] using hy'.2
  exact ⟨x, y, hxy, hxadj, hyadj, hx'.1, hy'.1⟩

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.high_degree_neighborFinset_card_le_two_of_degree_eq_three
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.high_degree_neighborFinset_card_le_two_of_degree_eq_three
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (minimalCounterexample : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G)
    {v : V} (hv : G.degree v = 3) :
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun w => 4 ≤ G.degree w)).filter (G.Adj v)).card ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H : Finset V := Finset.univ.filter (fun w => 4 ≤ G.degree w)
  let N : Finset V := H.filter (G.Adj v)
  obtain ⟨u, huv, hdu⟩ :=
    minimalCounterexample.vertexMinimal.exists_adjacent_degree_eq_three v
  have hu_mem : u ∈ G.neighborFinset v := by
    simpa [SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_eq_filter] using huv
  have hsub : N ⊆ (G.neighborFinset v).erase u := by
    intro x hx
    have hxN : x ∈ H ∧ G.Adj v x := by
      simpa [N] using hx
    have hxhigh : 4 ≤ G.degree x := by
      simpa [H] using hxN.1
    refine Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hxu
      subst x
      omega
    · simpa [SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_eq_filter] using hxN.2
  have hcard : N.card ≤ ((G.neighborFinset v).erase u).card :=
    Finset.card_le_card hsub
  rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hu_mem,
    SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hv] at hcard
  simpa [N] using hcard

name: Erdos64.ShortestCycleCertificate.hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_two_edge_ear
statement:
theorem ShortestCycleCertificate.hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_two_edge_ear
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (certificate : ShortestCycleCertificate G)
    (bridge : CycleBridgePath G certificate.cycle)
    (hpath : bridge.path.length = 2) :
    HasPowerOfTwoCycle G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, q, hdecomp⟩ :=
    bridge.exists_complementary_arcs certificate.isCycle
  have hpvalid :
      1 < bridge.path.length ∨
        1 < (p : G.Walk bridge.left bridge.right).length :=
    Or.inl (by omega)
  have hqvalid :
      1 < bridge.path.length ∨
        1 < (q : G.Walk bridge.right bridge.left).length :=
    Or.inl (by omega)
  have hbounds :=
    certificate.complementary_arc_le_bridge_length
      bridge hdecomp hpvalid hqvalid
  have hsum := bridge.complementary_arcs_length_add hdecomp
  have hp_pos : 0 < (p : G.Walk bridge.left bridge.right).length := by
    apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    intro hp_zero
    have hp_nil :=
      SimpleGraph.Walk.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hp_zero
    exact bridge.distinct_attachments
      ((p.property.nil_iff_eq).mp hp_nil)
  have hq_pos : 0 < (q : G.Walk bridge.right bridge.left).length := by
    apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    intro hq_zero
    have hq_nil :=
      SimpleGraph.Walk.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hq_zero
    exact bridge.distinct_attachments.symm
      ((q.property.nil_iff_eq).mp hq_nil)
  have hcycle_ge : 3 ≤ certificate.cycle.length :=
    certificate.isCycle.three_le_length
  have hor :
      (p : G.Walk bridge.left bridge.right).length = 2 ∨
        (q : G.Walk bridge.right bridge.left).length = 2 := by
    omega
  rcases hor with hp_two | hq_two
  · obtain ⟨c, hc, hlength⟩ :=
      bridge.cycle_of_extracted_arc hdecomp hpvalid
    refine hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_witness (k := 2) c (by omega) hc ?_
    omega
  · have hq_sub_cycle :
        (q : G.Walk bridge.right bridge.left).support ⊆
          certificate.cycle.support := by
      intro z hz
      have hzappend : z ∈
          ((p : G.Walk bridge.left bridge.right).append
            (q : G.Walk bridge.right bridge.left)).support := by
        simp [hz]
      rw [hdecomp] at hzappend
      exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_rotate_iff certificate.cycle
        bridge.left bridge.left_mem_cycle).mp hzappend
    have hdisjoint :=
      bridge.reverse.tails_disjoint_of_arc_support_subset
        q.property hq_sub_cycle
    have hqvalid' :
        1 < bridge.reverse.path.length ∨
          (q : G.Walk bridge.right bridge.left).length > 1 := by
      simpa [CycleBridgePath.reverse, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_reverse] using hqvalid
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hlength⟩ :=
      bridge.reverse.cycle_of_arc q.property hdisjoint hqvalid'
    have hlength' : c.length =
        bridge.path.length +
          (q : G.Walk bridge.right bridge.left).length := by
      simpa [CycleBridgePath.reverse, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_reverse] using
        hlength
    refine hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_witness (k := 2) c (by omega) hc ?_
    omega

name: Erdos64.exists_direct_ear_or_two_external_branches_of_degree_three
statement:
theorem exists_direct_ear_or_two_external_branches_of_degree_three
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {s v w : V} {cycle : G.Walk s s}
    (hcycle : cycle.IsCycle)
    (hv : v ∈ cycle.support) (hw : w ∉ cycle.support)
    (hvw : G.Adj v w) (hwdeg : G.degree w = 3) :
    (∃ x, x ∈ cycle.support ∧ x ≠ v ∧ G.Adj w x ∧
      ∃ bridge : CycleBridgePath G cycle,
        bridge.left = v ∧ bridge.right = x) ∨
    (∃ x y, x ≠ y ∧ G.Adj w x ∧ G.Adj w y ∧
      x ≠ v ∧ y ≠ v ∧ x ∉ cycle.support ∧ y ∉ cycle.support)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, hwx, hwy, hxv, hyv⟩ :=
    exists_two_other_neighbors_of_degree_three hvw hwdeg
  by_cases hx : x ∈ cycle.support
  · left
    refine ⟨x, hx, hxv, hwx, ?_⟩
    let bridge := CycleBridgePath.of_two_edge_ear hcycle hv hx
      hvw hw hwx (Ne.symm hxv)
    exact ⟨bridge, rfl, rfl⟩
  · by_cases hy : y ∈ cycle.support
    · left
      refine ⟨y, hy, hyv, hwy, ?_⟩
      let bridge := CycleBridgePath.of_two_edge_ear hcycle hv hy
        hvw hw hwy (Ne.symm hyv)
      exact ⟨bridge, rfl, rfl⟩
    · right
      exact ⟨x, y, hxy, hwx, hwy, hxv, hyv, hx, hy⟩

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.high_degree_count_mul_four_le_degree_three_count_mul_two
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.high_degree_count_mul_four_le_degree_three_count_mul_two
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (minimalCounterexample : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => 4 ≤ G.degree v)).card * 4 ≤
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => G.degree v = 3)).card * 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H : Finset V := Finset.univ.filter (fun v => 4 ≤ G.degree v)
  let L : Finset V := Finset.univ.filter (fun v => G.degree v = 3)
  have hdouble : H.card * 4 ≤ L.card * 2 := by
    apply Finset.card_mul_le_card_mul (fun u v => G.Adj u v)
    · intro u hu
      have hu4 : 4 ≤ G.degree u := by
        simpa [H] using hu
      have hcard :
          (L.bipartiteAbove (fun u v => G.Adj u v) u).card =
            G.degree u := by
        rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
        congr 1
        ext v
        constructor
        · intro hv
          have hv' : v ∈ L ∧ G.Adj u v := by
            simpa [Finset.bipartiteAbove] using hv
          have huv : G.Adj u v := hv'.2
          simpa [SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_eq_filter] using huv
        · intro hv
          have huv : G.Adj u v := by
            simpa [SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_eq_filter] using hv
          have hv3 :
              G.degree v = 3 :=
            minimalCounterexample.neighbor_degree_eq_three_of_degree_ge_four
              hu4 huv
          simpa [Finset.bipartiteAbove] using
            (show v ∈ L ∧ G.Adj u v from ⟨by
              simpa [L] using hv3, huv⟩)
      rw [hcard]
      exact hu4
    · intro v hv
      have hv3 : G.degree v = 3 := by
        simpa [L] using hv
      have hbound :=
        minimalCounterexample.high_degree_neighborFinset_card_le_two_of_degree_eq_three
          hv3
      have hcard :
          (H.bipartiteBelow (fun u v => G.Adj u v) v).card =
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun u => 4 ≤ G.degree u)).filter
              (G.Adj v)).card := by
        congr 1
        ext u
        simp only [Finset.bipartiteBelow, Finset.mem_filter]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hu, huv⟩
          exact ⟨by simpa [H] using hu, huv.symm⟩
        · rintro ⟨hu, huv⟩
          exact ⟨by simpa [H] using hu, huv.symm⟩
      rw [hcard]
      exact hbound
  simpa [H, L] using hdouble

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.high_degree_count_mul_two_le_degree_three_count
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.high_degree_count_mul_two_le_degree_three_count
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (minimalCounterexample : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => 4 ≤ G.degree v)).card * 2 ≤
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => G.degree v = 3)).card
proof:
:= by
  have hinc :=
    minimalCounterexample.high_degree_count_mul_four_le_degree_three_count_mul_two
  omega

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.exists_degree_eq_three
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.exists_degree_eq_three
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (minimalCounterexample : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => G.degree v = 3)).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H : Finset V := Finset.univ.filter (fun v => 4 ≤ G.degree v)
  let L : Finset V := Finset.univ.filter (fun v => G.degree v = 3)
  change L.Nonempty
  have hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3 :=
    minimalCounterexample.vertexMinimal.isCounterexample.1
  have hV : Nonempty V := by
    by_contra hV
    letI : IsEmpty V := ⟨fun v => hV ⟨v⟩⟩
    have hzero : (3 : ℕ) ≤ 0 := by
      simpa using hmin
    omega
  by_contra hL
  have hLempty : L = ∅ :=
    Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hL
  have hLcard : L.card = 0 :=
    Finset.card_eq_zero.mpr hLempty
  have hinc :
      H.card * 4 ≤ L.card * 2 := by
    simpa [H, L] using
      minimalCounterexample.high_degree_count_mul_four_le_degree_three_count_mul_two
  have hHcard : H.card = 0 := by
    have hbound : H.card * 4 ≤ 0 := by
      simpa [hLcard] using hinc
    omega
  have hHempty : H = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hHcard
  obtain ⟨v⟩ := hV
  have hvdeg : G.degree v ≥ 3 :=
    degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hmin v
  have hvnot3 : G.degree v ≠ 3 := by
    intro hv3
    apply hL
    exact ⟨v, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ v, hv3⟩⟩
  have hvhigh : 4 ≤ G.degree v := by
    omega
  have hvH : v ∈ H := by
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ v, hvhigh⟩
  rw [hHempty] at hvH
  simpa using hvH

name: Erdos64.exists_deficient_boundary_vertex
statement:
theorem exists_deficient_boundary_vertex
    {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) [Fintype V]
    [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hmin : ∀ v, 3 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (G.Adj v)).card)
    (hcritical : IsSubgraphCritical G)
    {U K : Finset V}
    (hU_nonempty : U.Nonempty)
    (hK_nonempty : K.Nonempty)
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint U K)
    (hU_degree : ∀ v, v ∈ U → 2 ≤ internalDegree G U v)
    (hseparated :
      ∀ x, x ∉ U → x ∉ K → ∀ y, y ∈ K → ¬G.Adj x y) :
    ∃ v, v ∈ U ∧ 2 ≤ internalDegree G U v ∧
      internalDegree G (Finset.univ \ K) v ≤ 2 ∧
      ∃ w, w ∈ K ∧ G.Adj v w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S := Finset.univ \ K
  have hS_nonempty : S.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hU_nonempty
    have huK : u ∉ K := by
      intro huK
      exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisjoint) hu huK
    exact ⟨u, Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ u, huK⟩⟩
  have hS_proper : S ≠ Finset.univ := by
    intro hS
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hK_nonempty
    have hkS : k ∈ S := hS ▸ Finset.mem_univ k
    exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hkS).2 hk
  obtain ⟨v, hvS, hvlow⟩ := hcritical S hS_nonempty hS_proper
  have hvU : v ∈ U := by
    by_contra hvU
    have hvK : v ∉ K := by
      intro hvK
      exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hvS).2 hvK
    have hsubset :
        (Finset.univ.filter (G.Adj v)) ⊆ (S.filter (G.Adj v)) := by
      intro w hw
      have hwAdj : G.Adj v w := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hw).2
      have hwS : w ∈ S := by
        apply Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr
        refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ w, ?_⟩
        intro hwK
        exact (hseparated v hvU hvK w hwK) hwAdj
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hwS, hwAdj⟩
    have hthree :
        3 ≤ (S.filter (G.Adj v)).card :=
      le_trans (hmin v) (Finset.card_le_card hsubset)
    have hbad : 3 ≤ 2 := le_trans hthree hvlow
    omega
  have hvK_neighbor : ∃ w, w ∈ K ∧ G.Adj v w := by
    by_contra hnone
    have hno : ∀ w, w ∈ K → ¬G.Adj v w := by
      intro w hwK hwAdj
      exact hnone ⟨w, hwK, hwAdj⟩
    have hsubset :
        (Finset.univ.filter (G.Adj v)) ⊆ (S.filter (G.Adj v)) := by
      intro w hw
      have hwAdj : G.Adj v w := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hw).2
      have hwS : w ∈ S := by
        apply Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr
        refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ w, ?_⟩
        intro hwK
        exact (hno w hwK) hwAdj
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hwS, hwAdj⟩
    have hthree :
        3 ≤ (S.filter (G.Adj v)).card :=
      le_trans (hmin v) (Finset.card_le_card hsubset)
    have hbad : 3 ≤ 2 := le_trans hthree hvlow
    omega
  exact ⟨v, hvU, hU_degree v hvU, hvlow, hvK_neighbor⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.exists_deficient_boundary_vertex
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.exists_deficient_boundary_vertex
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (minimalCounterexample : MinimalCounterexample G)
    {U K : Finset V}
    (hU_nonempty : U.Nonempty)
    (hK_nonempty : K.Nonempty)
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint U K)
    (hU_degree : ∀ v, v ∈ U → 2 ≤ internalDegree G U v)
    (hseparated :
      ∀ x, x ∉ U → x ∉ K → ∀ y, y ∈ K → ¬G.Adj x y) :
    ∃ v, v ∈ U ∧ 2 ≤ internalDegree G U v ∧
      internalDegree G (Finset.univ \ K) v ≤ 2 ∧
      ∃ w, w ∈ K ∧ G.Adj v w
proof:
:= by
  have hmin : ∀ v, 3 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (G.Adj v)).card := by
    intro v
    have hv := degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G
      minimalCounterexample.isCounterexample.1 v
    have hv' : 3 ≤ (G.neighborFinset v).card := by
      simpa only [SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] using hv
    simpa [SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_def] using hv'
  exact Erdos64.exists_deficient_boundary_vertex G hmin
    minimalCounterexample.isSubgraphCritical hU_nonempty hK_nonempty
    hdisjoint hU_degree hseparated

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.degree_three_count_ge_two_thirds
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.degree_three_count_ge_two_thirds
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (minimalCounterexample : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G) :
    2 * Fintype.card V ≤
      3 * (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => G.degree v = 3)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H : Finset V := Finset.univ.filter (fun v => 4 ≤ G.degree v)
  let L : Finset V := Finset.univ.filter (fun v => G.degree v = 3)
  have hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3 :=
    minimalCounterexample.vertexMinimal.isCounterexample.1
  have hpartition : L ∪ H = Finset.univ := by
    ext v
    simp only [L, H, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ,
      true_and]
    change (G.degree v = 3 ∨ 4 ≤ G.degree v) ↔ True
    have hv : 3 ≤ G.degree v :=
      degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hmin v
    constructor
    · intro _
      trivial
    · intro _
      by_cases hv3 : G.degree v = 3
      · exact Or.inl hv3
      · exact Or.inr (by omega)
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint L H := by
    refine Finset.disjoint_left.2 ?_
    intro v hvL hvH
    have hv3 : G.degree v = 3 := by
      simpa [L] using hvL
    have hv4 : 4 ≤ G.degree v := by
      simpa [H] using hvH
    omega
  have hcard :
      Fintype.card V = L.card + H.card := by
    calc
      Fintype.card V = (Finset.univ : Finset V).card := by
        simp
      _ = (L ∪ H).card := by rw [hpartition]
      _ = L.card + H.card := Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisjoint
  have hcount : 2 * H.card ≤ L.card := by
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm, H, L] using
      minimalCounterexample.high_degree_count_mul_two_le_degree_three_count
  rw [hcard]
  change 2 * (L.card + H.card) ≤ 3 * L.card
  omega

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.exists_edgeMinimal_predominantly_cubic
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.exists_edgeMinimal_predominantly_cubic
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (minimalCounterexample : MinimalCounterexample G) :
    ∃ (H : SimpleGraph V) (_ : DecidableRel H.Adj),
      EdgeMinimalCounterexample H ∧
        2 * Fintype.card V ≤
          3 * (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => H.degree v = 3)).card
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨H, hH, hedge⟩ :=
    minimalCounterexample.exists_edgeMinimalCounterexample
  letI : DecidableRel H.Adj := hH
  exact ⟨H, hH, hedge,
    hedge.degree_three_count_ge_two_thirds⟩

name: Erdos64.SimpleGraph.Walk.IsCycle.onePort_support_dichotomy
statement:
theorem SimpleGraph.Walk.IsCycle.onePort_support_dichotomy
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {s : V} {c : G.Walk s s} (hc : c.IsCycle)
    (K : Finset V) (x : V) (hx : x ∉ K)
    (hbd :
      ∀ u, u ∈ K → ∀ v, v ∉ K → G.Adj u v → v = x) :
    (∀ v, v ∈ c.support → v ∉ K) ∨
      (∀ v, v ∈ c.support → v = x ∨ v ∈ K)
proof:
:= by
  have path_subset_K :
      ∀ {a b : V} (p : G.Walk a b), p.IsPath → a ∈ K →
        x ∉ p.support → ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ K := by
    intro a b p
    induction p with
    | nil =>
        intro _ ha _ v hv
        simp at hv
        subst v
        exact ha
    | @cons a b d h q ih =>
        intro hp ha hxq v hv
        have hqpath : q.IsPath := hp.of_cons
        simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, List.mem_cons] at hv
        rcases hv with rfl | hv
        · exact ha
        · have hb : b ∈ K := by
            by_contra hbn
            have hbsupport : b ∈ (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons h q).support := by
              simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, List.mem_cons]
              exact Or.inr q.start_mem_support
            have hbx : b = x := hbd a ha b hbn h
            exact hxq (hbx ▸ hbsupport)
          have hxq' : x ∉ q.support := by
            intro hxm
            apply hxq
            simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, List.mem_cons]
            exact Or.inr hxm
          exact ih hqpath hb hxq' v hv
  by_cases hmeet : ∃ u, u ∈ K ∧ u ∈ c.support
  · right
    intro v hv
    by_cases hvK : v ∈ K
    · exact Or.inr hvK
    by_cases hvx : v = x
    · exact Or.inl hvx
    obtain ⟨u, huK, huC⟩ := hmeet
    have huv : u ≠ v := by
      intro huv
      apply hvK
      simpa [huv] using huK
    obtain ⟨p, q, hpq⟩ :=
      SimpleGraph.Walk.IsCycle.exists_path_arcs hc huC hv huv
    have hxu : x ≠ u := by
      intro hxu
      apply hx
      simpa [hxu] using huK
    have hxv : x ≠ v := by
      exact Ne.symm hvx
    have hnodup :
        ((p : G.Walk u v).append (q : G.Walk v u)).support.tail.Nodup := by
      rw [hpq]
      exact (hc.rotate huC).support_nodup
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.tail_support_append] at hnodup
    have hdisjoint :
        (p : G.Walk u v).support.tail.Disjoint
          (q : G.Walk v u).support.tail :=
      List.disjoint_of_nodup_append hnodup
    by_cases hxp : x ∈ (p : G.Walk u v).support
    · have hxq : x ∉ (q : G.Walk v u).support := by
        intro hxq
        have hxp_tail : x ∈ (p : G.Walk u v).support.tail := by
          rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_iff] at hxp
          exact hxp.resolve_left hxu
        have hxq_tail : x ∈ (q : G.Walk v u).support.tail := by
          rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_iff] at hxq
          exact hxq.resolve_left hxv
        exact (List.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint) hxp_tail hxq_tail
      have hqrevx : x ∉ (q : G.Walk v u).reverse.support := by
        simpa [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_reverse] using hxq
      have hvrev : v ∈ (q : G.Walk v u).reverse.support :=
        (q : G.Walk v u).reverse.end_mem_support
      have hvK' := path_subset_K (q : G.Walk v u).reverse
        q.property.reverse huK hqrevx v hvrev
      exact (hvK hvK').elim
    · have hvK' := path_subset_K (p : G.Walk u v)
        p.property huK hxp v (p : G.Walk u v).end_mem_support
      exact (hvK hvK').elim
  · left
    intro v hv hvK
    exact hmeet ⟨v, hvK, hv⟩

name: Erdos64.SimpleGraph.Walk.IsCycle.onePort_cycle_excursion
statement:
theorem SimpleGraph.Walk.IsCycle.onePort_cycle_excursion
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {s : V} {c : G.Walk s s} (hc : c.IsCycle)
    (x : V) (hxcycle : x ∈ c.support)
    (K : Finset V) (hx : x ∉ K)
    (hbd :
      ∀ u, u ∈ K → ∀ v, v ∉ K → G.Adj u v → v = x)
    (hmeet : ∃ v, v ∈ c.support ∧ v ∈ K) :
    ∃ a b : V, a ∈ K ∧ b ∈ K ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      G.Adj x a ∧ G.Adj b x ∧
      ∃ p : G.Walk a b,
        p.IsPath ∧
        (∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ K) ∧
        c.length = p.length + 2
proof:
:= by
  have hcontained : ∀ v, v ∈ c.support → v = x ∨ v ∈ K := by
    rcases Erdos64.SimpleGraph.Walk.IsCycle.onePort_support_dichotomy
      hc K x hx hbd with hnone | hcontained
    · obtain ⟨v, hvC, hvK⟩ := hmeet
      exact (hnone v hvC hvK).elim
    · exact hcontained
  let r := c.rotate x hxcycle
  have hr : r.IsCycle := by
    simpa [r] using hc.rotate hxcycle
  cases hR : r with
  | nil =>
      have hrnil : (SimpleGraph.Walk.nil : G.Walk x x).IsCycle := by
        simpa [hR] using hr
      exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.not_isCycle_nil hrnil).elim
  | @cons a b d h q =>
      have hr' : (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons h q).IsCycle := by
        simpa [hR] using hr
      have hqnotnil : ¬q.Nil :=
        SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_of_isCycle_cons hr'
      have hqpath : q.IsPath := by
        simpa using hr'.isPath_tail
      have hxa : G.Adj x b := by
        simpa using h
      have hbx : G.Adj q.penultimate x := by
        simpa using q.adj_penultimate hqnotnil
      have hq_to_c : ∀ {v : V}, v ∈ q.support → v ∈ c.support := by
        intro v hv
        have hvrot : v ∈ r.support := by
          rw [hR]
          simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, List.mem_cons]
          exact Or.inr hv
        exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_rotate_iff c x hxcycle).mp
          (by simpa [r] using hvrot)
      have hxdrop : x ∉ q.dropLast.support := by
        have hnodup : (q.dropLast.support ++ [x]).Nodup := by
          rw [q.support_dropLast_concat hqnotnil]
          exact hqpath.support_nodup
        exact fun hxm =>
          (List.disjoint_left.mp (List.disjoint_of_nodup_append hnodup))
            hxm (by simp)
      have hpK : ∀ v, v ∈ q.dropLast.support → v ∈ K := by
        intro v hv
        have hvq : v ∈ q.support := by
          rw [q.support_dropLast hqnotnil] at hv
          exact List.mem_of_mem_dropLast hv
        have hvx : v ≠ x := by
          intro hvx
          apply hxdrop
          simpa [hvx] using hv
        exact (hcontained v (hq_to_c hvq)).resolve_left hvx
      have haK : b ∈ K := by
        exact (hcontained b (hq_to_c q.start_mem_support)).resolve_left
          (Ne.symm hxa.ne)
      have hbK : q.penultimate ∈ K := by
        apply hpK
        rw [q.support_dropLast hqnotnil]
        exact q.penultimate_mem_dropLast_support hqnotnil
      have hq_len : 2 ≤ q.length := by
        have hlen := hr'.three_le_length
        simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons] at hlen
        omega
      have hab : b ≠ q.penultimate := by
        intro hab
        have hget : q.getVert 0 = q.getVert (q.length - 1) := by
          simpa [SimpleGraph.Walk.penultimate] using hab
        have hindex : 0 = q.length - 1 := by
          exact hqpath.getVert_injOn (x₁ := 0) (x₂ := q.length - 1)
            (show 0 ≤ q.length by exact Nat.zero_le _)
            (show q.length - 1 ≤ q.length by exact Nat.sub_le _ _) hget
        omega
      have hlength : c.length = q.dropLast.length + 2 := by
        have hq_length : q.dropLast.length + 1 = q.length :=
          q.length_dropLast_add_one hqnotnil
        calc
          c.length = r.length := by
            symm
            simpa [r] using (SimpleGraph.Walk.length_rotate c x hxcycle)
          _ = (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons h q).length := by rw [hR]
          _ = q.length + 1 := by simp
          _ = q.dropLast.length + 2 := by omega
      exact ⟨b, q.penultimate, haK, hbK, hab, hxa, hbx,
        q.dropLast, hqpath.dropLast, hpK, hlength⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.exact_adjacent_cubic_side_pow_two_add_one_path
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.exact_adjacent_cubic_side_pow_two_add_one_path
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D) (hx : x ∈ D) (hy : y ∈ D)
    (hxy : G.Adj x y)
    (hboundary : ∀ a, a ∈ D → ∀ b, b ∉ D → G.Adj a b → b = r)
    (hexact : ∀ a, a ∈ D → (G.Adj a r ↔ a = x ∨ a = y))
    (hcubic : G.degree x = 3 ∧ G.degree y = 3) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ p : G.Walk x y,
      2 ≤ k ∧ p.IsPath ∧ p.length = 2 ^ k + 1 ∧
      (∀ a, a ∈ p.support → a ∈ D) ∧ r ∉ p.support
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hxdeg, hydeg, hretained, _⟩ :=
    two_cubic_ports_boundary_accounting D r x y hr ⟨hx, hy, hxy.ne⟩
      hboundary hexact hcubic
  let H := G.induce (↑D : Set V)
  let x' : (↑D : Set V) := ⟨x, hx⟩
  let y' : (↑D : Set V) := ⟨y, hy⟩
  have hx' : H.degree x' = 2 := by
    rw [degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree]
    exact hxdeg
  have hy' : H.degree y' = 2 := by
    rw [degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree]
    exact hydeg
  have hrx : G.Adj r x := ((hexact x hx).2 (Or.inl rfl)).symm
  have hry : G.Adj r y := ((hexact y hy).2 (Or.inr rfl)).symm
  have hcommon : ∀ z, H.Adj x' z → H.Adj y' z → False := by
    intro z hxz hyz
    have hxz' : G.Adj x z.1 := hxz
    have hyz' : G.Adj y z.1 := hyz
    have hzr := M.common_neighbor_eq_root_of_nonadjacent_ports hrx hry hxy.ne
      hxz' hyz' hxz'.ne.symm hyz'.ne.symm
    exact hr (hzr ▸ z.2)
  have hother : ∀ z, z ≠ x' → z ≠ y' → 3 ≤ H.degree z := by
    intro z hzx hzy
    rw [degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree,
      hretained z.1 z.2 (fun h => hzx (Subtype.ext h))
        (fun h => hzy (Subtype.ext h))]
    exact degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G M.isCounterexample.1 z.1
  have hno : ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle H :=
    not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle_induce_of_not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle M.isCounterexample.2
  have hsmall : Fintype.card (↑D : Set V) < Fintype.card V :=
    Fintype.card_subtype_lt (x := r) hr
  obtain ⟨k, q, hk, hq, hlen⟩ :=
    M.adjacent_degree_two_ports_pow_two_add_one_path
      x' y' hxy hx' hy' hcommon hother hno hsmall
  let e : H ↪g G := SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce (↑D : Set V)
  let p : G.Walk x y := q.map e.toHom
  have hinside : ∀ a, a ∈ p.support → a ∈ D := by
    intro a ha
    change a ∈ (q.map e.toHom).support at ha
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map] at ha
    obtain ⟨z, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ha
    exact z.2
  refine ⟨k, p, hk, hq.map e.injective, ?_, hinside, fun h => hr (hinside r h)⟩
  change (q.map e.toHom).length = 2 ^ k + 1
  rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map]
  exact hlen

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_adjacent_ports_pow_two_add_one_path
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_adjacent_ports_pow_two_add_one_path
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hCD : C ≠ D) (x y : V)
    (hx : x ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (hy : y ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y) (hxy : G.Adj x y) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ p : G.Walk x y,
      2 ≤ k ∧ p.IsPath ∧ p.length = 2 ^ k + 1 ∧
      (∀ a, a ∈ p.support → a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) ∧
      r ∉ p.support
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
  obtain ⟨_, _, hcard, _, _, hcubic⟩ :=
    M.rootDeleted_two_components_exact_balanced_cubic r C D hCD
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hra, hrb, hports⟩ :=
    rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_attachment_exact r C hcard
  have hxyports : ∀ z, z ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      G.Adj z r → z = x ∨ z = y := by
    rcases hports x hx hrx.symm with rfl | rfl <;>
      rcases hports y hy hry.symm with rfl | rfl
    · exact (hxy.ne rfl).elim
    · exact hports
    · intro z hz hzr
      exact (hports z hz hzr).symm
    · exact (hxy.ne rfl).elim
  have hexact : ∀ z, z ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      (G.Adj z r ↔ z = x ∨ z = y) := by
    intro z hz
    refine ⟨hxyports z hz, ?_⟩
    rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact hrx.symm
    · exact hry.symm
  have hboundary : ∀ a, a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      ∀ b, b ∉ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C → G.Adj a b → b = r := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    rcases (rootDeletedComponent_boundary r M.vertexMinimal.isConnected C).1
      a ha b hab with hbC | hbr
    · exact (hb hbC).elim
    · exact hbr
  exact M.vertexMinimal.exact_adjacent_cubic_side_pow_two_add_one_path
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) r x y
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C).2 hx hy hxy
    hboundary hexact ⟨hcubic x hrx, hcubic y hry⟩

name: Erdos64.exists_odd_offPathComponent_of_even_card
statement:
theorem exists_odd_offPathComponent_of_even_card
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (A : Finset V) (hA : Even A.card) {x y : V}
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath) (heven : Even p.length)
    (hinside : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ A) :
    ∃ E : (G.induce {v : V | v ∈ A ∧ v ∉ p.support}).ConnectedComponent,
      Odd (offPathComponentCarrier G A p E).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let W := {v : V // v ∈ A ∧ v ∉ p.support}
  let H := G.induce {v : V | v ∈ A ∧ v ∉ p.support}
  have hsub : p.support.toFinset ⊆ A := by
    intro v hv
    exact hinside v (List.mem_toFinset.mp hv)
  have hpathcard : p.support.toFinset.card = p.length + 1 := by
    rw [List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hp.support_nodup, p.length_support]
  have hWcard : Fintype.card W = (A \ p.support.toFinset).card := by
    rw [Fintype.card_subtype]
    congr 1
    ext v
    simp
  have hsum := Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card hsub
  rw [← hWcard, hpathcard] at hsum
  have hWodd : Odd (Fintype.card W) := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hA
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := heven
    exact ⟨a - b - 1, by omega⟩
  have hWodd' : Odd (Nat.card W) := by
    rwa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  have hodd : Odd H.oddComponents.ncard := H.odd_ncard_oddComponents.mpr hWodd'
  have hnonempty : H.oddComponents.Nonempty :=
    Set.nonempty_of_ncard_ne_zero (fun h => Nat.not_odd_zero (h ▸ hodd))
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := hnonempty
  refine ⟨E, ?_⟩
  have hcard : (offPathComponentCarrier G A p E).card = E.supp.ncard := by
    unfold offPathComponentCarrier
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective,
      ← Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
  rw [hcard]
  exact hE

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_even_path_odd_offPathComponent
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_even_path_odd_offPathComponent
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    (hodd : ∀ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C → Odd (G.degree v))
    {x y : V} (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath) (heven : Even p.length)
    (hinside : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) :
    ∃ E : (G.induce {v : V | v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      v ∉ p.support}).ConnectedComponent,
      Odd (offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E).card
proof:
:= by
  exact exists_odd_offPathComponent_of_even_card _
    (M.rootDeleted_cut_side_card_even_of_odd_degrees r C D hCD hodd)
    p hp heven hinside

name: Erdos64.rootDeletedComponentAttachments_sum_card
statement:
theorem rootDeletedComponentAttachments_sum_card
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] (r : V) :
    letI : Fintype ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) :=
      Fintype.ofFinite _
    (∑ C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent,
      (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card) = G.degree r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) :=
    Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hcard :
      ((Finset.univ : Finset ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)).biUnion
        (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r)).card =
      ∑ C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent,
        (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_biUnion]
    intro (C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) _
      (D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) _ hCD
    exact (@rootDeletedComponentAttachments_pairwise_disjoint V _ _ G _ r) hCD
  have hpartition := @rootDeletedComponentAttachments_biUnion V _ _ G _ r
  rw [hpartition] at hcard
  simpa [SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] using hcard.symm

name: Erdos64.internalDegree_add_root_indicator_eq_degree
statement:
theorem internalDegree_add_root_indicator_eq_degree
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (D : Finset V) (r : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ D) :
    internalDegree G D v + (if G.Adj v r then 1 else 0) = G.degree v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B : Finset V := if G.Adj v r then {r} else ∅
  have hsplit : G.neighborFinset v = D.filter (G.Adj v) ∪ B := by
    ext w
    constructor
    · intro hw
      have hvw : G.Adj v w := (G.mem_neighborFinset v w).1 hw
      by_cases hwD : w ∈ D
      · exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inl (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hwD, hvw⟩))
      · have hwr : w = r := hboundary v hv w hwD hvw
        subst w
        by_cases hvr : G.Adj v r
        · exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr (by simp [B, hvr]))
        · exact False.elim (hvr hvw)
    · intro hw
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hw with hwD | hwB
      · exact (G.mem_neighborFinset v w).2 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hwD).2
      · by_cases hvr : G.Adj v r
        · have hwr : w = r := by simpa [B, hvr] using hwB
          subst w
          exact (G.mem_neighborFinset v r).2 hvr
        · simp [B, hvr] at hwB
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint (D.filter (G.Adj v)) B := by
    by_cases hvr : G.Adj v r
    · simp [B, hvr, hr]
    · simp [B, hvr]
  calc
    internalDegree G D v + (if G.Adj v r then 1 else 0) =
        (D.filter (G.Adj v)).card + B.card := by
          by_cases hvr : G.Adj v r <;> simp [internalDegree, B, hvr]
    _ = (D.filter (G.Adj v) ∪ B).card :=
      (Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisjoint).symm
    _ = (G.neighborFinset v).card := by rw [← hsplit]
    _ = G.degree v := SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree G v

name: Erdos64.two_cubic_ports_boundary_accounting
statement:
theorem two_cubic_ports_boundary_accounting
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D)
    (hports : x ∈ D ∧ y ∈ D ∧ x ≠ y)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hexact :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y))
    (hcubic : G.degree x = 3 ∧ G.degree y = 3) :
    internalDegree G D x = 2 ∧
    internalDegree G D y = 2 ∧
    (∀ v, v ∈ D → v ≠ x → v ≠ y →
      internalDegree G D v = G.degree v) ∧
    (D.filter (G.Adj r)).card = 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hxroot : G.Adj x r := (hexact x hports.1).2 (Or.inl rfl)
  have hyroot : G.Adj y r := (hexact y hports.2.1).2 (Or.inr rfl)
  have hxaccount := internalDegree_add_root_indicator_eq_degree
    D r hr hboundary hports.1
  have hyaccount := internalDegree_add_root_indicator_eq_degree
    D r hr hboundary hports.2.1
  have hxdeg : internalDegree G D x = 2 := by
    simp [hxroot, hcubic.1] at hxaccount
    omega
  have hydeg : internalDegree G D y = 2 := by
    simp [hyroot, hcubic.2] at hyaccount
    omega
  have hnonport : ∀ v, v ∈ D → v ≠ x → v ≠ y → ¬ G.Adj v r := by
    intro v hv hvx hvy hadj
    rcases (hexact v hv).mp hadj with h | h
    · exact hvx h
    · exact hvy h
  have hretained : ∀ v, v ∈ D → v ≠ x → v ≠ y →
      internalDegree G D v = G.degree v := by
    intro v hv hvx hvy
    have haccount := internalDegree_add_root_indicator_eq_degree
      D r hr hboundary hv
    have hvr := hnonport v hv hvx hvy
    simpa [hvr] using haccount
  have hports_filter : D.filter (G.Adj r) = {x, y} := by
    ext v
    constructor
    · intro hv
      have hvD : v ∈ D := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).1
      have hvr : G.Adj v r := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2.symm
      have hvxy : v = x ∨ v = y := (hexact v hvD).mp hvr
      simpa only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] using hvxy
    · intro hv
      have hvxy : v = x ∨ v = y := by
        simpa only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] using hv
      rcases hvxy with rfl | rfl
      · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hports.1, hxroot.symm⟩
      · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hports.2.1, hyroot.symm⟩
  refine ⟨hxdeg, hydeg, hretained, ?_⟩
  rw [hports_filter]
  simp [hports.2.2]

name: Erdos64.exists_unequal_cut_root_side
statement:
theorem exists_unequal_cut_root_side
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (_hcritical : IsSubgraphCritical G)
    (A B : Finset V) (r : V)
    (hpartition : A ∪ B = Finset.univ)
    (hinter : A ∩ B = ({r} : Finset V))
    (hnocross : ∀ x, x ∈ A → x ≠ r →
      ∀ y, y ∈ B → y ≠ r → ¬G.Adj x y)
    (hrootA : 2 ≤ internalDegree G A r)
    (_hrootB : 2 ≤ internalDegree G B r)
    (hAB : A.card < B.card) :
    ∃ (S : Finset V) (root : {v : V // v ∈ S}),
      (∀ v, v ∈ S → v ≠ root.1 → ∀ w, G.Adj v w → w ∈ S) ∧
      2 ≤ internalDegree G S root.1 ∧
      2 * S.card - 1 < Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hrA : r ∈ A := by
    have hr : r ∈ A ∩ B := by
      rw [hinter]
      simp
    exact (Finset.mem_inter.mp hr).1
  have hclosedA : ∀ v, v ∈ A → v ≠ r →
      ∀ w, G.Adj v w → w ∈ A := by
    intro v hvA hvr w hvw
    have hwpart : w ∈ A ∨ w ∈ B := by
      have hw : w ∈ A ∪ B := by
        rw [hpartition]
        exact Finset.mem_univ w
      exact Finset.mem_union.mp hw
    rcases hwpart with hwA | hwB
    · exact hwA
    · by_cases hwr : w = r
      · simpa [hwr] using hrA
      · exact (hnocross v hvA hvr w hwB hwr hvw).elim
  have hcard_identity : Fintype.card V + 1 = A.card + B.card := by
    have hcard := Finset.card_union_add_card_inter A B
    rw [hpartition, hinter] at hcard
    simpa using hcard
  refine ⟨A, ⟨r, hrA⟩, hclosedA, hrootA, ?_⟩
  have hAB' : A.card + 1 ≤ B.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hAB
  have hAB'' : A.card + (A.card + 1) ≤ A.card + B.card :=
    Nat.add_le_add_left hAB' A.card
  have hsum' : A.card + B.card = Fintype.card V + 1 :=
    hcard_identity.symm
  have htw : 2 * A.card + 1 ≤ Fintype.card V + 1 := by
    calc
      2 * A.card + 1 = A.card + (A.card + 1) := by omega
      _ ≤ A.card + B.card := hAB''
      _ = Fintype.card V + 1 := hsum'
  have htw' : 2 * A.card ≤ Fintype.card V := by
    exact Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ (by simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one,
      Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_assoc] using htw)
  have hAcard_filter : internalDegree G A r ≤ A.card := by
    exact Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  have hAcard : 2 ≤ A.card := le_trans hrootA hAcard_filter
  omega

name: Erdos64.hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_induce
statement:
theorem hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_induce
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {S : Set V}
    (hcycle : HasPowerOfTwoCycle (G.induce S)) :
    HasPowerOfTwoCycle G
proof:
:= by
  rcases hcycle with ⟨k, v, c, hk, hc, hlen⟩
  let e : G.induce S ↪g G := SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce S
  refine ⟨k, e v, c.map e.toHom, hk, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hc.map e.injective
  · rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map]
    exact hlen

name: Erdos64.not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle_induce_of_not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle

theorem not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle_induce_of_not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle

    (hno : ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle G) :
    ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle (G.induce S)
proof:
:= by
  intro hcycle
  exact hno (hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_induce hcycle)

name: Erdos64.not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle_rootDeleted_induce
statement:
theorem not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle_rootDeleted_induce

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.cycle8_of_hull_return
statement:
theorem cycle8_of_hull_return (H : PentagramEarHull G) (i₀ j₀ : Fin 5)
    (K : PentagramEarHull.Connector (G := G) H i₀ j₀)
    (R : PentagramEarHull.HullReturn H i₀ j₀ K) :
    ∃ c : G.Walk
        (PentagramEarHull.bVertex (G := G) H i₀)
        (PentagramEarHull.bVertex (G := G) H i₀),
      c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = 8
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hlen, _hle⟩ :=
    SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.cycle_of_first_reunion
      K.path R.route K.isPath R.route_isPath R.first_steps_distinct
      (i := K.path.length) (j := R.route.length)
      (by
        rcases K.length_one_to_three with h | h | h <;> omega)
      (by exact Nat.le_refl _)
      (by
        have hroute := R.route_length
        rcases K.length_one_to_three with h | h | h <;> omega)
      (by exact Nat.le_refl _)
      (by simp) R.route_disjoint
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
  have hroute := R.route_length
  omega

name: Erdos64.quotient_cycle_lift_of_avoids_none
statement:
theorem quotient_cycle_lift_of_avoids_none
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {a b : V} {z : QuotientVertex a b}
    {c : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Walk z z}
    (hc : c.IsCycle)
    (hnone : none ∉ c.support) :
    ∃ u : V, ∃ d : G.Walk u u, d.IsCycle ∧ d.length = c.length
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set (QuotientVertex a b) := Set.range
    (fun v : Internal a b => some v)
  have hcS : ∀ v, v ∈ c.support → v ∈ S := by
    intro v hv
    cases v with
    | none => exact (hnone hv).elim
    | some v => exact ⟨v, rfl⟩
  let ci := c.induce S hcS
  let e : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).induce S →g G :=
    { toFun := fun q => (Classical.choose q.property).1
      map_rel' := by
        intro q₁ q₂ hq
        let v₁ := Classical.choose q₁.property
        let v₂ := Classical.choose q₂.property
        have hv₁ : some v₁ = q₁.1 := Classical.choose_spec q₁.property
        have hv₂ : some v₂ = q₂.1 := Classical.choose_spec q₂.property
        change (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Adj q₁.1 q₂.1 at hq
        rw [← hv₁, ← hv₂] at hq
        exact hq }
  have he : Function.Injective e := by
    intro q₁ q₂ hq
    let v₁ := Classical.choose q₁.property
    let v₂ := Classical.choose q₂.property
    have hv₁ : some v₁ = q₁.1 := Classical.choose_spec q₁.property
    have hv₂ : some v₂ = q₂.1 := Classical.choose_spec q₂.property
    have hval : v₁.1 = v₂.1 := by
      change v₁.1 = v₂.1 at hq
      exact hq
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [← hv₁, ← hv₂]
    congr
    exact Subtype.ext hval
  let emb : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).induce S ↪g
      terminalQuotientGraph G a b := SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce S
  have hmap : ci.map emb.toHom = c := by
    dsimp [ci]
    exact SimpleGraph.Walk.map_induce c hcS
  have hci_map : (ci.map emb.toHom).IsCycle := by
    rw [hmap]
    exact hc
  have hci : ci.IsCycle :=
    (SimpleGraph.Walk.isCycle_map_iff_of_injective emb.injective).mp hci_map
  refine ⟨_, ci.map e, hci.map he, ?_⟩
  rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map]
  have hlen_induce : ∀ {u v : QuotientVertex a b}
      (w : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Walk u v)
      (hw : ∀ x ∈ w.support, x ∈ S),
      (w.induce S hw).length = w.length := by
    intro u v w
    induction w with
    | nil => intro hw; rfl
    | @cons u v w huv q ih =>
        intro hw
        simp [SimpleGraph.Walk.induce, ih]
  exact hlen_induce c hcS

name: Erdos64.quotient_path_lift_of_avoids_none
statement:
theorem quotient_path_lift_of_avoids_none
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {a b : V} {z₁ z₂ : QuotientVertex a b}
    {p : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Walk z₁ z₂}
    (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hnone : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ≠ none)
    (hstart : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Adj none z₁)
    (hend : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Adj z₂ none) :
    ∃ x y : V, ∃ q : G.Walk x y,
      q.IsPath ∧ q.length = p.length ∧
      (G.Adj a x ∨ G.Adj b x) ∧
      (G.Adj a y ∨ G.Adj b y) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ q.support → v ≠ a ∧ v ≠ b)
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set (QuotientVertex a b) := Set.range
    (fun v : Internal a b => some v)
  have hpS : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ S := by
    intro v hv
    cases v with
    | none => exact (hnone none hv rfl).elim
    | some v => exact ⟨v, rfl⟩
  let s₁ : {v : QuotientVertex a b // v ∈ S} :=
    ⟨z₁, hpS z₁ p.start_mem_support⟩
  let s₂ : {v : QuotientVertex a b // v ∈ S} :=
    ⟨z₂, hpS z₂ p.end_mem_support⟩
  let pi : ((terminalQuotientGraph G a b).induce S).Walk s₁ s₂ := by
    simpa [s₁, s₂] using p.induce S hpS
  let e : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).induce S →g G :=
    { toFun := fun q => (Classical.choose q.property).1
      map_rel' := by
        intro q₁ q₂ hq
        let v₁ := Classical.choose q₁.property
        let v₂ := Classical.choose q₂.property
        have hv₁ : some v₁ = q₁.1 := Classical.choose_spec q₁.property
        have hv₂ : some v₂ = q₂.1 := Classical.choose_spec q₂.property
        change (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Adj q₁.1 q₂.1 at hq
        rw [← hv₁, ← hv₂] at hq
        exact hq }
  have he : Function.Injective e := by
    intro q₁ q₂ hq
    let v₁ := Classical.choose q₁.property
    let v₂ := Classical.choose q₂.property
    have hv₁ : some v₁ = q₁.1 := Classical.choose_spec q₁.property
    have hv₂ : some v₂ = q₂.1 := Classical.choose_spec q₂.property
    have hval : v₁.1 = v₂.1 := by
      change v₁.1 = v₂.1 at hq
      exact hq
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [← hv₁, ← hv₂]
    congr
    exact Subtype.ext hval
  let emb : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).induce S ↪g
      terminalQuotientGraph G a b := SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce S
  have hmap : pi.map emb.toHom = p := by
    dsimp [pi]
    exact SimpleGraph.Walk.map_induce p hpS
  have hpi : pi.IsPath := by
    apply (SimpleGraph.Walk.isPath_map_iff_of_injective
      (p := pi) (f := emb.toHom) emb.injective).mp
    rw [hmap]
    exact hp
  let q : G.Walk (e s₁) (e s₂) := pi.map e
  have hq : q.IsPath := by
    exact hpi.map he
  have hlen_induce : ∀ {u v : QuotientVertex a b}
      (w : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Walk u v)
      (hw : ∀ x ∈ w.support, x ∈ S),
      (w.induce S hw).length = w.length := by
    intro u v w
    induction w with
    | nil => intro hw; rfl
    | @cons u v w huv r ih =>
        intro hw
        simp [SimpleGraph.Walk.induce, ih]
  have hroot_start : G.Adj a (e s₁) ∨ G.Adj b (e s₁) := by
    let v := Classical.choose s₁.property
    have hv : some v = s₁.1 := Classical.choose_spec s₁.property
    have hs : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Adj none (some v) := by
      rw [hv]
      simpa [emb, s₁] using hstart
    change G.Adj a v.1 ∨ G.Adj b v.1
    simpa [q, e, v] using hs
  have hroot_end : G.Adj a (e s₂) ∨ G.Adj b (e s₂) := by
    let v := Classical.choose s₂.property
    have hv : some v = s₂.1 := Classical.choose_spec s₂.property
    have he' : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Adj (some v) none := by
      rw [hv]
      simpa [emb, s₂] using hend
    change G.Adj a v.1 ∨ G.Adj b v.1
    simpa [q, e, v] using he'.symm
  have havoid : ∀ v, v ∈ q.support → v ≠ a ∧ v ≠ b := by
    intro v hv
    change v ∈ (pi.map e).support at hv
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map] at hv
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hze⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hv
    let w := Classical.choose z.property
    have hw : some w = z.1 := Classical.choose_spec z.property
    have hval : w.1 = v := by
      change w.1 = v at hze
      exact hze
    exact ⟨fun h => w.2.1 (hval.trans h),
      fun h => w.2.2 (hval.trans h)⟩
  refine ⟨e s₁, e s₂, q, hq, ?_, hroot_start, hroot_end, havoid⟩
  change (pi.map e).length = p.length
  rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map]
  exact hlen_induce p hpS

name: Erdos64.quotient_dyadic_cycle_through_none_lift_or_cross_path
statement:
theorem quotient_dyadic_cycle_through_none_lift_or_cross_path
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {a b : V} {z : QuotientVertex a b}
    {c : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Walk z z}
    (hc : c.IsCycle)
    (hnone : none ∈ c.support)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (hlen : c.length = 2 ^ k) :
    (∃ u : V, ∃ d : G.Walk u u,
      d.IsCycle ∧ d.length = 2 ^ k) ∨
    (∃ x y : V, ∃ p : G.Walk x y,
      p.IsPath ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ≠ a ∧ v ≠ b) ∧
      p.length + 2 = 2 ^ k ∧
      ((G.Adj a x ∧ G.Adj b y) ∨
        (G.Adj b x ∧ G.Adj a y)))
proof:
:= by
  let r := c.rotate none hnone
  have hr : r.IsCycle := hc.rotate hnone
  cases hR : r with
  | nil =>
      have : (SimpleGraph.Walk.nil :
          (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Walk none none).IsCycle := by
        simpa [hR] using hr
      exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.not_isCycle_nil this).elim
  | @cons u v w h q =>
      have hr' :
          (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons h q).IsCycle := by
        simpa [hR] using hr
      have hqnotnil : ¬q.Nil :=
        SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_of_isCycle_cons hr'
      have hqpath : q.IsPath := by
        simpa using hr'.isPath_tail
      have hdropnone : ∀ t, t ∈ q.dropLast.support → t ≠ none := by
        intro t ht
        have hnodup : (q.dropLast.support ++ [none]).Nodup := by
          rw [q.support_dropLast_concat hqnotnil]
          exact hqpath.support_nodup
        intro ht_none
        exact (List.disjoint_left.mp (List.disjoint_of_nodup_append hnodup))
          ht (by simpa [ht_none])
      obtain ⟨x, y, p, hp, hpl, hxa, hya, havoid⟩ :=
        quotient_path_lift_of_avoids_none
          (p := q.dropLast) hqpath.dropLast hdropnone h
          (q.adj_penultimate hqnotnil)
      have hclen : c.length = q.dropLast.length + 2 := by
        calc
          c.length = r.length := by
            symm
            exact SimpleGraph.Walk.length_rotate c none hnone
          _ = (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons h q).length := by rw [hR]
          _ = q.length + 1 := by simp
          _ = q.dropLast.length + 2 := by
            rw [← q.length_dropLast_add_one hqnotnil]
      have hcrosslen : p.length + 2 = 2 ^ k := by
        omega
      have hpow : 4 ≤ 2 ^ k := four_le_pow_two hk
      have hlong : 1 < p.length := by omega
      have hxy : x ≠ y := by
        intro hxy
        have hget : p.getVert 0 = p.getVert p.length := by
          simpa [hxy]
        have hidx := hp.getVert_injOn
          (x₁ := 0) (x₂ := p.length)
          (show 0 ≤ p.length by exact Nat.zero_le _)
          (show p.length ≤ p.length by exact le_rfl) hget
        omega
      rcases hxa with hxa | hxb <;> rcases hya with hya | hyb
      · obtain ⟨d, hd, hdl⟩ := endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate
          hp hxa hya (fun ht => (havoid a ht).1 rfl) hxy hlong
        left
        refine ⟨x, d, hd, ?_⟩
        omega
      · right
        refine ⟨x, y, p, hp, havoid, hcrosslen, ?_⟩
        exact Or.inl ⟨hxa, hyb⟩
      · right
        refine ⟨x, y, p, hp, havoid, hcrosslen, ?_⟩
        exact Or.inr ⟨hxb, hya⟩
      · obtain ⟨d, hd, hdl⟩ := endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate
          hp hxb hyb (fun ht => (havoid b ht).2 rfl) hxy hlong
        left
        refine ⟨x, d, hd, ?_⟩
        omega

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.nonadjacent_terminal_cross_path
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.nonadjacent_terminal_cross_path
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    {a b : V} (hab : a ≠ b) (hnadj : ¬G.Adj a b)
    (hcommon : ∀ z, z ≠ a → z ≠ b →
      ¬ (G.Adj a z ∧ G.Adj b z)) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ x y : V, ∃ p : G.Walk x y,
      k ≥ 2 ∧
      p.IsPath ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ≠ a ∧ v ≠ b) ∧
      p.length + 2 = 2 ^ k ∧
      ((G.Adj a x ∧ G.Adj b y) ∨
        (G.Adj b x ∧ G.Adj a y))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : DecidableRel (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Adj :=
    quotient_decidableRel G a b
  obtain ⟨k, z, c, hk, hc, hlen⟩ :=
    M.terminalQuotient_hasPowerOfTwoCycle hab hnadj hcommon
  have hnone : none ∈ c.support := by
    by_contra hnone
    obtain ⟨u, d, hd, hdl⟩ :=
      quotient_cycle_lift_of_avoids_none hc hnone
    exact M.isCounterexample.2 ⟨k, u, d, hk, hd, hdl.trans hlen⟩
  obtain hbranch :=
    quotient_dyadic_cycle_through_none_lift_or_cross_path
      hc hnone hk hlen
  rcases hbranch with ⟨u, d, hd, hdl⟩ | hcross
  · exact (M.isCounterexample.2 ⟨k, u, d, hk, hd, hdl⟩).elim
  · rcases hcross with ⟨x, y, p, hp, hav, hlenp, hadj⟩
    exact ⟨k, x, y, p, hk, hp, hav, hlenp, hadj⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.nonadjacent_terminal_cross_path_of_common_degree_ge_four
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.nonadjacent_terminal_cross_path_of_common_degree_ge_four
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    {a b : V} (hab : a ≠ b) (hnadj : ¬G.Adj a b)
    (hcommon4 : ∀ z, z ≠ a → z ≠ b →
      (G.Adj a z ∧ G.Adj b z) → 4 ≤ G.degree z) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ x y : V, ∃ p : G.Walk x y,
      k ≥ 2 ∧
      p.IsPath ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ≠ a ∧ v ≠ b) ∧
      p.length + 2 = 2 ^ k ∧
      ((G.Adj a x ∧ G.Adj b y) ∨
        (G.Adj b x ∧ G.Adj a y))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : DecidableRel (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Adj :=
    quotient_decidableRel G a b
  obtain ⟨k, z, c, hk, hc, hlen⟩ :=
    M.terminalQuotient_hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_common_degree_ge_four
      hab hnadj hcommon4
  have hnone : none ∈ c.support := by
    by_contra hnone
    obtain ⟨u, d, hd, hdl⟩ :=
      quotient_cycle_lift_of_avoids_none hc hnone
    exact M.isCounterexample.2 ⟨k, u, d, hk, hd, hdl.trans hlen⟩
  obtain hbranch :=
    quotient_dyadic_cycle_through_none_lift_or_cross_path
      hc hnone hk hlen
  rcases hbranch with ⟨u, d, hd, hdl⟩ | hcross
  · exact (M.isCounterexample.2 ⟨k, u, d, hk, hd, hdl⟩).elim
  · rcases hcross with ⟨x, y, p, hp, hav, hlenp, hadj⟩
    exact ⟨k, x, y, p, hk, hp, hav, hlenp, hadj⟩

name: Erdos64.quotient_root_degree_ge_three_of_adj_no_common
statement:
theorem quotient_root_degree_ge_three_of_adj_no_common
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {a b : V} (hab : G.Adj a b) (hmin : 3 ≤ G.minDegree)
    (hcommon : ∀ z, ¬ (G.Adj a z ∧ G.Adj b z)) :
    3 ≤ (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).degree none
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A := (G.neighborFinset a).erase b
  let B := (G.neighborFinset b).erase a
  have hA : 1 < A.card := by
    have hm := degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hmin a
    simp only [A, Finset.card_erase_of_mem ((G.mem_neighborFinset a b).mpr hab),
      SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
    omega
  have hB : B.Nonempty := by
    have hm := degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hmin b
    apply Finset.card_pos.mp
    simp only [B, Finset.card_erase_of_mem ((G.mem_neighborFinset b a).mpr hab.symm),
      SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
    omega
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.mp hA
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hB
  have hxa : G.Adj a x := (G.mem_neighborFinset a x).mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hx).2
  have hya : G.Adj a y := (G.mem_neighborFinset a y).mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hy).2
  have hzb : G.Adj b z := (G.mem_neighborFinset b z).mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hz).2
  have hxz : x ≠ z := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hcommon x ⟨hxa, hzb⟩
  have hyz : y ≠ z := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hcommon y ⟨hya, hzb⟩
  let xx : Internal a b := ⟨x, hxa.ne.symm, (Finset.mem_erase.mp hx).1⟩
  let yy : Internal a b := ⟨y, hya.ne.symm, (Finset.mem_erase.mp hy).1⟩
  let zz : Internal a b := ⟨z, (Finset.mem_erase.mp hz).1, hzb.ne.symm⟩
  have hthree : ({some xx, some yy, some zz} : Finset (QuotientVertex a b)).card = 3 := by
    simp [xx, yy, zz, hxy, hxz, hyz]
  have hsub : ({some xx, some yy, some zz} : Finset (QuotientVertex a b)) ⊆
      (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).neighborFinset none := by
    intro v hv
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
    rcases hv with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact (SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset _ _ _).mpr (Or.inl hxa)
    · exact (SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset _ _ _).mpr (Or.inl hya)
    · exact (SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset _ _ _).mpr (Or.inr hzb)
  have h := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  simpa only [hthree, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] using h

name: Erdos64.path_extend_fresh_terminals
statement:
private theorem path_extend_fresh_terminals
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b x y : V}
    (hab : a ≠ b) (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath)
    (havoid : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ≠ a ∧ v ≠ b)
    (hax : G.Adj a x) (hby : G.Adj b y) :
    ∃ q : G.Walk a b, q.IsPath ∧ q.length = p.length + 2
proof:
:= by
  have ha : a ∉ p.support := fun h => (havoid a h).1 rfl
  have hb : b ∉ p.support := fun h => (havoid b h).2 rfl
  let q : G.Walk a b := .cons hax (p.concat hby.symm)
  refine ⟨q, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.cons (hp.concat hb hby.symm)
    simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_concat, List.mem_append,
      List.mem_singleton, not_or] using And.intro ha hab
  · simp [q, Nat.add_assoc]

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.adjacent_dyadic_alternative_path
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.adjacent_dyadic_alternative_path
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) {a b : V} (hab : G.Adj a b) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ q : G.Walk a b,
      1 ≤ k ∧ q.IsPath ∧ q.length = 2 ^ k ∧ s(a, b) ∉ q.edges
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpath : ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ q : G.Walk a b,
      1 ≤ k ∧ q.IsPath ∧ q.length = 2 ^ k := by
    by_cases htriangle : ∃ z, G.Adj a z ∧ G.Adj b z
    · obtain ⟨z, haz, hbz⟩ := htriangle
      let q : G.Walk a b := .cons haz (.cons hbz.symm .nil)
      refine ⟨1, q, by omega, ?_, rfl⟩
      apply SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.cons (SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.of_adj hbz.symm)
      simp [haz.ne, hab.ne]
    · have hcommon : ∀ z, ¬ (G.Adj a z ∧ G.Adj b z) :=
        fun z hz => htriangle ⟨z, hz⟩
      have hroot := quotient_root_degree_ge_three_of_adj_no_common
        hab M.isCounterexample.1 hcommon
      obtain ⟨k, x, y, p, hk, hp, havoid, hlen, hcross⟩ :=
        M.terminal_cross_path_of_root_and_common hab.ne hroot
          (fun z _ _ hz => (hcommon z hz).elim)
      rcases hcross with ⟨hax, hby⟩ | ⟨hbx, hay⟩
      · obtain ⟨q, hq, hqlen⟩ := path_extend_fresh_terminals hab.ne p hp havoid hax hby
        exact ⟨k, q, by omega, hq, hqlen.trans hlen⟩
      · obtain ⟨q, hq, hqlen⟩ := path_extend_fresh_terminals hab.ne.symm p hp
          (fun v hv => (havoid v hv).symm) hbx hay
        refine ⟨k, q.reverse, by omega, hq.reverse, ?_⟩
        simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_reverse] using hqlen.trans hlen
  obtain ⟨k, q, hk, hq, hqlen⟩ := hpath
  refine ⟨k, q, hk, hq, hqlen, ?_⟩
  intro he
  have hone := hq.length_eq_one_of_mem_edges he
  have htwo : 2 ≤ 2 ^ k := by
    calc
      2 = 2 ^ 1 := by rfl
      _ ≤ 2 ^ k := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hk
  omega

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.edge_dyadic_successor_cycle
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.edge_dyadic_successor_cycle
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) {a b : V} (hab : G.Adj a b) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ c : G.Walk a a,
      1 ≤ k ∧ c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = 2 ^ k + 1 ∧ s(a, b) ∈ c.edges
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, p, hk, hp, hlen, hedge⟩ := M.adjacent_dyadic_alternative_path hab
  let c := SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hab p.reverse
  refine ⟨k, c, hk, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isCycle_iff p.reverse hab).mpr
    exact ⟨hp.reverse, by simpa using hedge⟩
  · simpa only [c, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_reverse] using
      congrArg (fun n : ℕ => n + 1) hlen
  · simp [c]

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.not_isBipartite
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.not_isBipartite
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) : ¬ G.IsBipartite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, c, hc⟩ := exists_simpleCycle_of_minDegree_ge_three G M.isCounterexample.1
  cases c with
  | nil => exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.not_isCycle_nil hc).elim
  | cons hab p =>
    obtain ⟨k, q, hk, _, hlen, _⟩ := M.adjacent_dyadic_alternative_path hab
    have heven : Even q.length := by
      rw [hlen]
      exact (show Even (2 : ℕ) by decide).pow_of_ne_zero (by omega)
    exact not_isBipartite_of_opposite_parity_routes hab.toWalk q (by simp) heven

name: Erdos64.rootDeletedComponent_internal_noPowerOfTwoCycle
statement:
theorem rootDeletedComponent_internal_noPowerOfTwoCycle
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hno : ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle G) (r : V)
    (C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) :
    ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).induce C.supp)
proof:
:= by
  apply not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle_induce_of_not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle
  exact not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle_induce_of_not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle hno

name: Erdos64.twoPortComponent_internal_noPowerOfTwoCycle
statement:
theorem twoPortComponent_internal_noPowerOfTwoCycle
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hno : ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle G) (r : V)
    (C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (_hports : (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card = 2) :
    ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).induce C.supp)
proof:
:=
  rootDeletedComponent_internal_noPowerOfTwoCycle hno r C

name: Erdos64.twoPort_path_length_ne_pow_two_sub_two
statement:
theorem twoPort_path_length_ne_pow_two_sub_two
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {r a b : V}
    {p : G.Walk a b}
    (hno : ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle G)
    (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hroot : r ∉ p.support)
    (hra : G.Adj r a)
    (hrb : G.Adj r b)
    (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hlong : 1 < p.length)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    p.length ≠ 2 ^ k - 2
proof:
:= by
  intro hlen
  have hnot := terminal_path_length_not_dyadic_of_no_powerOfTwoCycle
    hno hp hroot hra hrb hab hlong hk
  apply hnot
  rw [hlen]
  have hpow : 4 ≤ 2 ^ k := four_le_pow_two hk
  omega

name: Erdos64.root_edge_completion_path_of_pow_two_sub_two
statement:
theorem root_edge_completion_path_of_pow_two_sub_two
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {r a b : V}
    {p : G.Walk a b}
    (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hroot : r ∉ p.support)
    (hra : G.Adj r a)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (hlen : p.length = 2 ^ k - 2) :
    ∃ q : G.Walk r b, q.IsPath ∧ q.length = 2 ^ k - 1
proof:
:= by
  let q : G.Walk r b := SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hra p
  refine ⟨q, hp.cons hroot, ?_⟩
  simp only [q, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons, hlen]
  have hpow : 4 ≤ 2 ^ k := four_le_pow_two hk
  omega

name: Erdos64.leafBlock_articulation_internalDegree_le_two
statement:
theorem leafBlock_articulation_internalDegree_le_two
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (K : Finset V) (root : V)
    (hKconn : (G.induce (↑K : Set V)).Connected)
    (hKnonempty : K.Nonempty)
    (hKproper : K ≠ (Finset.univ : Finset V))
    (hroot : root ∈ K)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ x, x ∈ K → ∀ y, y ∉ K → G.Adj x y → x = root)
    (hclosed : ∀ v, v ∈ K → v ≠ root → 3 ≤ G.degree v)
    (hcritical : IsSubgraphCritical G) :
    internalDegree G K root ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvlow⟩ := hcritical K hKnonempty hKproper
  by_cases hvr : v = root
  · simpa only [hvr] using hvlow
  · have hvdeg : 3 ≤ G.degree v := hclosed v hv hvr
    have hneighbors : ∀ w, G.Adj v w → w ∈ K := by
      intro w hvw
      by_contra hwK
      exact hvr (hboundary v hv w hwK hvw)
    have hfilter : K.filter (G.Adj v) = G.neighborFinset v := by
      ext w
      rw [Finset.mem_filter]
      constructor
      · intro hw
        exact (G.mem_neighborFinset v w).2 hw.2
      · intro hw
        have hvw : G.Adj v w := (G.mem_neighborFinset v w).1 hw
        exact ⟨hneighbors w hvw, hvw⟩
    have hvinternal : internalDegree G K v = G.degree v := by
      change (K.filter (G.Adj v)).card = G.degree v
      rw [hfilter]
      exact SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree G v
    rw [hvinternal] at hvlow
    omega

name: Erdos64.rootedDouble_edge_count
statement:
theorem rootedDouble_edge_count
    {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) [Fintype V]
    [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj] (r : V) :
    (rootedDoubleGraph G r).edgeFinset.card = 2 * G.edgeFinset.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsum : (∑ z, (rootedDoubleGraph G r).degree z) =
      2 * ∑ v, G.degree v := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_option]
    simp_rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, rootedDouble_nonroot_degree_preservation]
    rw [Fintype.sum_bool, rootedDouble_root_degree_doubling,
      Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne (fun v => G.degree v) r]
    omega
  rw [(rootedDoubleGraph G r).sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges,
    G.sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges] at hsum
  omega

name: Erdos64.rootedDouble_edgeSet_ncard
statement:
theorem rootedDouble_edgeSet_ncard
    {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) [Fintype V]
    [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj] (r : V) :
    (rootedDoubleGraph G r).edgeSet.ncard = 2 * G.edgeSet.ncard
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa only [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card', SimpleGraph.edgeFinset]
    using rootedDouble_edge_count G r

name: Erdos64.rootedDouble_closed_side_isCounterexample
statement:
theorem rootedDouble_closed_side_isCounterexample
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hce : IsCounterexample G)
    (S : Finset V) (r : {v : V // v ∈ S})
    (hclosed : ∀ v, v ∈ S → v ≠ r.val →
      ∀ w, G.Adj v w → w ∈ S)
    (hroot : 2 ≤ internalDegree G S r.val) :
    IsCounterexample (rootedDoubleGraph (G.induce (↑S : Set V)) r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · apply SimpleGraph.le_minDegree_of_forall_le_degree
    intro z
    cases z with
    | none =>
        rw [rootedDouble_root_degree_doubling,
          degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree G r]
        omega
    | some bv =>
        rcases bv with ⟨b, v⟩
        rw [rootedDouble_nonroot_degree_preservation]
        have hvroot : v.val.val ≠ r.val := by
          intro heq
          exact v.property (Subtype.ext heq)
        have hneighbors : S.filter (G.Adj v.val.val) =
            G.neighborFinset v.val.val := by
          ext w
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]
          exact ⟨And.right, fun hadj =>
            ⟨hclosed v.val.val v.val.property hvroot w hadj, hadj⟩⟩
        rw [degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree G v.val]
        change 3 ≤ (S.filter (G.Adj v.val.val)).card
        rw [hneighbors, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
        exact degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hce.1 v.val.val
  · intro hdouble
    rcases hdouble with ⟨k, z, c, hk, hc, hlength⟩
    have hproject_cycle := (rootedDouble_cycle_projection c hc).1
    let inclusion : G.induce (↑S : Set V) →g G :=
      { toFun := Subtype.val
        map_rel' := by
          intro a b hab
          exact hab }
    refine hce.2 ⟨k, _, (c.map rootedDoubleProjectionHom).map inclusion,
      hk, hproject_cycle.map Subtype.val_injective, ?_⟩
    simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map] using hlength

name: Erdos64.cycle_based_at_fresh_vertex
statement:
theorem cycle_based_at_fresh_vertex
    {W : Type u} {H : SimpleGraph W} {x a b : W}
    (p : H.Walk a b) (hp : p.IsPath) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hxa : H.Adj x a) (hxb : H.Adj x b) (hx : x ∉ p.support) :
    ∃ c : H.Walk x x, c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = p.length + 2
proof:
:= by
  let c := SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hxa (p.concat hxb.symm)
  refine ⟨c, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isCycle_iff _ hxa).mpr
    refine ⟨hp.concat hx hxb.symm, ?_⟩
    intro he
    simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.edges_concat, List.concat_eq_append,
      List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at he
    rcases he with he | he
    · exact hx (p.fst_mem_support_of_mem_edges he)
    · rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp he with he | he
      · exact hxb.ne he.1
      · exact hab he.2
  · simp [c, Nat.add_assoc]

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.two_defect_port_dyadic_successor_cycle
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.two_defect_port_dyadic_successor_cycle
    {V W : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] [DecidableRel H.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (x y : W) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hx : H.degree x = 2) (hy : 2 ≤ H.degree y)
    (hother : ∀ w, w ≠ x → w ≠ y → 3 ≤ H.degree w)
    (hno : ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle H)
    (hsize : 2 * Fintype.card W - 3 < Fintype.card V) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ c : H.Walk x x,
      1 ≤ k ∧ c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = 2 ^ k + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hN⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp
    (show (H.neighborFinset x).card = 2 by simpa using hx)
  have hneighbors : ∀ w, H.Adj x w ↔ w = a ∨ w = b := by
    intro w
    rw [← SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, hN]
    simp
  have hxa := (hneighbors a).2 (Or.inl rfl)
  have hxb := (hneighbors b).2 (Or.inr rfl)
  by_cases hadj : H.Adj a b
  · have hxavoid : x ∉ hadj.toWalk.support := by
      simp [SimpleGraph.Adj.toWalk, hxa.ne, hxb.ne]
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hlen⟩ := cycle_based_at_fresh_vertex
      hadj.toWalk (SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.of_adj hadj) hab hxa hxb hxavoid
    exact ⟨1, c, by omega, hc, by simpa using hlen⟩
  let K := degreeTwoSuppressionGraph H x a b hxa.ne.symm hxb.ne.symm
  let y' : {w : W // w ≠ x} := ⟨y, hxy.symm⟩
  have hdeg : ∀ w, K.degree w = H.degree w.1 :=
    degreeTwoSuppressionGraph_degree H x a b hxa.ne.symm hxb.ne.symm
      hab hadj hneighbors
  have hroot : 2 ≤ K.degree y' := by rw [hdeg]; exact hy
  have hothers : ∀ w, w ≠ y' → 3 ≤ K.degree w := by
    intro w hw
    rw [hdeg]
    exact hother w.1 w.2 (fun h => hw (Subtype.ext h))
  have hcard := card_ne_vertex_add_one x
  have hsmall : 2 * Fintype.card {w : W // w ≠ x} - 1 < Fintype.card V := by
    omega
  have hyes := M.one_defect_small_has_dyadic_cycle y' hroot hothers hsmall
  have hdeleted : ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle (H.induce {w | w ≠ x}) :=
    not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle_induce_of_not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle hno
  obtain ⟨k, q, hk, hq, hlen⟩ := added_edge_dyadic_cycle_path hdeleted hyes
  let e : H.induce {w | w ≠ x} ↪g H := SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce _
  let p := q.map e.toHom
  have hp : p.IsPath := hq.map e.injective
  have hxavoid : x ∉ p.support := by
    intro hxmem
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map] at hxmem
    obtain ⟨w, _, hw⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hxmem
    exact w.2 hw
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hclen⟩ := cycle_based_at_fresh_vertex p hp hab hxa hxb hxavoid
  refine ⟨k, c, by omega, hc, ?_⟩
  have hplen : p.length + 1 = 2 ^ k := by
    simpa only [p, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map] using hlen
  omega

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.high_degree_incidence_le_cubic_plus_connectors
proof:
:= by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let H := Finset.univ.filter (fun v => 4 ≤ G.degree v)
  let L := Finset.univ.filter (fun v => G.degree v = 3)
  change 4 * H.card ≤ L.card +
    (L.filter (fun v => (H.filter (G.Adj v)).card = 2)).card
  have hleft : 4 * H.card ≤ ∑ u ∈ H, (L.filter (G.Adj u)).card := by
    calc
      4 * H.card = ∑ _u ∈ H, 4 := by simp [Nat.mul_comm]
      _ ≤ ∑ u ∈ H, (L.filter (G.Adj u)).card := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro u hu
        have hu4 : 4 ≤ G.degree u := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hu).2
        have hfin : L.filter (G.Adj u) = G.neighborFinset u := by
          ext v
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]
          constructor
          · exact fun h => h.2
          · intro huv
            refine ⟨?_, huv⟩
            simp only [L, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
            exact M.neighbor_degree_eq_three_of_degree_ge_four hu4 huv
        simpa only [hfin, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] using hu4
  have hdouble : (∑ u ∈ H, (L.filter (G.Adj u)).card) =
      ∑ v ∈ L, (H.filter (G.Adj v)).card := by
    simpa only [Finset.bipartiteAbove, Finset.bipartiteBelow, G.adj_comm] using
      (Finset.sum_card_bipartiteAbove_eq_sum_card_bipartiteBelow G.Adj
        (s := H) (t := L))
  have hright : (∑ v ∈ L, (H.filter (G.Adj v)).card) ≤
      L.card + (L.filter (fun v => (H.filter (G.Adj v)).card = 2)).card := by
    calc
      (∑ v ∈ L, (H.filter (G.Adj v)).card) ≤
          ∑ v ∈ L, (1 + if (H.filter (G.Adj v)).card = 2 then 1 else 0) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro v hv
        have hv3 : G.degree v = 3 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
        have hb : (H.filter (G.Adj v)).card ≤ 2 :=
          M.high_degree_neighborFinset_card_le_two_of_degree_eq_three hv3
        split <;> omega
      _ = _ := by simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  exact hleft.trans (hdouble ▸ hright)

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.card_eq_cubic_add_high
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.card_eq_cubic_add_high
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G) :
    Fintype.card V =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => G.degree v = 3)).card +
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => 4 ≤ G.degree v)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L := Finset.univ.filter (fun v => G.degree v = 3)
  let H := Finset.univ.filter (fun v => 4 ≤ G.degree v)
  have hpartition : L ∪ H = Finset.univ := by
    ext v
    have hv := degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G M.vertexMinimal.isCounterexample.1 v
    simp only [L, H, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · intro _
      trivial
    · intro _
      by_cases hv3 : G.degree v = 3
      · exact Or.inl hv3
      · exact Or.inr (by omega)
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint L H := by
    refine Finset.disjoint_left.2 ?_
    intro v hvL hvH
    have hv3 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hvL).2
    have hv4 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hvH).2
    omega
  simpa only [hpartition, Finset.card_univ] using
    (Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisjoint)

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.cubic_density_of_connector_bound
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.cubic_density_of_connector_bound
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G)
    (hconnectors :
      let H := Finset.univ.filter (fun v => 4 ≤ G.degree v)
      let L := Finset.univ.filter (fun v => G.degree v = 3)
      (L.filter (fun v => (H.filter (G.Adj v)).card = 2)).card + 3 ≤
        2 * H.card) :
    2 * (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => 4 ≤ G.degree v)).card + 3 ≤
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => G.degree v = 3)).card ∧
    2 * Fintype.card V + 3 ≤
      3 * (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => G.degree v = 3)).card
proof:
:= by
  have hinc := M.high_degree_incidence_le_cubic_plus_connectors
  have hpart := M.card_eq_cubic_add_high
  dsimp only at hinc hconnectors
  omega

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.six_le_card_of_degree_ge_four
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.six_le_card_of_degree_ge_four
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G)
    {r : V} (hr : 4 ≤ G.degree r) :
    6 ≤ Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  have hsmall : Fintype.card V ≤ 5 := by omega
  have hsub : G.neighborFinset r ⊆ Finset.univ.erase r := by
    intro v hv
    have hrv := (G.mem_neighborFinset r v).mp hv
    exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hrv.ne.symm, Finset.mem_univ v⟩
  have hN : G.neighborFinset r = Finset.univ.erase r := by
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ r), Finset.card_univ,
      SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
    omega
  have hnonempty : (G.neighborFinset r).Nonempty := by
    rw [← Finset.card_pos, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
    omega
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hnonempty
  have hrv := (G.mem_neighborFinset r v).mp hv
  have hv3 := M.neighbor_degree_eq_three_of_degree_ge_four hr hrv
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, hvx, hvy, hxr, hyr⟩ :=
    exists_two_other_neighbors_of_degree_three hrv hv3
  have hrx : G.Adj r x := by
    apply (G.mem_neighborFinset r x).mp
    rw [hN]
    simp [hxr]
  have hry : G.Adj r y := by
    apply (G.mem_neighborFinset r y).mp
    rw [hN]
    simp [hyr]
  have hvr := M.vertexMinimal.common_neighbor_eq_root_of_nonadjacent_ports
    hrx hry hxy hvx.symm hvy.symm hvx.ne hvy.ne
  exact hrv.ne hvr.symm

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.cubic_density_of_conditional_connector_bound
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.cubic_density_of_conditional_connector_bound
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G)
    (hconnectors :
      let H := Finset.univ.filter (fun v => 4 ≤ G.degree v)
      let L := Finset.univ.filter (fun v => G.degree v = 3)
      2 ≤ H.card →
        (L.filter (fun v => (H.filter (G.Adj v)).card = 2)).card + 3 ≤
          2 * H.card) :
    2 * (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => 4 ≤ G.degree v)).card + 3 ≤
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => G.degree v = 3)).card ∧
    2 * Fintype.card V + 3 ≤
      3 * (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => G.degree v = 3)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H := Finset.univ.filter (fun v => 4 ≤ G.degree v)
  by_cases htwo : 2 ≤ H.card
  · exact M.cubic_density_of_connector_bound (hconnectors htwo)
