  have hpart := M.card_eq_cubic_add_high
  have hfour : 4 ≤ Fintype.card V := by
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := M.exists_degree_eq_three
    have hv3 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have hvcard := G.degree_lt_card_verts v
    omega
  by_cases hzero : H.card = 0
  · change 2 * H.card + 3 ≤ _ ∧ _
    change Fintype.card V = _ + H.card at hpart
    omega
  have hnonempty : H.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hnonempty
  have hr4 : 4 ≤ G.degree r := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).2
  have hsix := M.six_le_card_of_degree_ge_four hr4
  change 2 * H.card + 3 ≤ _ ∧ _
  change Fintype.card V = _ + H.card at hpart
  omega

name: Erdos64.rootDeleted_distinct_carriers_disjoint
statement:
private theorem rootDeleted_distinct_carriers_disjoint
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (r : V) (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hCD : C ≠ D) :
    Disjoint (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
      (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D)
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro v hvC hvD
  obtain ⟨hvr, hvCs⟩ := (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r C v).mp hvC
  obtain ⟨_, hvDs⟩ := (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r D v).mp hvD
  have hC := (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff C ⟨v, hvr⟩).mp hvCs
  have hD := (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff D ⟨v, hvr⟩).mp hvDs
  exact hCD (hC.symm.trans hD)

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_two_components_order
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_two_components_order
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hCD : C ≠ D) :
    2 * (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C).card + 1 = Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcard, hcover⟩ := M.rootDeleted_two_components_balanced r C D hCD
  have hroot : r ∉ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∪
      rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_union, not_or]
    exact ⟨(rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C).2,
      (rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r D).2⟩
  have htotal := congrArg Finset.card hcover
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hroot,
    Finset.card_union_of_disjoint (rootDeleted_distinct_carriers_disjoint r C D hCD),
    Finset.card_univ] at htotal
  omega

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_root_unique
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_root_unique
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r x : V)
    (hr : ∃ C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent, C ≠ D)
    (hx : ∃ A B : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ x}).ConnectedComponent, A ≠ B) :
    r = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hrx
  let A : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ x}).ConnectedComponent :=
    (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ x}).connectedComponentMk ⟨r, hrx⟩
  have hrA : r ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G x A := by
    apply (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G x A r).mpr
    exact ⟨hrx, (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff A ⟨r, hrx⟩).mpr rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨E, F, hEF⟩ := hx
  have hother : ∃ B : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ x}).ConnectedComponent, A ≠ B := by
    by_cases hAE : A = E
    · exact ⟨F, by simpa only [hAE] using hEF⟩
    · exact ⟨E, hAE⟩
  obtain ⟨B, hAB⟩ := hother
  have hAorder := M.rootDeleted_two_components_order x A B hAB
  have hcontr : ∀ (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent),
      C ≠ D → x ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C → False := by
    intro C D hCD hxC
    have hDorder := M.rootDeleted_two_components_order r D C hCD.symm
    have hsubset : insert r (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D) ⊆
        rootDeletedComponentCarrier G x A := by
      intro v hv
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hv with hvr | hvD
      · simpa only [hvr] using hrA
      · exact M.rootDeleted_component_nested_in_other_root_component
          r x C D hCD hxC A hrA v hvD
    have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsubset
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem
      (rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r D).2] at hcard
    omega
  obtain ⟨C, D, hCD⟩ := hr
  have hcover := (M.rootDeleted_two_components_balanced r C D hCD).2
  have hxcover : x ∈ insert r (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∪
      rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D) := by
    rw [hcover]
    exact Finset.mem_univ x
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hxcover with hxr | hxCD
  · exact hrx hxr.symm
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hxCD with hxC | hxD
  · exact hcontr C D hCD hxC
  · exact hcontr D C hCD.symm hxD

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_connected_away_from_cut
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_connected_away_from_cut
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r x : V)
    (hr : ∃ C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent, C ≠ D)
    (hxr : x ≠ r) : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ x}).Connected
proof:
:= by
  refine { preconnected := ?_, nonempty := ⟨⟨r, hxr.symm⟩⟩ }
  intro u v
  apply SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.eq.mp
  by_contra huv
  exact hxr (M.rootDeleted_cut_root_unique r x hr ⟨_, _, huv⟩).symm

name: Erdos64.GlobalEdgeMinimalCounterexample.closed_sides_edge_count_eq
statement:
theorem GlobalEdgeMinimalCounterexample.closed_sides_edge_count_eq
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : GlobalEdgeMinimalCounterexample G)
    (A B : Finset V) (r : V)
    (hpartition : A ∪ B = Finset.univ)
    (hinter : A ∩ B = {r})
    (hclosedA : ∀ x, x ∈ A → x ≠ r → ∀ y, G.Adj x y → y ∈ A)
    (hclosedB : ∀ x, x ∈ B → x ≠ r → ∀ y, G.Adj x y → y ∈ B)
    (hrootA : 2 ≤ internalDegree G A r)
    (hrootB : 2 ≤ internalDegree G B r)
    (hcard : A.card = B.card) :
    (G.induce (↑A : Set V)).edgeFinset.card =
      (G.induce (↑B : Set V)).edgeFinset.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hr : r ∈ A ∧ r ∈ B := by
    apply Finset.mem_inter.mp
    rw [hinter]
    simp
  have horder := Finset.card_union_add_card_inter A B
  rw [hpartition, hinter, Finset.card_univ, Finset.card_singleton] at horder
  have hcompare : ∀ (S : Finset V) (hS : r ∈ S),
      (∀ x, x ∈ S → x ≠ r → ∀ y, G.Adj x y → y ∈ S) →
      2 ≤ internalDegree G S r → S.card = A.card →
      G.edgeFinset.card ≤ 2 * (G.induce (↑S : Set V)).edgeFinset.card := by
    intro S hS hclosed hroot hScard
    let root : {v : V // v ∈ S} := ⟨r, hS⟩
    have hcounter := rootedDouble_closed_side_isCounterexample
      M.vertexMinimal.isCounterexample S root hclosed hroot
    have hsize : Fintype.card (RootedDoubleVertex (↑S : Set V) root) =
        Fintype.card V := by
      rw [rootedDouble_card]
      have hSsize : Fintype.card (↑S : Set V) = S.card :=
        Fintype.card_of_finset' S (fun _ => Iff.rfl)
      rw [hSsize]
      omega
    have hle := M.edgeCountMinimal _ _ hcounter hsize
    rw [rootedDouble_edgeSet_ncard] at hle
    simpa only [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card', SimpleGraph.edgeFinset] using hle
  have hA := hcompare A hr.1 hclosedA hrootA rfl
  have hB := hcompare B hr.2 hclosedB hrootB hcard.symm
  have hsum := closed_sides_edge_count A B r hpartition hinter hclosedA hclosedB
  omega

name: Erdos64.GlobalEdgeMinimalCounterexample.two_onePort_sides_balanced_edges_excess
statement:
theorem GlobalEdgeMinimalCounterexample.two_onePort_sides_balanced_edges_excess
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : GlobalEdgeMinimalCounterexample G)
    (D E : Finset V) (r : V)
    (hD : D.Nonempty) (hE : E.Nonempty)
    (hrD : r ∉ D) (hrE : r ∉ E)
    (hdisj : Disjoint D E)
    (hboundaryD : ∀ u, u ∈ D → ∀ v, v ∉ D → G.Adj u v → v = r)
    (hboundaryE : ∀ u, u ∈ E → ∀ v, v ∉ E → G.Adj u v → v = r) :
    (G.induce (↑(insert r D) : Set V)).edgeFinset.card =
        (G.induce (↑(insert r E) : Set V)).edgeFinset.card ∧
      nonrootDegreeExcess G (insert r D) r =
        nonrootDegreeExcess G (insert r E) r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hcard, hcover⟩ := M.vertexMinimal.two_onePort_sides_balanced
    D E r hD hE hrD hrE hdisj hboundaryD hboundaryE
  obtain ⟨hdegreeD, hdegreeE, _⟩ := M.vertexMinimal.two_closed_sides_root_degree_four
    D E r hD hE hrD hrE hdisj hcover hboundaryD hboundaryE
  let A := insert r D
  let B := insert r E
  have hrootA : r ∈ A := Finset.mem_insert_self r D
  have hrootB : r ∈ B := Finset.mem_insert_self r E
  have hpartition : A ∪ B = Finset.univ := by
    simpa only [A, B, Finset.insert_union, Finset.union_insert, Finset.insert_idem]
      using hcover
  have hinter : A ∩ B = {r} := by
    ext v
    simp only [A, B, Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hvD, hvE⟩
      rcases hvD with hvr | hvD
      · exact hvr
      rcases hvE with hvr | hvE
      · exact hvr
      exact ((Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisj) hvD hvE).elim
    · intro hvr
      exact ⟨Or.inl hvr, Or.inl hvr⟩
  have closed : ∀ K : Finset V,
      (∀ u, u ∈ K → ∀ v, v ∉ K → G.Adj u v → v = r) →
      ∀ u, u ∈ insert r K → u ≠ r → ∀ v, G.Adj u v → v ∈ insert r K := by
    intro K hboundary u hu hur v huv
    have huK := (Finset.mem_insert.mp hu).resolve_left hur
    by_cases hvK : v ∈ K
    · exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr hvK)
    · exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inl (hboundary u huK v hvK huv))
  have hclosedA := closed D hboundaryD
  have hclosedB := closed E hboundaryE
  have hrootDegreeA : 2 ≤ internalDegree G A r := by
    have heq : internalDegree G A r = 2 := by
      simpa [A, internalDegree, Finset.filter_insert] using hdegreeD
    omega
  have hrootDegreeB : 2 ≤ internalDegree G B r := by
    have heq : internalDegree G B r = 2 := by
      simpa [B, internalDegree, Finset.filter_insert] using hdegreeE
    omega
  have hcardAB : A.card = B.card := by
    simp only [A, B, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hrD,
      Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hrE, hcard]
  have hedges := M.closed_sides_edge_count_eq A B r hpartition hinter
    hclosedA hclosedB hrootDegreeA hrootDegreeB hcardAB
  have hnocross : ∀ x, x ∈ A → x ≠ r →
      ∀ y, y ∈ B → y ≠ r → ¬ G.Adj x y := by
    intro x hx hxr y hy hyr hxy
    have hyA := hclosedA x hx hxr y hxy
    have hyAB := Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hyA, hy⟩
    rw [hinter, Finset.mem_singleton] at hyAB
    exact hyr hyAB
  have hbalance := equal_cut_root_balanced_excess M.toEdgeMinimalCounterexample
    A B r hpartition hinter hrootA hrootB hclosedA hclosedB hnocross
    hrootDegreeA hrootDegreeB hcardAB hedges
  exact ⟨hedges, hbalance.2.2.2.2⟩

name: Erdos64.GlobalEdgeMinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_two_components_balanced_edges_excess
statement:
theorem GlobalEdgeMinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_two_components_balanced_edges_excess
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : GlobalEdgeMinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hCD : C ≠ D) :
    (G.induce (↑(insert r (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)) : Set V)).edgeFinset.card =
        (G.induce (↑(insert r (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D)) : Set V)).edgeFinset.card ∧
      nonrootDegreeExcess G (insert r (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)) r =
        nonrootDegreeExcess G (insert r (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D)) r
proof:
:= by
  have hC := rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C
  have hD := rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r D
  have hdisj : Disjoint (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
      (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D) := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro v hvC hvD
    obtain ⟨hvr, hvCs⟩ := (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r C v).mp hvC
    obtain ⟨_, hvDs⟩ := (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r D v).mp hvD
    have hmkC := (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff C ⟨v, hvr⟩).mp hvCs
    have hmkD := (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff D ⟨v, hvr⟩).mp hvDs
    exact hCD (hmkC.symm.trans hmkD)
  have boundary : ∀ E : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent,
      ∀ u, u ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r E →
        ∀ v, v ∉ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r E → G.Adj u v → v = r := by
    intro E u hu v hv huv
    rcases (rootDeletedComponent_boundary r M.vertexMinimal.isConnected E).1
        u hu v huv with hvE | hvr
    · exact (hv hvE).elim
    · exact hvr
  exact M.two_onePort_sides_balanced_edges_excess
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D)
    r hC.1 hD.1 hC.2 hD.2 hdisj (boundary C) (boundary D)

name: Erdos64.terminal_path_reroute_of_ear
statement:
theorem terminal_path_reroute_of_ear
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {a b x y : V}
    (pre : G.Walk a x)
    (segment : G.Walk x y)
    (suffix : G.Walk y b)
    (ear : G.Walk x y)
    (hpre : pre.IsPath)
    (hsegment : segment.IsPath)
    (hsuffix : suffix.IsPath)
    (hear : ear.IsPath)
    (hprefix_segment :
      pre.support.Disjoint segment.support.tail)
    (hsegment_ear :
      segment.support.tail.Disjoint ear.reverse.support.tail)
    (horiginal_suffix :
      (pre.append segment).support.Disjoint suffix.support.tail)
    (hrerouted_prefix :
      pre.support.Disjoint ear.support.tail)
    (hrerouted_suffix :
      (pre.append ear).support.Disjoint suffix.support.tail)
    (hlong : 1 < segment.length ∨ 1 < ear.length) :
    ∃ rerouted : G.Walk a b, rerouted.IsPath ∧
      rerouted.length =
        pre.length + ear.length + suffix.length ∧
      ∃ cycle : G.Walk x x, cycle.IsCycle ∧
        cycle.length = segment.length + ear.length
proof:
:= by
  have original_prefix : (pre.append segment).IsPath := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.isPath_def, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_append]
    have hdisjoint :
        ∀ z ∈ pre.support, ∀ w ∈ segment.support.tail, z ≠ w :=
      by
        intro z hz w hw hzw
        subst w
        exact (List.disjoint_left.mp hprefix_segment hz) hw
    exact List.nodup_append.mpr
      ⟨hpre.support_nodup, hsegment.support_nodup.tail,
        hdisjoint⟩
  have original : ((pre.append segment).append suffix).IsPath := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.isPath_def, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_append]
    have hdisjoint :
        ∀ z ∈ (pre.append segment).support, ∀ w ∈ suffix.support.tail, z ≠ w :=
      by
        intro z hz w hw hzw
        subst w
        exact (List.disjoint_left.mp horiginal_suffix hz) hw
    exact List.nodup_append.mpr
      ⟨original_prefix.support_nodup, hsuffix.support_nodup.tail,
        hdisjoint⟩
  have rerouted_prefix : (pre.append ear).IsPath := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.isPath_def, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_append]
    have hdisjoint :
        ∀ z ∈ pre.support, ∀ w ∈ ear.support.tail, z ≠ w :=
      by
        intro z hz w hw hzw
        subst w
        exact (List.disjoint_left.mp hrerouted_prefix hz) hw
    exact List.nodup_append.mpr
      ⟨hpre.support_nodup, hear.support_nodup.tail,
        hdisjoint⟩
  have rerouted : ((pre.append ear).append suffix).IsPath := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.isPath_def, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_append]
    have hdisjoint :
        ∀ z ∈ (pre.append ear).support, ∀ w ∈ suffix.support.tail, z ≠ w :=
      by
        intro z hz w hw hzw
        subst w
        exact (List.disjoint_left.mp hrerouted_suffix hz) hw
    exact List.nodup_append.mpr
      ⟨rerouted_prefix.support_nodup, hsuffix.support_nodup.tail,
        hdisjoint⟩
  let cycle : G.Walk x x := segment.append ear.reverse
  have hcycle : cycle.IsCycle := by
    dsimp [cycle]
    exact hsegment.isCycle_append hear.reverse hsegment_ear
      (by simpa [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_reverse] using hlong)
  refine ⟨(pre.append ear).append suffix, rerouted, ?_, cycle, hcycle, ?_⟩
  · simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_append, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_reverse]
  · simp [cycle, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_append,
      SimpleGraph.Walk.length_reverse]

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.highDegreeAuxGraph_low_internal_degree
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.highDegreeAuxGraph_low_internal_degree
    (M : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G)
    (S : Finset (HighDegreeVertex G)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    ∃ w ∈ S, internalDegree (highDegreeAuxGraph G) S w ≤ 2
proof:
:=
  M.vertexMinimal.twoStep_has_low_internal_degree M.highDegreeTwoStepEmbedding S hS

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.highDegreeAuxGraph_edge_bound
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.highDegreeAuxGraph_edge_bound
    (M : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G)
    (hn : 2 ≤ Fintype.card (HighDegreeVertex G)) :
    (highDegreeAuxGraph G).edgeFinset.card + 3 ≤
      2 * Fintype.card (HighDegreeVertex G)
proof:
:=
  two_degenerate_edge_bound (highDegreeAuxGraph G)
    M.highDegreeAuxGraph_low_internal_degree hn

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.degreeThreeTwoHighNeighbors_card_bound
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.degreeThreeTwoHighNeighbors_card_bound
    (M : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G)
    (hn : 2 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => 4 ≤ G.degree v)).card) :
    (degreeThreeTwoHighNeighbors G).card + 3 ≤
      2 * (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => 4 ≤ G.degree v)).card
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : Fintype.card (HighDegreeVertex G) =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => 4 ≤ G.degree v)).card := by
    exact Fintype.card_subtype _
  have hbound := M.highDegreeAuxGraph_edge_bound (by omega)
  rw [← SimpleGraph.card_edgeSet, M.highDegreeAuxGraph_edge_card, hcard] at hbound
  exact hbound

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.cubic_density_additive_three
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.cubic_density_additive_three
    (M : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G) :
    2 * (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => 4 ≤ G.degree v)).card + 3 ≤
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => G.degree v = 3)).card ∧
    2 * Fintype.card V + 3 ≤
      3 * (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => G.degree v = 3)).card
proof:
:= by
  apply M.cubic_density_of_conditional_connector_bound
  dsimp only
  intro hn
  exact M.degreeThreeTwoHighNeighbors_card_bound hn

name: Erdos64.internalDegree_induce_map
statement:
theorem internalDegree_induce_map
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (s : Set V) [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)]
    (S : Finset s) (v : s) :
    internalDegree (G.induce s) S v =
      internalDegree G (S.map (.subtype (· ∈ s))) v.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [internalDegree, Finset.filter_map, Finset.card_map]
  rfl

name: Erdos64.two_degenerate_edge_bound_aux
statement:
private theorem two_degenerate_edge_bound_aux (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
      (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj],
      Fintype.card V = n →
      (∀ S : Finset V, S.Nonempty → ∃ v ∈ S, internalDegree G S v ≤ 2) →
      2 ≤ n → G.edgeFinset.card + 3 ≤ 2 * n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    intro V _ _ G _ hcard hlow hn
    classical
    by_cases htwo : n = 2
    · have hedge := G.card_edgeFinset_le_card_choose_two
      rw [hcard, htwo] at hedge
      simp only [Nat.choose_self] at hedge
      omega
    have hnonempty : (Finset.univ : Finset V).Nonempty := by
      rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
      intro he
      have := congrArg Finset.card he
      simp only [Finset.card_univ, Finset.card_empty] at this
      omega
    obtain ⟨v, _, hv⟩ := hlow Finset.univ hnonempty
    have hvdegree : G.degree v ≤ 2 := by
      simpa [internalDegree, ← SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_eq_filter] using hv
    let W := ({v}ᶜ : Set V)
    let H : SimpleGraph W := G.induce ({v}ᶜ : Set V)
    have hWcard : Fintype.card W = n - 1 := by
      change Fintype.card {w : V // ¬ w = v} = n - 1
      rw [Fintype.card_subtype_compl]
      simp [hcard]
    have hlowH : ∀ S : Finset W, S.Nonempty →
        ∃ w ∈ S, internalDegree H S w ≤ 2 := by
      intro S hS
      let emb : W ↪ V := .subtype (· ∈ ({v}ᶜ : Set V))
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hwdegree⟩ := hlow (S.map emb) hS.map
      obtain ⟨w, hwS, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hw
      refine ⟨w, hwS, ?_⟩
      change ((S.map emb).filter (G.Adj w.1)).card ≤ 2 at hwdegree
      rw [Finset.filter_map, Finset.card_map] at hwdegree
      exact hwdegree
    have hbound := ih (n - 1) (by omega) H hWcard hlowH (by omega)
    have hdelete : H.edgeFinset.card = G.edgeFinset.card - G.degree v := by
      exact (G.card_edgeFinset_induce_compl_singleton v).trans
        (G.card_edgeFinset_deleteIncidenceSet v)
    rw [hdelete] at hbound
    have hvle := G.degree_le_card_edgeFinset v
    omega

name: Erdos64.two_degenerate_edge_bound
statement:
theorem two_degenerate_edge_bound
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hlow : ∀ S : Finset V, S.Nonempty →
      ∃ v ∈ S, internalDegree G S v ≤ 2)
    (hn : 2 ≤ Fintype.card V) :
    G.edgeFinset.card + 3 ≤ 2 * Fintype.card V
proof:
:=
  two_degenerate_edge_bound_aux (Fintype.card V) G rfl hlow hn

name: Erdos64.two_degenerate_induce_edge_bound
statement:
theorem two_degenerate_induce_edge_bound
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (S : Finset V)
    (hlow : ∀ T : Finset V, T ⊆ S → T.Nonempty →
      ∃ v ∈ T, internalDegree G T v ≤ 2)
    (hn : 2 ≤ S.card) :
    (G.induce (↑S : Set V)).edgeFinset.card + 3 ≤ 2 * S.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hlowS : ∀ T : Finset (↑S : Set V), T.Nonempty →
      ∃ v ∈ T, internalDegree (G.induce (↑S : Set V)) T v ≤ 2 := by
    intro T hT
    let emb : (↑S : Set V) ↪ V := .subtype (· ∈ (↑S : Set V))
    have hsub : T.map emb ⊆ S := by
      intro v hv
      obtain ⟨w, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hv
      exact w.2
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hvdegree⟩ := hlow (T.map emb) hsub hT.map
    obtain ⟨v, hvT, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hv
    refine ⟨v, hvT, ?_⟩
    change ((T.map emb).filter (G.Adj v.1)).card ≤ 2 at hvdegree
    rw [Finset.filter_map, Finset.card_map] at hvdegree
    exact hvdegree
  simpa using two_degenerate_edge_bound (G.induce (↑S : Set V)) hlowS
    (by simpa using hn)

name: Erdos64.strict_double_of_closed_side
statement:
theorem strict_double_of_closed_side
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hce : IsCounterexample G)
    (S : Finset V) (r : {v : V // v ∈ S})
    (hclosed : ∀ v, v ∈ S → v ≠ r.val →
      ∀ w, G.Adj v w → w ∈ S)
    (hroot : 2 ≤ internalDegree G S r.val)
    (hsize : 2 * S.card - 1 < Fintype.card V) :
    IsStrictlySmallerCounterexample G
      (rootedDoubleGraph (G.induce (↑S : Set V)) r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · apply SimpleGraph.le_minDegree_of_forall_le_degree
    intro z
    cases z with
    | none =>
        rw [rootedDouble_root_degree_doubling,
          degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree G r]
        omega
    | some bv =>
        rcases bv with ⟨b, v⟩
        rw [rootedDouble_nonroot_degree_preservation]
        have hvroot : v.val.val ≠ r.val := by
          intro heq
          exact v.property (Subtype.ext heq)
        have hneighbors : S.filter (G.Adj v.val.val) =
            G.neighborFinset v.val.val := by
          ext w
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]
          exact ⟨And.right, fun hadj =>
            ⟨hclosed v.val.val v.val.property hvroot w hadj, hadj⟩⟩
        rw [degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree G v.val]
        change 3 ≤ (S.filter (G.Adj v.val.val)).card
        rw [hneighbors, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
        exact degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hce.1 v.val.val
  · intro hdouble
    rcases hdouble with ⟨k, z, c, hk, hc, hlength⟩
    have hproject_cycle := (rootedDouble_cycle_projection c hc).1
    let inclusion : G.induce (↑S : Set V) →g G :=
      { toFun := Subtype.val
        map_rel' := by
          intro a b hab
          exact hab }
    refine hce.2 ⟨k, _, (c.map rootedDoubleProjectionHom).map inclusion,
      hk, hproject_cycle.map Subtype.val_injective, ?_⟩
    simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map] using hlength
  · rw [rootedDouble_card]
    have hcard : Fintype.card (↑S : Set V) = S.card :=
      Fintype.card_of_finset' S (fun _ => Iff.rfl)
    rw [hcard]
    exact hsize

name: Erdos64.SimpleGraph.Walk.MarkedRootPath.exists_cycle
statement:
theorem MarkedRootPath.exists_cycle (P : MarkedRootPath (G := G) r a b) :
    ∃ c : G.Walk a a, c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = P.path.length + 2
proof:
:= by
  exact endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate P.isPath P.root_adj_start P.root_adj_end
    P.root_not_mem P.endpoints_ne P.length_gt_one

name: Erdos64.SimpleGraph.Walk.marked_cycle_decompose
statement:
theorem marked_cycle_decompose
    {r : V} {c : G.Walk r r} (hc : c.IsCycle) :
    ∃ q : G.Walk c.snd c.tail.penultimate,
      q.IsPath ∧ r ∉ q.support ∧ q.length + 2 = c.length
proof:
:= by
  have htail : c.tail.IsPath := hc.isPath_tail
  have htail_nil : ¬c.tail.Nil := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length]
    simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_tail]
    have hlen := hc.three_le_length
    omega
  let q : G.Walk c.snd c.tail.penultimate := c.tail.dropLast
  have hqpath : q.IsPath := by
    exact htail.dropLast
  have hqroot : r ∉ q.support := by
    intro hrq
    have hrdrop : r ∈ c.tail.support.dropLast := by
      simpa [q, c.tail.support_dropLast htail_nil] using hrq
    have hsplit : c.tail.support.dropLast ++ [r] = c.tail.support := by
      have hsne : c.tail.support ≠ [] := c.tail.support_ne_nil
      simpa using
        (List.dropLast_append_getLast (l := c.tail.support) hsne)
    have hnodup : (c.tail.support.dropLast ++ [r]).Nodup := by
      rw [hsplit]
      exact htail.support_nodup
    have hdisj := (List.nodup_append.mp hnodup).2.2
    exact (hdisj r hrdrop r (by simp)) rfl
  refine ⟨q, hqpath, hqroot, ?_⟩
  have htail_len := c.length_tail_add_one hc.not_nil
  have hdrop_len := c.tail.length_dropLast_add_one htail_nil
  change c.tail.dropLast.length + 2 = c.length
  omega

name: Erdos64.external_carrier_two_attachments_or_unique_root
statement:
theorem external_carrier_two_attachments_or_unique_root
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {s : V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {C : G.Walk s s} (hC : C.IsCycle) (K : Set V)
    (hKconn : (G.induce K).Connected)
    (hK_external : ∀ v, v ∈ K → v ∉ C.support)
    (hattach :
      ∃ a, a ∈ C.support ∧ ∃ x, x ∈ K ∧ G.Adj a x) :
    (∃ a b x y, a ∈ C.support ∧ b ∈ C.support ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      x ∈ K ∧ y ∈ K ∧ G.Adj a x ∧ G.Adj b y) ∨
      ∃ r, r ∈ C.support ∧
        ∀ b, b ∈ C.support →
          ((∃ y, y ∈ K ∧ G.Adj b y) ↔ b = r)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases htwo :
      ∃ a b x y, a ∈ C.support ∧ b ∈ C.support ∧ a ≠ b ∧
        x ∈ K ∧ y ∈ K ∧ G.Adj a x ∧ G.Adj b y
  · exact Or.inl htwo
  · right
    obtain ⟨r, hrC, x, hxK, hrx⟩ := hattach
    refine ⟨r, hrC, ?_⟩
    intro b hbC
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hyK, hby⟩
      by_contra hbr
      exact htwo ⟨r, b, x, y, hrC, hbC, Ne.symm hbr, hxK, hyK, hrx, hby⟩
    · intro hbr
      subst b
      exact ⟨x, hxK, hrx⟩

name: Erdos64.LeafBlock.neighbor_mem_of_mem_of_ne_root
statement:
theorem LeafBlock.neighbor_mem_of_mem_of_ne_root
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} (K : Set V)
    (hKconn : (G.induce K).Connected) {root v w : V}
    (hroot : root ∈ K)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ x, x ∈ K → ∀ y, y ∉ K → G.Adj x y → x = root)
    (hv : v ∈ K) (hvroot : v ≠ root) (hvw : G.Adj v w) :
    w ∈ K
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hw
  exact hvroot (hboundary v hv w hw hvw)

name: Erdos64.rootedDouble_cycle_projection_injOn
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨b, hcopy⟩ := rootedDouble_cycle_common_tag p hp
  intro a ha c hc hproj
  cases a with
  | none =>
      cases c with
      | none => rfl
      | some cw =>
          exact (cw.2.2 (by
            simpa [rootedDoubleProjection] using hproj.symm)).elim
  | some av =>
      cases c with
      | none =>
          exact (av.2.2 (by
            simpa [rootedDoubleProjection] using hproj)).elim
      | some cw =>
          have hav := hcopy (some av) ha (by simp)
          have hcw := hcopy (some cw) hc (by simp)
          obtain ⟨v, hav⟩ := hav
          obtain ⟨w, hcw⟩ := hcw
          have hav' : av = (b, v) := Option.some.inj hav
          have hcw' : cw = (b, w) := Option.some.inj hcw
          have hv : av.2 = cw.2 := by
            apply Subtype.ext
            simpa [rootedDoubleProjection] using hproj
          have htag : av.1 = cw.1 := by
            exact (congrArg Prod.fst hav').trans
              (congrArg Prod.fst hcw').symm
          exact congrArg some (Prod.ext htag hv)

name: Erdos64.rootedDouble_cycle_projection
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hinj := rootedDouble_cycle_projection_injOn p hp
  have htail_inj : Set.InjOn rootedDoubleProjection
      {z | z ∈ p.tail.support} := by
    intro a ha c hc h
    change a ∈ p.tail.support at ha
    change c ∈ p.tail.support at hc
    apply hinj ?_ ?_ h
    · exact List.mem_of_mem_tail (by
        simpa only [p.support_tail_of_not_nil hp.not_nil] using ha)
    · exact List.mem_of_mem_tail (by
        simpa only [p.support_tail_of_not_nil hp.not_nil] using hc)
  have htail_path : (p.tail.map rootedDoubleProjectionHom).IsPath :=
    rootedDouble_projection_path_of_support_injective p.tail
      hp.isPath_tail htail_inj
  have hmapped_cycle : (p.map rootedDoubleProjectionHom).IsCycle := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.isCycle_iff_isPath_tail_and_le_length]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · cases p with
      | nil => exact (hp.not_nil (by simp)).elim
      | cons h q =>
          simpa using htail_path
    · exact (rootedDouble_projection_length p).symm ▸ hp.three_le_length
  exact ⟨hmapped_cycle, rootedDouble_projection_length p⟩

name: Erdos64.not_isBipartite_of_opposite_parity_routes
statement:
theorem not_isBipartite_of_opposite_parity_routes
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b : V}
    (p q : G.Walk a b) (hp : Odd p.length) (hq : Even q.length) :
    ¬ G.IsBipartite
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨color⟩
  let c : G.Coloring Bool := SimpleGraph.recolorOfEquiv G finTwoEquiv color
  have hsame := (c.even_length_iff_congr q).mp hq
  have hpEven := (c.even_length_iff_congr p).mpr hsame
  exact (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hp) hpEven

name: Erdos64.twoPort_routes_parity_of_dyadic_completion
statement:
theorem twoPort_routes_parity_of_dyadic_completion
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b : V}
    (p q : G.Walk a b) {j k : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (hp : p.length + 1 = 2 ^ j) (hq : q.length = 2 ^ k) :
    Odd p.length ∧ Even q.length ∧ p.length ≠ q.length ∧
      p ≠ q ∧ ¬ G.IsBipartite
proof:
:= by
  have htwo : Even (2 : ℕ) := by decide
  have hpNext : Even (p.length + 1) := by
    rw [hp]
    exact htwo.pow_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  have hpOdd : Odd p.length := by
    exact Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mp (Nat.even_add_one.mp hpNext)
  have hqEven : Even q.length := by
    rw [hq]
    exact htwo.pow_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  have hlength : p.length ≠ q.length := by
    intro heq
    exact (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hpOdd) (heq.symm ▸ hqEven)
  refine ⟨hpOdd, hqEven, hlength, ?_,
    not_isBipartite_of_opposite_parity_routes p q hpOdd hqEven⟩
  intro heq
  exact hlength (congrArg SimpleGraph.Walk.length heq)

name: Erdos64.balanced_two_cubic_poles_force_odd_ambient_order_of_complement_balanced
statement:
theorem balanced_two_cubic_poles_force_odd_ambient_order_of_complement_balanced
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hrD : r ∉ D) (hports : x ∈ D ∧ y ∈ D ∧ x ≠ y)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hexact :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y))
    (hcubic : ∀ v, v ∈ D → G.degree v = 3)
    (hbalanced : D.card = (Finset.univ \ (D ∪ ({r} : Finset V))).card) :
    Even D.card ∧ Fintype.card V = 2 * D.card + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E : Finset V := Finset.univ \ (D ∪ ({r} : Finset V))
  have hDE : Disjoint D E := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.2
    intro v hvD hvE
    exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hvE).2
      (Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inl hvD))
  have hrE : r ∉ E := by
    intro hrE
    exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hrE).2
      (Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr (Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)))
  have hpartition : (D ∪ E) ∪ ({r} : Finset V) = Finset.univ := by
    ext v
    by_cases hvr : v = r
    · simp [hvr]
    · by_cases hvD : v ∈ D
      · simp [hvr, hvD]
      · simp [E, hvr, hvD]
  have hequal : D.card = E.card := by
    simpa [E] using hbalanced
  obtain ⟨hxdeg, hydeg, hnonport, _⟩ :=
    two_cubic_ports_boundary_accounting D r x y hrD hports hboundary
      hexact ⟨hcubic x hports.1, hcubic y hports.2.1⟩
  have hsum :
      D.sum (fun v => internalDegree G D v) =
        2 * (G.induce (↑D : Set V)).edgeFinset.card := by
    let H : SimpleGraph (↑D : Set V) := G.induce (↑D : Set V)
    have hhand := H.sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges
    have hsum_bij :
        D.sum (fun v => internalDegree G D v) =
          (Finset.univ : Finset (↑D : Set V)).sum (fun v => H.degree v) := by
      refine Finset.sum_bij (fun a ha => ⟨a, ?_⟩) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · exact ha
      · simp
      · intro a₁ ha₁ a₂ ha₂ h
        exact congrArg Subtype.val h
      · intro b hb
        refine ⟨b.1, b.2, ?_⟩
        exact Subtype.ext rfl
      · intro a ha
        simpa [H] using
          (degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree G ⟨a, ha⟩).symm
    calc
      D.sum (fun v => internalDegree G D v) =
          (Finset.univ : Finset (↑D : Set V)).sum (fun v => H.degree v) :=
        hsum_bij
      _ = 2 * H.edgeFinset.card := hhand
  have hy_erase : y ∈ D.erase x :=
    Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hports.2.2.symm, hports.2.1⟩
  have hcard_lower : 2 ≤ D.card := by
    have hsubset : ({x, y} : Finset V) ⊆ D := by
      intro v hv
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
      rcases hv with rfl | rfl
      · exact hports.1
      · exact hports.2.1
    have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsubset
    simpa [hports.2.2] using hcard
  have hnon_sum :
      ((D.erase x).erase y).sum (fun v => internalDegree G D v) =
        3 * ((D.erase x).erase y).card := by
    calc
      ((D.erase x).erase y).sum (fun v => internalDegree G D v) =
          ((D.erase x).erase y).sum (fun _ => 3) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro v hv
            have hvy : v ≠ y := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hv).1
            have hvx : v ≠ x :=
              (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hv).2).1
            have hvD : v ∈ D :=
              (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hv).2).2
            exact (hnonport v hvD hvx hvy).trans (hcubic v hvD)
      _ = 3 * ((D.erase x).erase y).card := by simp [Nat.mul_comm]
  have hsum_eval :
      D.sum (fun v => internalDegree G D v) = 3 * D.card - 2 := by
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase D (fun v => internalDegree G D v) hports.1]
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase (D.erase x)
      (fun v => internalDegree G D v) hy_erase]
    rw [hxdeg, hydeg, hnon_sum]
    have hcardD : ((D.erase x).erase y).card = D.card - 2 := by
      calc
        ((D.erase x).erase y).card = (D.erase x).card - 1 :=
          Finset.card_erase_of_mem hy_erase
        _ = (D.card - 1) - 1 := by
          rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hports.1]
        _ = D.card - 2 := by simp [Nat.sub_sub]
    rw [hcardD] at hnon_sum ⊢
    have hcardDsub : D.card - 2 + 2 = D.card := Nat.sub_add_cancel hcard_lower
    have hthree : 2 ≤ 3 * D.card := by omega
    symm
    apply (Nat.sub_eq_iff_eq_add hthree).2
    clear hnon_sum hcardD
    rw [← hcardDsub]
    simp [Nat.mul_add]
    omega
  have hDeven : Even D.card := by
    have hthree : 2 ≤ 3 * D.card := by omega
    have hparity : 2 ∣ 3 * D.card := by
      use (G.induce (↑D : Set V)).edgeFinset.card + 1
      have hEq :
          2 * (G.induce (↑D : Set V)).edgeFinset.card + 2 = 3 * D.card := by
        calc
          2 * (G.induce (↑D : Set V)).edgeFinset.card + 2 =
              D.sum (fun v => internalDegree G D v) + 2 := by rw [hsum]
          _ = (3 * D.card - 2) + 2 := by rw [hsum_eval]
          _ = 3 * D.card := Nat.sub_add_cancel hthree
      calc
        3 * D.card =
            2 * (G.induce (↑D : Set V)).edgeFinset.card + 2 := hEq.symm
        _ = 2 * ((G.induce (↑D : Set V)).edgeFinset.card + 1) := by omega
    rw [even_iff_two_dvd]
    omega
  have hroot_disjoint : Disjoint (D ∪ E) ({r} : Finset V) := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.2
    intro v hvDE hvr
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hvDE with hvD | hvE
    · exact hrD (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hvr ▸ hvD)
    · exact hrE (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hvr ▸ hvE)
  have hcard : D.card + E.card + 1 = Fintype.card V := by
    calc
      D.card + E.card + 1 = ((D ∪ E) ∪ ({r} : Finset V)).card := by
        rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hroot_disjoint,
          Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hDE,
          Finset.card_singleton]
      _ = Finset.univ.card := congrArg Finset.card hpartition
      _ = Fintype.card V := Finset.card_univ
  exact ⟨hDeven, by omega⟩

name: Erdos64.equal_induced_edge_count_of_equal_two_pole_card
statement:
theorem equal_induced_edge_count_of_equal_two_pole_card
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (D E : Finset V)
    (r xD yD xE yE : V)
    (hrD : r ∉ D)
    (hportsD : xD ∈ D ∧ yD ∈ D ∧ xD ≠ yD)
    (hboundaryD :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hexactD :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = xD ∨ v = yD))
    (hcubicD : ∀ v, v ∈ D → G.degree v = 3)
    (hrE : r ∉ E)
    (hportsE : xE ∈ E ∧ yE ∈ E ∧ xE ≠ yE)
    (hboundaryE :
      ∀ v, v ∈ E → ∀ w, w ∉ E → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hexactE :
      ∀ v, v ∈ E → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = xE ∨ v = yE))
    (hcubicE : ∀ v, v ∈ E → G.degree v = 3)
    (hcard : D.card = E.card) :
    (G.induce (↑D : Set V)).edgeFinset.card =
      (G.induce (↑E : Set V)).edgeFinset.card
proof:
:= by
  have hhandshake :
      ∀ (S : Finset V) (x y : V),
        r ∉ S →
        (x ∈ S ∧ y ∈ S ∧ x ≠ y) →
        (∀ v, v ∈ S → ∀ w, w ∉ S → G.Adj v w → w = r) →
        (∀ v, v ∈ S → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y)) →
        (∀ v, v ∈ S → G.degree v = 3) →
        2 * (G.induce (↑S : Set V)).edgeFinset.card + 2 =
          3 * S.card := by
    intro S x y hrS hportsS hboundaryS hexactS hcubicS
    obtain ⟨hxdeg, hydeg, hnonport, _⟩ :=
      two_cubic_ports_boundary_accounting S r x y hrS hportsS
        hboundaryS hexactS
        ⟨hcubicS x hportsS.1, hcubicS y hportsS.2.1⟩
    have hsum :
        S.sum (fun v => internalDegree G S v) =
          2 * (G.induce (↑S : Set V)).edgeFinset.card := by
      let H : SimpleGraph (↑S : Set V) := G.induce (↑S : Set V)
      have hhand := H.sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges
      have hsum_bij :
          S.sum (fun v => internalDegree G S v) =
            (Finset.univ : Finset (↑S : Set V)).sum
              (fun v => H.degree v) := by
        refine Finset.sum_bij (fun a ha => ⟨a, ?_⟩) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
        · exact ha
        · simp
        · intro a₁ ha₁ a₂ ha₂ h
          exact congrArg Subtype.val h
        · intro b hb
          refine ⟨b.1, b.2, ?_⟩
          exact Subtype.ext rfl
        · intro a ha
          simpa [H] using
            (degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree G ⟨a, ha⟩).symm
      calc
        S.sum (fun v => internalDegree G S v) =
            (Finset.univ : Finset (↑S : Set V)).sum
              (fun v => H.degree v) := hsum_bij
        _ = 2 * H.edgeFinset.card := hhand
    have hy_erase : y ∈ S.erase x :=
      Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hportsS.2.2.symm, hportsS.2.1⟩
    have hcard_lower : 2 ≤ S.card := by
      have hsubset : ({x, y} : Finset V) ⊆ S := by
        intro v hv
        simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
        rcases hv with rfl | rfl
        · exact hportsS.1
        · exact hportsS.2.1
      have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsubset
      simpa [hportsS.2.2] using hcard
    have hnon_sum :
        ((S.erase x).erase y).sum (fun v => internalDegree G S v) =
          3 * ((S.erase x).erase y).card := by
      calc
        ((S.erase x).erase y).sum (fun v => internalDegree G S v) =
            ((S.erase x).erase y).sum (fun _ => 3) := by
              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
              intro v hv
              have hvy : v ≠ y := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hv).1
              have hvx : v ≠ x :=
                (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hv).2).1
              have hvS : v ∈ S :=
                (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hv).2).2
              exact (hnonport v hvS hvx hvy).trans (hcubicS v hvS)
        _ = 3 * ((S.erase x).erase y).card := by
          simp [Nat.mul_comm]
    have hsum_eval :
        S.sum (fun v => internalDegree G S v) = 3 * S.card - 2 := by
      rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase S (fun v => internalDegree G S v)
        hportsS.1]
      rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase (S.erase x)
        (fun v => internalDegree G S v) hy_erase]
      rw [hxdeg, hydeg, hnon_sum]
      have hcardS : ((S.erase x).erase y).card = S.card - 2 := by
        calc
          ((S.erase x).erase y).card = (S.erase x).card - 1 :=
            Finset.card_erase_of_mem hy_erase
          _ = (S.card - 1) - 1 := by
            rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hportsS.1]
          _ = S.card - 2 := by simp [Nat.sub_sub]
      rw [hcardS] at hnon_sum ⊢
      have hcardSsub : S.card - 2 + 2 = S.card :=
        Nat.sub_add_cancel hcard_lower
      have hthree : 2 ≤ 3 * S.card := by omega
      symm
      apply (Nat.sub_eq_iff_eq_add hthree).2
      clear hnon_sum hcardS
      rw [← hcardSsub]
      simp [Nat.mul_add]
      omega
    have hthree : 2 ≤ 3 * S.card := by omega
    calc
      2 * (G.induce (↑S : Set V)).edgeFinset.card + 2 =
          S.sum (fun v => internalDegree G S v) + 2 := by rw [hsum]
      _ = (3 * S.card - 2) + 2 := by rw [hsum_eval]
      _ = 3 * S.card := Nat.sub_add_cancel hthree
  have hD := hhandshake D xD yD hrD hportsD hboundaryD hexactD hcubicD
  have hE := hhandshake E xE yE hrE hportsE hboundaryE hexactE hcubicE
  omega

name: Erdos64.hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_adjacent_two_port_third_neighbors
statement:
theorem hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_adjacent_two_port_third_neighbors
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {r x y z w : V}
    (hxy_ne : x ≠ y)
    (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y) (hxy : G.Adj x y)
    (hzr : z ≠ r) (hzx : z ≠ x) (hzy : z ≠ y) (hxz : G.Adj x z)
    (hwr : w ≠ r) (hwx : w ≠ x) (hwy : w ≠ y) (hyw : G.Adj y w)
    (hcase : z = w ∨ G.Adj z w) :
    HasPowerOfTwoCycle G
proof:
:= by
  rcases hcase with rfl | hzw
  · let q : G.Walk x y :=
      SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hxz
        (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hyw.symm SimpleGraph.Walk.nil)
    have hq : q.IsPath := by
      dsimp [q]
      refine (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff hxz _).2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff hyw.symm _).2
          ⟨SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.nil, by simp [hzy]⟩
      · simp [hzx.symm, hxy_ne]
    have hroot : r ∉ q.support := by
      simp [q, hrx.ne, hry.ne, hzr.symm]
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hlen⟩ := endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate
      hq hrx hry hroot hxy_ne (by simp [q])
    refine ⟨2, x, c, by omega, hc, ?_⟩
    calc
      c.length = 4 := by simpa [q] using hlen
      _ = 2 ^ 2 := by rfl
  · let q : G.Walk z y :=
      SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hzw
        (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hyw.symm SimpleGraph.Walk.nil)
    have hq : q.IsPath := by
      dsimp [q]
      refine (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff hzw _).2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff hyw.symm _).2
          ⟨SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.nil, by simp [hwy]⟩
      · simp [hzw.ne, hzy]
    have hroot : x ∉ q.support := by
      simp [q, hzx.symm, hwx.symm, hxy_ne]
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hlen⟩ := endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate
      hq hxz hxy hroot hzy (by simp [q])
    refine ⟨2, z, c, by omega, hc, ?_⟩
    calc
      c.length = 4 := by simpa [q] using hlen
      _ = 2 ^ 2 := by rfl

name: Erdos64.rootDeletedComponentAttachments_pairwise_disjoint
statement:
theorem rootDeletedComponentAttachments_pairwise_disjoint
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] (r : V) :
    letI : Fintype ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) :=
      Fintype.ofFinite _
    Pairwise (fun C D =>
      Disjoint (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C)
        (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) :=
    Fintype.ofFinite _
  intro C D hCD
  apply Finset.disjoint_left.2
  intro x hxC hxD
  have hxC' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hxC).2
  have hxD' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hxD).2
  obtain ⟨hxne, hCx⟩ :=
    (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r C x).1 hxC'
  obtain ⟨_, hDx⟩ :=
    (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r D x).1 hxD'
  have hmkC :
      (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hxne⟩ = C :=
    (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff C ⟨x, hxne⟩).mp hCx
  have hmkD :
      (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hxne⟩ = D :=
    (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff D ⟨x, hxne⟩).mp hDx
  exact hCD (hmkC.symm.trans hmkD)

name: Erdos64.rootDeletedComponentAttachments_biUnion
statement:
theorem rootDeletedComponentAttachments_biUnion
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] (r : V) :
    letI : Fintype ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) :=
      Fintype.ofFinite _
    (Finset.univ : Finset ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)).biUnion
        (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r) = G.neighborFinset r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) :=
    Fintype.ofFinite _
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨C, _, hxC⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hx
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hxC).1
  · intro hx
    have hxne : x ≠ r := by
      intro hxr
      subst x
      exact G.loopless.irrefl r ((G.mem_neighborFinset r r).mp hx)
    let C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent :=
      (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hxne⟩
    apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨C, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
    apply (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r C x).2
    exact ⟨hxne, SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_mem⟩

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.rotateVertexIndex_injective
statement:
private theorem rotateVertexIndex_injective (k : Fin 5) :
    Function.Injective (rotateVertexIndex k)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  rcases x with i | (i | i) <;> rcases y with j | (j | j) <;>
    simp_all [rotateVertexIndex, (rotate5_bijective k).1.eq_iff]

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.rotate5_add_two
statement:
private theorem rotate5_add_two (k i : Fin 5) :
    rotate5 k (i + 2) = rotate5 k i + 2
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases k <;> fin_cases i <;> decide

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.rotate5_zero
statement: private theorem rotate5_zero (k : Fin 5) : rotate5 k 0 = k
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases k <;> decide

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.rotateHull_cVertex
statement:
@[simp] theorem rotateHull_cVertex (H : PentagramEarHull G) (k i : Fin 5) :
    cVertex (rotateHull H k) i = cVertex H (rotate5 k i)
proof: := rfl

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.rotateHull_aVertex
statement:
@[simp] theorem rotateHull_aVertex (H : PentagramEarHull G) (k i : Fin 5) :
    aVertex (rotateHull H k) i = aVertex H (rotate5 k i)
proof: := rfl

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.rotateHull_bVertex
statement:
@[simp] theorem rotateHull_bVertex (H : PentagramEarHull G) (k i : Fin 5) :
    bVertex (rotateHull H k) i = bVertex H (rotate5 k i)
proof: := rfl

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.range_comp_rotate5
statement:
private theorem range_comp_rotate5 {W : Type u} (f : Fin 5 -> W) (k : Fin 5) :
    Set.range (fun i => f (rotate5 k i)) = Set.range f
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact ⟨rotate5 k i, hi⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (rotate5_bijective k).2 i
    exact ⟨j, by simpa only [hj] using hi⟩

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.hull_rotateHull
statement:
theorem hull_rotateHull (H : PentagramEarHull G) (k : Fin 5) :
    hull (rotateHull H k) = hull H
proof:
:= by
  change
    (Set.range (fun i => H.cVertex (rotate5 k i)) ∪
      Set.range (fun i => H.aVertex (rotate5 k i))) ∪
      Set.range (fun i => H.bVertex (rotate5 k i)) =
    (Set.range H.cVertex ∪ Set.range H.aVertex) ∪ Set.range H.bVertex
  rw [range_comp_rotate5, range_comp_rotate5, range_comp_rotate5]

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.Connector.rotateIndices_path
statement:
@[simp] theorem Connector.rotateIndices_path
    (H : PentagramEarHull G) (k i j : Fin 5)
    (K : Connector H (rotate5 k i) (rotate5 k j)) :
    (Connector.rotateIndices H k i j K).path = K.path
proof: := rfl

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.exists_rotated_connector
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := (rotate5_bijective i).2 j
  have hz : rotate5 i 0 = i := rotate5_zero i
  have hne : d ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact K.distinct (by simpa only [h, hz] using hd)
  have K' : Connector H (rotate5 i 0) (rotate5 i d) := by
    simpa only [hz, hd] using K
  exact ⟨d, hne, ⟨Connector.rotateIndices H i 0 d K'⟩⟩

name: Erdos64.path_first_hit_set
statement:
theorem path_first_hit_set
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b : V}
    (p : G.Walk a b) (hp : p.IsPath) (S : Set V) (hb : b ∈ S) :
    ∃ z, z ∈ S ∧ ∃ q : G.Walk a z,
      q.IsPath ∧ (∀ w, w ∈ q.support → w ∈ p.support) ∧
      (∀ w, w ∈ q.support → w ∈ S → w = z)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction p with
  | nil =>
      refine ⟨_, hb, .nil, SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.nil, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro w hw
        exact hw
      · intro w hw _
        simpa using hw
  | @cons a c b hac p ih =>
      by_cases ha : a ∈ S
      · refine ⟨a, ha, .nil, SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.nil, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro w hw
          have : w = a := by simpa using hw
          subst w
          exact SimpleGraph.Walk.start_mem_support _
        · intro w hw _
          simpa using hw
      · obtain ⟨z, hz, q, hq, hsub, hhit⟩ := ih hp.of_cons hb
        have hnot : a ∉ p.support :=
          ((SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff _ _).mp hp).2
        refine ⟨z, hz, q.cons hac, hq.cons (fun h => hnot (hsub a h)), ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro w hw
          simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, List.mem_cons] at hw ⊢
          exact hw.imp_right (hsub w)
        · intro w hw hwS
          simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, List.mem_cons] at hw
          rcases hw with rfl | hw
          · exact (ha hwS).elim
          · exact hhit w hw hwS

name: Erdos64.first_hit_path_support_in_carrier
statement:
theorem first_hit_path_support_in_carrier
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a z : V}
    (q : G.Walk a z) (hq : q.IsPath) (S D : Set V)
    (ha : a ∈ D)
    (hboundary : ∀ u, u ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj u w → u ∈ S)
    (hhit : ∀ w, w ∈ q.support → w ∈ S → w = z) :
    ∀ w, w ∈ q.support → w ∈ D
proof:
:= by
  induction q with
  | @nil a =>
      intro w hw
      have : w = a := by simpa using hw
      simpa only [this] using ha
  | @cons a b z hab q ih =>
      have hnot : a ∉ q.support :=
        ((SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff _ _).mp hq).2
      have hb : b ∈ D := by
        by_contra hb
        have haS := hboundary a ha b hb hab
        have haz := hhit a (SimpleGraph.Walk.start_mem_support _) haS
        exact hnot (haz.symm ▸ q.end_mem_support)
      have htailhit : ∀ w, w ∈ q.support → w ∈ S → w = z := by
        intro w hw hwS
        exact hhit w (by simp [hw]) hwS
      have htail := ih hq.of_cons hb htailhit
      intro w hw
      simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, List.mem_cons] at hw
      rcases hw with rfl | hw
      · exact ha
      · exact htail w hw

name: Erdos64.fresh_ear_of_external_neighbor
statement:
theorem fresh_ear_of_external_neighbor
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableEq V]
    {x y v w : V} (p : G.Walk x y) (D : Set V)
    (hconn : (G.induce {a : V | a ≠ v}).Connected)
    (hxv : x ≠ v) (hvw : G.Adj v w)
    (hw : w ∉ p.support) (hvD : v ∈ D) (hwD : w ∈ D)
    (hboundary : ∀ a, a ∈ D → ∀ b, b ∉ D → G.Adj a b → a ∈ p.support) :
    ∃ z, z ∈ p.support ∧ z ≠ v ∧ ∃ ear : G.Walk v z,
      ear.IsPath ∧ 2 ≤ ear.length ∧
      (∀ a, a ∈ ear.support → a ∈ D) ∧
      (∀ a, a ∈ ear.support → a ∈ p.support → a = v ∨ a = z) ∧
      ear.getVert 1 = w ∧ s(v, w) ∉ p.edges
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let ww : {a : V // a ≠ v} := ⟨w, hvw.ne.symm⟩
  let xx : {a : V // a ≠ v} := ⟨x, hxv⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hconn.exists_isPath ww xx
  let e : G.induce {a : V | a ≠ v} ↪g G := SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce _
  let q' : G.Walk w x := q.map e.toHom
  have hq' : q'.IsPath := hq.map e.injective
  have havoid : ∀ a, a ∈ q'.support → a ≠ v := by
    intro a ha
    change a ∈ (q.map e.toHom).support at ha
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map] at ha
    obtain ⟨t, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ha
    exact t.2
  obtain ⟨z, hz, t, ht, hsub, hhit⟩ :=
    path_first_hit_set q' hq' {a | a ∈ p.support} p.start_mem_support
  have hvnot : v ∉ t.support := fun h => havoid v (hsub v h) rfl
  have hzv : z ≠ v := havoid z (hsub z t.end_mem_support)
  have htD : ∀ a, a ∈ t.support → a ∈ D := by
    apply first_hit_path_support_in_carrier t ht {a | a ∈ p.support} D hwD
    · exact hboundary
    · exact hhit
  have htpos : 0 < t.length := by
    by_contra h
    have hwz := SimpleGraph.Walk.eq_of_length_eq_zero (by omega : t.length = 0)
    exact hw (hwz ▸ hz)
  refine ⟨z, hz, hzv, t.cons hvw, ht.cons hvnot, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons]
    omega
  · intro a ha
    simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, List.mem_cons] at ha
    rcases ha with rfl | ha
    · exact hvD
    · exact htD a ha
  · intro a ha hap
    simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, List.mem_cons] at ha
    exact ha.imp_right (fun h => hhit a h hap)
  · simp
  · intro he
    exact hw (p.snd_mem_support_of_mem_edges he)

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_side_path_ear_coverage
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_side_path_ear_coverage
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {a : V | a ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hinside : ∀ a, a ∈ p.support → a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (v : V) (hv : v ∈ p.support) (hvx : v ≠ x) (hvy : v ≠ y) :
    ∃ z, z ∈ p.support ∧ z ≠ v ∧ ∃ ear : G.Walk v z,
      ear.IsPath ∧ 1 ≤ ear.length ∧
      (∀ a, a ∈ ear.support → a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) ∧
      (∀ a, a ∈ ear.support → a ∈ p.support → a = v ∨ a = z) ∧
      s(v, ear.getVert 1) ∉ p.edges
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite ((G.induce {a : V | a ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
  let A := rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C
  have hcard : (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card = 2 :=
    (M.rootDeleted_two_components_exact_balanced r C D hCD).2.2.1
  have hxA : x ∈ A := hinside x p.start_mem_support
  have hyA : y ∈ A := hinside y p.end_mem_support
  have hpair : ({x, y} : Finset V) = rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C := by
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
    · intro a ha
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at ha
      rcases ha with hax | hay
      · subst a
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(G.mem_neighborFinset r x).mpr hrx, hxA⟩
      · subst a
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(G.mem_neighborFinset r y).mpr hry, hyA⟩
    · simp [hcard, hxy]
  have hports : ∀ a, a ∈ A → G.Adj a r → a = x ∨ a = y := by
    intro a ha har
    have hmem : a ∈ rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C :=
      Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(G.mem_neighborFinset r a).mpr har.symm, ha⟩
    rw [← hpair] at hmem
    simpa using hmem
  have hboundary : ∀ a, a ∈ A → ∀ b, b ∉ A → G.Adj a b → b = r := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    exact ((rootDeletedComponent_boundary r M.isConnected C).1 a ha b hab).resolve_left hb
  have hvA : v ∈ A := hinside v hv
  have hvroot : v ≠ r := by
    intro h
    have hrA : r ∈ A := by rw [← h]; exact hvA
    exact (rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C).2 hrA
  obtain ⟨w, hvw, hnotedge⟩ := exists_adj_not_mem_path_edges p hp
    (degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G M.isCounterexample.1 v)
  have hwA : w ∈ A := by
    by_contra hw
    have hwr := hboundary v hvA w hw hvw
    have hvr : G.Adj v r := hwr ▸ hvw
    exact (hports v hvA hvr).elim hvx hvy
  by_cases hw : w ∈ p.support
  · refine ⟨w, hw, hvw.ne.symm, hvw.toWalk, SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.of_adj hvw,
      by simp [SimpleGraph.Adj.toWalk], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro a ha
      simp [SimpleGraph.Adj.toWalk] at ha
      rcases ha with rfl | rfl
      · exact hvA
      · exact hwA
    · intro a ha _
      simpa [SimpleGraph.Adj.toWalk] using ha
    · simpa [SimpleGraph.Adj.toWalk] using hnotedge
  · have hconn := M.rootDeleted_connected_away_from_cut r v ⟨C, D, hCD⟩ hvroot
    have hreturn : ∀ a, a ∈ (↑A : Set V) → ∀ b, b ∉ (↑A : Set V) →
        G.Adj a b → a ∈ p.support := by
      intro a ha b hb hab
      have hbr := hboundary a ha b hb hab
      rcases hports a ha (hbr ▸ hab) with rfl | rfl
      · exact p.start_mem_support
      · exact p.end_mem_support
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzv, ear, hear, hlen, hearA, hfresh, hfirst, hnot⟩ :=
      fresh_ear_of_external_neighbor p (↑A : Set V) hconn hvx.symm hvw hw hvA hwA hreturn
    refine ⟨z, hz, hzv, ear, hear, by omega, hearA, hfresh, ?_⟩
    simpa only [hfirst] using hnot

name: Erdos64.isCycles_neighborFinset_card_zero_or_two
statement:
private theorem isCycles_neighborFinset_card_zero_or_two
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] {H : SimpleGraph V}
    (hH : H.IsCycles) (v : V) :
    (H.neighborFinset v).card = 0 ∨ (H.neighborFinset v).card = 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hnonempty : (H.neighborSet v).Nonempty
  · right
    simpa only [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card', ← SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_def] using
      hH hnonempty
  · left
    apply Finset.card_eq_zero.mpr
    ext w
    simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, Finset.notMem_empty, iff_false]
    exact fun hw => hnonempty ⟨w, hw⟩

name: Erdos64.subcubic_isCycles_symmDiff
statement:
theorem subcubic_isCycles_symmDiff
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] {G H K : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hHG : H ≤ G) (hKG : K ≤ G) (hH : H.IsCycles) (hK : K.IsCycles)
    (hdegree : ∀ v, G.degree v ≤ 3) :
    (H ∆ K).IsCycles ∧ H ∆ K ≤ G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨?_, symmDiff_le_sup.trans (sup_le hHG hKG)⟩
  intro v hnonempty
  let S := H.neighborFinset v
  let T := K.neighborFinset v
  have hS : S.card = 0 ∨ S.card = 2 :=
    isCycles_neighborFinset_card_zero_or_two hH v
  have hT : T.card = 0 ∨ T.card = 2 :=
    isCycles_neighborFinset_card_zero_or_two hK v
  have hunion : (S ∪ T).card ≤ 3 := by
    apply (Finset.card_le_card (show S ∪ T ⊆ G.neighborFinset v from ?_)).trans
      (hdegree v)
    intro w hw
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hw with h | h
    · exact G.mem_neighborFinset v w |>.mpr (hHG (H.mem_neighborFinset v w |>.mp h))
    · exact G.mem_neighborFinset v w |>.mpr (hKG (K.mem_neighborFinset v w |>.mp h))
  have hsymm : (H ∆ K).neighborFinset v = S ∆ T := by
    ext w
    rw [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]
    simp [S, T, symmDiff_def]
  have hpos : 0 < (S ∆ T).card := by
    rw [← hsymm]
    exact Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨hnonempty.choose,
      (H ∆ K).mem_neighborFinset v hnonempty.choose |>.mpr hnonempty.choose_spec⟩
  have hcounts := Finset.card_union_add_card_inter S T
  have hsubtract : (S ∆ T).card + (S ∩ T).card = (S ∪ T).card := by
    rw [symmDiff_eq_sup_sdiff_inf]
    exact Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card
      (Finset.inter_subset_left.trans Finset.subset_union_left)
  rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card', ← SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_def, hsymm]
  omega

name: Erdos64.isCycles_symmDiff_of_sup_degree_le_three
statement:
theorem isCycles_symmDiff_of_sup_degree_le_three
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] {H K : SimpleGraph V}
    (hH : H.IsCycles) (hK : K.IsCycles)
    (hdegree : ∀ v, (H ⊔ K).degree v ≤ 3) :
    (H ∆ K).IsCycles
proof:
:= by
  exact (subcubic_isCycles_symmDiff (G := H ⊔ K) (H := H) (K := K)
    le_sup_left le_sup_right hH hK hdegree).1

name: Erdos64.subcubic_cycle_exchange_component
statement:
theorem subcubic_cycle_exchange_component
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] {G H K : SimpleGraph V}
    (hHG : H ≤ G) (hKG : K ≤ G) (hH : H.IsCycles) (hK : K.IsCycles)
    (hdegree : ∀ v, G.degree v ≤ 3)
    {c : (H ∆ K).ConnectedComponent} {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ c.supp) (hnonempty : ((H ∆ K).neighborSet v).Nonempty) :
    ∃ p : (H ∆ K).Walk v v, p.IsCycle ∧ p.toSubgraph.verts = c.supp
proof:
:= by
  exact SimpleGraph.IsCycles.exists_cycle_toSubgraph_verts_eq_connectedComponentSupp
    (subcubic_isCycles_symmDiff hHG hKG hH hK hdegree).1 hv hnonempty

name: Erdos64.isCycles_sdiff_cycle
statement:
theorem isCycles_sdiff_cycle
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (hG : G.IsCycles) {v : V} (p : G.Walk v v) (hp : p.IsCycle) :
    (G \ p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe).IsCycles
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x ⟨y, hxy⟩
  change G.Adj x y ∧ ¬p.toSubgraph.Adj x y at hxy
  have hx : x ∉ p.toSubgraph.verts := by
    intro hx
    exact hxy.2 ((hp.adj_toSubgraph_iff_of_isCycles hG hx y).mpr hxy.1)
  have heq : (G \ p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe).neighborSet x = G.neighborSet x := by
    ext z
    change (G.Adj x z ∧ ¬p.toSubgraph.Adj x z) ↔ G.Adj x z
    exact ⟨And.left, fun hxz => ⟨hxz, fun hc => hx (p.toSubgraph.edge_vert hc)⟩⟩
  rw [heq]
  exact hG ⟨y, hxy.1⟩

name: Erdos64.exists_cycle_of_isCycles_ne_bot
statement:
private theorem exists_cycle_of_isCycles_ne_bot
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (hG : G.IsCycles) (hne : G ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ v, ∃ p : G.Walk v v, p.IsCycle
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, w, hvw⟩ := SimpleGraph.ne_bot_iff_exists_adj.mp hne
  obtain ⟨p, hp, _⟩ :=
    hG.exists_cycle_toSubgraph_verts_eq_connectedComponentSupp
      (c := G.connectedComponentMk v)
      SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_mem ⟨w, hvw⟩
  exact ⟨v, p, hp⟩

name: Erdos64.hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_isCycles_eight_edges_no_triangles
statement:
theorem hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_isCycles_eight_edges_no_triangles
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (hG : G.IsCycles) (hedges : G.edgeFinset.card = 8)
    (hno3 : ∀ {v : V} (p : G.Walk v v), p.IsCycle → p.length ≠ 3) :
    HasPowerOfTwoCycle G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hne : G ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro heq
    have hzero : G.edgeFinset.card = 0 := by
      exact Finset.card_eq_zero.mpr (SimpleGraph.edgeFinset_eq_empty.mpr heq)
    omega
  obtain ⟨v, p, hp⟩ := exists_cycle_of_isCycles_ne_bot hG hne
  by_cases hp4 : p.length = 4
  · exact ⟨2, v, p, by decide, hp, by simpa using hp4⟩
  have hp5 : 5 ≤ p.length := by
    have := hp.isCircuit.three_le_length
    have := hno3 p hp
    omega
  have hcycle_edges : p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe.edgeFinset = p.edges.toFinset := by
    ext e
    simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeFinset, SimpleGraph.Subgraph.edgeSet_spanningCoe,
      p.mem_edges_toSubgraph, List.mem_toFinset]
  have hcycle_card : p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe.edgeFinset.card = p.length := by
    rw [hcycle_edges, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hp.isTrail.edges_nodup,
      SimpleGraph.Walk.length_edges]
  have hcounts : (G \ p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe).edgeFinset.card + p.length = 8 := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.edgeFinset_sdiff, ← hcycle_card, ← hedges]
    exact Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card
      (SimpleGraph.edgeFinset_mono p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe_le)
  have hrest : G \ p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe = ⊥ := by
    by_contra hrest
    obtain ⟨w, q, hq⟩ := exists_cycle_of_isCycles_ne_bot
      (isCycles_sdiff_cycle hG p hp) hrest
    have hq3 := hq.isCircuit.three_le_length
    have hqnot3 := hno3 (q.mapLe sdiff_le) (hq.mapLe sdiff_le)
    simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_mapLe] at hqnot3
    have hqle := hq.isTrail.length_le_card_edgeFinset
    omega
  have hp8 : p.length = 8 := by
    have hzero : (G \ p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe).edgeFinset.card = 0 :=
      Finset.card_eq_zero.mpr (SimpleGraph.edgeFinset_eq_empty.mpr hrest)
    omega
  exact ⟨3, v, p, by decide, hp, by simpa using hp8⟩

name: Erdos64.hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_eight_edge_cycle_exchange
statement:
theorem hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_eight_edge_cycle_exchange
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] {G H K : SimpleGraph V}
    (hHG : H ≤ G) (hKG : K ≤ G) (hH : H.IsCycles) (hK : K.IsCycles)
    (hdegree : ∀ v, (H ⊔ K).degree v ≤ 3)
    (hedges : (H ∆ K).edgeFinset.card = 8)
    (hno3 : ∀ {v : V} (p : (H ∆ K).Walk v v), p.IsCycle → p.length ≠ 3) :
    HasPowerOfTwoCycle G
proof:
:= by
  have hcycles := isCycles_symmDiff_of_sup_degree_le_three hH hK hdegree
  obtain ⟨k, v, p, hk, hp, hlen⟩ :=
    hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_isCycles_eight_edges_no_triangles hcycles hedges hno3
  have hle : H ∆ K ≤ G := symmDiff_le_sup.trans (sup_le hHG hKG)
  exact ⟨k, v, p.mapLe hle, hk, hp.mapLe hle,
    by simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_mapLe] using hlen⟩

name: Erdos64.private_b_indices_ne_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem private_b_indices_ne_of_disjoint
    (H : PentagramEarHull G) {D E : Finset V}
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint D E)
    (hext : ∀ w, w ∈ D → w ∉ H.hull)
    {i j : Fin 5}
    (hD : ∃ w, w ∈ D ∧ G.Adj (H.bVertex i) w)
    (hE : ∀ w, G.Adj (H.bVertex j) w →
      w = H.aVertex j ∨ w = H.aVertex (j + 2) ∨ w ∈ E) :
    i ≠ j
proof:
:= by
  intro hij
  subst j
  obtain ⟨w, hwD, hwAdj⟩ := hD
  rcases hE w hwAdj with hwa | hwb | hwE
  · have hwHull : w ∈ H.hull := by
      rw [hwa]
      exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    exact hext w hwD hwHull
  · have hwHull : w ∈ H.hull := by
      rw [hwb]
      exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨i + 2, rfl⟩)
    exact hext w hwD hwHull
  · exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint) hwD hwE

name: Erdos64.closed_exterior_family_card_le_five
statement:
theorem closed_exterior_family_card_le_five
    (H : PentagramEarHull G)
    (hmin : 3 ≤ G.minDegree)
    (hcrit : IsSubgraphCritical G)
    {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι]
    (D : ι → Finset V)
    (hnonempty : ∀ a, (D a).Nonempty)
    (hext : ∀ a w, w ∈ D a → w ∉ H.hull)
    (hclosed : ∀ a x, x ∈ D a → ∀ y,
      G.Adj x y → y ∈ D a ∨ y ∈ H.hull)
    (hpair : Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint (D a) (D b))) :
    Fintype.card ι ≤ 5
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hwitness (a : ι) :=
    private_b_of_closed_exterior H hmin hcrit (D a)
      (hnonempty a) (hext a) (hclosed a)
  choose f hf using hwitness
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro a b hab
    by_contra hne
    exact (private_b_indices_ne_of_disjoint H (hpair hne)
      (hext a) (hf a).2.2 (hf b).2.1) hab
  calc
    Fintype.card ι ≤ Fintype.card (Fin 5) :=
      Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hinj
    _ = 5 := by simp

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.exteriorComponents_card_le_five
statement:
theorem PentagramEarHull.exteriorComponents_card_le_five
    (H : PentagramEarHull G)
    (hmin : 3 ≤ G.minDegree)
    (hcrit : IsSubgraphCritical G) :
    H.exteriorComponents.card ≤ 5
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype H.exteriorGraph.ConnectedComponent := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hcard := closed_exterior_family_card_le_five H hmin hcrit
    H.exteriorComponentCarrier
    H.exteriorComponentCarrier_nonempty
    (fun C w hw => H.exteriorComponentCarrier_not_mem_hull C hw)
    (fun C x hx y hxy => H.exteriorComponentCarrier_adj_closure C hx hxy)
    H.exteriorComponentCarrier_pairwise_disjoint
  simpa only [PentagramEarHull.exteriorComponents, Finset.card_univ] using hcard

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.mem_interior_of_mem_tail_ne_end
statement:
private theorem mem_interior_of_mem_tail_ne_end
    {u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v} {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ p.support.tail) (hxv : x ≠ v) :
    x ∈ p.support.tail.dropLast
proof:
:= by
  apply List.mem_dropLast_of_mem_of_ne_getLast hx
  grind [p.getLast_support]

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.snd_ne_end_of_isPath_of_two_le
statement:
private theorem snd_ne_end_of_isPath_of_two_le
    {u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v} (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hlen : 2 ≤ p.length) : p.snd ≠ v
proof:
:= by
  intro hb
  have hnil : ¬ p.Nil := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length]
    omega
  have hnodup := hp.support_nodup
  have h1 : 1 < p.support.length := by
    simp [p.length_support]
    omega
  have hl : p.length < p.support.length := by
    simp [p.length_support]
  have heq : p.support[1]'h1 = p.support[p.length]'hl := by
    rw [← p.snd_eq_support_getElem_one hnil]
    have hlast : p.support[p.length]'hl = v := p.support_getElem_length
    exact hb.trans hlast.symm
  have hidx := (List.Nodup.getElem_inj_iff hnodup).mp heq
  omega

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.snd_eq_end_of_length_one
statement:
private theorem snd_eq_end_of_length_one
    {u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v} (h : p.length = 1) :
    p.snd = v
proof:
:= by
  have hnil : ¬ p.Nil := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length]
    omega
  have h1 : 1 < p.support.length := by
    simp [p.length_support, h]
  rw [p.snd_eq_support_getElem_one hnil]
  have hlast : p.support[1]'h1 = v := by
    simpa [h] using p.support_getElem_length
  exact hlast

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.snd_not_hull_of_length_ge_two
statement:
private theorem snd_not_hull_of_length_ge_two
    (H : PentagramEarHull G) (K : Connector H i j)
    (hlen : 2 ≤ K.path.length) : K.path.snd ∉ hull H
proof:
:= by
  intro hsnd
  have hne : K.path.snd ≠ bVertex H j :=
    snd_ne_end_of_isPath_of_two_le K.isPath hlen
  have hnil : ¬ K.path.Nil := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length]
    omega
  have hinter : K.path.snd ∈ K.path.support.tail.dropLast :=
    mem_interior_of_mem_tail_ne_end
      (K.path.snd_mem_tail_support hnil) hne
  exact K.interior_disjoint _ hinter hsnd

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.route_snd_ne_end
statement:
private theorem route_snd_ne_end
    {u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v} (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hlen : 2 ≤ p.length) : p.snd ≠ v
proof:
:=
  snd_ne_end_of_isPath_of_two_le hp hlen

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.cycle8_of_incidence_bridge_witness
statement:
theorem cycle8_of_incidence_bridge_witness
    (H : PentagramEarHull G) (i j : Fin 5) (K : Connector H i j)
    (W : IncidenceBridgeWitness H i j K) :
    ∃ c : G.Walk (bVertex H i) (bVertex H i),
      c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = 8
proof:
:= by
  exact cycle8_of_hull_return (G := G) H i j K
    (IncidenceBridgeWitness.toHullReturn H i j K W)

name: Erdos64.exists_simple_marked_root_path
statement:
theorem exists_simple_marked_root_path
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (S : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hconn : (G.induce (↑S : Set V)).Connected)
    (hrS : r ∉ S)
    (hxS : x ∈ S) (hyS : y ∈ S) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ p : G.Walk x y,
      p.IsPath ∧ p.length = n ∧ 0 < n ∧
      r ∉ p.support ∧ G.Adj r x ∧ G.Adj r y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hconn.exists_isPath
    (⟨x, hxS⟩ : (↑S : Set V)) (⟨y, hyS⟩ : (↑S : Set V))
  let e : G.induce (↑S : Set V) →g G :=
    { toFun := Subtype.val
      map_rel' := fun h => h }
  let p : G.Walk x y := q.map e
  have hp : p.IsPath := by
    exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.isPath_map_iff_of_injective
      (f := e) Subtype.val_injective).mpr hq
  have hqpos : 0 < q.length := by
    have hqzero : q.length ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      have hxy' :
          (⟨x, hxS⟩ : (↑S : Set V)) = (⟨y, hyS⟩ : (↑S : Set V)) :=
        SimpleGraph.Walk.eq_of_length_eq_zero hzero
      exact hxy (congrArg Subtype.val hxy')
    omega
  have hrootavoid : r ∉ p.support := by
    intro hrp
    change r ∈ (q.map e).support at hrp
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map] at hrp
    obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hrp
    exact hrS z.property
  refine ⟨q.length, p, hp, ?_, ?_, hrootavoid, hrx, hry⟩
  · rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map]
  · exact hqpos

name: Erdos64.one_lt_length_of_ne_of_not_adj
statement:
theorem one_lt_length_of_ne_of_not_adj
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b : V} {p : G.Walk a b}
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hnadj : ¬ G.Adj a b) :
    1 < p.length
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnot
  have hle : p.length ≤ 1 := Nat.le_of_not_gt hnot
  have hcases : p.length = 0 ∨ p.length = 1 := by omega
  rcases hcases with hzero | hone
  · exact hab (SimpleGraph.Walk.eq_of_length_eq_zero hzero)
  · exact hnadj (SimpleGraph.Walk.adj_of_length_eq_one hone)

name: Erdos64.rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_path_of_nonadjacent
statement:
theorem rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_path_of_nonadjacent
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (r : V)
    (C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hcard : (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card = 2)
    (hnonadj : ∀ a b,
      a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      b ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      G.Adj r a → G.Adj r b →
      a ≠ b → ¬ G.Adj a b) :
    ∃ a b : V, ∃ p : G.Walk a b,
      a ≠ b ∧
      a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      b ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      G.Adj r a ∧ G.Adj r b ∧
      p.IsPath ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) ∧
      r ∉ p.support ∧ 1 < p.length
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, p, hab, ha, hb, hra, hrb, hp, hinside, hroot, _hpos⟩ :=
    rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_path r C hcard
  refine ⟨a, b, p, hab, ha, hb, hra, hrb, hp, hinside, hroot, ?_⟩
  exact one_lt_length_of_ne_of_not_adj hab
    (hnonadj a b ha hb hra hrb hab)

name: Erdos64.fresh_dyadic_ear_reroute_and_length_ne
statement:
private theorem fresh_dyadic_ear_reroute_and_length_ne
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b x y : V}
    (pre : G.Walk a x) (segment : G.Walk x y)
    (suffix : G.Walk y b) (ear : G.Walk x y)
    (horiginal : ((pre.append segment).append suffix).IsPath)
    (hear : ear.IsPath) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hfresh : ∀ z, z ∈ ear.support →
      z ∈ ((pre.append segment).append suffix).support → z = x ∨ z = y)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hlen : ear.length = 2 ^ k)
    (hno : ¬HasPowerOfTwoCycle G) :
    ((pre.append ear).append suffix).IsPath ∧ ear.length ≠ segment.length
proof:
:= by
  have htwo : 2 ≤ ear.length := by
    rw [hlen]
    exact (show 2 = 2 ^ 1 from rfl).le.trans
      (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) hk)
  obtain ⟨hreroute, hcycle⟩ := terminal_path_reroute_of_fresh_ear
    pre segment suffix ear horiginal hear hxy hfresh (Or.inr (by omega))
  refine ⟨hreroute, ?_⟩
  intro heq
  apply hno
  refine ⟨k + 1, x, segment.append ear.reverse, by omega, hcycle, ?_⟩
  simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_append, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_reverse,
    ← heq, hlen, Nat.pow_succ]
  omega

name: Erdos64.dyadic_ear_lt_segment_of_longest_terminal_path
statement:
theorem dyadic_ear_lt_segment_of_longest_terminal_path
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b x y : V}
    (pre : G.Walk a x) (segment : G.Walk x y)
    (suffix : G.Walk y b) (ear : G.Walk x y)
    (horiginal : ((pre.append segment).append suffix).IsPath)
    (hear : ear.IsPath) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hfresh : ∀ z, z ∈ ear.support →
      z ∈ ((pre.append segment).append suffix).support → z = x ∨ z = y)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hlen : ear.length = 2 ^ k)
    (hno : ¬HasPowerOfTwoCycle G)
    (hmax : ∀ q : G.Walk a b, q.IsPath →
      q.length ≤ ((pre.append segment).append suffix).length) :
    ear.length < segment.length
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hreroute, hne⟩ := fresh_dyadic_ear_reroute_and_length_ne
    pre segment suffix ear horiginal hear hxy hfresh hk hlen hno
  have hle := hmax ((pre.append ear).append suffix) hreroute
  simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_append] at hle
  omega

name: Erdos64.segment_lt_dyadic_ear_of_shortest_terminal_path
statement:
theorem segment_lt_dyadic_ear_of_shortest_terminal_path
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b x y : V}
    (pre : G.Walk a x) (segment : G.Walk x y)
    (suffix : G.Walk y b) (ear : G.Walk x y)
    (horiginal : ((pre.append segment).append suffix).IsPath)
    (hear : ear.IsPath) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hfresh : ∀ z, z ∈ ear.support →
      z ∈ ((pre.append segment).append suffix).support → z = x ∨ z = y)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hlen : ear.length = 2 ^ k)
    (hno : ¬HasPowerOfTwoCycle G)
    (hmin : ∀ q : G.Walk a b, q.IsPath →
      ((pre.append segment).append suffix).length ≤ q.length) :
    segment.length < ear.length
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hreroute, hne⟩ := fresh_dyadic_ear_reroute_and_length_ne
    pre segment suffix ear horiginal hear hxy hfresh hk hlen hno
  have hle := hmin ((pre.append ear).append suffix) hreroute
  simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_append] at hle
  omega

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.route03_length
statement:
theorem route03_length (H : PentagramEarHull G) :
    (H.route03).length = 5
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.route03_isPath
statement:
theorem route03_isPath (H : PentagramEarHull G) :
    H.route03.IsPath
proof:
:= by
  apply (SimpleGraph.Walk.isPath_def _).mpr
  change List.Nodup
    [H.vertex (.inr (.inr 0)), H.vertex (.inr (.inl 2)),
      H.vertex (.inl 2), H.vertex (.inl 3),
      H.vertex (.inr (.inl 3)), H.vertex (.inr (.inr 3))]
  let xs : List (Sum (Fin 5) (Sum (Fin 5) (Fin 5))) :=
    [.inr (.inr 0), .inr (.inl 2), .inl 2, .inl 3,
      .inr (.inl 3), .inr (.inr 3)]
  have hxs : xs.Nodup := by
    decide
  exact List.Nodup.map H.vertex_injective hxs

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.connector_length_three_interior_03
statement:
private theorem connector_length_three_interior_03
    (H : PentagramEarHull G) (K : Connector H 0 3)
    (hK : K.path.length = 3) {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ K.path.support.tail) (hv3 : v ≠ bVertex H 3) :
    v ∈ K.path.support.tail.dropLast
proof:
:= by
  apply List.mem_dropLast_of_mem_of_ne_getLast hv
  grind [K.path.length_support, K.path.getLast_support]

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.connector_length_three_not_first_hull_03
statement:
private theorem connector_length_three_not_first_hull_03
    (H : PentagramEarHull G) (K : Connector H 0 3)
    (hK : K.path.length = 3) :
    K.path.snd ≠ aVertex H 2
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hnil : ¬ K.path.Nil := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length]
    omega
  have hnodup := K.isPath.support_nodup
  have h1 : 1 < K.path.support.length := by
    simp [K.path.length_support, hK]
  have h3 : 3 < K.path.support.length := by
    simp [K.path.length_support, hK]
  have hne_b : K.path.snd ≠ bVertex H 3 := by
    intro hb
    have heq : K.path.support[1]'h1 = K.path.support[3]'h3 := by
      rw [← K.path.snd_eq_support_getElem_one hnil]
      have hlast : K.path.support[3]'h3 = bVertex H 3 := by
        simpa [hK] using K.path.support_getElem_length
      exact hb.trans hlast.symm
    have hidx := (List.Nodup.getElem_inj_iff hnodup).mp heq
    omega
  have hsnd : K.path.snd ∈ K.path.support.tail :=
    K.path.snd_mem_tail_support hnil
  have hinter : K.path.snd ∈ K.path.support.tail.dropLast :=
    connector_length_three_interior_03 H K hK hsnd hne_b
  exact K.interior_disjoint _ hinter (by
    rw [h]
    exact Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨2, rfl⟩))

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.cycle8_of_connector_03_length_three
statement:
theorem cycle8_of_connector_03_length_three
    (H : PentagramEarHull G) (K : Connector H 0 3)
    (hK : K.path.length = 3) :
    ∃ c : G.Walk (bVertex H 0) (bVertex H 0),
      c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = 8
proof:
:= by
  exact cycle8_of_hull_return H 0 3 K
    (hullReturn_of_connector_03_length_three H K hK)

name: Erdos64.rootDeletedComponentAttachments_nonempty
statement:
theorem rootDeletedComponentAttachments_nonempty
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] (r : V)
    (hconn : G.Connected)
    (C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) :
    (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxr⟩ :=
    (rootDeletedComponent_boundary r hconn C).2
  refine ⟨x, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, hx⟩⟩
  exact (G.mem_neighborFinset r x).2 hxr.symm
