name: Erdos64.exists_rootDeletedComponent_attachments_le_two_of_degree_eq_four
statement:
theorem exists_rootDeletedComponent_attachments_le_two_of_degree_eq_four
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] (r : V)
    (hconn : G.Connected) (hdegree : G.degree r = 4)
    (hcomponents : ∃ C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent,
      C ≠ D) :
    ∃ C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent,
      (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) :=
    Fintype.ofFinite _
  obtain ⟨C, D, hCD⟩ := hcomponents
  by_contra hnone
  have hCnot : ¬ (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card ≤ 2 := by
    intro hC
    exact hnone ⟨C, hC⟩
  have hDnot : ¬ (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D).card ≤ 2 := by
    intro hD
    exact hnone ⟨D, hD⟩
  have hC3 : 3 ≤ (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card := by
    omega
  have hD3 : 3 ≤ (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D).card := by
    omega
  have hdisj :
      Disjoint (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C)
        (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D) :=
    (rootDeletedComponentAttachments_pairwise_disjoint r) hCD
  have hsub :
      rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C ∪
          rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D ⊆ G.neighborFinset r := by
    intro x hx
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hx with hx | hx
    · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).1
    · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).1
  have hunion_card :
      (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C ∪
          rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D).card =
        (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card +
          (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D).card :=
    Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj
  have hle :
      (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C ∪
          rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D).card ≤ 4 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (G.neighborFinset r).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
      _ = 4 := by simpa [SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] using hdegree
  omega

name: Erdos64.TwoStepEmbedding.card_lt_of_adj
statement:
theorem TwoStepEmbedding.card_lt_of_adj
    {V W : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    (E : TwoStepEmbedding H G) {a b : W} (hab : H.Adj a b) :
    Fintype.card W < Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  apply Fintype.card_lt_of_injective_of_notMem E.vertex E.vertex.injective
    (b := E.middle ⟨s(a, b), hab⟩)
  rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
  exact E.disjoint w _ hw

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.smaller_dyadic_free_has_low_internal_degree
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.smaller_dyadic_free_has_low_internal_degree
    {V W : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] [DecidableRel H.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (hsmall : Fintype.card W < Fintype.card V)
    (hno : ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle H)
    (S : Finset W) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    ∃ w ∈ S, internalDegree H S w ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hnot
  have hdegrees : ∀ w ∈ S, 3 ≤ internalDegree H S w := by
    intro w hw
    by_contra hlt
    exact hnot ⟨w, hw, by omega⟩
  let K : SimpleGraph (↑S : Set W) := H.induce (↑S : Set W)
  let : Nonempty (↑S : Set W) := hS.to_subtype
  have hmin : 3 ≤ K.minDegree := by
    apply SimpleGraph.le_minDegree_of_forall_le_degree
    intro w
    change 3 ≤ (H.induce (↑S : Set W)).degree w
    rw [degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree]
    exact hdegrees w.1 w.2
  have hcard : Fintype.card (↑S : Set W) < Fintype.card V :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (Fintype.card_subtype_le _) hsmall
  exact M.not_exists_strictly_smaller
    ⟨⟨hmin, fun hc => hno (hasPowerOfTwoCycle_of_induce hc)⟩, hcard⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.smaller_twoStep_has_low_internal_degree
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.smaller_twoStep_has_low_internal_degree
    {V W : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] [DecidableRel H.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (E : TwoStepEmbedding H G)
    (hsmall : Fintype.card W < Fintype.card V)
    (S : Finset W) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    ∃ w ∈ S, internalDegree H S w ≤ 2
proof:
:=
  M.smaller_dyadic_free_has_low_internal_degree hsmall
    (fun hc => M.isCounterexample.2 (E.hasPowerOfTwoCycle hc)) S hS

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.smaller_twoStep_edge_bound
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.smaller_twoStep_edge_bound
    {V W : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] [DecidableRel H.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (E : TwoStepEmbedding H G)
    (hsmall : Fintype.card W < Fintype.card V)
    (hn : 2 ≤ Fintype.card W) :
    H.edgeFinset.card + 3 ≤ 2 * Fintype.card W
proof:
:=
  two_degenerate_edge_bound H
    (M.smaller_twoStep_has_low_internal_degree E hsmall) hn

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.twoStep_has_low_internal_degree
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.twoStep_has_low_internal_degree
    {V W : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] [DecidableRel H.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (E : TwoStepEmbedding H G)
    (S : Finset W) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    ∃ w ∈ S, internalDegree H S w ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hedge : ∃ a b, H.Adj a b
  · obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := hedge
    exact M.smaller_twoStep_has_low_internal_degree E (E.card_lt_of_adj hab) S hS
  · obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hS
    refine ⟨w, hw, ?_⟩
    have hzero : S.filter (H.Adj w) = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro z hz
      exact hedge ⟨w, z, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz).2⟩
    simp only [internalDegree, hzero, Finset.card_empty, Nat.zero_le]

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.not_twoStepEmbedding_of_minDegree_ge_three
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.not_twoStepEmbedding_of_minDegree_ge_three
    {V W : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] [DecidableRel H.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (hmin : 3 ≤ H.minDegree)
    (E : TwoStepEmbedding H G) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnonempty : Nonempty W := by
    by_contra h
    let : IsEmpty W := ⟨fun w => h ⟨w⟩⟩
    simp at hmin
  have hS : (Finset.univ : Finset W).Nonempty := Finset.univ_nonempty
  obtain ⟨w, _, hw⟩ := M.twoStep_has_low_internal_degree E Finset.univ hS
  have hwdegree : H.degree w ≤ 2 := by
    simpa [internalDegree, ← SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_eq_filter] using hw
  have := H.minDegree_le_degree w
  omega

name: Erdos64.boundaryRoot_dyadic_cycle_path
statement:
theorem boundaryRoot_dyadic_cycle_path
    {W : Type u} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    {H : SimpleGraph W} [DecidableRel H.Adj] (B : Finset W)
    (hno : ¬HasPowerOfTwoCycle H)
    (hyes : HasPowerOfTwoCycle (boundaryRootGraph H B)) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : W, ∃ p : H.Walk a b,
      2 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ B ∧ b ∈ B ∧ a ≠ b ∧ p.IsPath ∧
      p.length + 2 = 2 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K := boundaryRootGraph H B
  obtain ⟨k, z, c, hk, hc, hlen⟩ := hyes
  have hnone : none ∈ c.support := by
    by_contra hav
    obtain ⟨w, d, hd, hdl⟩ := boundaryRoot_cycle_avoiding_root c hc hav
    exact hno ⟨k, w, d, hk, hd, hdl.trans hlen⟩
  let r := c.rotate none hnone
  have hr : r.IsCycle := hc.rotate hnone
  cases hR : r with
  | nil =>
      have hnil : (SimpleGraph.Walk.nil : K.Walk none none).IsCycle := by
        simpa only [hR] using hr
      exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.not_isCycle_nil hnil).elim
  | @cons u v w h q =>
      have hr' : (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons h q).IsCycle := by
        simpa only [hR] using hr
      have hqnotnil : ¬q.Nil := SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_of_isCycle_cons hr'
      have hqpath : q.IsPath := by simpa using hr'.isPath_tail
      have hdropnone : ∀ t, t ∈ q.dropLast.support → t ≠ none := by
        intro t ht
        have hnodup : (q.dropLast.support ++ [none]).Nodup := by
          rw [q.support_dropLast_concat hqnotnil]
          exact hqpath.support_nodup
        intro ht_none
        exact (List.disjoint_left.mp (List.disjoint_of_nodup_append hnodup))
          ht (by simp [ht_none])
      let S : Set (Option W) := {t | t ≠ none}
      let qi := q.dropLast.induce S hdropnone
      let e := boundaryRootDeletedIso H B
      let emb : K.induce S ↪g K := SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce S
      have hmap : qi.map emb.toHom = q.dropLast :=
        q.dropLast.map_induce hdropnone
      have hqi : qi.IsPath := by
        apply (SimpleGraph.Walk.isPath_map_iff_of_injective
          (p := qi) (f := emb.toHom) emb.injective).mp
        rw [hmap]
        exact hqpath.dropLast
      let p := qi.map e.toHom
      have hp : p.IsPath := hqi.map e.injective
      have hp_len : p.length = q.dropLast.length := by
        have hind := congrArg SimpleGraph.Walk.length hmap
        rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map] at hind
        exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map e.toHom qi).trans hind
      have hboundary : ∀ t : {t : Option W // t ≠ none},
          K.Adj none t.1 → e t ∈ B := by
        rintro ⟨t, ht⟩ hadj
        cases t with
        | none => exact (ht rfl).elim
        | some a =>
            simpa [e, K] using hadj
      have ha := hboundary
        ⟨v, hdropnone v q.dropLast.start_mem_support⟩ h
      have hb := hboundary
        ⟨q.penultimate, hdropnone _ q.dropLast.end_mem_support⟩
        (q.adj_penultimate hqnotnil).symm
      have hclen : c.length = q.dropLast.length + 2 := by
        calc
          c.length = r.length := (c.length_rotate none hnone).symm
          _ = (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons h q).length := by rw [hR]
          _ = q.length + 1 := by simp
          _ = q.dropLast.length + 2 := by
            rw [← q.length_dropLast_add_one hqnotnil]
      have hplen : p.length + 2 = 2 ^ k := by omega
      have hpos : 0 < p.length := by
        have hpow := four_le_pow_two hk
        omega
      have hab : e ⟨v, hdropnone v q.dropLast.start_mem_support⟩ ≠
          e ⟨q.penultimate, hdropnone _ q.dropLast.end_mem_support⟩ := by
        intro hab
        have hnil := hp.nil_iff_eq.mpr hab
        exact (Nat.ne_of_gt hpos) hnil.length_eq_zero
      exact ⟨k, _, _, p, hk, ha, hb, hab, hp, hplen⟩

name: Erdos64.twoRootDeletedComponents_partition
statement:
theorem twoRootDeletedComponents_partition
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (r : V) (C₁ C₂ : Finset V)
    (_hGconn : G.Connected)
    (hC₁nonempty : C₁.Nonempty)
    (hC₂nonempty : C₂.Nonempty)
    (hr₁ : r ∉ C₁)
    (hr₂ : r ∉ C₂)
    (hC₁conn : (G.induce (↑C₁ : Set V)).Connected)
    (hC₂conn : (G.induce (↑C₂ : Set V)).Connected)
    (hcross : ∀ x, x ∈ C₁ → ∀ y, y ∈ C₂ → ¬G.Adj x y)
    (hattach₁ : ∃ x, x ∈ C₁ ∧ G.Adj r x)
    (hattach₂ : ∃ x, x ∈ C₂ ∧ G.Adj r x)
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint C₁ C₂)
    (hcover : C₁ ∪ C₂ = Finset.univ.erase r) :
    ∃ A B : Finset V,
      A = {r} ∪ C₁ ∧
      B = {r} ∪ C₂ ∧
      C₁ ∪ C₂ = Finset.univ.erase r ∧
      Disjoint C₁ C₂ ∧
      A ∩ B = ({r} : Finset V) ∧
      A ∪ B = Finset.univ ∧
      A.Nonempty ∧ B.Nonempty ∧
      r ∈ A ∧ r ∈ B ∧
      C₁.Nonempty ∧ C₂.Nonempty ∧
      (G.induce (↑C₁ : Set V)).Connected ∧
      (G.induce (↑C₂ : Set V)).Connected ∧
      (∀ x, x ∈ C₁ → ∀ y, y ∈ C₂ → ¬G.Adj x y) ∧
      (∃ x, x ∈ C₁ ∧ G.Adj r x) ∧
      (∃ x, x ∈ C₂ ∧ G.Adj r x)
proof:
:= by
  have hinter :
      ({r} ∪ C₁ : Finset V) ∩ ({r} ∪ C₂ : Finset V) = {r} := by
    ext v
    by_cases hvr : v = r
    · simp [hvr]
    · constructor
      · intro hv
        rcases Finset.mem_inter.mp hv with ⟨hv₁, hv₂⟩
        rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hv₁ with hroot | h₁
        · exact (hvr (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hroot)).elim
        · rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hv₂ with hroot | h₂
          · exact (hr₁ (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hroot ▸ h₁)).elim
          · exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint h₁ h₂).elim
      · intro hv
        exact (hvr (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hv)).elim
  have hunion :
      ({r} ∪ C₁ : Finset V) ∪ ({r} ∪ C₂ : Finset V) = Finset.univ := by
    ext v
    by_cases hvr : v = r
    · simp [hvr]
    · constructor
      · intro _
        exact Finset.mem_univ v
      · intro _
        have hverase : v ∈ Finset.univ.erase r := by
          simp [hvr]
        have hvc : v ∈ C₁ ∪ C₂ := by
          rw [← hcover] at hverase
          exact hverase
        rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hvc with hv₁ | hv₂
        · exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inl
            (Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr hv₁)))
        · exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr
            (Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr hv₂)))
  refine ⟨{r} ∪ C₁, {r} ∪ C₂, rfl, rfl, hcover, hdisjoint,
    hinter, hunion, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hC₁nonempty, hC₂nonempty,
    hC₁conn, hC₂conn, hcross, hattach₁, hattach₂⟩
  · exact ⟨r, by simp⟩
  · exact ⟨r, by simp⟩
  · simp
  · simp

name: Erdos64.rootDeletedComponentAttachments_ge_two_of_degree_eq_four
statement:
theorem rootDeletedComponentAttachments_ge_two_of_degree_eq_four
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] (r : V)
    (hconn : G.Connected) (hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3)
    (hcritical : IsSubgraphCritical G)
    (C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hdegree : G.degree r = 4) :
    2 ≤ (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K : Finset V := rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C
  have hKnonempty : K.Nonempty := by
    exact (rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C).1
  have hrK : r ∉ K := by
    exact (rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C).2
  have hboundary : ∀ x, x ∈ K → ∀ y, y ∉ K → G.Adj x y → y = r := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    have hclosed := (rootDeletedComponent_boundary r hconn C).1 x hx y hxy
    rcases hclosed with hyK | hyr
    · exact (hy hyK).elim
    · exact hyr
  obtain ⟨_, hdegree_bound⟩ :=
    component_attachment_lower_bound hconn hmin hcritical K r
      hKnonempty hrK hboundary
  have hdegree_bound' : 4 ≤ (K.filter (G.Adj r)).card + 2 := by
    simpa [hdegree] using hdegree_bound
  have hattach : 2 ≤ (K.filter (G.Adj r)).card := by
    omega
  have hattach_eq :
      rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C = K.filter (G.Adj r) := by
    ext x
    simp [rootDeletedComponentAttachments, K,
      SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, and_comm]
  rw [hattach_eq]
  exact hattach

name: Erdos64.externalComponent_bridge_or_unique_root
statement:
theorem externalComponent_bridge_or_unique_root
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {s : V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {C : G.Walk s s} (hC : C.IsCycle) (hG : G.Connected)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∉ C.support) :
    (∃ bridge : CycleBridgePath G C, True) ∨
      ∃ r, r ∈ C.support ∧
        ∀ b, b ∈ C.support →
          ((∃ v, v ∈ externalComponent G C x hx ∧ G.Adj b v) ↔ b = r)
proof:
:= by
  let K : Set V := externalComponent G C x hx
  have hKconn : (G.induce K).Connected := by
    simpa [K] using externalComponent_induced_connected hx
  have hK_external : ∀ v, v ∈ K → v ∉ C.support := by
    intro v hv
    exact (show v ∈ externalComponent G C x hx from by simpa [K] using hv).1
  rcases externalComponent_two_attachments_or_unique_root hC hG hx with htwo | hroot
  · left
    rcases htwo with ⟨a, b, u, v, ha, hb, hab, hu, hv, hau, hbv⟩
    exact ⟨CycleBridgePath.of_connected_external_set hC K hKconn
      ha hb hab (by simpa [K] using hu) (by simpa [K] using hv)
      hau hbv hK_external, trivial⟩
  · exact Or.inr hroot

name: Erdos64.TwoStepEmbedding.length_lift
statement:
@[simp] theorem length_lift {a b : W} (p : H.Walk a b) :
    (E.lift p).length = 2 * p.length
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons h p ih => simp only [lift, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons, ih]; omega

name: Erdos64.TwoStepEmbedding.vertex_mem_support_lift
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertex_mem_support_lift {a b : W} (p : H.Walk a b) (w : W) :
    E.vertex w ∈ (E.lift p).support ↔ w ∈ p.support
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [lift, E.vertex.injective.eq_iff]
  | cons h p ih =>
    simp only [lift, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, List.mem_cons, ih,
      E.vertex.injective.eq_iff, E.disjoint, false_or]

name: Erdos64.TwoStepEmbedding.middle_mem_support_lift
statement:
@[simp] theorem middle_mem_support_lift {a b : W} (p : H.Walk a b)
    (e : H.edgeSet) : E.middle e ∈ (E.lift p).support ↔ e.1 ∈ p.edges
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [lift, (E.disjoint _ _).symm]
  | cons h p ih =>
    simp only [lift, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, List.mem_cons,
      SimpleGraph.Walk.edges_cons, ih, (E.disjoint _ _).symm, false_or,
      E.middle.injective.eq_iff, Subtype.ext_iff]

name: Erdos64.TwoStepEmbedding.isPath_lift
statement:
theorem isPath_lift {a b : W} {p : H.Walk a b} (hp : p.IsPath) :
    (E.lift p).IsPath
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => exact SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.nil
  | @cons a b c h p ih =>
    obtain ⟨hp, ha⟩ := (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff h p).mp hp
    apply (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff _ _).mpr
    constructor
    · apply (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff _ _).mpr
      refine ⟨ih hp, ?_⟩
      rw [E.middle_mem_support_lift]
      exact fun he => ha (p.fst_mem_support_of_mem_edges he)
    · simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, List.mem_cons,
        E.disjoint, E.vertex_mem_support_lift, false_or]
      exact ha

name: Erdos64.TwoStepEmbedding.isCycle_lift
statement:
theorem isCycle_lift {a : W} {p : H.Walk a a} (hp : p.IsCycle) :
    (E.lift p).IsCycle
proof:
:= by
  have hlen := hp.three_le_length
  cases p with
  | nil => simp at hp
  | cons h p =>
    obtain ⟨hpath, hedge⟩ := (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isCycle_iff p h).mp hp
    apply SimpleGraph.Walk.isCycle_iff_isPath_tail_and_le_length.mpr
    constructor
    · change (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons (E.adj h).2 (E.lift p)).IsPath
      apply (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff _ _).mpr
      exact ⟨E.isPath_lift hpath, by simpa only [E.middle_mem_support_lift] using hedge⟩
    · rw [E.length_lift]
      omega

name: Erdos64.TwoStepEmbedding.hasPowerOfTwoCycle
statement: theorem hasPowerOfTwoCycle (hH : HasPowerOfTwoCycle H) : HasPowerOfTwoCycle G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, a, p, hk, hp, hlen⟩ := hH
  refine ⟨k + 1, E.vertex a, E.lift p, by omega, E.isCycle_lift hp, ?_⟩
  rw [E.length_lift, hlen, pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]

name: Erdos64.balanced_two_cubic_poles_force_odd_ambient_order
statement:
theorem balanced_two_cubic_poles_force_odd_ambient_order
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (D E : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hrD : r ∉ D) (hports : x ∈ D ∧ y ∈ D ∧ x ≠ y)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hexact :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y))
    (hcubic : ∀ v, v ∈ D → G.degree v = 3)
    (hDE : Disjoint D E)
    (hrE : r ∉ E)
    (hpartition : (D ∪ E) ∪ ({r} : Finset V) = Finset.univ)
    (hequal : D.card = E.card) :
    Even D.card ∧ Fintype.card V = 2 * D.card + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hDeven :=
    (two_pole_cubic_even_order D r x y hrD hports hboundary hexact hcubic).2
  have hroot_disjoint : Disjoint (D ∪ E) ({r} : Finset V) := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.2
    intro v hvDE hvr
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hvDE with hvD | hvE
    · exact hrD (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hvr ▸ hvD)
    · exact hrE (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hvr ▸ hvE)
  have hcard := congrArg Finset.card hpartition
  rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hroot_disjoint,
    Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hDE,
    Finset.card_singleton, Finset.card_univ] at hcard
  constructor
  · exact hDeven
  · omega

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.mem_exteriorComponents
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_exteriorComponents (H : PentagramEarHull G) [Fintype V]
    (C : H.exteriorGraph.ConnectedComponent) : C ∈ H.exteriorComponents
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [exteriorComponents]

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.mem_exteriorComponentCarrier_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_exteriorComponentCarrier_iff (H : PentagramEarHull G)
    [Fintype V] (C : H.exteriorGraph.ConnectedComponent) (v : V) :
    v ∈ H.exteriorComponentCarrier C ↔
      ∃ hv : v ∉ H.hull, (⟨v, hv⟩ : {w : V // w ∉ H.hull}) ∈ C.supp
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [exteriorComponentCarrier, Finset.mem_image, Set.mem_toFinset]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, hC, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hw, hC⟩
  · rintro ⟨hv, hC⟩
    exact ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, hC, rfl⟩

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.exteriorComponentCarrier_nonempty
statement:
theorem exteriorComponentCarrier_nonempty (H : PentagramEarHull G) [Fintype V]
    (C : H.exteriorGraph.ConnectedComponent) :
    (H.exteriorComponentCarrier C).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, hC⟩ := C.nonempty_supp
  exact ⟨v, (H.mem_exteriorComponentCarrier_iff C v).2 ⟨hv, hC⟩⟩

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.exteriorComponentCarrier_not_mem_hull
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hext, _⟩ := (H.mem_exteriorComponentCarrier_iff C v).1 hv
  exact hext

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.exteriorComponentCarrier_pairwise_disjoint
statement:
theorem exteriorComponentCarrier_pairwise_disjoint (H : PentagramEarHull G)
    [Fintype V] :
    Pairwise (fun C D : H.exteriorGraph.ConnectedComponent =>
      Disjoint (H.exteriorComponentCarrier C) (H.exteriorComponentCarrier D))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro C D hne
  apply Finset.disjoint_left.2
  intro v hvC hvD
  obtain ⟨hv, hC⟩ := (H.mem_exteriorComponentCarrier_iff C v).1 hvC
  obtain ⟨hv', hD⟩ := (H.mem_exteriorComponentCarrier_iff D v).1 hvD
  exact hne (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.eq_of_common_vertex hC hD)

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.exteriorComponentCarrier_adj_closure
statement:
theorem exteriorComponentCarrier_adj_closure (H : PentagramEarHull G)
    [Fintype V] (C : H.exteriorGraph.ConnectedComponent) {x y : V}
    (hx : x ∈ H.exteriorComponentCarrier C) (hxy : G.Adj x y) :
    y ∈ H.exteriorComponentCarrier C ∨ y ∈ H.hull
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hy : y ∈ H.hull
  · exact Or.inr hy
  · apply Or.inl
    obtain ⟨hxext, hxC⟩ := (H.mem_exteriorComponentCarrier_iff C x).1 hx
    have hxyext : H.exteriorGraph.Adj ⟨x, hxext⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ := hxy
    exact (H.mem_exteriorComponentCarrier_iff C y).2
      ⟨hy, (C.mem_supp_congr_adj hxyext).1 hxC⟩

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.exists_exteriorComponentCarrier_of_not_mem_hull
statement:
theorem exists_exteriorComponentCarrier_of_not_mem_hull (H : PentagramEarHull G)
    [Fintype V] {v : V} (hv : v ∉ H.hull) :
    ∃ C ∈ H.exteriorComponents, v ∈ H.exteriorComponentCarrier C
proof:
:= by
  let C := H.exteriorGraph.connectedComponentMk ⟨v, hv⟩
  refine ⟨C, H.mem_exteriorComponents C, ?_⟩
  apply (H.mem_exteriorComponentCarrier_iff C v).2
  exact ⟨hv, SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_mem⟩

name: Erdos64.component_attachment_lower_bound
statement:
theorem component_attachment_lower_bound
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hconn : G.Connected) (hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3)
    (hcritical : IsSubgraphCritical G)
    (C : Finset V) (r : V)
    (hCnonempty : C.Nonempty)
    (hrC : r ∉ C)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ x, x ∈ C → ∀ y, y ∉ C → G.Adj x y → y = r) :
    1 ≤ (C.filter (G.Adj r)).card ∧
      G.degree r ≤ (C.filter (G.Adj r)).card + 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Finset V := Finset.univ \ C
  have hrS : r ∈ S := by
    exact Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ r, hrC⟩
  have hSnonempty : S.Nonempty := ⟨r, hrS⟩
  have hSproper : S ≠ (Finset.univ : Finset V) := by
    obtain ⟨x, hxC⟩ := hCnonempty
    intro hS
    have hxS : x ∈ S := by
      rw [hS]
      exact Finset.mem_univ x
    exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hxS).2 hxC
  obtain ⟨v, hvS, hvlow⟩ := hcritical S hSnonempty hSproper
  have hvr : v = r := by
    by_contra hvr
    have hneighbors : ∀ w, G.Adj v w → w ∈ S := by
      intro w hvw
      have hwC : w ∉ C := by
        intro hwC
        have hvroot : v = r := hboundary w hwC v
          (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hvS).2 hvw.symm
        exact hvr hvroot
      exact Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ w, hwC⟩
    have hfilter : S.filter (G.Adj v) = G.neighborFinset v := by
      ext w
      constructor
      · intro hw
        exact (G.mem_neighborFinset v w).2
          (Finset.mem_filter.mp hw).2
      · intro hw
        have hvw : G.Adj v w := (G.mem_neighborFinset v w).1 hw
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hneighbors w hvw, hvw⟩
    have hvinternal : internalDegree G S v = G.degree v := by
      change (S.filter (G.Adj v)).card = G.degree v
      rw [hfilter]
      exact SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree G v
    rw [hvinternal] at hvlow
    have hvmin : 3 ≤ G.degree v :=
      degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hmin v
    omega
  have hrootlow : internalDegree G S r ≤ 2 := by
    simpa [hvr] using hvlow
  have hunion :
      S.filter (G.Adj r) ∪ C.filter (G.Adj r) = G.neighborFinset r := by
    ext w
    by_cases hwC : w ∈ C
    · simp [S, SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_eq_filter, hwC]
    · simp [S, SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_eq_filter, hwC]
  have hdisjoint :
      Disjoint (S.filter (G.Adj r)) (C.filter (G.Adj r)) := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.2
    intro w hwS hwC
    exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hwS).1).2
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hwC).1
  have hsum :
      internalDegree G S r + (C.filter (G.Adj r)).card = G.degree r := by
    have hcard := congrArg Finset.card hunion
    rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisjoint,
      SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] at hcard
    change (S.filter (G.Adj r)).card +
      (C.filter (G.Adj r)).card = G.degree r at hcard
    exact hcard
  have htpos : 1 ≤ (C.filter (G.Adj r)).card := by
    obtain ⟨x, hxC⟩ := hCnonempty
    obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, huv⟩ :=
      exists_adj_mem_of_mem_of_not_mem hconn
        (show x ∈ (↑C : Set V) by simpa using hxC)
        (show r ∉ (↑C : Set V) by simpa using hrC)
    have hvr' : v = r := hboundary u (by simpa using hu) v
      (by simpa using hv) huv
    have hur : G.Adj r u := by
      simpa [hvr'] using huv.symm
    have humem : u ∈ C.filter (G.Adj r) :=
      Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨by simpa using hu, hur⟩
    exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨u, humem⟩)
  constructor
  · exact htpos
  · omega

name: Erdos64.path_spanningCoe_degree_of_mem_support
statement:
theorem path_spanningCoe_degree_of_mem_support
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {x y : V} (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ p.support) :
    p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe.degree v = if v = x ∨ v = y then 1 else 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn : ¬p.Nil := fun h => hxy h.eq
  rw [SimpleGraph.Subgraph.degree_spanningCoe, SimpleGraph.Subgraph.degree,
    ← Set.toFinset_card, ← Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
  by_cases hx : v = x
  · subst v
    simp [hp.neighborSet_toSubgraph_startpoint hn]
  by_cases hy : v = y
  · subst v
    simp [hp.neighborSet_toSubgraph_endpoint hn]
  rw [if_neg (not_or.mpr ⟨hx, hy⟩)]
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hile⟩ := SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_iff_exists_getVert.mp hv
  have hi0 : i ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hx (by simpa [h] using hi.symm)
  have hin : i < p.length := by
    have hne : i ≠ p.length := by
      intro h
      exact hy (by simpa [h] using hi.symm)
    omega
  rw [← hi]
  exact hp.ncard_neighborSet_toSubgraph_internal_eq_two hi0 hin

name: Erdos64.path_complement_degree_of_mem_support
statement:
theorem path_complement_degree_of_mem_support
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] {x y : V}
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (v : V) (hv : v ∈ p.support) :
    (G \ p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe).degree v =
      G.degree v - (if v = x ∨ v = y then 1 else 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsub : p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe.neighborFinset v ⊆ G.neighborFinset v := by
    intro w hw
    exact (G.mem_neighborFinset v w).mpr
      (p.toSubgraph.adj_sub ((p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe.mem_neighborFinset v w).mp hw))
  rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree,
    SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_sdiff, Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hsub,
    SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree,
    path_spanningCoe_degree_of_mem_support p hp hxy v hv]

name: Erdos64.spanning_two_port_path_complement_isPerfectMatching
statement:
theorem spanning_two_port_path_complement_isPerfectMatching
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] {x y : V}
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hspan : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, G.degree v = if v = x ∨ v = y then 2 else 3) :
    (G.toSubgraph (G \ p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe) sdiff_le).IsPerfectMatching
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply SimpleGraph.Subgraph.isPerfectMatching_iff_forall_degree.mpr
  intro v
  rw [SimpleGraph.degree_toSubgraph,
    path_complement_degree_of_mem_support p hp hxy v (hspan v), hdeg v]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: Erdos64.spanning_two_port_path_unique_unused_neighbor
statement:
theorem spanning_two_port_path_unique_unused_neighbor
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] {x y : V}
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hspan : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, G.degree v = if v = x ∨ v = y then 2 else 3)
    (v : V) :
    ∃! w, G.Adj v w ∧ s(v, w) ∉ p.edges
proof:
:= by
  have h := SimpleGraph.Subgraph.isPerfectMatching_iff.mp
    (spanning_two_port_path_complement_isPerfectMatching p hp hxy hspan hdeg) v
  simpa only [SimpleGraph.toSubgraph_adj, SimpleGraph.sdiff_adj,
    SimpleGraph.Subgraph.spanningCoe_adj, SimpleGraph.Walk.adj_toSubgraph_iff_mem_edges] using h

name: Erdos64.spanning_two_port_path_matching_involution
statement:
theorem spanning_two_port_path_matching_involution
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] {x y : V}
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hspan : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, G.degree v = if v = x ∨ v = y then 2 else 3) :
    ∃ mate : V → V, Function.Involutive mate ∧
      (∀ v, mate v ≠ v) ∧
      (∀ v w, G.Adj v w ∧ s(v, w) ∉ p.edges ↔ w = mate v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hu := spanning_two_port_path_unique_unused_neighbor p hp hxy hspan hdeg
  let mate : V → V := fun v => (hu v).choose
  have hm (v : V) : (G.Adj v (mate v) ∧ s(v, mate v) ∉ p.edges) ∧
      ∀ w, G.Adj v w ∧ s(v, w) ∉ p.edges → w = mate v := (hu v).choose_spec
  refine ⟨mate, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v
    apply Eq.symm
    apply (hm (mate v)).2
    refine ⟨(hm v).1.1.symm, ?_⟩
    simpa only [Sym2.eq_swap] using (hm v).1.2
  · intro v h
    exact (hm v).1.1.ne h.symm
  · intro v w
    exact ⟨(hm v).2 w, fun h => h.symm ▸ (hm v).1⟩

name: Erdos64.spanning_two_port_path_length_odd
statement:
theorem spanning_two_port_path_length_odd
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] {x y : V}
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hspan : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, G.degree v = if v = x ∨ v = y then 2 else 3) :
    Odd p.length
proof:
:= by
  have heven :=
    (spanning_two_port_path_complement_isPerfectMatching p hp hxy hspan hdeg).even_card
  have hcard : Fintype.card V = p.length + 1 := by
    have hfin : p.support.toFinset = Finset.univ := by
      ext v
      simp [hspan v]
    rw [← Finset.card_univ, ← hfin, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hp.support_nodup,
      p.length_support]
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := heven
  exact ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_cubic_port_side_dyadic_successor_cycle
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_cubic_port_side_dyadic_successor_cycle
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D) (hx : x ∈ D) (hy : y ∈ D) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hboundary : ∀ a, a ∈ D → ∀ b, b ∉ D → G.Adj a b → b = r)
    (hexact : ∀ a, a ∈ D → (G.Adj a r ↔ a = x ∨ a = y))
    (hcubic : G.degree x = 3 ∧ G.degree y = 3)
    (hsize : 2 * D.card - 3 < Fintype.card V) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ c : G.Walk x x,
      1 ≤ k ∧ c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = 2 ^ k + 1 ∧
      (∀ a, a ∈ c.support → a ∈ D) ∧ r ∉ c.support
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hxdeg, hydeg, hretained, _⟩ :=
    two_cubic_ports_boundary_accounting D r x y hr ⟨hx, hy, hxy⟩
      hboundary hexact hcubic
  let H := G.induce (↑D : Set V)
  let x' : (↑D : Set V) := ⟨x, hx⟩
  let y' : (↑D : Set V) := ⟨y, hy⟩
  have hxy' : x' ≠ y' := fun h => hxy (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  have hx' : H.degree x' = 2 := by
    rw [degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree]
    exact hxdeg
  have hy' : 2 ≤ H.degree y' := by
    rw [degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree]
    exact hydeg.ge
  have hother : ∀ v, v ≠ x' → v ≠ y' → 3 ≤ H.degree v := by
    intro v hvx hvy
    rw [degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree,
      hretained v.1 v.2 (fun h => hvx (Subtype.ext h))
        (fun h => hvy (Subtype.ext h))]
    exact degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G M.isCounterexample.1 v.1
  have hno : ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle H :=
    not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle_induce_of_not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle M.isCounterexample.2
  have hsmall : 2 * Fintype.card (↑D : Set V) - 3 < Fintype.card V := by
    simpa using hsize
  obtain ⟨k, c, hk, hc, hlen⟩ :=
    M.two_defect_port_dyadic_successor_cycle x' y' hxy' hx' hy' hother hno hsmall
  let e : H ↪g G := SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce (↑D : Set V)
  let q : G.Walk x x := c.map e.toHom
  have hq : q.IsCycle := hc.map e.injective
  have hinside : ∀ a, a ∈ q.support → a ∈ D := by
    intro a ha
    change a ∈ (c.map e.toHom).support at ha
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map] at ha
    obtain ⟨v, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ha
    exact v.2
  refine ⟨k, q, hk, hq, ?_, hinside, fun h => hr (hinside r h)⟩
  change (c.map e.toHom).length = 2 ^ k + 1
  rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map]
  exact hlen

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_port_dyadic_successor_cycle
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_port_dyadic_successor_cycle
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hCD : C ≠ D) (x : V)
    (hx : x ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) (hrx : G.Adj r x) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ c : G.Walk x x,
      1 ≤ k ∧ c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = 2 ^ k + 1 ∧
      (∀ a, a ∈ c.support → a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) ∧
      r ∉ c.support
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
  obtain ⟨_, _, hcard, _, _, hcubic⟩ :=
    M.rootDeleted_two_components_exact_balanced_cubic r C D hCD
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hra, hrb, hports⟩ :=
    rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_attachment_exact r C hcard
  have hpartner : ∃ y, y ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧ x ≠ y ∧
      G.Adj r y ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
        G.Adj v r → v = x ∨ v = y) := by
    rcases hports x hx hrx.symm with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨b, hb, hab, hrb, hports⟩
    · refine ⟨a, ha, hab.symm, hra, ?_⟩
      intro v hv hvr
      exact (hports v hv hvr).symm
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy, hry, hxyports⟩ := hpartner
  have hexact : ∀ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y) := by
    intro v hv
    refine ⟨hxyports v hv, ?_⟩
    rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact hrx.symm
    · exact hry.symm
  have hboundary : ∀ a, a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      ∀ b, b ∉ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C → G.Adj a b → b = r := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    rcases (rootDeletedComponent_boundary r M.vertexMinimal.isConnected C).1
      a ha b hab with hbC | hbr
    · exact (hb hbC).elim
    · exact hbr
  have horder := M.vertexMinimal.rootDeleted_two_components_order r C D hCD
  exact M.vertexMinimal.exact_two_cubic_port_side_dyadic_successor_cycle
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) r x y
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C).2 hx hy hxy
    hboundary hexact ⟨hcubic x hrx, hcubic y hry⟩ (by omega)

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.highDegree_private_add_aux_degree
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.highDegree_private_add_aux_degree
    (M : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G) (x : HighDegreeVertex G) :
    (highDegreePrivateNeighbors G x.1).card +
      (highDegreeAuxGraph G).degree x = G.degree x.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let N := G.neighborFinset x.1
  have hconnect : N.filter (fun v => (highDegreeNeighbors G v).card = 2) =
      (degreeThreeTwoHighNeighbors G).filter (G.Adj x.1) := by
    ext v
    simp only [N, degreeThreeTwoHighNeighbors, Finset.mem_filter,
      Finset.mem_univ, true_and, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hv, hc⟩
      exact ⟨⟨M.neighbor_degree_eq_three_of_degree_ge_four x.2 hv, hc⟩, hv⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨_, hc⟩, hv⟩
      exact ⟨hv, hc⟩
  have hprivate : N.filter (fun v => ¬ (highDegreeNeighbors G v).card = 2) =
      highDegreePrivateNeighbors G x.1 := by
    ext v
    simp only [highDegreePrivateNeighbors, N, Finset.mem_filter,
      SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hv, hc⟩
      have hv3 := M.neighbor_degree_eq_three_of_degree_ge_four x.2 hv
      refine ⟨hv, hv3, ?_⟩
      have hbound : (highDegreeNeighbors G v).card ≤ 2 :=
        M.high_degree_neighborFinset_card_le_two_of_degree_eq_three hv3
      have hxmem : x.1 ∈ highDegreeNeighbors G v := by
        simp [highDegreeNeighbors, x.2, hv.symm]
      exact (Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
        (Finset.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hxmem) (by simp; omega)).symm
    · rintro ⟨hv, _, hc⟩
      exact ⟨hv, by simp [hc]⟩
  have hsum := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
    (s := N) (p := fun v => (highDegreeNeighbors G v).card = 2)
  rw [hconnect, hprivate, ← M.highDegreeAuxGraph_degree_eq_connector_count,
    show N.card = G.degree x.1 from G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree x.1] at hsum
  omega

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.exists_highDegree_vertex_two_private_neighbors
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.exists_highDegree_vertex_two_private_neighbors
    (M : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G)
    (hH : (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => 4 ≤ G.degree v)).Nonempty) :
    ∃ r : V, 4 ≤ G.degree r ∧
      G.degree r ≤ (highDegreePrivateNeighbors G r).card + 2 ∧
      2 ≤ (highDegreePrivateNeighbors G r).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hH
  let x : HighDegreeVertex G := ⟨r, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).2⟩
  have hS : (Finset.univ : Finset (HighDegreeVertex G)).Nonempty :=
    ⟨x, Finset.mem_univ x⟩
  obtain ⟨y, _, hy⟩ := M.highDegreeAuxGraph_low_internal_degree Finset.univ hS
  have hdegree : (highDegreeAuxGraph G).degree y ≤ 2 := by
    simpa [internalDegree, ← SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_eq_filter] using hy
  have hsum := M.highDegree_private_add_aux_degree y
  refine ⟨y.1, y.2, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> have := y.2 <;> omega

name: Erdos64.cross_residual_path_to_dyadic_port_path
statement:
theorem cross_residual_path_to_dyadic_port_path
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {r x y u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v} {k : ℕ}
    (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hp : p.IsPath)
    (havoid : ∀ w, w ∈ p.support → w ≠ x ∧ w ≠ y)
    (hroot : r ∉ p.support)
    (hlen : p.length + 2 = 2 ^ k)
    (hadj : (G.Adj x u ∧ G.Adj y v) ∨
      (G.Adj y u ∧ G.Adj x v)) :
    (∃ q : G.Walk x y,
      q.IsPath ∧ r ∉ q.support ∧ q.length = 2 ^ k) ∨
    (∃ q : G.Walk y x,
      q.IsPath ∧ r ∉ q.support ∧ q.length = 2 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hadj with ⟨hxu, hyv⟩ | ⟨hyu, hxv⟩
  · left
    let tail : G.Walk u y :=
      p.append (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hyv.symm SimpleGraph.Walk.nil)
    have htail : tail.IsPath := by
      dsimp [tail]
      rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.isPath_def, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_append]
      simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil,
        List.tail_cons]
      apply List.nodup_append.mpr
      refine ⟨hp.support_nodup, by simp, ?_⟩
      intro w hw z hz
      simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hz
      subst z
      exact (havoid w hw).2
    let q : G.Walk x y := SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hxu tail
    have hq : q.IsPath := by
      dsimp [q]
      apply (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff hxu _).2
      refine ⟨htail, ?_⟩
      rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_append]
      simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil,
        List.tail_cons, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton]
      intro hxmem
      rcases hxmem with hxmem | rfl
      · exact (havoid x hxmem).1 rfl
      · exact hxy rfl
    have hqroot : r ∉ q.support := by
      have hrv : r ≠ v := by
        intro hrv
        apply hroot
        simpa [hrv] using p.end_mem_support
      simp [q, tail, hroot, hrx.ne, hry.ne, hrv]
    refine ⟨q, hq, hqroot, ?_⟩
    simp [q, tail, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons,
      SimpleGraph.Walk.length_append, hlen]
  · right
    let tail : G.Walk u x :=
      p.append (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hxv.symm SimpleGraph.Walk.nil)
    have htail : tail.IsPath := by
      dsimp [tail]
      rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.isPath_def, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_append]
      simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil,
        List.tail_cons]
      apply List.nodup_append.mpr
      refine ⟨hp.support_nodup, by simp, ?_⟩
      intro w hw z hz
      simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hz
      subst z
      exact (havoid w hw).1
    let q : G.Walk y x := SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hyu tail
    have hq : q.IsPath := by
      dsimp [q]
      apply (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff hyu _).2
      refine ⟨htail, ?_⟩
      rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_append]
      simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil,
        List.tail_cons, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton]
      intro hymem
      rcases hymem with hymem | rfl
      · exact (havoid y hymem).2 rfl
      · exact hxy.symm rfl
    have hqroot : r ∉ q.support := by
      have hrv : r ≠ v := by
        intro hrv
        apply hroot
        simpa [hrv] using p.end_mem_support
      simp [q, tail, hroot, hrx.ne, hry.ne, hrv]
    refine ⟨q, hq, hqroot, ?_⟩
    simp [q, tail, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons,
      SimpleGraph.Walk.length_append, hlen]

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.length_two_snd_ne_end
statement:
private theorem length_two_snd_ne_end
    (H : PentagramEarHull G) (K : Connector H 0 1)
    (hK : K.path.length = 2) : K.path.snd ≠ bVertex H 1
proof:
:= by
  intro hb
  have hnil : ¬ K.path.Nil := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length]
    omega
  have hnodup := K.isPath.support_nodup
  have h1 : 1 < K.path.support.length := by
    simp [K.path.length_support, hK]
  have h2 : 2 < K.path.support.length := by
    simp [K.path.length_support, hK]
  have heq : K.path.support[1]'h1 = K.path.support[2]'h2 := by
    rw [← K.path.snd_eq_support_getElem_one hnil]
    have hlast : K.path.support[2]'h2 = bVertex H 1 := by
      simpa [hK] using K.path.support_getElem_length
    exact hb.trans hlast.symm
  have hidx := (List.Nodup.getElem_inj_iff hnodup).mp heq
  omega

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.length_two_snd_ne_first_hull
statement:
private theorem length_two_snd_ne_first_hull
    (H : PentagramEarHull G) (K : Connector H 0 1)
    (hK : K.path.length = 2) : K.path.snd ≠ aVertex H 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hnil : ¬ K.path.Nil := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length]
    omega
  have hsnd : K.path.snd ∈ K.path.support.tail := K.path.snd_mem_tail_support hnil
  have hinter : K.path.snd ∈ K.path.support.tail.dropLast :=
    mem_interior_of_mem_tail_ne_end hsnd (length_two_snd_ne_end H K hK)
  exact K.interior_disjoint _ hinter (by
    rw [h]
    exact Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨0, rfl⟩))

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.routeLengthTwo_disjoint
statement:
private theorem routeLengthTwo_disjoint
    (H : PentagramEarHull G) (K : Connector H 0 1)
    (hK : K.path.length = 2) :
    (K.path.take K.path.length).support.tail.Disjoint
      (routeLengthTwo H).reverse.support.tail
proof:
:= by
  rw [K.path.take_of_length_le (Nat.le_refl _)]
  simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_copy]
  apply List.disjoint_left.2
  intro v hvK hvR
  have hvR' : v ∈ (routeLengthTwo H).reverse.support :=
    List.mem_of_mem_tail hvR
  have hvh : v ∈ hull H := by
    simp [routeLengthTwo, hull, cVertex, aVertex, bVertex] at hvR' ⊢
    aesop
  have hv1 : v ≠ bVertex H 1 := by
    intro hv1
    subst v
    simp [routeLengthTwo, aVertex, bVertex, cVertex] at hvR
    rcases hvR with h | h | h | h | h | h <;>
      have hi := H.vertex_injective h <;> simp_all
  exact K.interior_disjoint v
    (mem_interior_of_mem_tail_ne_end hvK hv1) hvh

name: Erdos64.highDegreeAuxGraph_edge_has_connector
statement:
theorem highDegreeAuxGraph_edge_has_connector (e : (highDegreeAuxGraph G).edgeSet) :
    ∃ v, G.degree v = 3 ∧ ∀ x ∈ e.1, G.Adj v x.1
proof:
:= by
  rcases e with ⟨e, he⟩
  induction e using Sym2.inductionOn with
  | _ x y =>
    obtain ⟨_, v, hv, hx, hy⟩ := he
    refine ⟨v, hv, ?_⟩
    intro z hz
    rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hz with rfl | rfl

    · exact hy

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.highDegreeAuxGraph_connector_unique
proof:

  exact (M.vertexMinimal.common_neighbor_eq_root_of_nonadjacent_ports
    hvx hvy (fun h => hxy (Subtype.ext h)) hwx.symm hwy.symm hwx.ne hwy.ne).symm

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.highDegreeNeighbors_eq_pair
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.highDegreeNeighbors_eq_pair
    (M : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G) {v : V} (hv : G.degree v = 3)
    {x y : HighDegreeVertex G} (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hx : G.Adj v x.1) (hy : G.Adj v y.1) :
    highDegreeNeighbors G v = {x.1, y.1}
proof:
:= by
  have hxy' : x.1 ≠ y.1 := fun h => hxy (Subtype.ext h)
  have hsub : ({x.1, y.1} : Finset V) ⊆ highDegreeNeighbors G v := by
    intro w hw
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hw
    rcases hw with rfl | rfl
    · simp [highDegreeNeighbors, x.2, hx]
    · simp [highDegreeNeighbors, y.2, hy]
  have hcard := M.high_degree_neighborFinset_card_le_two_of_degree_eq_three hv
  apply (Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub ?_).symm
  simpa [highDegreeNeighbors, hxy'] using hcard

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.highDegreeConnector_injective
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.highDegreeConnector_injective
    (M : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G) : Function.Injective (highDegreeConnector G)
proof:
:= by
  intro e d heq
  rcases e with ⟨e, he⟩
  rcases d with ⟨d, hd⟩
  induction e using Sym2.inductionOn with
  | _ x y =>
    induction d using Sym2.inductionOn with
    | _ z w =>
      have hxy := (highDegreeConnector_spec G ⟨s(x, y), he⟩)
      have hzw := (highDegreeConnector_spec G ⟨s(z, w), hd⟩)
      have hp := M.highDegreeNeighbors_eq_pair hxy.1 he.1
        (hxy.2 x (by simp)) (hxy.2 y (by simp))
      have hq := M.highDegreeNeighbors_eq_pair hzw.1 hd.1
        (hzw.2 z (by simp)) (hzw.2 w (by simp))
      rw [heq] at hp
      have hpq : ({x.1, y.1} : Finset V) = {z.1, w.1} := hp.symm.trans hq
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply Sym2.ext
      intro a
      have hmem := congrArg (fun S : Finset V => a.1 ∈ S) hpq
      simpa only [Sym2.mem_iff, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton,
        Subtype.ext_iff] using eq_iff_iff.mp hmem

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.highDegreeAuxGraph_no_dyadic_cycle

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.highDegreeVertex_card_lt
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.highDegreeVertex_card_lt
    (M : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G) : Fintype.card (HighDegreeVertex G) < Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := M.exists_degree_eq_three
  have hc : G.degree v = 3 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
  exact Fintype.card_subtype_lt (x := v) (by omega)

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.highDegreeConnector_mem_degreeThreeTwoHighNeighbors
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.highDegreeConnector_mem_degreeThreeTwoHighNeighbors
    (M : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G) (e : (highDegreeAuxGraph G).edgeSet) :
    highDegreeConnector G e ∈ degreeThreeTwoHighNeighbors G
proof:
:= by
  rcases e with ⟨e, he⟩
  induction e using Sym2.inductionOn with
  | _ x y =>
    have hs := highDegreeConnector_spec G ⟨s(x, y), he⟩
    have hn := M.highDegreeNeighbors_eq_pair hs.1 he.1
      (hs.2 x (by simp)) (hs.2 y (by simp))
    have hne : x.1 ≠ y.1 := fun h => he.1 (Subtype.ext h)
    simp [degreeThreeTwoHighNeighbors, hs.1, hn, hne]

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.highDegreeConnector_range_iff
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.highDegreeConnector_range_iff
    (M : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G) (v : V) :
    (∃ e, highDegreeConnector G e = v) ↔ v ∈ degreeThreeTwoHighNeighbors G
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, rfl⟩
    exact M.highDegreeConnector_mem_degreeThreeTwoHighNeighbors e
  · intro hv
    have hdeg : G.degree v = 3 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).1).2
    have hcard : (highDegreeNeighbors G v).card = 2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
    obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.mp (show
      1 < (highDegreeNeighbors G v).card by omega)
    have hx' : 4 ≤ G.degree x ∧ G.Adj v x := by simpa [highDegreeNeighbors] using hx
    have hy' : 4 ≤ G.degree y ∧ G.Adj v y := by simpa [highDegreeNeighbors] using hy
    let X : HighDegreeVertex G := ⟨x, hx'.1⟩
    let Y : HighDegreeVertex G := ⟨y, hy'.1⟩
    have hXY : X ≠ Y := fun h => hxy (congrArg Subtype.val h)
    have hedge : (highDegreeAuxGraph G).Adj X Y := ⟨hXY, v, hdeg, hx'.2, hy'.2⟩
    let e : (highDegreeAuxGraph G).edgeSet := ⟨s(X, Y), hedge⟩
    refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
    have hs := highDegreeConnector_spec G e
    exact M.highDegreeAuxGraph_connector_unique hXY
      (hs.2 X (by simp [e])) (hs.2 Y (by simp [e])) hx'.2 hy'.2

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.highDegreeAuxGraph_edge_card
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.highDegreeAuxGraph_edge_card
    (M : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G) :
    Fintype.card (highDegreeAuxGraph G).edgeSet = (degreeThreeTwoHighNeighbors G).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : (highDegreeAuxGraph G).edgeSet → (degreeThreeTwoHighNeighbors G) :=
    fun e => ⟨highDegreeConnector G e, M.highDegreeConnector_mem_degreeThreeTwoHighNeighbors e⟩
  have hf : Function.Bijective f := by
    constructor
    · intro e d h
      exact M.highDegreeConnector_injective (congrArg Subtype.val h)
    · intro v
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := (M.highDegreeConnector_range_iff v.1).2 v.2
      exact ⟨e, Subtype.ext he⟩
  exact (Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective f hf)).trans (Fintype.card_coe _)

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.highDegreeAuxGraph_degree_eq_connector_count
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.highDegreeAuxGraph_degree_eq_connector_count
    (M : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G) (x : HighDegreeVertex G) :
    (highDegreeAuxGraph G).degree x =
      ((degreeThreeTwoHighNeighbors G).filter (G.Adj x.1)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
  let edgeOf : ∀ y, y ∈ (highDegreeAuxGraph G).neighborFinset x →
      (highDegreeAuxGraph G).edgeSet :=
    fun y hy => ⟨s(x, y), by simpa using hy⟩
  apply Finset.card_bij (fun y hy => highDegreeConnector G (edgeOf y hy))
  · intro y hy
    refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      ⟨M.highDegreeConnector_mem_degreeThreeTwoHighNeighbors _, ?_⟩
    exact ((highDegreeConnector_spec G (edgeOf y hy)).2 x (by simp [edgeOf])).symm
  · intro y hy z hz heq
    have he := congrArg Subtype.val (M.highDegreeConnector_injective heq)
    change s(x, y) = s(x, z) at he
    rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp he with h | h
    · exact h.2
    · exact h.2.trans h.1
  · intro v hv
    have hL := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).1
    have hxv := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have hdeg : G.degree v = 3 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hL).1).2
    have hcard : (highDegreeNeighbors G v).card = 2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hL).2
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_ne (show
      1 < (highDegreeNeighbors G v).card by omega) x.1
    have hy' : 4 ≤ G.degree y ∧ G.Adj v y := by simpa [highDegreeNeighbors] using hy
    let Y : HighDegreeVertex G := ⟨y, hy'.1⟩
    have hXY : x ≠ Y := fun h => hyx (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
    have hedge : (highDegreeAuxGraph G).Adj x Y :=
      ⟨hXY, v, hdeg, hxv.symm, hy'.2⟩
    have hY : Y ∈ (highDegreeAuxGraph G).neighborFinset x :=
      by simpa using hedge
    refine ⟨Y, hY, ?_⟩
    have hs := highDegreeConnector_spec G (edgeOf Y hY)
    exact M.highDegreeAuxGraph_connector_unique hXY
      (hs.2 x (by simp [edgeOf])) (hs.2 Y (by simp [edgeOf])) hxv.symm hy'.2

name: Erdos64.rootedDouble_degree_order_interface
statement:
theorem rootedDouble_degree_order_interface
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (S : Finset V) (r : {v : V // v ∈ S})
    (hclosed : ∀ v, v ∈ S → v ≠ r.val →
      ∀ w, G.Adj v w → w ∈ S)
    (hroot : 2 ≤ internalDegree G S r.val)
    (hside : ∀ v, v ∈ S → 3 ≤ G.degree v)
    (hsize : 2 * S.card - 1 < Fintype.card V) :
    (∀ (b : Bool) (v : {v : (↑S : Set V) // v ≠ r}),
      3 ≤ (rootedDoubleGraph (G.induce (↑S : Set V)) r).degree
        (some (b, v))) ∧
    4 ≤ (rootedDoubleGraph (G.induce (↑S : Set V)) r).degree none ∧
    Fintype.card (RootedDoubleVertex (↑S : Set V) r) = 2 * S.card - 1 ∧
    Fintype.card (RootedDoubleVertex (↑S : Set V) r) < Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnonroot :
      ∀ (b : Bool) (v : {v : (↑S : Set V) // v ≠ r}),
        3 ≤ (rootedDoubleGraph (G.induce (↑S : Set V)) r).degree
          (some (b, v)) := by
    intro b v
    rw [rootedDouble_nonroot_degree_preservation]
    rw [degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree (G := G) v.1]
    have hvroot : v.1.1 ≠ r.val := by
      intro heq
      apply v.2
      exact Subtype.ext heq
    have hneighbors : S.filter (G.Adj v.1.1) = G.neighborFinset v.1.1 := by
      ext w
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]
      constructor
      · exact And.right
      · intro hadj
        exact ⟨hclosed v.1.1 v.1.property hvroot w hadj, hadj⟩
    change 3 ≤ (S.filter (G.Adj v.1.1)).card
    rw [hneighbors, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
    exact hside v.1.1 v.1.property
  have hrootDouble :
      4 ≤ (rootedDoubleGraph (G.induce (↑S : Set V)) r).degree none := by
    rw [rootedDouble_root_degree_doubling,
      degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree (G := G) r]
    omega
  have hcard :
      Fintype.card (RootedDoubleVertex (↑S : Set V) r) = 2 * S.card - 1 := by
    rw [rootedDouble_card]
    have hsidecard : Fintype.card (↑S : Set V) = S.card :=
      Fintype.card_of_finset' S (fun _ => Iff.rfl)
    rw [hsidecard]
  refine ⟨hnonroot, hrootDouble, hcard, ?_⟩
  rw [hcard]
  exact hsize

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.route02_length
statement:

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.route02_isPath
statement:
theorem route02_isPath (H : PentagramEarHull G) :
    H.route02.IsPath
proof:
:= by
  apply (SimpleGraph.Walk.isPath_def _).mpr
  change List.Nodup
    [H.vertex (.inr (.inr 0)), H.vertex (.inr (.inl 0)),
      H.vertex (.inl 0), H.vertex (.inl 4),
      H.vertex (.inr (.inl 4)), H.vertex (.inr (.inr 2))]

      .inr (.inl 4), .inr (.inr 2)]

    decide

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.connector_length_three_interior_02
statement:
private theorem connector_length_three_interior_02
    (H : PentagramEarHull G) (K : Connector H 0 2)
    (hK : K.path.length = 3) {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ K.path.support.tail) (hv2 : v ≠ bVertex H 2) :
    v ∈ K.path.support.tail.dropLast
proof:
:= by
  apply List.mem_dropLast_of_mem_of_ne_getLast hv
  grind [K.path.length_support, K.path.getLast_support]

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.connector_length_three_not_first_hull_02
statement:
private theorem connector_length_three_not_first_hull_02
    (H : PentagramEarHull G) (K : Connector H 0 2)
    (hK : K.path.length = 3) :
    K.path.snd ≠ aVertex H 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hnil : ¬ K.path.Nil := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length]
    omega
  have hnodup := K.isPath.support_nodup
  have h1 : 1 < K.path.support.length := by
    simp [K.path.length_support, hK]
  have h3 : 3 < K.path.support.length := by
    simp [K.path.length_support, hK]
  have hne_b : K.path.snd ≠ bVertex H 2 := by
    intro hb
    have heq : K.path.support[1]'h1 = K.path.support[3]'h3 := by
      rw [← K.path.snd_eq_support_getElem_one hnil]
      have hlast : K.path.support[3]'h3 = bVertex H 2 := by
        simpa [hK] using K.path.support_getElem_length
      exact hb.trans hlast.symm
    have hidx := (List.Nodup.getElem_inj_iff hnodup).mp heq
    omega
  have hsnd : K.path.snd ∈ K.path.support.tail :=
    K.path.snd_mem_tail_support hnil
  have hinter : K.path.snd ∈ K.path.support.tail.dropLast :=
    connector_length_three_interior_02 H K hK hsnd hne_b
  exact K.interior_disjoint _ hinter (by
    rw [h]
    exact Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨0, rfl⟩))

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.cycle8_of_connector_02_length_three
statement:
theorem cycle8_of_connector_02_length_three

      c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = 8
proof:
:= by

    (hullReturn_of_connector_02_length_three H K hK)

name: Erdos64.walk_support_in_side_of_avoiding_ports
statement:
theorem walk_support_in_side_of_avoiding_ports
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {D : Finset V} {r x y u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v)
    (hu : u ∈ D)
    (hboundary : ∀ a, a ∈ D → ∀ b, b ∉ D → G.Adj a b → b = r)
    (hports : ∀ a, a ∈ D → G.Adj a r → a = x ∨ a = y)
    (havoid : ∀ a, a ∈ p.support → a ≠ x ∧ a ≠ y) :
    ∀ a, a ∈ p.support → a ∈ D
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil =>
      intro a ha
      simpa using (List.mem_singleton.mp ha) ▸ hu
  | @cons a b c hab q ih =>
      have hb : b ∈ D := by
        by_contra hb
        have hbr := hboundary a hu b hb hab
        have har : G.Adj a r := hbr ▸ hab
        have haavoid := havoid a (by simp)
        rcases hports a hu har with hax | hay
        · exact haavoid.1 hax
        · exact haavoid.2 hay
      have hqavoid : ∀ z, z ∈ q.support → z ≠ x ∧ z ≠ y := by
        intro z hz
        exact havoid z (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hz)
      intro z hz
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hz with rfl | hz
      · exact hu
      · exact ih hb hqavoid z hz

name: Erdos64.cross_residual_in_exact_two_port_side
statement:
theorem cross_residual_in_exact_two_port_side
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {D : Finset V} {r x y u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v}
    (hr : r ∉ D) (hx : x ∈ D) (hy : y ∈ D)
    (hboundary : ∀ a, a ∈ D → ∀ b, b ∉ D → G.Adj a b → b = r)
    (hports : ∀ a, a ∈ D → G.Adj a r → a = x ∨ a = y)
    (hur : u ≠ r) (hvr : v ≠ r)
    (havoid : ∀ a, a ∈ p.support → a ≠ x ∧ a ≠ y)
    (hadj : (G.Adj x u ∧ G.Adj y v) ∨ (G.Adj y u ∧ G.Adj x v)) :
    u ∈ D ∧ v ∈ D ∧ (∀ a, a ∈ p.support → a ∈ D) ∧ r ∉ p.support
proof:
:= by
  have hneighbor : ∀ a, a ∈ D → ∀ b, b ≠ r → G.Adj a b → b ∈ D := by
    intro a ha b hbr hab
    by_contra hb
    exact hbr (hboundary a ha b hb hab)
  have huv : u ∈ D ∧ v ∈ D := by
    rcases hadj with ⟨hxu, hyv⟩ | ⟨hyu, hxv⟩
    · exact ⟨hneighbor x hx u hur hxu, hneighbor y hy v hvr hyv⟩
    · exact ⟨hneighbor y hy u hur hyu, hneighbor x hx v hvr hxv⟩
  have hinside := walk_support_in_side_of_avoiding_ports p huv.1 hboundary hports havoid
  exact ⟨huv.1, huv.2, hinside, fun hroot => hr (hinside r hroot)⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_port_side_dyadic_path
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_port_side_dyadic_path
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D) (hx : x ∈ D) (hy : y ∈ D)
    (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (hnadj : ¬ G.Adj x y)
    (hroot_degree : 4 ≤ G.degree r)
    (hboundary : ∀ a, a ∈ D → ∀ b, b ∉ D → G.Adj a b → b = r)
    (hports : ∀ a, a ∈ D → G.Adj a r → a = x ∨ a = y) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ q : G.Walk x y,
      2 ≤ k ∧ q.IsPath ∧ q.length = 2 ^ k ∧
      (∀ a, a ∈ q.support → a ∈ D) ∧ r ∉ q.support
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, u, v, p, hk, hp, havoid, hlen, hadj⟩ :=
    M.shared_root_quotient_residual_path hrx hry hxy hnadj hroot_degree
  have hur : u ≠ r := hadj.elim (fun h => h.2.2.1) (fun h => h.2.2.1)
  have hvr : v ≠ r := hadj.elim (fun h => h.2.2.2) (fun h => h.2.2.2)
  have hattach : (G.Adj x u ∧ G.Adj y v) ∨ (G.Adj y u ∧ G.Adj x v) :=
    hadj.imp (fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩) (fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩)
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hroot⟩ := cross_residual_in_exact_two_port_side
    hr hx hy hboundary hports hur hvr havoid hattach
  have hpath := cross_residual_path_to_dyadic_port_path
    hrx hry hxy hp havoid hroot hlen hattach
  have hnormalized : ∃ q : G.Walk x y,
      q.IsPath ∧ r ∉ q.support ∧ q.length = 2 ^ k := by
    rcases hpath with hforward | ⟨q, hq, hqr, hqlen⟩
    · exact hforward
    · exact ⟨q.reverse, hq.reverse, by simpa using hqr, by simpa using hqlen⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqr, hqlen⟩ := hnormalized
  exact ⟨k, q, hk, hq, hqlen,
    SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.support_subset_of_boundary_avoiding_root
      hq hx hqr hboundary, hqr⟩

name: Erdos64.rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_attachment_exact
statement:
theorem rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_attachment_exact
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] (r : V)
    (C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hcard : (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card = 2) :
    ∃ x y : V,
      x ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      y ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      x ≠ y ∧ G.Adj r x ∧ G.Adj r y ∧
      (∀ a, a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
        G.Adj a r → a = x ∨ a = y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, hset⟩ :=
    Finset.card_eq_two.mp hcard
  have hxatt : x ∈ rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C := by
    rw [hset]
    simp [hxy]
  have hyatt : y ∈ rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C := by
    rw [hset]
    simp
  have hx := Finset.mem_filter.mp hxatt
  have hy := Finset.mem_filter.mp hyatt
  refine ⟨x, y, hx.2, hy.2, hxy, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (G.mem_neighborFinset r x).mp hx.1
  · exact (G.mem_neighborFinset r y).mp hy.1
  · intro a ha har
    have haatt : a ∈ rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C := by
      apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      exact ⟨(G.mem_neighborFinset r a).mpr har.symm, ha⟩
    rw [hset] at haatt
    simpa only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] using haatt

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_twoPort_component_dyadic_path
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_twoPort_component_dyadic_path
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hcard : (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card = 2)
    (hroot_degree : 4 ≤ G.degree r)
    (hnonadj : ∀ a b,
      a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      b ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      G.Adj r a → G.Adj r b → a ≠ b → ¬ G.Adj a b) :
    ∃ x y : V, ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ q : G.Walk x y,
      x ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      y ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      x ≠ y ∧ G.Adj r x ∧ G.Adj r y ∧
      2 ≤ k ∧ q.IsPath ∧ q.length = 2 ^ k ∧
      (∀ a, a ∈ q.support →
        a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) ∧ r ∉ q.support
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hxy, hrx, hry, hports⟩ :=
    rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_attachment_exact r C hcard
  have hboundary :
      ∀ a, a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
        ∀ b, b ∉ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
          G.Adj a b → b = r := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    rcases (rootDeletedComponent_boundary r M.isConnected C).1 a ha b hab with
      hbC | hbr
    · exact (hb hbC).elim
    · exact hbr
  have hxy_nonadj := hnonadj x y hx hy hrx hry hxy
  obtain ⟨k, q, hk, hq, hqlen, hinside, hroot⟩ :=
    M.exact_two_port_side_dyadic_path
      (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) r x y
      (rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C).2
      hx hy hrx hry hxy hxy_nonadj hroot_degree hboundary hports
  exact ⟨x, y, k, q, hx, hy, hxy, hrx, hry, hk, hq, hqlen,
    hinside, hroot⟩

name: Erdos64.degree_sup_edge_of_not_adj
statement:
theorem degree_sup_edge_of_not_adj
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (K : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel K.Adj]
    {a b : V} (hab : a ≠ b) (hnadj : ¬ K.Adj a b) (v : V) :
    (K ⊔ SimpleGraph.edge a b).degree v =
      K.degree v + if v = a ∨ v = b then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hna : b ∉ K.neighborFinset a := by simpa using hnadj
  have hnb : a ∉ K.neighborFinset b := by
    simpa only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset] using (fun h => hnadj h.symm)
  by_cases hva : v = a
  · subst v
    have hfin : (K ⊔ SimpleGraph.edge a b).neighborFinset a =
        insert b (K.neighborFinset a) := by
      ext w
      simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, SimpleGraph.sup_adj,
        SimpleGraph.edge_adj, Finset.mem_insert]
      by_cases hw : w = b <;> simp [hw, hab, or_comm]
    rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hfin,
      Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hna, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
    simp
  · by_cases hvb : v = b
    · subst v
      have hfin : (K ⊔ SimpleGraph.edge a b).neighborFinset b =
          insert a (K.neighborFinset b) := by
        ext w
        simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, SimpleGraph.sup_adj,
          SimpleGraph.edge_adj, Finset.mem_insert]
        by_cases hw : w = a <;> simp [hw, hab.symm, or_comm]
      rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hfin,
        Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hnb, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
      simp
    · have hfin : (K ⊔ SimpleGraph.edge a b).neighborFinset v =
          K.neighborFinset v := by
        ext w
        simp [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset,
          SimpleGraph.edge_adj, hva, hvb]
      rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hfin,
        SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
      simp [hva, hvb]

name: Erdos64.two_port_edge_completion_degree
statement:
theorem two_port_edge_completion_degree
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D) (hx : x ∈ D) (hy : y ∈ D)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (hnadj : ¬ G.Adj x y)
    (hboundary : ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hexact : ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y))
    (v : (↑D : Set V)) :
    ((G.induce (↑D : Set V)) ⊔ SimpleGraph.edge ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩).degree v =
      G.degree v.1
proof:
:= by
  have hneq : (⟨x, hx⟩ : (↑D : Set V)) ≠ ⟨y, hy⟩ := by
    intro h
    exact hxy (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  have hn : ¬ (G.induce (↑D : Set V)).Adj ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ := hnadj
  rw [degree_sup_edge_of_not_adj _ hneq hn,
    degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree]
  have haccount := internalDegree_add_root_indicator_eq_degree D r hr hboundary v.2
  have hiff : (v = ⟨x, hx⟩ ∨ v = ⟨y, hy⟩) ↔ G.Adj v.1 r := by
    rw [hexact v.1 v.2]
    simp only [Subtype.ext_iff]
  simpa only [hiff] using haccount

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.two_port_edge_completion_has_dyadic_cycle
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.two_port_edge_completion_has_dyadic_cycle
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D) (hx : x ∈ D) (hy : y ∈ D)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (hnadj : ¬ G.Adj x y)
    (hboundary : ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hexact : ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y)) :
    HasPowerOfTwoCycle
      ((G.induce (↑D : Set V)) ⊔ SimpleGraph.edge ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H := (G.induce (↑D : Set V)) ⊔ SimpleGraph.edge ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩
  let : Nonempty (↑D : Set V) := ⟨⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  have hmin : H.minDegree ≥ 3 := by
    apply H.le_minDegree_of_forall_le_degree
    intro v
    rw [show H.degree v = G.degree v.1 from
      two_port_edge_completion_degree D r x y hr hx hy hxy hnadj
        hboundary hexact v]
    exact degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G M.isCounterexample.1 v.1
  have hcard : Fintype.card (↑D : Set V) < Fintype.card V :=
    Fintype.card_subtype_lt hr
  by_contra hno
  exact M.not_exists_strictly_smaller (H := H) ⟨⟨hmin, hno⟩, hcard⟩
