name: Erdos64.root_cycle_of_internal_path
statement:
theorem root_cycle_of_internal_path
    (_hnadj : ¬ G.Adj a b)
    {x y : Internal a b}
    (p : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ a ∧ v ≠ b}).Walk x y)
    (hp : p.IsPath) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hx : G.Adj a x.1 ∨ G.Adj b x.1)
    (hy : G.Adj a y.1 ∨ G.Adj b y.1) :
    ∃ c : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Walk none none, c.IsCycle
proof:
:= by
  let e := internalEmbedding G a b
  have hroot_x : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Adj none (some x) := hx
  have hroot_y : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Adj none (some y) := hy
  have hnone : none ∉ (p.map e.toHom).support := by
    simp [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map, e, internalEmbedding]
  let r : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Walk none (some y) :=
    SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hroot_x (p.map e.toHom)
  let s : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Walk (some y) none :=
    hroot_y.symm.toWalk
  have hr : r.IsPath := (hp.map e.injective).cons hnone
  have hs : s.IsPath := hroot_y.symm.isPath_toWalk
  have hdis : r.support.tail.Disjoint s.support.tail := by
    rw [List.disjoint_left]
    intro z hz_r hz_s
    have hz : z = none := by simpa [s] using hz_s
    subst z
    change none ∈ (p.map e.toHom).support at hz_r
    exact hnone hz_r
  have hpos : 0 < p.length := by
    cases p with
    | nil => exact False.elim (hxy rfl)
    | cons h p => simp
  have hlong : 1 < r.length := by
    change 1 < (p.map e.toHom).length + 1
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map]
    omega
  exact ⟨r.append s, hr.isCycle_append hs hdis (Or.inl hlong)⟩

name: Erdos64.root_cycle_of_internal_path_length
statement:
theorem root_cycle_of_internal_path_length
    (_hnadj : ¬ G.Adj a b)
    {x y : Internal a b}
    (p : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ a ∧ v ≠ b}).Walk x y)
    (hp : p.IsPath) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hx : G.Adj a x.1 ∨ G.Adj b x.1)
    (hy : G.Adj a y.1 ∨ G.Adj b y.1) :
    ∃ c : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Walk none none,
      c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = p.length + 2
proof:
:= by
  let e := internalEmbedding G a b
  have hroot_x : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Adj none (some x) := hx
  have hroot_y : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Adj none (some y) := hy
  have hnone : none ∉ (p.map e.toHom).support := by
    simp [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map, e, internalEmbedding]
  let r : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Walk none (some y) :=
    SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hroot_x (p.map e.toHom)
  let s : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Walk (some y) none :=
    hroot_y.symm.toWalk
  have hr : r.IsPath := (hp.map e.injective).cons hnone
  have hs : s.IsPath := hroot_y.symm.isPath_toWalk
  have hdis : r.support.tail.Disjoint s.support.tail := by
    rw [List.disjoint_left]
    intro z hz_r hz_s
    have hz : z = none := by simpa [s] using hz_s
    subst z
    change none ∈ (p.map e.toHom).support at hz_r
    exact hnone hz_r
  have hpos : 0 < p.length := by
    cases p with
    | nil => exact False.elim (hxy rfl)
    | cons h p => simp
  have hlong : 1 < r.length := by
    change 1 < (p.map e.toHom).length + 1
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map]
    omega
  refine ⟨r.append s, hr.isCycle_append hs hdis (Or.inl hlong), ?_⟩
  have hr_length : r.length = p.length + 1 := by
    change (p.map e.toHom).length + 1 = p.length + 1
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map]
  rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_append]
  rw [hr_length]
  simp only [s, SimpleGraph.Adj.length_toWalk]

name: Erdos64.root_cycle_correspondence
statement:
theorem root_cycle_correspondence (hab : a ≠ b) (hnadj : ¬ G.Adj a b)
    {x y : Internal a b}
    (p : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ a ∧ v ≠ b}).Walk x y)
    (hp : p.IsPath) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hax : G.Adj a x.1) (hby : G.Adj b y.1) :
    (∃ c : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Walk none none, c.IsCycle) ∧
    (∃ q : G.Walk a b, q.IsPath)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨root_cycle_of_internal_path G a b hnadj p hp hxy
      (Or.inl hax) (Or.inr hby), ?_⟩
  let i : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ a ∧ v ≠ b}) ↪g G :=
    SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce _
  let m : G.Walk x.1 y.1 := p.map i.toHom
  have hm : m.IsPath := hp.map i.injective
  have hna : a ∉ m.support := by
    intro ha
    change a ∈ (p.map i.toHom).support at ha
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map] at ha
    rw [List.mem_map] at ha
    rcases ha with ⟨z, hz, hza⟩
    change z.1 = a at hza
    exact z.2.1 hza
  have hnb : b ∉ m.support := by
    intro hb
    change b ∈ (p.map i.toHom).support at hb
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map] at hb
    rw [List.mem_map] at hb
    rcases hb with ⟨z, hz, hzb⟩
    change z.1 = b at hzb
    exact z.2.2 hzb
  have hma : (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hax m).IsPath := hm.cons hna
  exact ⟨(SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hax m).concat hby.symm,
    hma.concat (by simp [hnb, hab.symm]) hby.symm⟩

name: Erdos64.root_cycle_correspondence_length
statement:
theorem root_cycle_correspondence_length (hab : a ≠ b) (hnadj : ¬ G.Adj a b)
    {x y : Internal a b}
    (p : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ a ∧ v ≠ b}).Walk x y)
    (hp : p.IsPath) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hax : G.Adj a x.1) (hby : G.Adj b y.1) :
    ∃ c : (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Walk none none,
      ∃ q : G.Walk a b,
        c.IsCycle ∧ q.IsPath ∧ q.length = p.length + 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, _hclen⟩ :=
    root_cycle_of_internal_path_length G a b hnadj p hp hxy
      (Or.inl hax) (Or.inr hby)
  let i : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ a ∧ v ≠ b}) ↪g G :=
    SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce _
  let m : G.Walk x.1 y.1 := p.map i.toHom
  have hm : m.IsPath := hp.map i.injective
  have hna : a ∉ m.support := by
    intro ha
    change a ∈ (p.map i.toHom).support at ha
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map] at ha
    rw [List.mem_map] at ha
    rcases ha with ⟨z, _hz, hza⟩
    change z.1 = a at hza
    exact z.2.1 hza
  have hnb : b ∉ m.support := by
    intro hb
    change b ∈ (p.map i.toHom).support at hb
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map] at hb
    rw [List.mem_map] at hb
    rcases hb with ⟨z, _hz, hzb⟩
    change z.1 = b at hzb
    exact z.2.2 hzb
  have hma : (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hax m).IsPath := hm.cons hna
  have hq :
      ((SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hax m).concat hby.symm).IsPath :=
    hma.concat (by simp [hnb, hab.symm]) hby.symm
  refine ⟨c, (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hax m).concat hby.symm, hc, hq, ?_⟩
  rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_concat]
  change (p.map i.toHom).length + 1 + 1 = p.length + 2
  rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map]

name: Erdos64.quotient_cycle_of_internal_cycle
statement:
theorem quotient_cycle_of_internal_cycle
    {x : Internal a b}
    (c : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ a ∧ v ≠ b}).Walk x x)
    (hc : c.IsCycle) :
    (c.map (internalEmbedding G a b).toHom).IsCycle
proof:
:= by
  exact hc.map (internalEmbedding G a b).injective

name: Erdos64.terminalQuotient_card_lt
statement:
theorem terminalQuotient_card_lt
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {a b : V} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    Fintype.card (QuotientVertex a b) < Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_congr (quotientToNotBEquiv hab)]
  have hb : ¬ (b ≠ b) := by simp
  exact Fintype.card_subtype_lt hb

name: Erdos64.terminalQuotient_root_degree_ge_three
statement:
private theorem terminalQuotient_root_degree_ge_three
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] {a b : V}
    (hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3) (hnadj : ¬ G.Adj a b) :
    3 ≤ (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).degree none
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T := {v : V // v ≠ a ∧ v ≠ b ∧ (G.Adj a v ∨ G.Adj b v)}
  let f : G.neighborSet a → T := fun x =>
    ⟨x.1, by
      have hax : G.Adj a x.1 := (G.mem_neighborSet a x.1).mp x.2
      have hxa : x.1 ≠ a := by
        intro h
        have haa : G.Adj a a := by simpa [h] using hax
        exact G.loopless.irrefl a haa
      have hxb : x.1 ≠ b := by
        intro h
        exact hnadj (by simpa [h] using hax)
      exact ⟨hxa, hxb, Or.inl hax⟩⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply Subtype.ext
    change x.1 = y.1
    exact congrArg (fun z : T => z.1) hxy
  have hcard : Fintype.card (G.neighborSet a) ≤ Fintype.card T :=
    Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf
  rw [SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree] at hcard
  rw [quotient_root_degree]
  exact (degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hmin a).trans hcard

name: Erdos64.terminalQuotient_internal_degree_ge_three
statement:
private theorem terminalQuotient_internal_degree_ge_three
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] {a b : V}
    (hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3)
    (hcommon : ∀ z, z ≠ a → z ≠ b →
      ¬ (G.Adj a z ∧ G.Adj b z))
    {v : Internal a b} :
    3 ≤ (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).degree (some v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : DecidableRel (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Adj :=
    quotient_decidableRel G a b
  let f : G.neighborSet v.1 →
      (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).neighborSet (some v) := fun x =>
    if hx : x.1 = a ∨ x.1 = b then
      ⟨none, by
        rcases hx with hxa | hxb
        · exact Or.inl (by simpa [hxa] using
            (G.mem_neighborSet v.1 x.1).mp x.2)
        · exact Or.inr (by simpa [hxb] using
            (G.mem_neighborSet v.1 x.1).mp x.2)⟩
    else
      ⟨some ⟨x.1, by
        exact ⟨fun h => hx (Or.inl h), fun h => hx (Or.inr h)⟩⟩,
        (G.mem_neighborSet v.1 x.1).mp x.2⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x y hxy
    by_cases hx : x.1 = a ∨ x.1 = b
    · by_cases hy : y.1 = a ∨ y.1 = b
      · rcases hx with hxa | hxb <;> rcases hy with hya | hyb
        · apply Subtype.ext
          exact hxa.trans hya.symm
        · exfalso
          have hva : G.Adj v.1 a := by simpa [hxa] using
            (G.mem_neighborSet v.1 x.1).mp x.2
          have hvb : G.Adj v.1 b := by simpa [hyb] using
            (G.mem_neighborSet v.1 y.1).mp y.2
          exact hcommon v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2 ⟨hva.symm, hvb.symm⟩
        · exfalso
          have hvb : G.Adj v.1 b := by simpa [hxb] using
            (G.mem_neighborSet v.1 x.1).mp x.2
          have hva : G.Adj v.1 a := by simpa [hya] using
            (G.mem_neighborSet v.1 y.1).mp y.2
          exact hcommon v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2 ⟨hva.symm, hvb.symm⟩
        · apply Subtype.ext
          exact hxb.trans hyb.symm
      · have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
        simp [f, hx, hy] at hval
    · by_cases hy : y.1 = a ∨ y.1 = b
      · have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
        simp [f, hx, hy] at hval
      · have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
        simp [f, hx, hy] at hval
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact hval
  have hcard : Fintype.card (G.neighborSet v.1) ≤
      Fintype.card ((terminalQuotientGraph G a b).neighborSet (some v)) :=
    Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf
  rw [SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree] at hcard
  have hqdeg :
      Fintype.card ((terminalQuotientGraph G a b).neighborSet (some v)) =
        (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).degree (some v) :=
    SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree _ _
  rw [hqdeg] at hcard
  exact (degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hmin v.1).trans hcard

name: Erdos64.terminalQuotient_minDegree_ge_three
statement:
theorem terminalQuotient_minDegree_ge_three
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] {a b : V}
    (hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3) (_hab : a ≠ b) (hnadj : ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hcommon : ∀ z, z ≠ a → z ≠ b →
      ¬ (G.Adj a z ∧ G.Adj b z)) :
    (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).minDegree ≥ 3
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty (QuotientVertex a b) := ⟨none⟩
  apply SimpleGraph.le_minDegree_of_forall_le_degree
    (terminalQuotientGraph G a b) 3
  intro q
  cases q with
  | none => exact terminalQuotient_root_degree_ge_three hmin hnadj
  | some v => exact terminalQuotient_internal_degree_ge_three hmin hcommon

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.terminalQuotient_hasPowerOfTwoCycle
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.terminalQuotient_hasPowerOfTwoCycle
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) {a b : V}
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hnadj : ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hcommon : ∀ z, z ≠ a → z ≠ b →
      ¬ (G.Adj a z ∧ G.Adj b z)) :
    HasPowerOfTwoCycle (terminalQuotientGraph G a b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : DecidableRel (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Adj :=
    quotient_decidableRel G a b
  by_contra hno
  have hsmall :
      IsStrictlySmallerCounterexample G (terminalQuotientGraph G a b) := by
    refine ⟨⟨terminalQuotient_minDegree_ge_three M.isCounterexample.1
        hab hnadj hcommon, hno⟩, ?_⟩
    exact terminalQuotient_card_lt hab
  exact M.not_exists_strictly_smaller hsmall

name: Erdos64.two_pole_cubic_even_order
statement:
theorem two_pole_cubic_even_order
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D)
    (hports : x ∈ D ∧ y ∈ D ∧ x ≠ y)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hexact :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y))
    (hcubic : ∀ v, v ∈ D → G.degree v = 3) :
    2 * (G.induce (↑D : Set V)).edgeFinset.card + 2 = 3 * D.card ∧
      Even D.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hxdeg, hydeg, hnonport, _⟩ :=
    two_cubic_ports_boundary_accounting D r x y hr hports hboundary
      hexact ⟨hcubic x hports.1, hcubic y hports.2.1⟩
  have hsum :
      D.sum (fun v => internalDegree G D v) =
        2 * (G.induce (↑D : Set V)).edgeFinset.card := by
    let H : SimpleGraph (↑D : Set V) := G.induce (↑D : Set V)
    have hhand := H.sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges
    have hsum_bij :
        D.sum (fun v => internalDegree G D v) =
          (Finset.univ : Finset (↑D : Set V)).sum (fun v => H.degree v) := by
      refine Finset.sum_bij (fun a ha => ⟨a, ?_⟩) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · exact ha
      · simp
      · intro a₁ ha₁ a₂ ha₂ h
        exact congrArg Subtype.val h
      · intro b hb
        refine ⟨b.1, b.2, ?_⟩
        exact Subtype.ext rfl
      · intro a ha
        simpa [H] using
          (degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree G ⟨a, ha⟩).symm
    calc
      D.sum (fun v => internalDegree G D v) =
          (Finset.univ : Finset (↑D : Set V)).sum (fun v => H.degree v) :=
        hsum_bij
      _ = 2 * H.edgeFinset.card := hhand
  have hy_erase : y ∈ D.erase x :=
    Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hports.2.2.symm, hports.2.1⟩
  have hnon_sum :
      ((D.erase x).erase y).sum (fun v => internalDegree G D v) =
        3 * ((D.erase x).erase y).card := by
    calc
      ((D.erase x).erase y).sum (fun v => internalDegree G D v) =
          ((D.erase x).erase y).sum (fun _ => 3) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro v hv
            have hvy : v ≠ y := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hv).1
            have hvx : v ≠ x :=
              (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hv).2).1
            have hvD : v ∈ D :=
              (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hv).2).2
            exact (hnonport v hvD hvx hvy).trans (hcubic v hvD)
      _ = 3 * ((D.erase x).erase y).card := by simp [Nat.mul_comm]
  have hcard_lower : 2 ≤ D.card := by
    have hsub : ({x, y} : Finset V) ⊆ D := by
      intro v hv
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
      rcases hv with rfl | rfl
      · exact hports.1
      · exact hports.2.1
    have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    simpa [hports.2.2] using hcard
  have hsum_eval :
      D.sum (fun v => internalDegree G D v) = 3 * D.card - 2 := by
    have hcardD : ((D.erase x).erase y).card = D.card - 2 := by
      calc
        ((D.erase x).erase y).card = (D.erase x).card - 1 :=
          Finset.card_erase_of_mem hy_erase
        _ = (D.card - 1) - 1 := by
          rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hports.1]
        _ = D.card - 2 := by simp [Nat.sub_sub]
    have hnon_sum' := hnon_sum
    rw [hcardD] at hnon_sum'
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase D (fun v => internalDegree G D v) hports.1]
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase (D.erase x)
      (fun v => internalDegree G D v) hy_erase]
    rw [hxdeg, hydeg, hnon_sum']
    omega
  have hEq :
      2 * (G.induce (↑D : Set V)).edgeFinset.card + 2 = 3 * D.card := by
    calc
      2 * (G.induce (↑D : Set V)).edgeFinset.card + 2 =
          D.sum (fun v => internalDegree G D v) + 2 := by rw [hsum]
      _ = (3 * D.card - 2) + 2 := by rw [hsum_eval]
      _ = 3 * D.card := by
        have hthree : 2 ≤ 3 * D.card := by omega
        exact Nat.sub_add_cancel hthree
  constructor
  · exact hEq
  · have hparity : 2 ∣ 3 * D.card := by
      use (G.induce (↑D : Set V)).edgeFinset.card + 1
      omega
    rw [even_iff_two_dvd]
    omega

name: Erdos64.two_port_safe_side_or_cubic_defect
statement:
theorem two_port_safe_side_or_cubic_defect
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V) (hD : D.Nonempty)
    (hr : r ∉ D)
    (hboundary : ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3)
    (hports : ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y)) :
    (G.induce (↑D : Set V)).minDegree ≥ 3 ∨
      G.degree x = 3 ∨ G.degree y = 3
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hsafe : ∀ v, v ∈ D → G.Adj v r → 4 ≤ G.degree v
  · exact Or.inl (induced_minDegree_ge_three_of_high_degree_ports
      D r hD hboundary hmin hsafe)
  · right
    push_neg at hsafe
    obtain ⟨v, hvD, hvr, hvlt⟩ := hsafe
    have hvdeg : G.degree v = 3 := by
      have hvmin : 3 ≤ G.degree v :=
        degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hmin v
      omega
    rcases (hports v hvD).mp hvr with rfl | rfl
    · exact Or.inl hvdeg
    · exact Or.inr hvdeg

name: Erdos64.rootedDouble_cycle_localization
proof:
:= by

  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  by_cases hnone : z = none
  · exact Or.inl hnone
  · exact Or.inr (hb z hz hnone)

name: Erdos64.externalComponent_bridge_branch_cycle_length_certificate
statement:
theorem externalComponent_bridge_branch_cycle_length_certificate
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {s : V}
    [DecidableEq V] {C : G.Walk s s} (hC : C.IsCycle)
    (hbridge : ∃ bridge : CycleBridgePath G C, True) :
    ∃ (bridge : CycleBridgePath G C)
      (p : G.Path bridge.left bridge.right)
      (q : G.Path bridge.right bridge.left),
      (p : G.Walk bridge.left bridge.right).append
          (q : G.Walk bridge.right bridge.left) =
        C.rotate bridge.left bridge.left_mem_cycle ∧
      (p : G.Walk bridge.left bridge.right).length +
          (q : G.Walk bridge.right bridge.left).length = C.length ∧
      ((p : G.Walk bridge.left bridge.right).length > 1 ∨
        (q : G.Walk bridge.right bridge.left).length > 1) ∧
      ((∃ c : G.Walk bridge.left bridge.left,
          c.IsCycle ∧
            c.length = bridge.path.length +
              (p : G.Walk bridge.left bridge.right).length) ∨
       (∃ c : G.Walk bridge.right bridge.right,
          c.IsCycle ∧
            c.length = bridge.path.length +
              (q : G.Walk bridge.right bridge.left).length))
proof:
:= by
  rcases hbridge with ⟨bridge, _⟩
  obtain ⟨p, q, hdecomp, hlonger⟩ :=
    bridge.exists_complementary_arc_longer_than_one hC
  have hsum := bridge.complementary_arcs_length_add hdecomp
  refine ⟨bridge, p, q, hdecomp, hsum, hlonger, ?_⟩
  rcases hlonger with hp | hq
  · left
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hlength⟩ :=
      bridge.cycle_of_extracted_arc hdecomp (Or.inr hp)
    exact ⟨c, hc, hlength⟩
  · right
    have hq_sub_cycle :
        (q : G.Walk bridge.right bridge.left).support ⊆ C.support := by
      intro z hz
      have hzappend : z ∈
          ((p : G.Walk bridge.left bridge.right).append
            (q : G.Walk bridge.right bridge.left)).support := by
        simp [hz]
      rw [hdecomp] at hzappend
      exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_rotate_iff C bridge.left
        bridge.left_mem_cycle).mp hzappend
    have hdisjoint :=
      bridge.reverse.tails_disjoint_of_arc_support_subset
        q.property hq_sub_cycle
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hlength⟩ :=
      bridge.reverse.cycle_of_arc q.property hdisjoint (Or.inr hq)
    refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
    simpa [CycleBridgePath.reverse, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_reverse]
      using hlength

name: Erdos64.even_card_of_two_even_degree_vertices
statement:
theorem even_card_of_two_even_degree_vertices
    {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (x y : V) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hx : Even (G.degree x)) (hy : Even (G.degree y))
    (hother : ∀ v, v ≠ x → v ≠ y → Odd (G.degree v)) :
    Even (Fintype.card V)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfilter : Finset.univ.filter (fun v => Odd (G.degree v)) =
      (Finset.univ.erase x).erase y := by
    ext v
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_erase]
    constructor
    · intro hv
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, trivial⟩
      · intro h
        subst v
        exact (Nat.not_odd_iff_even.mpr hy) hv
      · intro h
        subst v
        exact (Nat.not_odd_iff_even.mpr hx) hv
    · rintro ⟨hvy, hvx, _⟩
      exact hother v hvx hvy
  have heven := G.even_card_odd_degree_vertices
  rw [hfilter] at heven
  have hxcard := Finset.card_erase_add_one (Finset.mem_univ x)
  have hycard := Finset.card_erase_add_one
    (show y ∈ Finset.univ.erase x by simp [hxy.symm])
  rw [Finset.card_univ] at hxcard
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := heven
  exact ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩

name: Erdos64.exact_two_port_side_card_even_of_odd_degrees
statement:
theorem exact_two_port_side_card_even_of_odd_degrees
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D) (hx : x ∈ D) (hy : y ∈ D) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hboundary : ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hexact : ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y))
    (hodd : ∀ v, v ∈ D → Odd (G.degree v)) :
    Even D.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H := G.induce (↑D : Set V)
  let xx : (↑D : Set V) := ⟨x, hx⟩
  let yy : (↑D : Set V) := ⟨y, hy⟩
  have hdeg : ∀ v : (↑D : Set V),
      H.degree v + (if G.Adj v.1 r then 1 else 0) = G.degree v.1 := by
    intro v
    rw [degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree]
    exact internalDegree_add_root_indicator_eq_degree D r hr hboundary v.2
  have hxroot : G.Adj x r := (hexact x hx).mpr (Or.inl rfl)
  have hyroot : G.Adj y r := (hexact y hy).mpr (Or.inr rfl)
  have hxEven : Even (H.degree xx) := by
    have h : H.degree xx + 1 = G.degree x := by
      simpa only [xx, hxroot, ↓reduceIte] using hdeg xx
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hodd x hx
    exact ⟨k, by omega⟩
  have hyEven : Even (H.degree yy) := by
    have h : H.degree yy + 1 = G.degree y := by
      simpa only [yy, hyroot, ↓reduceIte] using hdeg yy
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hodd y hy
    exact ⟨k, by omega⟩
  have hother : ∀ v, v ≠ xx → v ≠ yy → Odd (H.degree v) := by
    intro v hvx hvy
    have hvr : ¬G.Adj v.1 r := by
      intro h
      rcases (hexact v.1 v.2).mp h with h | h
      · exact hvx (Subtype.ext h)
      · exact hvy (Subtype.ext h)
    have h := hdeg v
    simp only [hvr, ↓reduceIte, Nat.add_zero] at h
    rw [h]
    exact hodd v.1 v.2
  have heven := even_card_of_two_even_degree_vertices H xx yy
    (fun h => hxy (congrArg Subtype.val h)) hxEven hyEven hother
  simpa using heven

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_side_card_even_of_odd_degrees
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_side_card_even_of_odd_degrees
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    (hodd : ∀ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C → Odd (G.degree v)) :
    Even (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
  have hcard := (M.rootDeleted_two_components_exact_balanced r C D hCD).2.2.1
  obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hxy, hrx, hry, hports⟩ :=
    rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_attachment_exact r C hcard
  have hboundary : ∀ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      ∀ w, w ∉ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C → G.Adj v w → w = r := by
    intro v hv w hw hvw
    exact ((rootDeletedComponent_boundary r M.isConnected C).1 v hv w hvw).resolve_left hw
  have hexact : ∀ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y) := by
    intro v hv
    refine ⟨hports v hv, ?_⟩
    rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact hrx.symm
    · exact hry.symm
  exact exact_two_port_side_card_even_of_odd_degrees
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) r x y
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C).2 hx hy hxy
    hboundary hexact hodd

name: Erdos64.exists_vertex_outside_even_path_of_even_card
statement:
theorem exists_vertex_outside_even_path_of_even_card
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableEq V]
    (D : Finset V) (hD : Even D.card) {x y : V}
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath) (heven : Even p.length)
    (hinside : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ D) :
    ∃ v, v ∈ D ∧ v ∉ p.support
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hnot
  have hcover : ∀ v, v ∈ D → v ∈ p.support := by
    intro v hv
    by_contra hvp
    exact hnot ⟨v, hv, hvp⟩
  have heq : p.support.toFinset = D := by
    ext v
    simpa using ⟨hinside v, hcover v⟩
  have hcard : D.card = p.length + 1 := by
    rw [← heq, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hp.support_nodup, p.length_support]
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hD
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := heven
  omega

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_even_path_external_vertex_of_odd_degrees
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_even_path_external_vertex_of_odd_degrees
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    (hodd : ∀ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C → Odd (G.degree v))
    {x y : V} (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath) (heven : Even p.length)
    (hinside : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) :
    ∃ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧ v ∉ p.support
proof:
:= by
  exact exists_vertex_outside_even_path_of_even_card
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (M.rootDeleted_cut_side_card_even_of_odd_degrees r C D hCD hodd)
    p hp heven hinside

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_even_port_path_dyadic_ear_of_odd_degrees
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_even_port_path_dyadic_ear_of_odd_degrees
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    (hodd : ∀ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C → Odd (G.degree v))
    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath) (heven : Even p.length)
    (hinside : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : V, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      1 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ p.support ∧ b ∈ p.support ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      ear.IsPath ∧ ear.length = 2 ^ k ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ p.support → v = a ∨ v = b) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvp⟩ :=
    M.rootDeleted_even_path_external_vertex_of_odd_degrees r C D hCD hodd
      p hp heven hinside
  exact M.rootDeleted_cut_side_dyadic_ear_of_external_vertex r C D hCD
    hxy hrx hry p hinside v hv hvp

name: Erdos64.EdgeMinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_even_port_path_ear_or_spanning_even_degree_vertex
statement:
theorem EdgeMinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_even_port_path_ear_or_spanning_even_degree_vertex
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath) (heven : Even p.length)
    (hinside : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) :
    (∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : V, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      1 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ p.support ∧ b ∈ p.support ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      ear.IsPath ∧ ear.length = 2 ^ k ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ p.support → v = a ∨ v = b) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)) ∨
    ((∀ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C → v ∈ p.support) ∧
      ∃ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧ v ≠ x ∧ v ≠ y ∧
        Even (G.degree v) ∧ 4 ≤ G.degree v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hexternal : ∃ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧ v ∉ p.support
  · obtain ⟨v, hv, hvp⟩ := hexternal
    exact Or.inl (M.vertexMinimal.rootDeleted_cut_side_dyadic_ear_of_external_vertex
      r C D hCD hxy hrx hry p hinside v hv hvp)
  right
  have hcover : ∀ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C → v ∈ p.support := by
    intro v hv
    by_contra hvp
    exact hexternal ⟨v, hv, hvp⟩
  have hnotodd : ¬∀ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C → Odd (G.degree v) := by
    intro hodd
    exact hexternal (M.vertexMinimal.rootDeleted_even_path_external_vertex_of_odd_degrees
      r C D hCD hodd p hp heven hinside)
  push Not at hnotodd
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvodd⟩ := hnotodd
  have hveven : Even (G.degree v) := Nat.not_odd_iff_even.mp hvodd
  have hmin := degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G M.vertexMinimal.isCounterexample.1 v
  have hhigh : 4 ≤ G.degree v := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hveven
    omega
  let := Fintype.ofFinite ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
  have hrootdeg := (M.vertexMinimal.rootDeleted_two_components_exact_balanced r C D hCD).2.2.2.2
  have hxdeg := M.neighbor_degree_eq_three_of_degree_ge_four (by omega : 4 ≤ G.degree r) hrx
  have hydeg := M.neighbor_degree_eq_three_of_degree_ge_four (by omega : 4 ≤ G.degree r) hry
  refine ⟨hcover, v, hv, ?_, ?_, hveven, hhigh⟩
  · intro h
    subst v
    omega
  · intro h
    subst v
    omega

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.exists_connector_iff_shortConnectorWitness
statement:
theorem exists_connector_iff_shortConnectorWitness
  (H : PentagramEarHull G) {i₀ j₀ : Fin 5} :
    (∃ K : Connector H i₀ j₀, True) ↔
      i₀ ≠ j₀ ∧ Nonempty (ShortConnectorWitness H i₀ j₀)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨K, -⟩
    exact ⟨K.distinct, ⟨shortConnectorWitness_of_connector H K⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨hij, ⟨h⟩⟩
    exact ⟨connector_of_shortConnectorWitness H hij h, trivial⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.onePort_side_card_bound
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.onePort_side_card_bound
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D : Finset V) (r : V)
    (hD : D.Nonempty) (hr : r ∉ D)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ u, u ∈ D → ∀ v, v ∉ D → G.Adj u v → v = r) :
    Fintype.card V ≤ 2 * D.card + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hneighbor : ∃ z, z ∈ D ∧ G.Adj r z := by
    by_contra hnone
    have hclosed : ∀ u, u ∈ D → ∀ v, G.Adj u v → v ∈ D := by
      intro u hu v huv
      by_contra hv
      have hvr := hboundary u hu v hv huv
      exact hnone ⟨u, hu, by simpa only [hvr] using huv.symm⟩
    have hwalk : ∀ {a b : V}, G.Walk a b → a ∈ D → b ∈ D := by
      intro a b p
      induction p with
      | nil => exact fun ha => ha
      | cons hab p ih => exact fun ha => ih (hclosed _ ha _ hab)
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hD
    obtain ⟨p⟩ := M.isConnected.preconnected a r
    exact hr (hwalk p ha)
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hrz⟩ := hneighbor
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hrt, htz⟩ :=
    M.exists_second_onePort_neighbor D r z hr hz hrz hboundary
  let S : Finset V := insert r D
  let root : {v : V // v ∈ S} := ⟨r, Finset.mem_insert_self r D⟩
  have hclosed : ∀ u, u ∈ S → u ≠ root.val →
      ∀ v, G.Adj u v → v ∈ S := by
    intro u hu hur v huv
    have huD : u ∈ D := (Finset.mem_insert.mp hu).resolve_left hur
    by_cases hvD : v ∈ D
    · exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr hvD)
    · exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr
        (Or.inl (hboundary u huD v hvD huv))
  have hpair : ({z, t} : Finset V) ⊆ S.filter (G.Adj r) := by
    intro v hv
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
    rcases hv with hv | hv
    · subst v
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr hz), hrz⟩
    · subst v
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr ht), hrt⟩
  have hpaircard : ({z, t} : Finset V).card = 2 := by
    simp [htz.symm]
  have hroot : 2 ≤ internalDegree G S root.val := by
    have hle := Finset.card_le_card hpair
    simpa only [hpaircard, internalDegree] using hle
  have hScard : S.card = D.card + 1 := Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hr
  by_contra hbound
  have hsmall : 2 * S.card - 1 < Fintype.card V := by omega
  exact M.not_exists_strictly_smaller
    (strict_double_of_closed_side M.isCounterexample S root
      hclosed hroot hsmall)

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.two_onePort_sides_balanced
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.two_onePort_sides_balanced
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D E : Finset V) (r : V)
    (hD : D.Nonempty) (hE : E.Nonempty)
    (hrD : r ∉ D) (hrE : r ∉ E)
    (hdisj : Disjoint D E)
    (hboundaryD :
      ∀ u, u ∈ D → ∀ v, v ∉ D → G.Adj u v → v = r)
    (hboundaryE :
      ∀ u, u ∈ E → ∀ v, v ∉ E → G.Adj u v → v = r) :
    D.card = E.card ∧ insert r (D ∪ E) = Finset.univ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hDbound := M.onePort_side_card_bound D r hD hrD hboundaryD
  have hEbound := M.onePort_side_card_bound E r hE hrE hboundaryE
  have hrU : r ∉ D ∪ E := by
    simpa only [Finset.mem_union, not_or] using And.intro hrD hrE
  have hcard : (insert r (D ∪ E)).card = D.card + E.card + 1 := by
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hrU, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj]
  have hle : D.card + E.card + 1 ≤ Fintype.card V := by
    have h := Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_univ (insert r (D ∪ E)))
    simpa only [hcard, Finset.card_univ] using h
  have hDE : D.card = E.card := by omega
  have hN : Fintype.card V = D.card + E.card + 1 := by omega
  refine ⟨hDE, ?_⟩
  ext v
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, iff_true]
  by_contra hv
  have hle' :=
    Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_univ (insert v (insert r (D ∪ E))))
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hv, hcard, Finset.card_univ] at hle'
  omega

name: Erdos64.induced_minDegree_ge_three_of_high_degree_ports
statement:
theorem induced_minDegree_ge_three_of_high_degree_ports
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (K : Finset V) (r : V) (hK : K.Nonempty)
    (hboundary : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3)
    (hports : ∀ v, v ∈ K → G.Adj v r → 4 ≤ G.degree v) :
    (G.induce (↑K : Set V)).minDegree ≥ 3
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty (↑K : Set V) := by
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hK
    exact ⟨⟨v, hv⟩⟩
  apply SimpleGraph.le_minDegree_of_forall_le_degree
    (G := G.induce (↑K : Set V)) 3
  intro v
  rw [degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree G v]
  have hvK : v.1 ∈ K := v.2
  have hvdeg : 3 ≤ G.degree v.1 :=
    degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hmin v.1
  by_cases hvr : G.Adj v.1 r
  · by_cases hrK : r ∈ K
    · have hfilter : K.filter (G.Adj v.1) = G.neighborFinset v.1 := by
        ext w
        constructor
        · intro hw
          exact (G.mem_neighborFinset v.1 w).2
            (Finset.mem_filter.mp hw).2
        · intro hw
          have hAdj : G.Adj v.1 w := (G.mem_neighborFinset v.1 w).1 hw
          refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, hAdj⟩
          by_contra hwK
          have hwr : w = r := hboundary v.1 hvK w hwK hAdj
          exact hwK (hwr ▸ hrK)
      rw [internalDegree, hfilter]
      exact hvdeg
    · have hunion :
          K.filter (G.Adj v.1) ∪ ({r} : Finset V) = G.neighborFinset v.1 := by
        ext w
        constructor
        · intro hw
          rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hw with hw | hw
          · exact (G.mem_neighborFinset v.1 w).2
              (Finset.mem_filter.mp hw).2
          · have hwr : w = r := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hw
            exact (G.mem_neighborFinset v.1 w).2 (hwr ▸ hvr)
        · intro hw
          have hAdj : G.Adj v.1 w := (G.mem_neighborFinset v.1 w).1 hw
          by_cases hwK : w ∈ K
          · exact Finset.mem_union_left _
              (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hwK, hAdj⟩)
          · exact Finset.mem_union.mpr <| Or.inr <|
              Finset.mem_singleton.mpr (hboundary v.1 hvK w hwK hAdj)
      have hdisjoint :
          Disjoint (K.filter (G.Adj v.1)) ({r} : Finset V) := by
        apply Finset.disjoint_left.2
        intro w hwK hwr
        have hwmem : w ∈ K := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hwK).1
        exact hrK (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hwr ▸ hwmem)
      have hcard := congrArg Finset.card hunion
      rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisjoint,
        Finset.card_singleton, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
        at hcard
      have hcard' : internalDegree G K v.1 + 1 = G.degree v.1 := by
        simpa only [internalDegree] using hcard
      have hvdeg4 : 4 ≤ G.degree v.1 := hports v.1 hvK hvr
      rw [internalDegree]
      omega
  · have hfilter : K.filter (G.Adj v.1) = G.neighborFinset v.1 := by
      ext w
      constructor
      · intro hw
        exact (G.mem_neighborFinset v.1 w).2
          (Finset.mem_filter.mp hw).2
      · intro hw
        have hAdj : G.Adj v.1 w := (G.mem_neighborFinset v.1 w).1 hw
        refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, hAdj⟩
        by_contra hwK
        have hwr : w = r := hboundary v.1 hvK w hwK hAdj
        exact hvr (hwr ▸ hAdj)
    rw [internalDegree, hfilter]
    exact hvdeg

name: Erdos64.degree_induce_ne_vertex_add_indicator
statement:
theorem degree_induce_ne_vertex_add_indicator
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (x : V) (v : {v : V // v ≠ x}) :
    (G.induce {w : V | w ≠ x}).degree v +
      (if G.Adj v.1 x then 1 else 0) = G.degree v.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfin :
      ((G.induce {w : V | w ≠ x}).neighborFinset v).map
        (.subtype (fun w : V => w ≠ x)) = (G.neighborFinset v.1).erase x := by
    ext w
    simp [SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_eq_filter, and_comm]
  have hdeg : (G.induce {w : V | w ≠ x}).degree v =
      ((G.neighborFinset v.1).erase x).card := by
    rw [← hfin, Finset.card_map, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
  rw [hdeg, ← SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
  by_cases hadj : G.Adj v.1 x
  · simpa [hadj] using
      Finset.card_erase_add_one ((G.mem_neighborFinset v.1 x).2 hadj)
  · simp [hadj]

name: Erdos64.degreeTwoSuppressionGraph_degree
statement:
theorem degreeTwoSuppressionGraph_degree
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (x a b : V) (hax : a ≠ x) (hbx : b ≠ x)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hnadj : ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hneighbors : ∀ w, G.Adj x w ↔ w = a ∨ w = b)
    (v : {v : V // v ≠ x}) :
    (degreeTwoSuppressionGraph G x a b hax hbx).degree v = G.degree v.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hab' : (⟨a, hax⟩ : {v : V // v ≠ x}) ≠ ⟨b, hbx⟩ := by
    intro h
    exact hab (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  change ((G.induce {w : V | w ≠ x}) ⊔
    SimpleGraph.edge ⟨a, hax⟩ ⟨b, hbx⟩).degree v = G.degree v.1
  rw [degree_sup_edge_of_not_adj _ hab' hnadj]
  have hiff : (v = ⟨a, hax⟩ ∨ v = ⟨b, hbx⟩) ↔ G.Adj v.1 x := by
    rw [G.adj_comm, hneighbors]
    simp only [Subtype.ext_iff]
  simpa only [hiff] using degree_induce_ne_vertex_add_indicator G x v

name: Erdos64.card_ne_vertex_add_one
statement:
theorem card_ne_vertex_add_one
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (x : V) :
    Fintype.card {v : V // v ≠ x} + 1 = Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 1 ≤ Fintype.card V := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨x⟩
  simp only [Fintype.card_subtype_compl, Fintype.card_subtype_eq]
  omega

name: Erdos64.terminalQuotient_minDegree_ge_three_of_root_and_common
statement:
theorem terminalQuotient_minDegree_ge_three_of_root_and_common
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] {a b : V}
    (hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3)
    (hroot : 3 ≤ (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).degree none)
    (hcommon4 : ∀ z, z ≠ a → z ≠ b →
      (G.Adj a z ∧ G.Adj b z) → 4 ≤ G.degree z) :
    (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).minDegree ≥ 3
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : DecidableRel (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Adj :=
    quotient_decidableRel G a b
  let : Nonempty (QuotientVertex a b) := ⟨none⟩
  apply SimpleGraph.le_minDegree_of_forall_le_degree
    (terminalQuotientGraph G a b) 3
  intro q
  cases q with
  | none => exact hroot
  | some v =>
      let fFull : G.neighborSet v.1 →
          (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).neighborSet (some v) := fun x =>
        if hx : x.1 = a ∨ x.1 = b then
          ⟨none, by
            rcases hx with hxa | hxb
            · exact Or.inl (by simpa [hxa] using x.2)
            · exact Or.inr (by simpa [hxb] using x.2)⟩
        else
          ⟨some ⟨x.1, by
            exact ⟨fun h => hx (Or.inl h), fun h => hx (Or.inr h)⟩⟩,
            x.2⟩
      have hfFull : ∀ hnot : ¬ (G.Adj a v.1 ∧ G.Adj b v.1),
          Function.Injective fFull := by
        intro hnot x y hxy
        by_cases hx : x.1 = a ∨ x.1 = b
        · by_cases hy : y.1 = a ∨ y.1 = b
          · rcases hx with hxa | hxb <;> rcases hy with hya | hyb
            · apply Subtype.ext
              exact hxa.trans hya.symm
            · exfalso
              apply hnot
              have hax : G.Adj a v.1 := by
                simpa [hxa] using x.2.symm
              have hby : G.Adj b v.1 := by
                simpa [hyb] using y.2.symm
              exact ⟨hax, hby⟩
            · exfalso
              apply hnot
              have hay : G.Adj a v.1 := by
                simpa [hya] using y.2.symm
              have hbx : G.Adj b v.1 := by
                simpa [hxb] using x.2.symm
              exact ⟨hay, hbx⟩
            · apply Subtype.ext
              exact hxb.trans hyb.symm
          · have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
            simp [fFull, hx, hy] at hval
        · by_cases hy : y.1 = a ∨ y.1 = b
          · have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
            simp [fFull, hx, hy] at hval
          · have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
            simp [fFull, hx, hy] at hval
            apply Subtype.ext
            exact hval
      have hdeg : 3 ≤ G.degree v.1 :=
        degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hmin v.1
      have hcardN : Fintype.card (G.neighborSet v.1) = G.degree v.1 :=
        SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree G v.1
      by_cases hboth : G.Adj v.1 a ∧ G.Adj v.1 b
      · let S := {x : G.neighborSet v.1 // x.1 ≠ a}
        let f : S → (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).neighborSet (some v) :=
          fun x =>
            if hx : x.1.1 = a ∨ x.1.1 = b then
              ⟨none, by
                rcases hx with hxa | hxb
                · exact Or.inl (by simpa [hxa] using x.1.2)
                · exact Or.inr (by simpa [hxb] using x.1.2)⟩
            else
              ⟨some ⟨x.1.1, by
                exact ⟨fun h => hx (Or.inl h), fun h => hx (Or.inr h)⟩⟩,
                x.1.2⟩
        have hf : Function.Injective f := by
          intro x y hxy
          by_cases hx : x.1.1 = b
          · by_cases hy : y.1.1 = b
            · apply Subtype.ext
              apply Subtype.ext
              exact hx.trans hy.symm
            · have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
              exfalso
              simp [f, hx, hy, y.2] at hval
          · by_cases hy : y.1.1 = b
            · have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
              exfalso
              simp [f, hx, hy, x.2] at hval
            · have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
              simp [f, hx, hy, x.2, y.2] at hval
              apply Subtype.ext
              apply Subtype.ext
              exact hval
        have hcardS : Fintype.card S ≤
            Fintype.card ((terminalQuotientGraph G a b).neighborSet (some v)) :=
          Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf
        rw [SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree] at hcardS
        have hcardS_eq : Fintype.card S =
            Fintype.card (G.neighborSet v.1) -
              Fintype.card {x : G.neighborSet v.1 // x.1 = a} := by
          simp [S, Fintype.card_subtype_compl]
        have hcardA : Fintype.card {x : G.neighborSet v.1 // x.1 = a} = 1 := by
          apply (Fintype.card_eq_one_iff.mpr)
          refine ⟨⟨⟨a, (G.mem_neighborSet v.1 a).mpr hboth.1⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
          intro x
          apply Subtype.ext
          apply Subtype.ext
          exact x.2
        rw [hcardS_eq, hcardA, hcardN] at hcardS
        have hhigh : 4 ≤ G.degree v.1 := by
          apply hcommon4 v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2
          exact ⟨hboth.1.symm, hboth.2.symm⟩
        omega
      · have hnot : ¬ (G.Adj a v.1 ∧ G.Adj b v.1) := by
          intro h
          exact hboth ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.symm⟩
        have hcardFull : Fintype.card (G.neighborSet v.1) ≤
            Fintype.card ((terminalQuotientGraph G a b).neighborSet (some v)) :=
          Fintype.card_le_of_injective fFull (hfFull hnot)
        rw [SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree] at hcardFull
        have hqdeg :
            Fintype.card ((terminalQuotientGraph G a b).neighborSet (some v)) =
              (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).degree (some v) :=
          SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree _ _
        rw [hqdeg] at hcardFull
        exact hdeg.trans hcardFull

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.terminal_cross_path_of_root_and_common
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.terminal_cross_path_of_root_and_common
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    {a b : V} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hroot : 3 ≤ (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).degree none)
    (hcommon4 : ∀ z, z ≠ a → z ≠ b →
      (G.Adj a z ∧ G.Adj b z) → 4 ≤ G.degree z) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ x y : V, ∃ p : G.Walk x y,
      k ≥ 2 ∧
      p.IsPath ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ≠ a ∧ v ≠ b) ∧
      p.length + 2 = 2 ^ k ∧
      ((G.Adj a x ∧ G.Adj b y) ∨
        (G.Adj b x ∧ G.Adj a y))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : DecidableRel (terminalQuotientGraph G a b).Adj :=
    quotient_decidableRel G a b
  have hyes : HasPowerOfTwoCycle (terminalQuotientGraph G a b) := by
    by_contra hno
    exact M.not_exists_strictly_smaller
      ⟨⟨terminalQuotient_minDegree_ge_three_of_root_and_common
        M.isCounterexample.1 hroot hcommon4, hno⟩, terminalQuotient_card_lt hab⟩
  obtain ⟨k, z, c, hk, hc, hlen⟩ := hyes
  have hnone : none ∈ c.support := by
    by_contra hnone
    obtain ⟨u, d, hd, hdl⟩ :=
      quotient_cycle_lift_of_avoids_none hc hnone
    exact M.isCounterexample.2 ⟨k, u, d, hk, hd, hdl.trans hlen⟩
  obtain hbranch :=
    quotient_dyadic_cycle_through_none_lift_or_cross_path
      hc hnone hk hlen
  rcases hbranch with ⟨u, d, hd, hdl⟩ | hcross
  · exact (M.isCounterexample.2 ⟨k, u, d, hk, hd, hdl⟩).elim
  · rcases hcross with ⟨x, y, p, hp, hav, hlenp, hadj⟩
    exact ⟨k, x, y, p, hk, hp, hav, hlenp, hadj⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.shared_root_residual_path_of_quotient_root_degree
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.shared_root_residual_path_of_quotient_root_degree
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    {r x y : V}
    (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hqroot : 3 ≤ (terminalQuotientGraph G x y).degree none)
    (hroot_degree : 4 ≤ G.degree r) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ u v : V, ∃ p : G.Walk u v,
      k ≥ 2 ∧
      p.IsPath ∧
      (∀ w, w ∈ p.support → w ≠ x ∧ w ≠ y) ∧
      p.length + 2 = 2 ^ k ∧
      ((G.Adj x u ∧ G.Adj y v ∧ u ≠ r ∧ v ≠ r) ∨
        (G.Adj y u ∧ G.Adj x v ∧ u ≠ r ∧ v ≠ r))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcommon4 : ∀ z, z ≠ x → z ≠ y →
      (G.Adj x z ∧ G.Adj y z) → 4 ≤ G.degree z := by
    intro z hzx hzy hz
    have hzroot := M.common_neighbor_eq_root_of_nonadjacent_ports
      hrx hry hxy hz.1 hz.2 hzx hzy
    subst z
    exact hroot_degree
  obtain ⟨k, u, v, p, hk, hp, havoid, hlen, hadj⟩ :=
    M.terminal_cross_path_of_root_and_common
      hxy hqroot hcommon4
  have hne : u ≠ v := by
    intro huv
    have hget : p.getVert 0 = p.getVert p.length := by
      simp [huv]
    have hidx := hp.getVert_injOn
      (x₁ := 0) (x₂ := p.length)
      (show 0 ≤ p.length by exact Nat.zero_le _)
      (show p.length ≤ p.length by exact le_rfl) hget
    have hpow : 4 ≤ 2 ^ k := four_le_pow_two hk
    omega
  have hlong : 1 < p.length := by
    have hpow : 4 ≤ 2 ^ k := four_le_pow_two hk
    omega
  rcases hadj with ⟨hxu, hyv⟩ | ⟨hyu, hxv⟩
  · by_cases hur : u = r
    · exfalso
      subst u
      have hyavoid : y ∉ p.support := by
        intro hy
        exact (havoid y hy).2 rfl
      have hcycle : HasPowerOfTwoCycle G := by
        obtain ⟨c, hc, hclen⟩ := endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate
          hp hry.symm hyv hyavoid hne hlong
        refine ⟨k, r, c, hk, hc, ?_⟩
        exact hclen.trans hlen
      exact M.isCounterexample.2 hcycle
    · by_cases hvr : v = r
      · exfalso
        subst v
        have hxavoid : x ∉ p.support := by
          intro hx
          exact (havoid x hx).1 rfl
        have hcycle : HasPowerOfTwoCycle G := by
          obtain ⟨c, hc, hclen⟩ := endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate
            hp hxu hrx.symm hxavoid hne hlong
          refine ⟨k, u, c, hk, hc, ?_⟩
          exact hclen.trans hlen
        exact M.isCounterexample.2 hcycle
      · exact ⟨k, u, v, p, hk, hp, havoid, hlen,
          Or.inl ⟨hxu, hyv, hur, hvr⟩⟩
  · by_cases hvr : v = r
    · exfalso
      subst v
      have hyavoid : y ∉ p.support := by
        intro hy
        exact (havoid y hy).2 rfl
      have hcycle : HasPowerOfTwoCycle G := by
        obtain ⟨c, hc, hclen⟩ := endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate
          hp hyu hry.symm hyavoid hne hlong
        refine ⟨k, u, c, hk, hc, ?_⟩
        exact hclen.trans hlen
      exact M.isCounterexample.2 hcycle
    · by_cases hur : u = r
      · exfalso
        subst u
        have hxavoid : x ∉ p.support := by
          intro hx
          exact (havoid x hx).1 rfl
        have hcycle : HasPowerOfTwoCycle G := by
          obtain ⟨c, hc, hclen⟩ := endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate
            hp hrx.symm hxv hxavoid hne hlong
          refine ⟨k, r, c, hk, hc, ?_⟩
          exact hclen.trans hlen
        exact M.isCounterexample.2 hcycle
      · exact ⟨k, u, v, p, hk, hp, havoid, hlen,
          Or.inr ⟨hyu, hxv, hur, hvr⟩⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_port_side_dyadic_path_of_quotient_root_degree
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_port_side_dyadic_path_of_quotient_root_degree
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D) (hx : x ∈ D) (hy : y ∈ D)
    (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hqroot : 3 ≤ (terminalQuotientGraph G x y).degree none)
    (hroot_degree : 4 ≤ G.degree r)
    (hboundary : ∀ a, a ∈ D → ∀ b, b ∉ D → G.Adj a b → b = r)
    (hports : ∀ a, a ∈ D → G.Adj a r → a = x ∨ a = y) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ q : G.Walk x y,
      2 ≤ k ∧ q.IsPath ∧ q.length = 2 ^ k ∧
      (∀ a, a ∈ q.support → a ∈ D) ∧ r ∉ q.support
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, u, v, p, hk, hp, havoid, hlen, hadj⟩ :=
    M.shared_root_residual_path_of_quotient_root_degree hrx hry hxy hqroot hroot_degree
  have hur : u ≠ r := hadj.elim (fun h => h.2.2.1) (fun h => h.2.2.1)
  have hvr : v ≠ r := hadj.elim (fun h => h.2.2.2) (fun h => h.2.2.2)
  have hattach : (G.Adj x u ∧ G.Adj y v) ∨ (G.Adj y u ∧ G.Adj x v) :=
    hadj.imp (fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩) (fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩)
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hroot⟩ := cross_residual_in_exact_two_port_side
    hr hx hy hboundary hports hur hvr havoid hattach
  have hpath := cross_residual_path_to_dyadic_port_path
    hrx hry hxy hp havoid hroot hlen hattach
  have hnormalized : ∃ q : G.Walk x y,
      q.IsPath ∧ r ∉ q.support ∧ q.length = 2 ^ k := by
    rcases hpath with hforward | ⟨q, hq, hqr, hqlen⟩
    · exact hforward
    · exact ⟨q.reverse, hq.reverse, by simpa using hqr, by simpa using hqlen⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqr, hqlen⟩ := hnormalized
  exact ⟨k, q, hk, hq, hqlen,
    SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.support_subset_of_boundary_avoiding_root
      hq hx hqr hboundary, hqr⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.exact_adjacent_two_port_side_dyadic_path
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.exact_adjacent_two_port_side_dyadic_path
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D) (hx : x ∈ D) (hy : y ∈ D)
    (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (hadj : G.Adj x y)
    (hroot_degree : 4 ≤ G.degree r)
    (hboundary : ∀ a, a ∈ D → ∀ b, b ∉ D → G.Adj a b → b = r)
    (hports : ∀ a, a ∈ D → G.Adj a r → a = x ∨ a = y) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ q : G.Walk x y,
      2 ≤ k ∧ q.IsPath ∧ q.length = 2 ^ k ∧
      (∀ a, a ∈ q.support → a ∈ D) ∧ r ∉ q.support
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hexact : ∀ a, a ∈ D → (G.Adj a r ↔ a = x ∨ a = y) := by
    intro a ha
    refine ⟨hports a ha, ?_⟩
    rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact hrx.symm
    · exact hry.symm
  obtain ⟨z, w, _, _, hzr, hzx, hzy, hxz, hwr, hwx, hwy, hyw⟩ :=
    adjacent_exact_two_ports_have_internal_third_neighbors D r x y
      hr ⟨hx, hy, hxy⟩ hboundary hexact M.isCounterexample.1 hadj
  have hzw : z ≠ w := by
    intro hzw
    have hzy' : G.Adj y z := hzw ▸ hyw
    exact hzr (M.common_neighbor_eq_root_of_nonadjacent_ports
      hrx hry hxy hxz hzy' hzx hzy)
  let rr : Internal x y := ⟨r, hrx.ne, hry.ne⟩
  let zz : Internal x y := ⟨z, hzx, hzy⟩
  let ww : Internal x y := ⟨w, hwx, hwy⟩
  have hthree : ({some rr, some zz, some ww} : Finset (QuotientVertex x y)).card = 3 := by
    simp [rr, zz, ww, hzr.symm, hwr.symm, hzw]
  have hsub : ({some rr, some zz, some ww} : Finset (QuotientVertex x y)) ⊆
      (terminalQuotientGraph G x y).neighborFinset none := by
    intro v hv
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
    rcases hv with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact (SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset _ _ _).mpr (Or.inl hrx.symm)
    · exact (SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset _ _ _).mpr (Or.inl hxz)
    · exact (SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset _ _ _).mpr (Or.inr hyw)
  have hqroot := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  rw [hthree, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] at hqroot
  exact M.exact_two_port_side_dyadic_path_of_quotient_root_degree
    D r x y hr hx hy hrx hry hxy hqroot hroot_degree hboundary hports

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_port_side_dyadic_path_unrestricted
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_port_side_dyadic_path_unrestricted
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D) (hx : x ∈ D) (hy : y ∈ D)
    (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hroot_degree : 4 ≤ G.degree r)
    (hboundary : ∀ a, a ∈ D → ∀ b, b ∉ D → G.Adj a b → b = r)
    (hports : ∀ a, a ∈ D → G.Adj a r → a = x ∨ a = y) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ q : G.Walk x y,
      2 ≤ k ∧ q.IsPath ∧ q.length = 2 ^ k ∧
      (∀ a, a ∈ q.support → a ∈ D) ∧ r ∉ q.support
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hadj : G.Adj x y
  · exact M.exact_adjacent_two_port_side_dyadic_path
      D r x y hr hx hy hrx hry hxy hadj hroot_degree hboundary hports
  · exact M.exact_two_port_side_dyadic_path
      D r x y hr hx hy hrx hry hxy hadj hroot_degree hboundary hports

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_port_side_not_isBipartite_unrestricted
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_port_side_not_isBipartite_unrestricted
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D) (hx : x ∈ D) (hy : y ∈ D)
    (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hroot_degree : 4 ≤ G.degree r)
    (hboundary : ∀ a, a ∈ D → ∀ b, b ∉ D → G.Adj a b → b = r)
    (hports : ∀ a, a ∈ D → G.Adj a r → a = x ∨ a = y) :
    ¬ (G.induce (↑D : Set V)).IsBipartite
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hadj : G.Adj x y
  · obtain ⟨k, q, hk, _, hlen, hinside, _⟩ :=
      M.exact_adjacent_two_port_side_dyadic_path
        D r x y hr hx hy hrx hry hxy hadj hroot_degree hboundary hports
    let q' := q.induce (↑D : Set V) hinside
    have hq'len : q'.length = q.length := by
      have h := congrArg (fun w : G.Walk x y => w.length) (q.map_induce hinside)
      exact (SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map
        (SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce (↑D : Set V)).toHom q').symm.trans h
    have hedge : (G.induce (↑D : Set V)).Adj ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ := hadj
    have heven : Even q'.length := by
      rw [hq'len, hlen]
      exact (show Even (2 : ℕ) by decide).pow_of_ne_zero (by omega)
    exact not_isBipartite_of_opposite_parity_routes hedge.toWalk q'
      (by simp) heven
  · exact M.exact_two_port_side_not_isBipartite
      D r x y hr hx hy hrx hry hxy hadj hroot_degree hboundary hports

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_side_not_isBipartite
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_side_not_isBipartite
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hCD : C ≠ D) :
    ¬ (G.induce (↑(rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) : Set V)).IsBipartite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
  obtain ⟨_, _, hcard, _, hdegree⟩ :=
    M.rootDeleted_two_components_exact_balanced r C D hCD
  obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hxy, hrx, hry, hports⟩ :=
    rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_attachment_exact r C hcard
  have hboundary : ∀ a, a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      ∀ b, b ∉ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C → G.Adj a b → b = r := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    rcases (rootDeletedComponent_boundary r M.isConnected C).1 a ha b hab with
      hbC | hbr
    · exact (hb hbC).elim
    · exact hbr
  exact M.exact_two_port_side_not_isBipartite_unrestricted
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) r x y
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C).2
    hx hy hrx hry hxy (by omega) hboundary hports

name: Erdos64.mem_externalComponent_of_mem_support
statement:
theorem mem_externalComponent_of_mem_support
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {s : V} {C : G.Walk s s}
    {x a b : V} (hx : x ∉ C.support)
    (ha : a ∈ externalComponent G C x hx)
    (p : G.Walk a b)
    (hp : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∉ C.support)
    {z : V} (hz : z ∈ p.support) :
    z ∈ externalComponent G C x hx
proof:
:= by
  have aux :
      ∀ {a b : V} (p : G.Walk a b),
        a ∈ externalComponent G C x hx →
        (∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∉ C.support) →
        ∀ {z}, z ∈ p.support → z ∈ externalComponent G C x hx := by
    intro a b p
    induction p with
    | nil =>
        intro ha hp z hz
        rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil] at hz
        have hzu : z = _ := List.mem_singleton.mp hz
        rw [hzu]
        exact ha
    | @cons a b c hab q ih =>
        intro ha hp z hz
        have hbmem : b ∈ (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hab q).support := by
          rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons]
          exact List.mem_of_mem_tail q.start_mem_support
        have hb : b ∈ externalComponent G C x hx := by
          rcases externalComponent_adj_closure hx ha hab with hbc | hbK
          · exact (hp b hbmem hbc).elim
          · exact hbK
        rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons] at hz
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hz with hza | hzq
        · simpa [hza] using ha
        · apply ih hb
          intro v hv
          exact hp v (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hv)
          exact hzq
  exact aux p ha hp hz

name: Erdos64.externalComponent_exists_walk
statement:
theorem externalComponent_exists_walk
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {s : V} {C : G.Walk s s}
    {x a b : V} (hx : x ∉ C.support)
    (ha : a ∈ externalComponent G C x hx)
    (hb : b ∈ externalComponent G C x hx) :
    ∃ p : G.Walk a b, ∀ v, v ∈ p.support →
      v ∈ externalComponent G C x hx
proof:
:= by
  rcases (ExternalReachable.symm ha.2).trans hb.2 with ⟨p, hp⟩
  refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  exact mem_externalComponent_of_mem_support hx ha p hp hv

name: Erdos64.externalComponent_connected
statement:
theorem externalComponent_connected
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {s : V} {C : G.Walk s s}
    {x : V} (hx : x ∉ C.support) :
    (G.induce (externalComponent G C x hx)).Connected
proof:
:= by
  letI : Nonempty (externalComponent G C x hx) :=
    ⟨⟨x, mem_externalComponent_self hx⟩⟩
  refine { preconnected := ?_ }
  intro u v
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := externalComponent_exists_walk hx u.property v.property
  exact ⟨p.induce (externalComponent G C x hx) hp⟩

name: Erdos64.cycle_path_of_mem_edge
statement:
theorem cycle_path_of_mem_edge
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b z : V}
    {c : G.Walk z z} (hc : c.IsCycle)
    (he : s(a, b) ∈ c.edges) :
    ∃ p : G.Walk a b, p.IsPath ∧ s(a, b) ∉ p.edges ∧
      p.length + 1 = c.length
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hab : a ≠ b := (c.adj_of_mem_edges he).ne
  have ha : a ∈ c.support := c.fst_mem_support_of_mem_edges he
  let d := c.rotate a ha
  have hd : d.IsCycle := hc.rotate ha
  have hde : s(a, b) ∈ d.edges :=
    (c.rotate_edges a ha).perm.mem_iff.mpr he
  have hdlen : d.length = c.length := c.length_rotate a ha
  cases hddef : d with
  | nil => simp [hddef] at hd
  | @cons _ t _ hat q =>
      have hd' : (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hat q).IsCycle := by
        simpa [hddef] using hd
      have hq := (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isCycle_iff q hat |>.mp hd').1
      have hedge := (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isCycle_iff q hat |>.mp hd').2
      have hedges : s(a, b) = s(a, t) ∨ s(a, b) ∈ q.edges := by
        simpa only [hddef, SimpleGraph.Walk.edges_cons, List.mem_cons] using hde
      rcases hedges with hfront | hlast
      · have htb : t = b := by
          rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp hfront with h | h
          · exact h.2.symm
          · exact (hab h.2.symm).elim
        subst t
        refine ⟨q.reverse, hq.reverse, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa [Sym2.eq_swap] using hedge
        · simpa [hddef] using hdlen
      · have hbpen : b = q.penultimate := hq.eq_penultimate_of_mem_edges hlast
        have hqnil : ¬q.Nil := SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_of_isCycle_cons hd'
        have hdpen : d.penultimate = b := by
          rw [hddef, SimpleGraph.Walk.penultimate_cons_of_not_nil hat q hqnil]
          exact hbpen.symm
        let p := d.dropLast.copy rfl hdpen
        have hp : p.IsPath := by
          simpa [p] using hd.isPath_dropLast
        have hparts : d.dropLast.edges ++ [s(d.penultimate, a)] = d.edges := by
          have heq := congrArg SimpleGraph.Walk.edges
            (SimpleGraph.Walk.concat_dropLast (p := d) (d.adj_penultimate hd.not_nil))
          simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.edges_concat, List.concat_eq_append] using heq
        have hnot : s(a, b) ∉ d.dropLast.edges := by
          have hnodup := hd.isTrail.edges_nodup
          rw [← hparts] at hnodup
          intro hmem
          have hdisj := (List.nodup_append.mp hnodup).2.2
          exact hdisj _ hmem _ (by simp [hdpen, Sym2.eq_swap]) rfl
        refine ⟨p, hp, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa [p] using hnot
        · simpa [p, hdlen] using d.length_dropLast_add_one hd.not_nil

name: Erdos64.added_edge_dyadic_cycle_path
statement:
theorem added_edge_dyadic_cycle_path
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b : V}
    (hno : ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle G)
    (hyes : HasPowerOfTwoCycle (G ⊔ SimpleGraph.edge a b)) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ p : G.Walk a b,
      2 ≤ k ∧ p.IsPath ∧ p.length + 1 = 2 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have htransfer : ∀ {u v : V}
      (p : (G ⊔ SimpleGraph.edge a b).Walk u v),
      s(a, b) ∉ p.edges → ∀ e, e ∈ p.edges → e ∈ G.edgeSet := by
    intro u v p hav e he
    have heG := p.edges_subset_edgeSet he
    rw [SimpleGraph.edgeSet_sup] at heG
    rcases heG with heG | headd
    · exact heG
    · have heeq : e = s(a, b) := SimpleGraph.edgeSet_edge_subset headd
      exact (hav (heeq ▸ he)).elim
  obtain ⟨k, z, c, hk, hc, hlen⟩ := hyes
  have he : s(a, b) ∈ c.edges := by
    by_contra he
    let q := c.transfer G (htransfer c he)
    apply hno
    refine ⟨k, z, q, hk, hc.transfer _, ?_⟩
    simpa [q] using hlen
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpavoid, hplen⟩ := cycle_path_of_mem_edge hc he
  let q := p.transfer G (htransfer p hpavoid)
  refine ⟨k, q, hk, hp.transfer _, ?_⟩
  simpa [q, ← hlen] using hplen

name: Erdos64.mem_carrierBoundaryVertices
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_carrierBoundaryVertices
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (D : Finset V)
    (v : {v : V // v ∈ D}) :
    v ∈ carrierBoundaryVertices G D ↔ ∃ w, w ∉ D ∧ G.Adj v.1 w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [carrierBoundaryVertices]

name: Erdos64.carrier_degree_add_boundary_indicator
statement:
theorem carrier_degree_add_boundary_indicator
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (D : Finset V)
    (hsingle : ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ a, a ∉ D → ∀ b, b ∉ D →
      G.Adj v a → G.Adj v b → a = b)
    (v : {v : V // v ∈ D}) :
    (G.induce (↑D : Set V)).degree v +
      (if v ∈ carrierBoundaryVertices G D then 1 else 0) = G.degree v.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let O := (G.neighborFinset v.1).filter (fun w => w ∉ D)
  have hinside : (G.neighborFinset v.1).filter (fun w => w ∈ D) =
      D.filter (G.Adj v.1) := by
    ext w
    simp [and_comm]
  have houtside : O.card = if v ∈ carrierBoundaryVertices G D then 1 else 0 := by
    by_cases hv : v ∈ carrierBoundaryVertices G D
    · obtain ⟨a, ha, hva⟩ := (mem_carrierBoundaryVertices G D v).mp hv
      have hO : O = {a} := by
        ext b
        simp only [O, Finset.mem_filter, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset,
          Finset.mem_singleton]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hvb, hb⟩
          exact hsingle v.1 v.2 b hb a ha hvb hva
        · rintro rfl
          exact ⟨hva, ha⟩
      simp [hv, hO]
    · have hO : O = ∅ := by
        apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
        intro a ha
        obtain ⟨hva, ha⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
        exact hv ((mem_carrierBoundaryVertices G D v).mpr
          ⟨a, ha, (G.mem_neighborFinset v.1 a).mp hva⟩)
      simp [hv, hO]
  have hsplit := (G.neighborFinset v.1).card_filter_add_card_filter_not
    (fun w => w ∈ D)
  rw [hinside, show ((G.neighborFinset v.1).filter (fun w => ¬w ∈ D)).card =
      O.card from rfl, houtside] at hsplit
  simpa only [degree_induce_coeFinset_eq_internalDegree, internalDegree,
    SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] using hsplit

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.small_carrier_boundary_card_ge_two
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.small_carrier_boundary_card_ge_two
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (D : Finset V) (hD : D.Nonempty)
    (hsingle : ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ a, a ∉ D → ∀ b, b ∉ D →
      G.Adj v a → G.Adj v b → a = b)
    (hsize : 2 * D.card + 1 < Fintype.card V) :
    2 ≤ (carrierBoundaryVertices G D).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B := carrierBoundaryVertices G D
  let H := G.induce (↑D : Set V)
  by_contra hsmall
  have hBcard : B.card ≤ 1 := by
    change (carrierBoundaryVertices G D).card ≤ 1
    omega
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y : {v : V // v ∈ D}, ∀ v, v ∈ B → v = y := by
    by_cases hB : B.Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hB
      exact ⟨y, fun v hv => (Finset.card_le_one.mp hBcard) v hv y hy⟩
    · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hD
      refine ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ?_⟩
      intro v hv
      exact (hB ⟨v, hv⟩).elim
  have hdeg : ∀ v : {v : V // v ∈ D},
      H.degree v + (if v ∈ B then 1 else 0) = G.degree v.1 :=
    carrier_degree_add_boundary_indicator D hsingle
  have hydeg : 2 ≤ H.degree y := by
    have h := hdeg y
    have hmin := degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G M.isCounterexample.1 y.1
    split_ifs at h <;> omega
  have hother : ∀ v, v ≠ y → 3 ≤ H.degree v := by
    intro v hv
    have hvB : v ∉ B := fun h => hv (hy v h)
    have h := hdeg v
    have hmin := degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G M.isCounterexample.1 v.1
    simp only [hvB, ↓reduceIte, Nat.add_zero] at h
    omega
  have horder : 2 * Fintype.card {v : V // v ∈ D} - 1 < Fintype.card V := by
    simpa using (show 2 * D.card - 1 < Fintype.card V by omega)
  have hyes := M.one_defect_small_has_dyadic_cycle y hydeg hother horder
  exact (not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle_induce_of_not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle
    M.isCounterexample.2) hyes

name: Erdos64.rootedDoubleCopyEmbedding_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rootedDoubleCopyEmbedding_apply
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {r : V} (b : Bool)
    (v : {v : V // v ≠ r}) :
    rootedDoubleCopyEmbedding (G := G) b v = some (b, v)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Erdos64.rootedDouble_card
statement:
theorem rootedDouble_card
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {r : V} :
    Fintype.card (RootedDoubleVertex V r) = 2 * Fintype.card V - 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcard : 1 ≤ Fintype.card V := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨r⟩
  simp [RootedDoubleVertex, Fintype.card_subtype_compl]
  omega

name: Erdos64.rootedDouble_projection_length
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: Erdos64.rootedDouble_projection_cycle_of_injective

name: Erdos64.rootedDouble_projection_path_of_support_injective
statement:
theorem rootedDouble_projection_path_of_support_injective
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {r : V}

    (p : (rootedDoubleGraph G r).Walk x y)
    (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn rootedDoubleProjection {v | v ∈ p.support}) :
    (p.map rootedDoubleProjectionHom).IsPath
proof:
:= by
  rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.isPath_def]
  rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map]
