name: Erdos64.rootedDouble_nonroot_degree_preservation_of_neighborEquiv
statement:
theorem rootedDouble_nonroot_degree_preservation_of_neighborEquiv
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} [Fintype V]
    [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj] {r : V}
    (b : Bool) (v : {v : V // v ≠ r})
    (e : (rootedDoubleGraph G r).neighborSet (some (b, v)) ≃
      G.neighborSet v.1) :
    (rootedDoubleGraph G r).degree (some (b, v)) = G.degree v.1
proof:
:=
  by
    rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree,
      ← SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree]
    exact Fintype.card_congr e

name: Erdos64.rootedDouble_root_degree_doubling_of_neighborEquiv
statement:
theorem rootedDouble_root_degree_doubling_of_neighborEquiv
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} [Fintype V]
    [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj] {r : V}
    (e : (rootedDoubleGraph G r).neighborSet none ≃
      Bool × G.neighborSet r) :
    (rootedDoubleGraph G r).degree none = 2 * G.degree r
proof:
:=
  by
    rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree,
      ← SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree, Fintype.card_congr e,
      Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_bool]

name: Erdos64.exact_two_rootDeletedComponents_two_ports
statement:
theorem exact_two_rootDeletedComponents_two_ports
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] (r : V)
    (hdegree : G.degree r = 4)
    (hports : ∀ C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent,
      2 ≤ (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card)
    (hcomponents : ∃ C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent,
      C ≠ D) :
    ∃ C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent,
      C ≠ D ∧
      (∀ E : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent,
        E = C ∨ E = D) ∧
      (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card = 2 ∧
      (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D).card = 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype ((G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) :=
    Fintype.ofFinite _
  obtain ⟨C, D, hCD⟩ := hcomponents
  have hC2 := hports C
  have hD2 := hports D
  have hdisjCD :
      Disjoint (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C)
        (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D) :=
    (rootDeletedComponentAttachments_pairwise_disjoint r) hCD
  have hsubCD :
      rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C ∪
          rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D ⊆ G.neighborFinset r := by
    intro x hx
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hx with hx | hx
    · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).1
    · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).1
  have hCDle :
      (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card +
          (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D).card ≤ 4 := by
    have hunion := Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisjCD
    have hle := Finset.card_le_card hsubCD
    rw [hunion] at hle
    simpa [SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] using hle.trans_eq hdegree
  have hCeq : (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card = 2 := by
    omega
  have hDeq : (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D).card = 2 := by
    omega
  have honly : ∀ E : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent,
      E = C ∨ E = D := by
    intro E
    by_contra hnot
    have hEC : E ≠ C := by
      intro h
      exact hnot (Or.inl h)
    have hED : E ≠ D := by
      intro h
      exact hnot (Or.inr h)
    have hdisjCE :
        Disjoint (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C)
          (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r E) :=
      (rootDeletedComponentAttachments_pairwise_disjoint r) hEC.symm
    have hdisjDE :
        Disjoint (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D)
          (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r E) :=
      (rootDeletedComponentAttachments_pairwise_disjoint r) hED.symm
    have hdisj_union :
        Disjoint
          (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C ∪
            rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D)
          (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r E) := by
      apply Finset.disjoint_left.2
      intro x hxCD hxE
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hxCD with hxC | hxD
      · exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisjCE) hxC hxE
      · exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisjDE) hxD hxE
    have hsub :
        rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C ∪
            rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r D ∪
            rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r E ⊆ G.neighborFinset r := by
      intro x hx
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hx with hxCD | hxE
      · exact hsubCD hxCD
      · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hxE).1
    have hle := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj_union,
      Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisjCD] at hle
    have hE2 := hports E
    have hdegree' : (G.neighborFinset r).card = 4 := by
      simpa [SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] using hdegree
    rw [hdegree'] at hle
    omega
  exact ⟨C, D, hCD, honly, hCeq, hDeq⟩

name: Erdos64.internal_path_vertex_two_neighbors
statement:
theorem internal_path_vertex_two_neighbors
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {x y s : V}
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath) (hs : s ∈ p.support)
    (hsx : s ≠ x) (hsy : s ≠ y) :
    ∃ a b, a ≠ b ∧ G.Adj s a ∧ G.Adj s b ∧ a ∈ p.support ∧ b ∈ p.support
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hile⟩ := SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_iff_exists_getVert.mp hs
  have hi0 : i ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hsx (by simpa [h] using hi.symm)
  have hin : i ≠ p.length := by
    intro h
    exact hsy (by simpa [h] using hi.symm)
  have hipos : 0 < i := by omega
  have hilt : i < p.length := by omega
  refine ⟨p.getVert (i - 1), p.getVert (i + 1), ?_, ?_, ?_,
    p.getVert_mem_support _, p.getVert_mem_support _⟩
  · intro h
    have heq := hp.getVert_injOn (by change i - 1 ≤ p.length; omega)
      (by change i + 1 ≤ p.length; omega) h
    omega
  · have hadj := p.adj_getVert_succ (i := i - 1) (by omega)
    rw [show i - 1 + 1 = i by omega, hi] at hadj
    exact hadj.symm
  · simpa only [hi] using p.adj_getVert_succ hilt

name: Erdos64.port_path_vertex_two_retained_neighbors
statement:
theorem port_path_vertex_two_retained_neighbors
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {r x y s : V}
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hrp : r ∉ p.support) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (hs : s ∈ p.support) :
    ∃ a b, a ≠ b ∧ G.Adj s a ∧ G.Adj s b ∧
      (a = r ∨ a ∈ p.support) ∧ (b = r ∨ b ∈ p.support)
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : 0 < p.length := by
    by_contra h
    exact hxy (SimpleGraph.Walk.eq_of_length_eq_zero (by omega : p.length = 0))
  by_cases hsx : s = x
  · subst s
    refine ⟨r, p.getVert 1, ?_, hrx.symm, ?_, Or.inl rfl,
      Or.inr (p.getVert_mem_support 1)⟩
    · intro h
      exact hrp (h.symm ▸ p.getVert_mem_support 1)
    · simpa using p.adj_getVert_succ (i := 0) hlen
  by_cases hsy : s = y
  · subst s
    have hmem : p.reverse.getVert 1 ∈ p.support := by
      simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_reverse, List.mem_reverse] using
        p.reverse.getVert_mem_support 1
    refine ⟨r, p.reverse.getVert 1, ?_, hry.symm, ?_, Or.inl rfl, Or.inr hmem⟩
    · intro h
      exact hrp (h.symm ▸ hmem)
    · simpa using p.reverse.adj_getVert_succ (i := 0) (by simpa using hlen)
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hsa, hsb, ha, hb⟩ :=
    internal_path_vertex_two_neighbors p hp hs hsx hsy
  exact ⟨a, b, hab, hsa, hsb, Or.inr ha, Or.inr hb⟩

name: Erdos64.cubic_vertex_external_neighbors_eq
statement:
theorem cubic_vertex_external_neighbors_eq
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {s a b v w : V} (S : Set V) (hsdeg : G.degree s = 3)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hsa : G.Adj s a) (hsb : G.Adj s b)
    (ha : a ∈ S) (hb : b ∈ S)
    (hv : v ∉ S) (hw : w ∉ S) (hsv : G.Adj s v) (hsw : G.Adj s w) :
    v = w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hamem : a ∈ G.neighborFinset s := (G.mem_neighborFinset s a).mpr hsa
  have hbmem : b ∈ (G.neighborFinset s).erase a :=
    Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hab.symm, (G.mem_neighborFinset s b).mpr hsb⟩
  have hcard : (((G.neighborFinset s).erase a).erase b).card ≤ 1 := by
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hbmem, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hamem,
      SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hsdeg]
  have hvmem : v ∈ ((G.neighborFinset s).erase a).erase b := by
    apply Finset.mem_erase.mpr
    refine ⟨fun h => hv (h ▸ hb), ?_⟩
    exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨fun h => hv (h ▸ ha),
      (G.mem_neighborFinset s v).mpr hsv⟩
  have hwmem : w ∈ ((G.neighborFinset s).erase a).erase b := by
    apply Finset.mem_erase.mpr
    refine ⟨fun h => hw (h ▸ hb), ?_⟩
    exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨fun h => hw (h ▸ ha),
      (G.mem_neighborFinset s w).mpr hsw⟩
  exact (Finset.card_le_one.mp hcard) v hvmem w hwmem

name: Erdos64.cubic_port_path_external_neighbors_eq
statement:
theorem cubic_port_path_external_neighbors_eq
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {r x y : V} (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hrp : r ∉ p.support) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (s : V) (hs : s ∈ p.support) (hsdeg : G.degree s = 3)
    (v : V) (hvp : v ∉ p.support) (hvr : v ≠ r)
    (w : V) (hwp : w ∉ p.support) (hwr : w ≠ r)
    (hsv : G.Adj s v) (hsw : G.Adj s w) : v = w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hsa, hsb, ha, hb⟩ :=
    port_path_vertex_two_retained_neighbors p hp hxy hrp hrx hry hs
  exact cubic_vertex_external_neighbors_eq {z | z = r ∨ z ∈ p.support}
    hsdeg hab hsa hsb ha hb (fun h => h.elim hvr hvp) (fun h => h.elim hwr hwp)
    hsv hsw

name: Erdos64.cut_side_port_path_external_neighbors_eq
statement:
theorem cut_side_port_path_external_neighbors_eq
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (r : V) (C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hinside : ∀ z, z ∈ p.support → z ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (K : Finset V)
    (hK : ∀ z, z ∈ K → z ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧ z ∉ p.support)
    (s : V) (hs : s ∈ p.support) (hsdeg : G.degree s = 3)
    (v : V) (hv : v ∈ K) (w : V) (hw : w ∈ K)
    (hsv : G.Adj s v) (hsw : G.Adj s w) : v = w
proof:
:= by
  have hrC := (rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C).2
  have hrp : r ∉ p.support := fun h => hrC (hinside r h)
  have hvr : v ≠ r := by
    intro h
    subst v
    exact hrC (hK r hv).1
  have hwr : w ≠ r := by
    intro h
    subst w
    exact hrC (hK r hw).1
  exact cubic_port_path_external_neighbors_eq p hp hxy hrp hrx hry
    s hs hsdeg v (hK v hv).2 hvr w (hK w hw).2 hwr hsv hsw

name: Erdos64.terminal_path_reroute_isPath_of_fresh_ear
statement:
theorem terminal_path_reroute_isPath_of_fresh_ear
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b x y : V}
    (pre : G.Walk a x) (segment : G.Walk x y)
    (suffix : G.Walk y b) (ear : G.Walk x y)
    (horiginal : ((pre.append segment).append suffix).IsPath)
    (hear : ear.IsPath) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hfresh : ∀ z, z ∈ ear.support →
      z ∈ ((pre.append segment).append suffix).support → z = x ∨ z = y) :
    ((pre.append ear).append suffix).IsPath
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hlong : 1 < segment.length ∨ 1 < ear.length
  · exact (terminal_path_reroute_of_fresh_ear pre segment suffix ear
      horiginal hear hxy hfresh hlong).1
  · have heq : ear = segment :=
      SimpleGraph.Walk.eq_of_length_le_one (by omega) (by omega)
    simpa only [heq] using horiginal

name: Erdos64.terminal_path_reroute_of_two_disjoint_fresh_ears
statement:
theorem terminal_path_reroute_of_two_disjoint_fresh_ears
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : V}
    (pre : G.Walk a x₁) (segment₁ : G.Walk x₁ y₁)
    (middle : G.Walk y₁ x₂) (segment₂ : G.Walk x₂ y₂)
    (suffix : G.Walk y₂ b)
    (ear₁ : G.Walk x₁ y₁) (ear₂ : G.Walk x₂ y₂)
    (horiginal :
      ((((pre.append segment₁).append middle).append segment₂).append suffix).IsPath)
    (hear₁ : ear₁.IsPath) (hear₂ : ear₂.IsPath)
    (hxy₁ : x₁ ≠ y₁) (hxy₂ : x₂ ≠ y₂)
    (hfresh₁ : ∀ z, z ∈ ear₁.support →
      z ∈ ((((pre.append segment₁).append middle).append segment₂).append suffix).support →
      z = x₁ ∨ z = y₁)
    (hfresh₂ : ∀ z, z ∈ ear₂.support →
      z ∈ ((((pre.append segment₁).append middle).append segment₂).append suffix).support →
      z = x₂ ∨ z = y₂)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ z, z ∈ ear₁.support → z ∈ ear₂.support →
      z ∈ ((((pre.append segment₁).append middle).append segment₂).append suffix).support) :
    ((((pre.append ear₁).append middle).append ear₂).append suffix).IsPath ∧
      ((((pre.append ear₁).append middle).append ear₂).append suffix).length +
          (segment₁.length + segment₂.length) =
        ((((pre.append segment₁).append middle).append segment₂).append suffix).length +
          (ear₁.length + ear₂.length)
proof:
:= by
  have horiginal' :
      ((pre.append segment₁).append ((middle.append segment₂).append suffix)).IsPath := by
    simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.append_assoc] using horiginal
  have hfresh₁' : ∀ z, z ∈ ear₁.support →
      z ∈ ((pre.append segment₁).append ((middle.append segment₂).append suffix)).support →
      z = x₁ ∨ z = y₁ := by
    simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.append_assoc] using hfresh₁
  have hfirst :
      ((((pre.append ear₁).append middle).append segment₂).append suffix).IsPath := by
    simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.append_assoc] using
      terminal_path_reroute_isPath_of_fresh_ear pre segment₁
        ((middle.append segment₂).append suffix) ear₁ horiginal' hear₁ hxy₁ hfresh₁'
  have hfresh₂' : ∀ z, z ∈ ear₂.support →
      z ∈ ((((pre.append ear₁).append middle).append segment₂).append suffix).support →
      z = x₂ ∨ z = y₂ := by
    intro z hzear₂ hzfirst
    apply hfresh₂ z hzear₂
    simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_append_iff] at hzfirst ⊢
    rcases hzfirst with (((hzpre | hzear₁) | hzmiddle) | hzsegment₂) | hzsuffix
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl hzpre)))
    · have hz := hdisjoint z hzear₁ hzear₂
      simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_append_iff] using hz
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr hzmiddle))
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hzsegment₂)
    · exact Or.inr hzsuffix
  refine ⟨terminal_path_reroute_isPath_of_fresh_ear
    ((pre.append ear₁).append middle) segment₂ suffix ear₂
    hfirst hear₂ hxy₂ hfresh₂', ?_⟩
  simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_append]
  omega

name: Erdos64.terminal_path_equal_length_exchange_of_two_disjoint_fresh_ears
statement:
theorem terminal_path_equal_length_exchange_of_two_disjoint_fresh_ears
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : V}
    (pre : G.Walk a x₁) (segment₁ : G.Walk x₁ y₁)
    (middle : G.Walk y₁ x₂) (segment₂ : G.Walk x₂ y₂)
    (suffix : G.Walk y₂ b)
    (ear₁ : G.Walk x₁ y₁) (ear₂ : G.Walk x₂ y₂)
    (horiginal :
      ((((pre.append segment₁).append middle).append segment₂).append suffix).IsPath)
    (hear₁ : ear₁.IsPath) (hear₂ : ear₂.IsPath)
    (hxy₁ : x₁ ≠ y₁) (hxy₂ : x₂ ≠ y₂)
    (hfresh₁ : ∀ z, z ∈ ear₁.support →
      z ∈ ((((pre.append segment₁).append middle).append segment₂).append suffix).support →
      z = x₁ ∨ z = y₁)
    (hfresh₂ : ∀ z, z ∈ ear₂.support →
      z ∈ ((((pre.append segment₁).append middle).append segment₂).append suffix).support →
      z = x₂ ∨ z = y₂)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ z, z ∈ ear₁.support → z ∈ ear₂.support →
      z ∈ ((((pre.append segment₁).append middle).append segment₂).append suffix).support)
    (hbalance : ear₁.length + ear₂.length = segment₁.length + segment₂.length) :
    ((((pre.append ear₁).append middle).append ear₂).append suffix).IsPath ∧
      ((((pre.append ear₁).append middle).append ear₂).append suffix).length =
        ((((pre.append segment₁).append middle).append segment₂).append suffix).length
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpath, hlength⟩ := terminal_path_reroute_of_two_disjoint_fresh_ears
    pre segment₁ middle segment₂ suffix ear₁ ear₂ horiginal hear₁ hear₂
    hxy₁ hxy₂ hfresh₁ hfresh₂ hdisjoint
  exact ⟨hpath, by omega⟩

name: Erdos64.closed_sides_edge_count
statement:
theorem closed_sides_edge_count
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (A B : Finset V) (r : V)
    (hpartition : A ∪ B = Finset.univ)
    (hinter : A ∩ B = {r})
    (hclosedA : ∀ x, x ∈ A → x ≠ r → ∀ y, G.Adj x y → y ∈ A)
    (hclosedB : ∀ x, x ∈ B → x ≠ r → ∀ y, G.Adj x y → y ∈ B) :
    G.edgeFinset.card = (G.induce (↑A : Set V)).edgeFinset.card +
      (G.induce (↑B : Set V)).edgeFinset.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let EA := G.edgeFinset.filter (fun e => e.toFinset ⊆ A)
  let EB := G.edgeFinset.filter (fun e => e.toFinset ⊆ B)
  have hcover : ∀ v, v ∈ A ∨ v ∈ B := by
    intro v
    have hv : v ∈ A ∪ B := by rw [hpartition]; exact Finset.mem_univ v
    exact Finset.mem_union.mp hv
  have hroot : r ∈ A ∧ r ∈ B := by
    have hr : r ∈ A ∩ B := by rw [hinter]; simp
    exact Finset.mem_inter.mp hr
  have hunion : EA ∪ EB = G.edgeFinset := by
    ext e
    constructor
    · intro he
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp he with he | he
      · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp he).1
      · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp he).1
    · induction e using Sym2.inductionOn with
      | hf x y =>
        intro he
        have hxy : G.Adj x y := SimpleGraph.mem_edgeFinset.mp he
        have hside : (x ∈ A ∧ y ∈ A) ∨ (x ∈ B ∧ y ∈ B) := by
          by_cases hxr : x = r
          · subst x
            rcases hcover y with hy | hy
            · exact Or.inl ⟨hroot.1, hy⟩
            · exact Or.inr ⟨hroot.2, hy⟩
          · rcases hcover x with hx | hx
            · exact Or.inl ⟨hx, hclosedA x hx hxr y hxy⟩
            · exact Or.inr ⟨hx, hclosedB x hx hxr y hxy⟩
        simpa only [EA, EB, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter,
          Sym2.toFinset_mk_eq, Finset.insert_subset_iff,
          Finset.singleton_subset_iff, he, true_and] using hside
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint EA EB := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro e heA heB
    induction e using Sym2.inductionOn with
    | hf x y =>
      obtain ⟨he, hA⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp heA
      obtain ⟨_, hB⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp heB
      have hxy : G.Adj x y := SimpleGraph.mem_edgeFinset.mp he
      have hx : x ∈ A ∩ B := by
        exact Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hA (by simp), hB (by simp)⟩
      have hy : y ∈ A ∩ B := by
        exact Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hA (by simp), hB (by simp)⟩
      rw [hinter, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx hy
      exact hxy.ne (hx.trans hy.symm)
  calc
    G.edgeFinset.card = (EA ∪ EB).card := congrArg Finset.card hunion.symm
    _ = EA.card + EB.card := Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisjoint
    _ = _ := by
      rw [SimpleGraph.card_filter_edgeFinset_toFinset_subset,
        SimpleGraph.card_filter_edgeFinset_toFinset_subset]

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.boundary_root_erase_has_dyadic_cycle
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.boundary_root_erase_has_dyadic_cycle
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (K : Finset V)
    (hsingle : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ a, a ∉ K → ∀ b, b ∉ K →
      G.Adj v a → G.Adj v b → a = b)
    (hB : 4 ≤ (carrierBoundaryVertices G K).card)
    (hsize : 2 * K.card + 1 < Fintype.card V)
    (t : {v : V // v ∈ K}) :
    HasPowerOfTwoCycle (boundaryRootGraph (G.induce (↑K : Set V))
      ((carrierBoundaryVertices G K).erase t))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H := G.induce (↑K : Set V)
  let B := carrierBoundaryVertices G K
  let R := boundaryRootGraph H (B.erase t)
  have haccount := carrier_degree_add_boundary_indicator K hsingle
  have htdegree : 2 ≤ R.degree (some t) := by
    rw [boundaryRootGraph_degree_some]
    simp only [Finset.notMem_erase, ↓reduceIte, Nat.add_zero]
    change 2 ≤ (G.induce (↑K : Set V)).degree t
    have ht := haccount t
    have hmin := degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G M.isCounterexample.1 t.1
    split_ifs at ht <;> omega
  have hroot : 3 ≤ R.degree none := by
    rw [boundaryRootGraph_degree_none]
    have hB' : 4 ≤ B.card := hB
    by_cases ht : t ∈ B
    · rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem ht]
      omega
    · rw [Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem ht]
      omega
  have hother : ∀ v, v ≠ some t → 3 ≤ R.degree v := by
    intro v hv
    cases v with
    | none => exact hroot
    | some v =>
      have hvt : v ≠ t := fun h => hv (congrArg some h)
      rw [boundaryRootGraph_degree_some]
      change 3 ≤ (G.induce (↑K : Set V)).degree v +
        (if v ∈ (carrierBoundaryVertices G K).erase t then 1 else 0)
      have hmem : v ∈ (carrierBoundaryVertices G K).erase t ↔
          v ∈ carrierBoundaryVertices G K := by
        exact ⟨fun h => (Finset.mem_erase.mp h).2,
          fun h => Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hvt, h⟩⟩
      rw [if_congr hmem rfl rfl]
      rw [haccount]
      exact degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G M.isCounterexample.1 v.1
  have horder : 2 * Fintype.card (Option (↑K : Set V)) - 1 < Fintype.card V := by
    simpa using (show 2 * (K.card + 1) - 1 < Fintype.card V by omega)
  exact M.one_defect_small_has_dyadic_cycle (some t) htdegree hother horder

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.carrier_boundary_path_avoiding
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.carrier_boundary_path_avoiding
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (K : Finset V)
    (hsingle : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ a, a ∉ K → ∀ b, b ∉ K →
      G.Adj v a → G.Adj v b → a = b)
    (hB : 4 ≤ (carrierBoundaryVertices G K).card)
    (hsize : 2 * K.card + 1 < Fintype.card V)
    (t : {v : V // v ∈ K}) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : {v : V // v ∈ K},
      ∃ p : (G.induce (↑K : Set V)).Walk a b,
        2 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ carrierBoundaryVertices G K ∧
        b ∈ carrierBoundaryVertices G K ∧ a ≠ t ∧ b ≠ t ∧
        a ≠ b ∧ p.IsPath ∧ p.length + 2 = 2 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hno : ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle (G.induce (↑K : Set V)) :=
    not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle_induce_of_not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle M.isCounterexample.2
  have hyes := M.boundary_root_erase_has_dyadic_cycle K hsingle hB hsize t
  obtain ⟨k, a, b, p, hk, ha, hb, hab, hp, hlen⟩ :=
    boundaryRoot_dyadic_cycle_path ((carrierBoundaryVertices G K).erase t) hno hyes
  exact ⟨k, a, b, p, hk, (Finset.mem_erase.mp ha).2,
    (Finset.mem_erase.mp hb).2, (Finset.mem_erase.mp ha).1,
    (Finset.mem_erase.mp hb).1, hab, hp, hlen⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.carrier_dyadic_ear_avoiding_unique_attachment
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.carrier_dyadic_ear_avoiding_unique_attachment
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (K : Finset V) (S : Set V)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ v, v ∈ K → v ∉ S)
    (hboundary : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj v w → w ∈ S)
    (hsingle : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ a, a ∉ K → ∀ b, b ∉ K →
      G.Adj v a → G.Adj v b → a = b)
    (hB : 4 ≤ (carrierBoundaryVertices G K).card)
    (hsize : 2 * K.card + 1 < Fintype.card V)
    (t : {v : V // v ∈ K}) (s : V) (hs : s ∈ S)
    (hunique : ∀ v, v ∈ K → G.Adj v s → v = t.1) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : V, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      2 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ S ∧ b ∈ S ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      ear.IsPath ∧ ear.length = 2 ^ k ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v = a ∨ v = b ∨ v ∈ K) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ S → v = a ∨ v = b) ∧
      s ∉ ear.support
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨k, a, b, q, hk, ha, hb, hat, hbt, hab, hq, hlen⟩ :=
    M.carrier_boundary_path_avoiding K hsingle hB hsize t
  obtain ⟨aOut, haOut, haa⟩ := (mem_carrierBoundaryVertices G K a).mp ha
  obtain ⟨bOut, hbOut, hbb⟩ := (mem_carrierBoundaryVertices G K b).mp hb
  have haS := hboundary a.1 a.2 aOut haOut haa
  have hbS := hboundary b.1 b.2 bOut hbOut hbb
  have haOutNe : aOut ≠ s := by
    intro h
    subst aOut
    exact hat (Subtype.ext (hunique a.1 a.2 haa))
  have hbOutNe : bOut ≠ s := by
    intro h
    subst bOut
    exact hbt (Subtype.ext (hunique b.1 b.2 hbb))
  let e : (G.induce (↑K : Set V)) ↪g G := SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce (↑K : Set V)
  let p : G.Walk a.1 b.1 := q.map e.toHom
  have hp : p.IsPath := hq.map e.injective
  have hpK : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ K := by
    intro v hv
    change v ∈ (q.map e.toHom).support at hv
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map] at hv
    obtain ⟨w, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hv
    exact w.2
  have hplen : p.length + 2 = 2 ^ k := by
    change (q.map e.toHom).length + 2 = 2 ^ k
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map]
    exact hlen
  have haavoid : aOut ∉ p.support := fun h => haOut (hpK aOut h)
  have hbavoid : bOut ∉ p.support := fun h => hbOut (hpK bOut h)
  have habOut : aOut ≠ bOut := by
    intro heq
    subst bOut
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hclen⟩ := cycle_based_at_fresh_vertex p hp
      (fun h => hab (Subtype.ext h)) haa.symm hbb.symm haavoid
    exact M.isCounterexample.2 ⟨k, aOut, c, hk, hc, hclen.trans hplen⟩
  let ear : G.Walk aOut bOut := .cons haa.symm (p.concat hbb)
  have hear : ear.IsPath := by
    apply SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.cons (hp.concat hbavoid hbb)
    simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_concat, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton]
    exact fun h => h.elim haavoid habOut
  have hsupport : ∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v = aOut ∨ v = bOut ∨ v ∈ K := by
    intro v hv
    simp only [ear, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_concat,
      List.mem_cons, List.mem_append, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hv
    rcases hv with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (hpK v h))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
  refine ⟨k, aOut, bOut, ear, hk, haS, hbS, habOut, hear, ?_, hsupport, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [ear, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_concat]
    omega
  · intro v hv hvS
    rcases hsupport v hv with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr h
    · exact (hdisjoint v h hvS).elim
  · intro h
    rcases hsupport s h with h | h | h
    · exact haOutNe h.symm
    · exact hbOutNe h.symm
    · exact hdisjoint s h hs

name: Erdos64.extend_carrier_path_to_external_ear
statement:
private theorem extend_carrier_path_to_external_ear
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {u v a b : V}
    (K : Finset V) (ha : a ∉ K) (hb : b ∉ K) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hua : G.Adj u a) (hvb : G.Adj v b)
    (q : G.Walk u v) (hq : q.IsPath)
    (hqK : ∀ z, z ∈ q.support → z ∈ K) :
    ∃ ear : G.Walk a b, ear.IsPath ∧ ear.length = q.length + 2 ∧
      (∀ z, z ∈ ear.support → z = a ∨ z = b ∨ z ∈ K)
proof:
:= by
  have haavoid : a ∉ q.support := fun h => ha (hqK a h)
  have hbavoid : b ∉ q.support := fun h => hb (hqK b h)
  let ear := (q.cons hua.symm).concat hvb
  refine ⟨ear, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.concat (hq.cons haavoid)
    simp [hbavoid, hab.symm]
  · simp [ear, Nat.add_assoc]
  · intro z hz
    simp only [ear, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_concat, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons,
      List.mem_append, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hz
    rcases hz with (h | h) | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (hqK z h))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_crossing_edges_dyadic_ear
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_crossing_edges_dyadic_ear
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (K : Finset V)
    (u v a b : V) (hu : u ∈ K) (ha : a ∉ K) (hb : b ∉ K) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hboundary : ∀ z, z ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj z w →
      (z = u ∧ w = a) ∨ (z = v ∧ w = b))
    (hsize : 2 * K.card + 1 < Fintype.card V) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      1 ≤ k ∧ ear.IsPath ∧ ear.length = 2 ^ k ∧
      (∀ z, z ∈ ear.support → z = a ∨ z = b ∨ z ∈ K)
proof:
:= by
  have hdisjoint : ∀ z, z ∈ K → z ∉ ({w | w = a ∨ w = b} : Set V) := by
    intro z hz h
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · exact ha hz
    · exact hb hz
  have hbound : ∀ z, z ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj z w →
      w ∈ ({z | z = a ∨ z = b} : Set V) := by
    intro z hz w hw hzw
    exact (hboundary z hz w hw hzw).imp And.right And.right
  obtain ⟨k, c, d, q, hk, hc, hd, hcd, hq, hlen, hsupport, _⟩ :=
    M.small_carrier_dyadic_ear K {z | z = a ∨ z = b} ⟨u, hu⟩
      hdisjoint hbound hsize
  rcases hc with hca | hcb <;> rcases hd with hda | hdb
  · exact (hcd (hca.trans hda.symm)).elim
  · subst c
    subst d
    exact ⟨k, q, hk, hq, hlen, hsupport⟩
  · subst c
    subst d
    refine ⟨k, q.reverse, hk, hq.reverse, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_reverse] using hlen
    · intro z hz
      have hz' : z ∈ q.support := by simpa using hz
      rcases hsupport z hz' with h | h | h
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)
  · exact (hcd (hcb.trans hdb.symm)).elim

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_crossing_edges_dyadic_successor_ear
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_crossing_edges_dyadic_successor_ear
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (K : Finset V)
    (u v a b : V) (hu : u ∈ K) (hv : v ∈ K) (huv : u ≠ v)
    (ha : a ∉ K) (hb : b ∉ K) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hua : G.Adj u a) (hvb : G.Adj v b)
    (hboundary : ∀ z, z ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj z w →
      (z = u ∧ w = a) ∨ (z = v ∧ w = b))
    (hsize : K.card < Fintype.card V) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      1 ≤ k ∧ ear.IsPath ∧ ear.length = 2 ^ k + 1 ∧
      (∀ z, z ∈ ear.support → z = a ∨ z = b ∨ z ∈ K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases huvAdj : G.Adj u v
  · obtain ⟨ear, hear, hlen, hsupport⟩ := extend_carrier_path_to_external_ear
      K ha hb hab hua hvb huvAdj.toWalk (SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.of_adj huvAdj)
      (by intro z hz; simp [SimpleGraph.Adj.toWalk] at hz; rcases hz with rfl | rfl
          · exact hu
          · exact hv)
    exact ⟨1, ear, by omega, hear, by simpa using hlen, hsupport⟩
  have hsingle : ∀ z, z ∈ K → ∀ c, c ∉ K → ∀ d, d ∉ K →
      G.Adj z c → G.Adj z d → c = d := by
    intro z hz c hc d hd hzc hzd
    have hc' := hboundary z hz c hc hzc
    have hd' := hboundary z hz d hd hzd
    rcases hc' with ⟨hzu, hca⟩ | ⟨hzv, hcb⟩
    · rcases hd' with ⟨_, hda⟩ | ⟨hzv, _⟩
      · exact hca.trans hda.symm
      · exact (huv (hzu.symm.trans hzv)).elim
    · rcases hd' with ⟨hzu, _⟩ | ⟨_, hdb⟩
      · exact (huv (hzu.symm.trans hzv)).elim
      · exact hcb.trans hdb.symm
  let H := G.induce (↑K : Set V)
  let uu : (↑K : Set V) := ⟨u, hu⟩
  let vv : (↑K : Set V) := ⟨v, hv⟩
  have huuvv : uu ≠ vv := fun h => huv (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  have hB : ∀ z : (↑K : Set V),
      z ∈ carrierBoundaryVertices G K ↔ z = uu ∨ z = vv := by
    intro z
    rw [mem_carrierBoundaryVertices]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨w, hw, hzw⟩
      rcases hboundary z.1 z.2 w hw hzw with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (Subtype.ext h.1)
      · exact Or.inr (Subtype.ext h.1)
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact ⟨a, ha, hua⟩
      · exact ⟨b, hb, hvb⟩
  let J := H ⊔ SimpleGraph.edge uu vv
  have hdeg : ∀ z, J.degree z = G.degree z.1 := by
    intro z
    rw [degree_sup_edge_of_not_adj H huuvv huvAdj]
    have h := carrier_degree_add_boundary_indicator K hsingle z
    simpa only [hB z] using h
  have hyes : HasPowerOfTwoCycle J := by
    by_contra hno
    have hmin : 3 ≤ J.minDegree := by
      let : Nonempty (↑K : Set V) := ⟨uu⟩
      apply J.le_minDegree_of_forall_le_degree
      intro z
      rw [hdeg]
      exact degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G M.isCounterexample.1 z.1
    have hsmall : Fintype.card (↑K : Set V) < Fintype.card V := by simpa using hsize
    exact M.not_exists_strictly_smaller (H := J) ⟨⟨hmin, hno⟩, hsmall⟩
  have hHno : ¬HasPowerOfTwoCycle H :=
    not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle_induce_of_not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle M.isCounterexample.2
  obtain ⟨k, q, hk, hq, hlen⟩ := added_edge_dyadic_cycle_path hHno hyes
  let e : H ↪g G := SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce (↑K : Set V)
  let q' : G.Walk u v := q.map e.toHom
  have hq' : q'.IsPath := hq.map e.injective
  have hqK : ∀ z, z ∈ q'.support → z ∈ K := by
    intro z hz
    change z ∈ (q.map e.toHom).support at hz
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map] at hz
    obtain ⟨w, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hz
    exact w.2
  obtain ⟨ear, hear, hearlength, hsupport⟩ :=
    extend_carrier_path_to_external_ear K ha hb hab hua hvb q' hq' hqK
  have hqlength : q'.length + 1 = 2 ^ k := by
    change (q.map e.toHom).length + 1 = 2 ^ k
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map]
    exact hlen
  exact ⟨k, ear, by omega, hear, by omega, hsupport⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_crossing_edges_ear_spectrum
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_crossing_edges_ear_spectrum
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (K : Finset V)
    (u v a b : V) (hu : u ∈ K) (hv : v ∈ K) (huv : u ≠ v)
    (ha : a ∉ K) (hb : b ∉ K) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hua : G.Adj u a) (hvb : G.Adj v b)
    (hboundary : ∀ z, z ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj z w →
      (z = u ∧ w = a) ∨ (z = v ∧ w = b))
    (hsize : 2 * K.card + 1 < Fintype.card V) :
    ∃ i j : ℕ, ∃ evenEar oddEar : G.Walk a b,
      1 ≤ i ∧ 1 ≤ j ∧ evenEar.IsPath ∧ oddEar.IsPath ∧
      evenEar.length = 2 ^ i ∧ oddEar.length = 2 ^ j + 1 ∧
      (∀ z, z ∈ evenEar.support → z = a ∨ z = b ∨ z ∈ K) ∧
      (∀ z, z ∈ oddEar.support → z = a ∨ z = b ∨ z ∈ K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, evenEar, hi, heven, helen, hesupport⟩ :=
    M.exact_two_crossing_edges_dyadic_ear K u v a b hu ha hb hab hboundary hsize
  obtain ⟨j, oddEar, hj, hodd, holen, hosupport⟩ :=
    M.exact_two_crossing_edges_dyadic_successor_ear K u v a b hu hv huv ha hb hab
      hua hvb hboundary (by omega)
  exact ⟨i, j, evenEar, oddEar, hi, hj, heven, hodd, helen, holen, hesupport, hosupport⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_two_boundary_component_fork_or_ear_spectrum
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_two_boundary_component_fork_or_ear_spectrum
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hinside : ∀ z, z ∈ p.support → z ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (hcubic : ∀ z, z ∈ p.support → G.degree z = 3)
    (E : (G.induce {z : V | z ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      z ∉ p.support}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hB : (carrierBoundaryVertices G
      (offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E)).card = 2) :
    let K := offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E
    (∃ u a b : V, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      u ∈ K ∧ a ∈ p.support ∧ b ∈ p.support ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      G.Adj u a ∧ G.Adj u b ∧ ear.IsPath ∧ ear.length = 2 ∧
      (∀ z, z ∈ ear.support → z = a ∨ z = b ∨ z ∈ K)) ∨
    (∃ u v a b : V,
      u ∈ K ∧ v ∈ K ∧ u ≠ v ∧ a ∈ p.support ∧ b ∈ p.support ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      G.Adj u a ∧ G.Adj v b ∧
      (∀ z, z ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj z w →
        (z = u ∧ w = a) ∨ (z = v ∧ w = b)) ∧
      ∃ i j : ℕ, ∃ evenEar oddEar : G.Walk a b,
        1 ≤ i ∧ 1 ≤ j ∧ evenEar.IsPath ∧ oddEar.IsPath ∧
        evenEar.length = 2 ^ i ∧ oddEar.length = 2 ^ j + 1 ∧
        (∀ z, z ∈ evenEar.support → z = a ∨ z = b ∨ z ∈ K) ∧
        (∀ z, z ∈ oddEar.support → z = a ∨ z = b ∨ z ∈ K))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K := offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E
  obtain ⟨_, hKdata, hboundary, hsize⟩ :=
    cut_side_offPath_carrier_data M r C D hCD hxy hrx hry p hinside E
  by_cases htwo : ∃ z ∈ K, ∃ a, a ∉ K ∧ ∃ b, b ∉ K ∧
      a ≠ b ∧ G.Adj z a ∧ G.Adj z b
  · obtain ⟨u, hu, a, ha, b, hb, hab, hua, hub⟩ := htwo
    let ear : G.Walk a b := .cons hua.symm (.cons hub .nil)
    have hear : ear.IsPath := by
      apply SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.cons (SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.of_adj hub)
      simp [hua.ne.symm, hab]
    left
    refine ⟨u, a, b, ear, hu, hboundary u hu a ha hua,
      hboundary u hu b hb hub, hab, hua, hub, hear, rfl, ?_⟩
    intro z hz
    simp only [ear, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil,
      List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hz
    rcases hz with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (h ▸ hu))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
  have hsingle : ∀ z, z ∈ K → ∀ a, a ∉ K → ∀ b, b ∉ K →
      G.Adj z a → G.Adj z b → a = b := by
    intro z hz a ha b hb hza hzb
    by_contra hab
    exact htwo ⟨z, hz, a, ha, b, hb, hab, hza, hzb⟩
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv, hBeq⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp hB
  have huB : u ∈ carrierBoundaryVertices G K := by rw [hBeq]; simp
  have hvB : v ∈ carrierBoundaryVertices G K := by rw [hBeq]; simp
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hua⟩ := (mem_carrierBoundaryVertices G K u).mp huB
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hvb⟩ := (mem_carrierBoundaryVertices G K v).mp hvB
  have haP : a ∈ p.support := hboundary u.1 u.2 a ha hua
  have hbP : b ∈ p.support := hboundary v.1 v.2 b hb hvb
  have hab : a ≠ b := by
    intro h
    have hvb' : G.Adj v.1 a := h ▸ hvb
    have hvals := cut_side_port_path_external_neighbors_eq r C hxy hrx hry p hp hinside
      K hKdata a haP (hcubic a haP) u.1 u.2 v.1 v.2 hua.symm hvb'.symm
    exact huv (Subtype.ext hvals)
  have hbound : ∀ z, z ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj z w →
      (z = u.1 ∧ w = a) ∨ (z = v.1 ∧ w = b) := by
    intro z hz w hw hzw
    have hzB : (⟨z, hz⟩ : (↑K : Set V)) ∈ carrierBoundaryVertices G K :=
      (mem_carrierBoundaryVertices G K ⟨z, hz⟩).mpr ⟨w, hw, hzw⟩
    rw [hBeq] at hzB
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hzB with hzu | hzv
    · have hzu : z = u.1 := congrArg Subtype.val hzu
      exact Or.inl ⟨hzu, hsingle z hz w hw a ha hzw (hzu.symm ▸ hua)⟩
    · have hzv : z = v.1 := congrArg Subtype.val (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hzv)
      exact Or.inr ⟨hzv, hsingle z hz w hw b hb hzw (hzv.symm ▸ hvb)⟩
  have huv' : u.1 ≠ v.1 := fun h => huv (Subtype.ext h)
  right
  refine ⟨u.1, v.1, a, b, u.2, v.2, huv', haP, hbP, hab, hua, hvb, hbound, ?_⟩
  exact M.exact_two_crossing_edges_ear_spectrum K u.1 v.1 a b
    u.2 v.2 huv' ha hb hab hua hvb hbound hsize

name: Erdos64.boundaryRoot_dyadic_cycle_ear
statement:
theorem boundaryRoot_dyadic_cycle_ear
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (K : Finset V) (S : Set V)
    (hnoG : ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle G)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ v, v ∈ K → v ∉ S)
    (hboundary : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj v w → w ∈ S)
    (hyes : HasPowerOfTwoCycle
      (boundaryRootGraph (G.induce (↑K : Set V)) (carrierBoundaryVertices G K))) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : V, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      2 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ S ∧ b ∈ S ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      ear.IsPath ∧ ear.length = 2 ^ k ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v = a ∨ v = b ∨ v ∈ K) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ S → v = a ∨ v = b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H := G.induce (↑K : Set V)
  let B := carrierBoundaryVertices G K
  have hno : ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle H :=
    not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle_induce_of_not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle hnoG
  obtain ⟨k, a, b, q, hk, ha, hb, hab, hq, hlen⟩ :=
    boundaryRoot_dyadic_cycle_path B hno hyes
  obtain ⟨aOut, haOut, haa⟩ := (mem_carrierBoundaryVertices G K a).mp ha
  obtain ⟨bOut, hbOut, hbb⟩ := (mem_carrierBoundaryVertices G K b).mp hb
  have haS := hboundary a.1 a.2 aOut haOut haa
  have hbS := hboundary b.1 b.2 bOut hbOut hbb
  let e : H ↪g G := SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce (↑K : Set V)
  let p : G.Walk a.1 b.1 := q.map e.toHom
  have hp : p.IsPath := hq.map e.injective
  have hpK : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ K := by
    intro v hv
    change v ∈ (q.map e.toHom).support at hv
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map] at hv
    obtain ⟨w, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hv
    exact w.2
  have hplen : p.length + 2 = 2 ^ k := by
    change (q.map e.toHom).length + 2 = 2 ^ k
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map]
    exact hlen
  have haavoid : aOut ∉ p.support := fun h => haOut (hpK aOut h)
  have hbavoid : bOut ∉ p.support := fun h => hbOut (hpK bOut h)
  have habOut : aOut ≠ bOut := by
    intro heq
    subst bOut
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hclen⟩ := cycle_based_at_fresh_vertex p hp
      (fun h => hab (Subtype.ext h)) haa.symm hbb.symm haavoid
    exact hnoG ⟨k, aOut, c, hk, hc, hclen.trans hplen⟩
  let ear : G.Walk aOut bOut := .cons haa.symm (p.concat hbb)
  have hear : ear.IsPath := by
    apply SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.cons (hp.concat hbavoid hbb)
    simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_concat,
      List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton]
    exact fun h => h.elim haavoid habOut
  have hsupport : ∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v = aOut ∨ v = bOut ∨ v ∈ K := by
    intro v hv
    simp only [ear, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_concat,
      List.mem_cons, List.mem_append, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hv
    rcases hv with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (hpK v h))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
  refine ⟨k, aOut, bOut, ear, by omega, haS, hbS, habOut, hear, ?_, hsupport, ?_⟩
  · simp only [ear, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_concat]
    omega
  · intro v hv hvS
    rcases hsupport v hv with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr h
    · exact (hdisjoint v h hvS).elim

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.small_carrier_dyadic_ear
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.small_carrier_dyadic_ear
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (K : Finset V) (S : Set V)
    (hK : K.Nonempty)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ v, v ∈ K → v ∉ S)
    (hboundary : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj v w → w ∈ S)
    (hsize : 2 * K.card + 1 < Fintype.card V) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : V, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      1 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ S ∧ b ∈ S ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      ear.IsPath ∧ ear.length = 2 ^ k ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v = a ∨ v = b ∨ v ∈ K) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ S → v = a ∨ v = b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases htwo : ∃ v ∈ K, ∃ a, a ∉ K ∧ ∃ b, b ∉ K ∧
      a ≠ b ∧ G.Adj v a ∧ G.Adj v b
  · obtain ⟨v, hv, a, haK, b, hbK, hab, hva, hvb⟩ := htwo
    let ear : G.Walk a b := .cons hva.symm (.cons hvb .nil)
    have hear : ear.IsPath := by
      apply SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.cons
      · exact SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.of_adj hvb
      · simp [hva.ne.symm, hab]
    have hsupport : ∀ w, w ∈ ear.support → w = a ∨ w = b ∨ w ∈ K := by
      intro w hw
      simp only [ear, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil,
        List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hw
      rcases hw with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr hv)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
    refine ⟨1, a, b, ear, by omega, hboundary v hv a haK hva,
      hboundary v hv b hbK hvb, hab, hear, by rfl, hsupport, ?_⟩
    intro w hw hwS
    rcases hsupport w hw with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr h
    · exact (hdisjoint w h hwS).elim
  have hsingle : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ a, a ∉ K → ∀ b, b ∉ K →
      G.Adj v a → G.Adj v b → a = b := by
    intro v hv a ha b hb hva hvb
    by_contra hab
    exact htwo ⟨v, hv, a, ha, b, hb, hab, hva, hvb⟩
  let H := G.induce (↑K : Set V)
  let B := carrierBoundaryVertices G K
  let R := boundaryRootGraph H B
  have hdeg : ∀ v, R.degree (some v) = G.degree v.1 := by
    intro v
    rw [boundaryRootGraph_degree_some]
    exact carrier_degree_add_boundary_indicator (G := G) K hsingle v
  have hroot : 2 ≤ R.degree none := by
    rw [boundaryRootGraph_degree_none]
    exact M.small_carrier_boundary_card_ge_two K hK hsingle hsize
  have hothers : ∀ v, v ≠ none → 3 ≤ R.degree v := by
    intro v hv
    cases v with
    | none => exact (hv rfl).elim
    | some v =>
        rw [hdeg]
        exact degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G M.isCounterexample.1 v.1
  have hsmall : 2 * Fintype.card (Option (↑K : Set V)) - 1 < Fintype.card V := by
    simpa using (show 2 * (K.card + 1) - 1 < Fintype.card V by omega)
  have hyes := M.one_defect_small_has_dyadic_cycle none hroot hothers hsmall
  obtain ⟨k, a, b, ear, hk, hrest⟩ :=
    boundaryRoot_dyadic_cycle_ear K S M.isCounterexample.2
      hdisjoint hboundary hyes
  exact ⟨k, a, b, ear, by omega, hrest⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.carrier_dyadic_ear_of_three_boundary
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.carrier_dyadic_ear_of_three_boundary
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (K : Finset V) (S : Set V)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ v, v ∈ K → v ∉ S)
    (hboundary : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj v w → w ∈ S)
    (hsingle : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ a, a ∉ K → ∀ b, b ∉ K →
      G.Adj v a → G.Adj v b → a = b)
    (hB : 3 ≤ (carrierBoundaryVertices G K).card)
    (hsize : K.card + 1 < Fintype.card V) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : V, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      2 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ S ∧ b ∈ S ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      ear.IsPath ∧ ear.length = 2 ^ k ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v = a ∨ v = b ∨ v ∈ K) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ S → v = a ∨ v = b)
proof:
:= by
  exact boundaryRoot_dyadic_cycle_ear K S M.isCounterexample.2
    hdisjoint hboundary
    (M.boundary_root_has_dyadic_cycle_of_three_boundary K hsingle hB hsize)

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.shared_root_residual_case_split
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.shared_root_residual_case_split
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    {r x y : V}
    (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (hnadj : ¬ G.Adj x y)
    (hroot_degree : 4 ≤ G.degree r) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ u v : V, ∃ p : G.Walk u v,
      k ≥ 2 ∧
      p.IsPath ∧
      (∀ w, w ∈ p.support → w ≠ x ∧ w ≠ y) ∧
      p.length + 2 = 2 ^ k ∧
      (((r ∉ p.support) ∧
          ((∃ q : G.Walk x y,
              q.IsPath ∧ r ∉ q.support ∧ q.length = 2 ^ k) ∨
            (∃ q : G.Walk y x,
              q.IsPath ∧ r ∉ q.support ∧ q.length = 2 ^ k))) ∨
        ((r ∈ p.support) ∧
          ∃ a : G.Walk u r, ∃ b : G.Walk r v,
            a.IsPath ∧ b.IsPath ∧ a.append b = p ∧
            a.support ⊆ p.support ∧ b.support ⊆ p.support ∧
            a.length + b.length = p.length ∧
            0 < a.length ∧ 0 < b.length ∧
            r ∉ a.support.dropLast ∧ r ∉ b.support.tail ∧
            (∀ j : ℕ, 2 ≤ j → a.length + 2 ≠ 2 ^ j) ∧
            (∀ j : ℕ, 2 ≤ j → b.length + 2 ≠ 2 ^ j)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, u, v, p, hk, hp, havoid, hlen, hadj⟩ :=
    M.shared_root_quotient_residual_path hrx hry hxy hnadj hroot_degree
  rcases hadj with ⟨hxu, hyv, hur, hvr⟩ | ⟨hyu, hxv, hur, hvr⟩
  · by_cases hroot : r ∈ p.support
    · refine ⟨k, u, v, p, hk, hp, havoid, hlen, Or.inr ⟨hroot, ?_⟩⟩
      exact M.cross_residual_root_internal_excursions_nondyadic
        hrx hry hp havoid hur hvr hroot (Or.inl ⟨hxu, hyv⟩)
    · refine ⟨k, u, v, p, hk, hp, havoid, hlen, Or.inl ⟨hroot, ?_⟩⟩
      exact cross_residual_path_to_dyadic_port_path
        hrx hry hxy hp havoid hroot hlen (Or.inl ⟨hxu, hyv⟩)
  · by_cases hroot : r ∈ p.support
    · refine ⟨k, u, v, p, hk, hp, havoid, hlen, Or.inr ⟨hroot, ?_⟩⟩
      exact M.cross_residual_root_internal_excursions_nondyadic
        hrx hry hp havoid hur hvr hroot (Or.inr ⟨hyu, hxv⟩)
    · refine ⟨k, u, v, p, hk, hp, havoid, hlen, Or.inl ⟨hroot, ?_⟩⟩
      exact cross_residual_path_to_dyadic_port_path
        hrx hry hxy hp havoid hroot hlen (Or.inr ⟨hyu, hxv⟩)

name: Erdos64.residual_root_internal_excursion_interiors_in_closed_side
statement:
theorem residual_root_internal_excursion_interiors_in_closed_side
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {D : Finset V} {r u v : V}
    {a : G.Walk u r} {b : G.Walk r v}
    (ha : a.IsPath) (hb : b.IsPath)
    (hapos : 0 < a.length) (hbpos : 0 < b.length)
    (hroota : r ∉ a.support.dropLast)
    (hrootb : r ∉ b.support.tail)
    (hu : u ∈ D) (hv : v ∈ D)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ x, x ∈ D → ∀ y, y ∉ D → G.Adj x y → y = r) :
    (∀ z, z ∈ a.support.dropLast → z ∈ D) ∧
      (∀ z, z ∈ b.support.tail → z ∈ D)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact Erdos64.SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.dropLast_support_subset_of_boundary
      ha hapos hu hroota hboundary
  · exact Erdos64.SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.tail_support_subset_of_boundary
      hb hbpos hv hrootb hboundary

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.two_port_cubic_defect_of_no_dyadic
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.two_port_cubic_defect_of_no_dyadic
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V) (hD : D.Nonempty)
    (hr : r ∉ D)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hports : ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y)) :
    G.degree x = 3 ∨ G.degree y = 3
proof:
:= by
  rcases two_port_safe_side_or_cubic_defect D r x y hD hr hboundary
      M.isCounterexample.1 hports with hsafe | hxcubic | hycubic
  · have hcounter :
        IsCounterexample (G.induce (↑D : Set V)) := by
      refine ⟨hsafe, ?_⟩
      exact not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle_induce_of_not_hasPowerOfTwoCycle
        M.isCounterexample.2
    have hcard : Fintype.card (↑D : Set V) < Fintype.card V := by
      apply Fintype.card_subtype_lt (p := fun v : V => v ∈ D) (x := r)
      exact hr
    exact (M.not_exists_strictly_smaller ⟨hcounter, hcard⟩).elim
  · exact Or.inl hxcubic
  · exact Or.inr hycubic

name: Erdos64.degree_two_neighbor_description
statement:
private theorem degree_two_neighbor_description
    {W : Type u} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] [DecidableRel H.Adj]
    {x y : W} (hxy : H.Adj x y) (hx : H.degree x = 2) :
    ∃ u, u ≠ y ∧ ∀ w, H.Adj x w ↔ w = y ∨ w = u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hy : y ∈ H.neighborFinset x := by simpa using hxy
  have hcard : (H.neighborFinset x).card = 2 := by simpa using hx
  have hpos : 0 < ((H.neighborFinset x).erase y).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hy, hcard]
    omega
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp hpos
  obtain ⟨huy, hu⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hu
  have hsub : ({y, u} : Finset W) ⊆ H.neighborFinset x := by
    intro w hw
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hw
    rcases hw with rfl | rfl
    · exact hy
    · exact hu
  have heq : ({y, u} : Finset W) = H.neighborFinset x :=
    Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (by simp [hcard, huy.symm])
  refine ⟨u, huy, ?_⟩
  intro w
  rw [← SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, ← heq]
  simp

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.adjacent_two_defect_pow_two_add_one_path
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.adjacent_two_defect_pow_two_add_one_path
    {V W : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] [DecidableRel H.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (x y u v : W)
    (huy : u ≠ y) (hvx : v ≠ x) (huv : u ≠ v)
    (hnadj : ¬H.Adj u v)
    (hnx : ∀ w, H.Adj x w ↔ w = y ∨ w = u)
    (hny : ∀ w, H.Adj y w ↔ w = x ∨ w = v)
    (hother : ∀ w, w ≠ x → w ≠ y → 3 ≤ H.degree w)
    (hno : ¬HasPowerOfTwoCycle H)
    (hsize : Fintype.card W < Fintype.card V) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ p : H.Walk x y,
      2 ≤ k ∧ p.IsPath ∧ p.length = 2 ^ k + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hxy : H.Adj x y := (hnx y).2 (Or.inl rfl)
  have hxu : H.Adj x u := (hnx u).2 (Or.inr rfl)
  have hyv : H.Adj y v := (hny v).2 (Or.inr rfl)
  have hyu : ¬H.Adj y u := by
    intro h
    rcases (hny u).1 h with h | h
    · exact hxu.ne h.symm
    · exact huv h
  let X := {w : W // w ≠ x}
  let yy : X := ⟨y, hxy.ne.symm⟩
  let uu : X := ⟨u, hxu.ne.symm⟩
  let vv : X := ⟨v, hvx⟩
  let K := degreeTwoSuppressionGraph H x y u hxy.ne.symm hxu.ne.symm
  have huuyy : uu ≠ yy := fun h => huy (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  have hvvyy : vv ≠ yy := fun h => hyv.ne (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have huuvv : uu ≠ vv := fun h => huv (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  have hKdeg : ∀ w : X, K.degree w = H.degree w.1 := by
    intro w
    exact degreeTwoSuppressionGraph_degree H x y u hxy.ne.symm
      hxu.ne.symm huy.symm hyu hnx w
  have hKneighbors : ∀ w : X, K.Adj yy w ↔ w = uu ∨ w = vv := by
    intro w
    change (H.Adj y w.1 ∨ (SimpleGraph.edge yy uu).Adj yy w) ↔ _
    rw [hny]
    have hwx : w.1 ≠ x := w.2
    simp only [SimpleGraph.edge_adj, true_and, hwx, false_or]
    simp only [X, yy, uu, vv, Subtype.ext_iff] at *
    aesop
  have hKnadj : ¬K.Adj uu vv := by
    change ¬(H.Adj u v ∨ (SimpleGraph.edge yy uu).Adj uu vv)
    simp only [SimpleGraph.edge_adj]
    simp [hnadj, huuyy, hvvyy]
  let T := {w : X // w ≠ yy}
  let a : T := ⟨uu, huuyy⟩
  let b : T := ⟨vv, hvvyy⟩
  let A : SimpleGraph T := H.comap (fun w => w.1.1)
  let L := degreeTwoSuppressionGraph K yy uu vv huuyy hvvyy
  have hLdegree : ∀ w : T, L.degree w = H.degree w.1.1 := by
    intro w
    rw [show L.degree w = K.degree w.1 from
      degreeTwoSuppressionGraph_degree K yy uu vv huuyy hvvyy
        huuvv hKnadj hKneighbors w, hKdeg]
  have hLdef : L = A ⊔ SimpleGraph.edge a b := by
    ext s t
    change ((H.Adj s.1.1 t.1.1 ∨ (SimpleGraph.edge yy uu).Adj s.1 t.1) ∨
      (SimpleGraph.edge a b).Adj s t) ↔ _
    have hs : s.1 ≠ yy := s.2
    have ht : t.1 ≠ yy := t.2
    simp only [SimpleGraph.sup_adj, A, SimpleGraph.comap_adj,
      SimpleGraph.edge_adj, hs, ht, false_and, and_false, or_false]
  let e : A ↪g H :=
    { toFun := fun w => w.1.1
      inj' := fun s t h => Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext h)
      map_rel_iff' := Iff.rfl }
  have hAno : ¬HasPowerOfTwoCycle A := by
    rintro ⟨k, z, c, hk, hc, hlen⟩
    apply hno
    exact ⟨k, e z, c.map e.toHom, hk, hc.map e.injective,
      by simpa using hlen⟩
  have hLyes : HasPowerOfTwoCycle L := by
    by_contra hLno
    have hLmin : 3 ≤ L.minDegree := by
      let : Nonempty T := ⟨a⟩
      apply L.le_minDegree_of_forall_le_degree
      intro w
      rw [hLdegree]
      exact hother w.1.1 w.1.2 (fun h => w.2 (Subtype.ext h))
    have hcard : Fintype.card T < Fintype.card V := by
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt
        (le_trans (Fintype.card_subtype_le _) (Fintype.card_subtype_le _)) hsize
    exact M.not_exists_strictly_smaller (H := L) ⟨⟨hLmin, hLno⟩, hcard⟩
  rw [hLdef] at hLyes
  obtain ⟨k, p, hk, hp, hlen⟩ := added_edge_dyadic_cycle_path hAno hLyes
  let q : H.Walk u v := p.map e.toHom
  have hq : q.IsPath := hp.map e.injective
  have havoid : ∀ w, w ∈ q.support → w ≠ x ∧ w ≠ y := by
    intro w hw
    change w ∈ (p.map e.toHom).support at hw
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map] at hw
    obtain ⟨t, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hw
    exact ⟨t.1.2, fun h => t.2 (Subtype.ext h)⟩
  let result : H.Walk x y := (q.cons hxu).concat hyv.symm
  have hresult : result.IsPath := by
    apply SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.concat
    · exact hq.cons (fun hx => (havoid x hx).1 rfl)
    · simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, List.mem_cons]
      rintro (h | h)
      · exact hxy.ne h.symm
      · exact (havoid y h).2 rfl
  refine ⟨k, result, hk, hresult, ?_⟩
  have hqlen : q.length + 1 = 2 ^ k := by
    simpa [q] using hlen
  simp only [result, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_concat, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons]
  omega

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.adjacent_degree_two_ports_pow_two_add_one_path
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.adjacent_degree_two_ports_pow_two_add_one_path
    {V W : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] [DecidableRel H.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (x y : W)
    (hxy : H.Adj x y) (hxdeg : H.degree x = 2) (hydeg : H.degree y = 2)
    (hcommon : ∀ z, H.Adj x z → H.Adj y z → False)
    (hother : ∀ w, w ≠ x → w ≠ y → 3 ≤ H.degree w)
    (hno : ¬HasPowerOfTwoCycle H)
    (hsize : Fintype.card W < Fintype.card V) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ p : H.Walk x y,
      2 ≤ k ∧ p.IsPath ∧ p.length = 2 ^ k + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, huy, hnx⟩ := degree_two_neighbor_description hxy hxdeg
  obtain ⟨v, hvx, hny⟩ := degree_two_neighbor_description hxy.symm hydeg
  have hxu : H.Adj x u := (hnx u).2 (Or.inr rfl)
  have hyv : H.Adj y v := (hny v).2 (Or.inr rfl)
  have huv : u ≠ v := by
    intro h
    exact hcommon u hxu (h ▸ hyv)
  have hnadj : ¬H.Adj u v := by
    intro huvAdj
    let q : H.Walk u y := huvAdj.toWalk.append hyv.symm.toWalk
    have hq : q.IsPath := by
      change (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons huvAdj
        (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hyv.symm SimpleGraph.Walk.nil)).IsPath
      simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons,
        SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
      exact ⟨⟨SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.nil, hyv.ne.symm⟩,
        fun h => h.elim huv huy⟩
    have hxnot : x ∉ q.support := by
      simp [q, hxu.ne, hvx.symm, hxy.ne]
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hlen⟩ := endpoint_fan_cycle_certificate
      hq hxu hxy hxnot huy (by simp [q])
    apply hno
    exact ⟨2, u, c, by omega, hc, by simpa [q] using hlen⟩
  exact M.adjacent_two_defect_pow_two_add_one_path x y u v
    huy hvx huv hnadj hnx hny hother hno hsize

name: Erdos64.separated_third_neighbor_path
statement:
theorem separated_third_neighbor_path
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {D : Set V}
    {r x y z w : V}
    (hDroot : ∀ v, v ∈ D → v ≠ r)
    (hDxy : ∀ v, v ∈ D → v ≠ x ∧ v ≠ y)
    (C : (G.induce D).ConnectedComponent)
    (hzD : z ∈ D) (hwD : w ∈ D)
    (hzC : (⟨z, hzD⟩ : D) ∈ C)
    (hwC : (⟨w, hwD⟩ : D) ∈ C) :
    ∃ p : G.Walk z w, p.IsPath ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ≠ r ∧ v ≠ x ∧ v ≠ y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := C.connected_toSimpleGraph.exists_isPath
    (⟨⟨z, hzD⟩, hzC⟩ : C) (⟨⟨w, hwD⟩, hwC⟩ : C)
  let e : C.toSimpleGraph →g G :=
    { toFun := fun v => v.1.1
      map_rel' := fun h => h }
  have he : Function.Injective e := by
    intro a b hab
    change a.1.1 = b.1.1 at hab
    exact Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext hab)
  let p : G.Walk z w := q.map e
  have hp : p.IsPath :=
    (SimpleGraph.Walk.isPath_map_iff_of_injective (f := e) he).mpr hq
  have havoid : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ≠ r ∧ v ≠ x ∧ v ≠ y := by
    intro v hv
    change v ∈ (q.map e).support at hv
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map] at hv
    obtain ⟨u, _hu, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hv
    exact ⟨hDroot u.1.1 u.1.2, hDxy u.1.1 u.1.2⟩
  exact ⟨p, hp, havoid⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.not_isBridge
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.not_isBridge
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    {x z : V} (hxz : G.Adj x z) :
    ¬G.IsBridge s(x, z)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro hbridge
  obtain ⟨S, r, hclosed, hroot, hsize⟩ :=
    exists_strict_closed_side_of_bridge M.isConnected
      M.isCounterexample.1 hxz hbridge
  exact M.not_exists_strictly_smaller
    (strict_double_of_closed_side M.isCounterexample S r
      hclosed hroot hsize)

name: Erdos64.isBridge_of_onePort_unique_neighbor
statement:
theorem isBridge_of_onePort_unique_neighbor
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (K : Finset V) (x z : V)
    (hx : x ∉ K) (hz : z ∈ K)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ u, u ∈ K → ∀ v, v ∉ K → G.Adj u v → v = x)
    (hunique : ∀ u, u ∈ K → G.Adj x u → u = z) :
    G.IsBridge s(x, z)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H := G.deleteEdges {s(x, z)}
  have hclosed : ∀ a, a ∈ K → ∀ b, H.Adj a b → b ∈ K := by
    intro a ha b hab
    by_contra hb
    have habG : G.Adj a b := (SimpleGraph.deleteEdges_adj.mp hab).1
    have hbx : b = x := hboundary a ha b hb habG
    have hax : G.Adj a x := hbx ▸ habG
    have haz : a = z := hunique a ha hax.symm
    have hdeleted : ¬H.Adj x z := by
      simp [H, SimpleGraph.deleteEdges_adj]
    apply hdeleted
    simpa only [haz, hbx] using hab.symm
  have hwalk :
      ∀ {a b : V} (p : H.Walk a b), a ∈ K → b ∈ K := by
    intro a b p
    induction p with
    | nil => exact fun ha => ha
    | @cons a b c hab q ih =>
        exact fun ha => ih (hclosed a ha b hab)
  apply SimpleGraph.isBridge_iff.mpr
  intro hreach
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := hreach.symm
  exact hx (hwalk p hz)

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.exists_second_onePort_neighbor
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.exists_second_onePort_neighbor
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (K : Finset V) (x z : V)
    (hx : x ∉ K) (hz : z ∈ K) (hxz : G.Adj x z)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ u, u ∈ K → ∀ v, v ∉ K → G.Adj u v → v = x) :
    ∃ w, w ∈ K ∧ G.Adj x w ∧ w ≠ z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hnone
  apply M.not_isBridge hxz
  apply isBridge_of_onePort_unique_neighbor K x z hx hz hboundary
  intro w hw hxw
  by_contra hwz
  exact hnone ⟨w, hw, hxw, hwz⟩

name: Erdos64.exists_strict_closed_side_of_bridge
statement:
theorem exists_strict_closed_side_of_bridge
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hconn : G.Connected) (hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3)
    {u v : V} (huv : G.Adj u v)
    (hbridge : G.IsBridge s(u, v)) :
    ∃ (S : Finset V) (r : {x : V // x ∈ S}),
      (∀ x, x ∈ S → x ≠ r.val →
        ∀ y, G.Adj x y → y ∈ S) ∧
      2 ≤ internalDegree G S r.val ∧
      2 * S.card - 1 < Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D : SimpleGraph V := G.deleteEdges {s(u, v)}
  have hnreach : ¬D.Reachable u v := by
    simpa [D] using (SimpleGraph.isBridge_iff.mp hbridge)
  have huv_ne : u ≠ v := huv.ne
  have hside : ∀ {a b : V}, G.Adj a b → s(a, b) = s(u, v) →
      ¬D.Reachable a b →
      ∃ (S : Finset V) (ra : {x : V // x ∈ S}),
        S = (D.connectedComponentMk a).supp.toFinset ∧
        (∀ x, x ∈ S → x ≠ ra.val →
          ∀ y, G.Adj x y → y ∈ S) ∧
        2 ≤ internalDegree G S ra.val := by
    intro a b hab hedge hnab
    let C : D.ConnectedComponent := D.connectedComponentMk a
    let S : Finset V := C.supp.toFinset
    have haS : a ∈ S := by
      apply Set.mem_toFinset.mpr
      simpa [C] using (D.connectedComponentMk_mem a)
    have hbS : b ∉ S := by
      intro hb
      have hb' : b ∈ C.supp := Set.mem_toFinset.mp hb
      rw [SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff] at hb'
      have hr : D.Reachable b a :=
        (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.eq.mp hb')
      exact hnab hr.symm
    let ra : {x : V // x ∈ S} := ⟨a, haS⟩
    have mem_of_D_adj {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ C.supp)
        (hxy : D.Adj x y) : y ∈ C.supp := by
      rw [SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff] at hx ⊢
      rw [← hx]
      exact SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.eq.mpr hxy.reachable.symm
    have hdelete_case {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ C.supp)
        (hxroot : x ≠ a) (hxy : G.Adj x y) (hy : y ∉ C.supp) :
        False := by
      have hxyD : D.Adj x y := by
        dsimp [D]
        rw [← hedge]
        apply SimpleGraph.deleteEdges_adj.mpr
        refine ⟨hxy, ?_⟩
        intro he
        have hor : (x = a ∧ y = b) ∨ (x = b ∧ y = a) := by
          simpa [Sym2.eq_iff] using he
        rcases hor with hor | hor
        · exact hxroot hor.1
        · exact hy (by
            rw [hor.2]
            simpa [C] using (D.connectedComponentMk_mem a))
      exact hy (mem_of_D_adj hx hxyD)
    have hclosed : ∀ x, x ∈ S → x ≠ ra.val →
        ∀ y, G.Adj x y → y ∈ S := by
      intro x hxS hxroot y hxy
      apply Set.mem_toFinset.mpr
      apply by_contra
      intro hy
      exact hdelete_case (Set.mem_toFinset.mp hxS) hxroot hxy hy
    have houtside : ∀ y, G.Adj a y → y ∉ C.supp → y = b := by
      intro y hay hy
      have hayD : ¬D.Adj a y := by
        intro hayD
        exact hy (mem_of_D_adj (by
          simpa [C] using (D.connectedComponentMk_mem a)) hayD)
      have he : s(a, y) ∈ ({s(a, b)} : Set (Sym2 V)) := by
        by_contra he'
        exact hayD ((show D.Adj a y from by
          dsimp [D]
          rw [← hedge]
          exact SimpleGraph.deleteEdges_adj.mpr ⟨hay, he'⟩))
      have heq : s(a, b) = s(a, y) := (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp he).symm
      have hor : (a = a ∧ b = y) ∨ (a = y ∧ b = a) := by
        simpa [Sym2.eq_iff] using heq
      rcases hor with hor | hor
      · exact hor.2.symm
      · exact (hab.ne hor.2.symm).elim
    have hneighbors : G.neighborFinset a =
        insert b (S.filter (G.Adj a)) := by
      ext y
      simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, Finset.mem_insert,
        Finset.mem_filter]
      constructor
      · intro hay
        by_cases hyb : y = b
        · exact Or.inl hyb
        · right
          have hyS : y ∈ C.supp := by
            by_contra hyS
            exact hyb (houtside y hay hyS)
          exact ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr hyS, hay⟩
      · intro hy
        rcases hy with rfl | ⟨hyS, hay⟩
        · exact hab
        · exact hay
    have hrootdeg : 2 ≤ internalDegree G S ra.val := by
      have hcard : G.degree a = 1 + internalDegree G S a := by
        rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hneighbors]
        have hbnot : b ∉ S.filter (G.Adj a) := by
          intro hb'
          exact hbS (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb').1
        rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hbnot]
        simp [internalDegree, Nat.add_comm]
      have hadeg : 3 ≤ G.degree a :=
        degree_ge_three_of_minDegree_ge_three G hmin a
      simpa [ra] using (show 2 ≤ internalDegree G S a by omega)
    exact ⟨S, ra, rfl, hclosed, hrootdeg⟩
  obtain ⟨S, rS, hS, hSclosed, hSroot⟩ :=
    hside huv rfl hnreach
  obtain ⟨T, rT, hT, hTclosed, hTroot⟩ :=
    hside huv.symm (by simp [Sym2.eq_swap]) (fun h => hnreach h.symm)
  have hdisj : Disjoint S T := by
    rw [hS, hT, Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzS hzT
    have hzS' : z ∈ (D.connectedComponentMk u).supp :=
      Set.mem_toFinset.mp hzS
    have hzT' : z ∈ (D.connectedComponentMk v).supp :=
      Set.mem_toFinset.mp hzT
    rw [SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff] at hzS' hzT'
    exact hnreach ((SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.eq.mp hzS').symm.trans
      (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.eq.mp hzT'))
  have hsum : S.card + T.card ≤ Fintype.card V := by
    have hle : (S ∪ T).card ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset V).card :=
      Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_univ _)
    rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj] at hle
    simpa using hle
  have hSpos : 0 < S.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨rS.val, rS.property⟩
  by_cases hsmall : S.card ≤ T.card
  · refine ⟨S, rS, hSclosed, hSroot, ?_⟩
    omega
  · refine ⟨T, rT, hTclosed, hTroot, ?_⟩
    have hsmall' : T.card ≤ S.card := Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hsmall)
    omega

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.route02LengthTwo_length
statement:

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.route02LengthTwo_isPath
statement:
private theorem route02LengthTwo_isPath (H : PentagramEarHull G) :
    (route02LengthTwo H).IsPath
proof:
:= by
  apply (SimpleGraph.Walk.isPath_def _).mpr
  change List.Nodup
    [H.vertex (.inr (.inr 0)), H.vertex (.inr (.inl 0)),
      H.vertex (.inl 0), H.vertex (.inl 1), H.vertex (.inl 2),
      H.vertex (.inr (.inl 2)), H.vertex (.inr (.inr 2))]
  let xs : List (Sum (Fin 5) (Sum (Fin 5) (Fin 5))) :=
    [.inr (.inr 0), .inr (.inl 0), .inl 0, .inl 1, .inl 2,
      .inr (.inl 2), .inr (.inr 2)]
  have hxs : xs.Nodup := by decide
  exact List.Nodup.map H.vertex_injective hxs

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.route02LengthTwo_disjoint
statement:
private theorem route02LengthTwo_disjoint
    (H : PentagramEarHull G) (K : Connector H 0 2)
    (hK : K.path.length = 2) :
    (K.path.take K.path.length).support.tail.Disjoint
      (route02LengthTwo H).reverse.support.tail
proof:
:= by
  rw [K.path.take_of_length_le (Nat.le_refl _)]
  simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_copy]
  apply List.disjoint_left.2
  intro v hvK hvR
  have hvR' : v ∈ (route02LengthTwo H).reverse.support :=
    List.mem_of_mem_tail hvR
  have hvh : v ∈ hull H := by
    simp [route02LengthTwo, hull, cVertex, aVertex, bVertex] at hvR' ⊢
    aesop
  have hv2 : v ≠ bVertex H 2 := by
    intro hv2
    subst v
    simp [route02LengthTwo, aVertex, bVertex, cVertex] at hvR
    rcases hvR with h | h | h | h | h | h <;>
      have hi := H.vertex_injective h <;> simp_all
  exact K.interior_disjoint v
    (mem_interior_of_mem_tail_ne_end hvK hv2) hvh

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.cycle8_of_connector_02_length_two
statement:

      c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = 8

    (hullReturn_of_connector_02_length_two H K hK)

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.route02LengthOne_disjoint
statement:
private theorem route02LengthOne_disjoint
    (H : PentagramEarHull G) (K : Connector H 0 2)
    (hK : K.path.length = 1) :
    (K.path.take K.path.length).support.tail.Disjoint
      (route02LengthOne H).reverse.support.tail
proof:
:= by
  rw [K.path.take_of_length_le (Nat.le_refl _)]
  simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_copy]
  apply List.disjoint_left.2
  intro v hvK hvR

  have hv2 : v ≠ bVertex H 2 := by
    intro hv2
    subst v
    simp [route02LengthOne, aVertex, bVertex, cVertex] at hvR
    rcases hvR with h | h | h | h | h | h | h <;>
      have hi := H.vertex_injective h <;> simp_all
  exact K.interior_disjoint v
    (mem_interior_of_mem_tail_ne_end hvK hv2) hvh

name: Erdos64.PentagramEarHull.cycle8_of_connector_02_length_one
statement:
theorem cycle8_of_connector_02_length_one
    (H : PentagramEarHull G) (K : Connector H 0 2)
    (hK : K.path.length = 1) :
    ∃ c : G.Walk (bVertex H 0) (bVertex H 0),
      c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = 8

    (hullReturn_of_connector_02_length_one H K hK)

name: Erdos64.rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_path
statement:
theorem rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_path
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (r : V)
    (C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hcard : (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card = 2) :
    ∃ a b : V, ∃ p : G.Walk a b,
      a ≠ b ∧
      a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      b ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      G.Adj r a ∧ G.Adj r b ∧
      p.IsPath ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) ∧
      r ∉ p.support ∧ 0 < p.length
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, ha, hb, hra, hrb⟩ :=
    rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_extraction r C hcard
  obtain ⟨har, haC⟩ := (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r C a).mp ha
  obtain ⟨hbr, hbC⟩ := (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r C b).mp hb
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := C.connected_toSimpleGraph.exists_isPath
    (⟨⟨a, har⟩, haC⟩ : C) (⟨⟨b, hbr⟩, hbC⟩ : C)
  let e : C.toSimpleGraph →g G :=
    { toFun := fun v => v.1.1
      map_rel' := fun h => h }
  have he : Function.Injective e := by
    intro x y hxy
    change x.1.1 = y.1.1 at hxy
    exact Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext hxy)
  let p : G.Walk a b := q.map e
  have hp : p.IsPath :=
    (SimpleGraph.Walk.isPath_map_iff_of_injective (f := e) he).mpr hq
  have hinside : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support →
      v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C := by
    intro v hv
    change v ∈ (q.map e).support at hv
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map] at hv
    obtain ⟨z, _hz, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hv
    change z.1.1 ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C
    exact (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r C z.1.1).mpr
      ⟨z.1.2, z.2⟩
  have hroot : r ∉ p.support := by
    intro hrp
    exact (rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C).2
      (hinside r hrp)
  have hpos : 0 < p.length := by
    apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    intro hzero
    exact hab (SimpleGraph.Walk.eq_of_length_eq_zero hzero)
  exact ⟨a, b, p, hab, ha, hb, hra, hrb, hp, hinside, hroot, hpos⟩

name: Erdos64.rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_extraction
statement:
theorem rootDeletedComponent_twoPort_extraction
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] (r : V)
    (C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hcard : (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card = 2) :
    ∃ a b : V, a ≠ b ∧
      a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      b ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      G.Adj r a ∧ G.Adj r b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hs⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp hcard
  have ha : a ∈ rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C := by
    rw [hs]
    simp [hab]
  have hb : b ∈ rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C := by
    rw [hs]
    simp [hab]
  have ha' := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
  have hb' := Finset.mem_filter.mp hb
  exact ⟨a, b, hab, ha'.2, hb'.2,
    (G.mem_neighborFinset r a).mp ha'.1,
    (G.mem_neighborFinset r b).mp hb'.1⟩

name: Erdos64.rootedDouble_root_degree_doubling
statement:

    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} [Fintype V]
