    (rootedDouble_root_neighborEquiv (G := G) (r := r))

name: Erdos64.mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (r : V)
    (C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (v : V) :
    v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ↔
      ∃ hv : v ≠ r,
        (⟨v, hv⟩ : {w : V // w ≠ r}) ∈ C.supp
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [rootDeletedComponentCarrier]

name: Erdos64.rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem
statement:
theorem rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (r : V)
    (C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) :
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C).Nonempty ∧
      r ∉ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, hC⟩ := C.nonempty_supp
    exact ⟨v, (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r C v).2 ⟨hv, hC⟩⟩
  · intro hr
    obtain ⟨hr', _⟩ := (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r C r).1 hr
    exact hr' rfl

name: Erdos64.rootDeletedComponent_boundary
statement:
theorem rootDeletedComponent_boundary
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] (r : V) (hconn : G.Connected)
    (C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) :
    (∀ x, x ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      ∀ y, G.Adj x y →
        y ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∨ y = r) ∧
      ∃ x, x ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧ G.Adj x r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hclosure : ∀ x, x ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      ∀ y, G.Adj x y →
        y ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∨ y = r := by
    intro x hx y hxy
    by_cases hyr : y = r
    · exact Or.inr hyr
    · left
      obtain ⟨hx', hxC⟩ := (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r C x).1 hx
      apply (mem_rootDeletedComponentCarrier_iff G r C y).2
      refine ⟨hyr, ?_⟩
      have hCeq :
          (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hx'⟩ = C :=
        (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff C ⟨x, hx'⟩).mp hxC
      have hxyD : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).Adj
          ⟨x, hx'⟩ ⟨y, hyr⟩ := hxy
      rw [SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff]
      exact (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.eq.mpr hxyD.reachable.symm).trans hCeq
  have hnonempty : (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C).Nonempty :=
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C).1
  have hroot_fin : r ∉ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C :=
    (rootDeletedComponentCarrier_nonempty_not_mem G r C).2
  have hroot_not_mem : r ∉ (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C : Set V) := by
    simpa only [Finset.mem_coe] using hroot_fin
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hnonempty
  have hx' : x ∈ (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C : Set V) := by
    exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr hx
  obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, huv⟩ :=
    exists_adj_mem_of_mem_of_not_mem hconn hx' hroot_not_mem
  have hvr : v = r := by
    rcases hclosure u (Finset.mem_coe.mp hu) v huv with hvC | hvr
    · exact (hv (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hvC)).elim
    · exact hvr
  exact ⟨hclosure, ⟨u, Finset.mem_coe.mp hu, hvr ▸ huv⟩⟩

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_even_port_path_mixed_ear_avoiding_vertex
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_even_port_path_mixed_ear_avoiding_vertex
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    (hodd : ∀ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C → Odd (G.degree v))
    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath) (heven : Even p.length)
    (hinside : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (hcubic : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → G.degree v = 3)
    (s : V) (hs : s ∈ p.support) :
    ∃ E : (G.induce {v : V | v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      v ∉ p.support}).ConnectedComponent,
      Odd (offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E).card ∧
      ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : V, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
        1 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ p.support ∧ b ∈ p.support ∧ a ≠ b ∧
        ear.IsPath ∧ (ear.length = 2 ^ k ∨ ear.length = 2 ^ k + 1) ∧
        (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v = a ∨ v = b ∨
          v ∈ offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E) ∧
        (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ p.support → v = a ∨ v = b) ∧
        (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) ∧
        s ∉ ear.support
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨E, hKodd⟩ := M.rootDeleted_even_path_odd_offPathComponent r C D hCD
    hodd p hp heven hinside
  let K := offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E
  obtain ⟨_, hKdata, hboundary, hsize⟩ :=
    cut_side_offPath_carrier_data M r C D hCD hxy hrx hry p hinside E
  have hattachments : ∀ w, w ∈ p.support → ∀ a, a ∈ K → ∀ b, b ∈ K →
      G.Adj a w → G.Adj b w → a = b := by
    intro w hw a ha b hb haw hbw
    exact cut_side_port_path_external_neighbors_eq r C hxy hrx hry p hp hinside
      K hKdata w hw (hcubic w hw) a ha b hb haw.symm hbw.symm
  obtain ⟨k, a, b, ear, hk, ha, hb, hab, hear, hlen, hsupport, hfresh, hav⟩ :=
    M.odd_carrier_mixed_ear_avoiding_attachment K {v | v ∈ p.support}
      (fun v hv => (hKdata v hv).2) hboundary hKodd
      (fun v hv => hodd v (hKdata v hv).1) hsize hattachments s hs
  refine ⟨E, hKodd, k, a, b, ear, hk, ha, hb, hab, hear, hlen,
    hsupport, hfresh, ?_, hav⟩
  intro v hv
  rcases hsupport v hv with h | h | h
  · subst v
    exact hinside a ha
  · subst v
    exact hinside b hb
  · exact (hKdata v h).1

name: Erdos64.cubicTwoTerminalCompletion_isCycle
statement:
private theorem cubicTwoTerminalCompletion_isCycle
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b : V}
    {p q : G.Walk a b}
    (hp : p.IsPath) (hq : q.IsPath)
    (hinter : ∀ z, z ∈ p.support → z ∈ q.support → z = a ∨ z = b)
    (hlong : 1 < p.length) :
    (p.append q.reverse).IsCycle
proof:
:= by
  have ha : a ∉ p.support.tail := by
    have hn : (a :: p.support.tail).Nodup := by
      rw [p.cons_tail_support]
      exact hp.support_nodup
    exact (List.nodup_cons.mp hn).1
  have hb : b ∉ q.reverse.support.tail := by
    have hn : (b :: q.reverse.support.tail).Nodup := by
      rw [q.reverse.cons_tail_support]
      exact hq.reverse.support_nodup
    exact (List.nodup_cons.mp hn).1
  have htails : p.support.tail.Disjoint q.reverse.support.tail := by
    rw [List.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzp hzq
    have hzq' : z ∈ q.support := by
      have hmem := List.mem_of_mem_tail hzq
      simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_reverse, List.mem_reverse] using hmem
    rcases hinter z (List.mem_of_mem_tail hzp) hzq' with hza | hzb
    · exact ha (hza ▸ hzp)
    · exact hb (hzb ▸ hzq)
  exact hp.isCycle_append hq.reverse htails (Or.inl hlong)

name: Erdos64.CubicTwoTerminalCompletion.completion_cycle
statement:
theorem CubicTwoTerminalCompletion.completion_cycle
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (T : CubicTwoTerminalCompletion G) :
    (T.gadget.append T.returnPath.reverse).IsCycle ∧
      (T.gadget.append T.returnPath.reverse).length =
        T.gadget.length + T.returnPath.length
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨cubicTwoTerminalCompletion_isCycle T.gadget_isPath
      T.returnPath_isPath T.interiors_disjoint T.gadget_length_gt_one, ?_⟩
  simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_append, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_reverse]

name: Erdos64.CubicTwoTerminalCompletion.terminal_length_equation
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_append, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_reverse]
    using hdyadic

name: Erdos64.separatedThirdNeighborComponentCarrier_mem_iff
statement:
theorem separatedThirdNeighborComponentCarrier_mem_iff
    {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (D : Finset V) (x y : V)
    (C : (G.induce (↑(D.erase x |>.erase y) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent)
    (v : V) :
    v ∈ separatedThirdNeighborComponentCarrier G D x y C ↔
      ∃ hv : v ∈ (D.erase x |>.erase y),
        (⟨v, (show v ∈ (↑(D.erase x |>.erase y) : Set V) from hv)⟩ :
          (↑(D.erase x |>.erase y) : Set V)) ∈ C.supp
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [separatedThirdNeighborComponentCarrier]

name: Erdos64.separated_third_neighbor_component_split
statement:
theorem separated_third_neighbor_component_split
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (D : Finset V) (r x y z w : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D)
    (hports : x ∈ D ∧ y ∈ D ∧ x ≠ y)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ t, t ∉ D → G.Adj v t → t = r)
    (hexact :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y))
    (hcubic : G.degree x = 3 ∧ G.degree y = 3)
    (hxy : G.Adj x y)
    (hz : z ∈ D ∧ z ≠ r ∧ z ≠ x ∧ z ≠ y ∧ G.Adj x z)
    (hw : w ∈ D ∧ w ≠ r ∧ w ≠ x ∧ w ≠ y ∧ G.Adj y w)
    (hzw : z ≠ w)
    (hzw_adj : ¬G.Adj z w) :
    (∃ C : (G.induce (↑(D.erase x |>.erase y) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent,
      (⟨z, (show z ∈ (↑(D.erase x |>.erase y) : Set V) from by
        simpa [hz.2.2.1, hz.2.2.2.1] using hz.1)⟩ :
        (↑(D.erase x |>.erase y) : Set V)) ∈ C.supp ∧
      (⟨w, (show w ∈ (↑(D.erase x |>.erase y) : Set V) from by
        simpa [hw.2.2.1, hw.2.2.2.1] using hw.1)⟩ :
        (↑(D.erase x |>.erase y) : Set V)) ∈ C.supp) ∨
    ∃ K : Finset V,
      z ∈ K ∧ K ⊆ D ∧ K ⊂ D ∧
      w ∉ K ∧ x ∉ K ∧ y ∉ K ∧
      (G.induce (↑K : Set V)).Connected ∧
      (∀ u, u ∈ K → ∀ v, v ∉ K → G.Adj u v → v = x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Set V := (↑(D.erase x |>.erase y) : Set V)
  have hzS : z ∈ S := by
    simp [S, hz.1, hz.2.2.1, hz.2.2.2.1]
  have hwS : w ∈ S := by
    simp [S, hw.1, hw.2.2.1, hw.2.2.2.1]
  let H := G.induce S
  let Cz : H.ConnectedComponent := H.connectedComponentMk ⟨z, hzS⟩
  have hzC : (⟨z, hzS⟩ : S) ∈ Cz.supp :=
    SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_mem
  by_cases hwC : (⟨w, hwS⟩ : S) ∈ Cz.supp
  · exact Or.inl ⟨Cz, hzC, hwC⟩
  · right
    let K : Finset V := separatedThirdNeighborComponentCarrier G D x y Cz
    have hzK : z ∈ K := by
      apply (separatedThirdNeighborComponentCarrier_mem_iff G D x y Cz z).2
      exact ⟨hzS, hzC⟩
    have hKsub : K ⊆ D := by
      intro v hv
      obtain ⟨hvS, _⟩ :=
        (separatedThirdNeighborComponentCarrier_mem_iff G D x y Cz v).1 hv
      have hvD' : v ∈ (D.erase x).erase y := by simpa [S] using hvS
      exact (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hvD').2).2
    have hKnotxy : ∀ v, v ∈ K → v ≠ x ∧ v ≠ y := by
      intro v hv
      obtain ⟨hvS, _⟩ :=
        (separatedThirdNeighborComponentCarrier_mem_iff G D x y Cz v).1 hv
      have hvD' : v ∈ (D.erase x).erase y := by simpa [S] using hvS
      exact ⟨(Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hvD').2).1,
        (Finset.mem_erase.mp hvD').1⟩
    have hwK : w ∉ K := by
      intro hwK
      obtain ⟨hwS', hwC'⟩ :=
        (separatedThirdNeighborComponentCarrier_mem_iff G D x y Cz w).1 hwK
      have hwC'' : (⟨w, hwS⟩ : S) ∈ Cz.supp := by
        simpa only [Subsingleton.elim hwS' hwS] using hwC'
      exact hwC hwC''
    have hxK : x ∉ K := by
      intro hxK
      exact (hKnotxy x hxK).1 rfl
    have hyK : y ∉ K := by
      intro hyK
      exact (hKnotxy y hyK).2 rfl
    have hKconn : (G.induce (↑K : Set V)).Connected := by
      refine { preconnected := ?_, nonempty := ⟨⟨z, hzK⟩⟩ }
      rintro ⟨u, huK⟩ ⟨v, hvK⟩
      obtain ⟨huS, huC⟩ :=
        (separatedThirdNeighborComponentCarrier_mem_iff G D x y Cz u).1 huK
      obtain ⟨hvS, hvC⟩ :=
        (separatedThirdNeighborComponentCarrier_mem_iff G D x y Cz v).1 hvK
      have huS' : u ∈ S := by
        simpa [S, and_assoc, and_left_comm, and_comm] using huS
      have hvS' : v ∈ S := by
        simpa [S, and_assoc, and_left_comm, and_comm] using hvS
      have huC' : (⟨u, huS'⟩ : S) ∈ Cz.supp := by
        simpa only [Subsingleton.elim huS huS'] using huC
      have hvC' : (⟨v, hvS'⟩ : S) ∈ Cz.supp := by
        simpa only [Subsingleton.elim hvS hvS'] using hvC
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Cz.connected_toSimpleGraph.exists_isPath
        (⟨⟨u, huS'⟩, huC'⟩ : Cz) (⟨⟨v, hvS'⟩, hvC'⟩ : Cz)
      let e : Cz.toSimpleGraph →g G :=
        { toFun := fun a => a.1.1
          map_rel' := fun h => h }
      let p : G.Walk u v := q.map e
      have hpK : ∀ a, a ∈ p.support → a ∈ K := by
        intro a ha
        rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_map] at ha
        obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ha
        exact (separatedThirdNeighborComponentCarrier_mem_iff G D x y Cz b.1.1).2
          ⟨b.1.2, b.2⟩
      exact (p.induce (↑K : Set V) hpK).reachable
    have hy_unique : ∀ u, u ∈ D → u ≠ x → G.Adj y u → u = w := by
      intro u huD hux hyu
      have hyaccount := two_cubic_ports_boundary_accounting D r x y hr hports
        hboundary hexact hcubic
      have hF : (D.filter (G.Adj y)).card = 2 := by
        simpa [internalDegree] using hyaccount.2.1
      have hxF : x ∈ D.filter (G.Adj y) :=
        Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hports.1, hxy.symm⟩
      have hwF : w ∈ D.filter (G.Adj y) :=
        Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hw.1, hw.2.2.2.2⟩
      have huF : u ∈ D.filter (G.Adj y) := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨huD, hyu⟩
      have hcard : ({x, w, u} : Finset V).card ≤ (D.filter (G.Adj y)).card :=
        Finset.card_le_card (by
          intro v hv
          simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
          rcases hv with rfl | rfl | rfl
          · exact hxF
          · exact hwF
          · exact huF)
      by_cases huw : u = w
      · exact huw
      have huxw : x ≠ w := hw.2.2.1.symm
      have hxu : x ≠ u := by
        intro h
        exact hux h.symm
      have hwu : w ≠ u := by
        intro h
        exact huw h.symm
      have : ({x, w, u} : Finset V).card = 3 := by
        simp [huxw, hxu, hwu]
      omega
    have hboundaryK :
        ∀ u, u ∈ K → ∀ v, v ∉ K → G.Adj u v → v = x := by
      intro u huK v hvK huv
      have huD := hKsub huK
      by_cases hvD : v ∈ D
      · by_cases hvx : v = x
        · exact hvx
        · by_cases hvy : v = y
          · subst v
            have huw : u = w := hy_unique u huD (hKnotxy u huK).1 huv.symm
            exact (hwK (huw ▸ huK)).elim
          · have hvS : v ∈ S := by
              simp [S, hvD, hvx, hvy]
            have huS : u ∈ S := by
              obtain ⟨huS, _⟩ :=
                (separatedThirdNeighborComponentCarrier_mem_iff G D x y Cz u).1 huK
              simpa [S, and_assoc, and_left_comm, and_comm] using huS
            have huC : (⟨u, huS⟩ : S) ∈ Cz.supp := by
              obtain ⟨huS', huC'⟩ :=
                (separatedThirdNeighborComponentCarrier_mem_iff G D x y Cz u).1 huK
              have huS'' : u ∈ S := by
                simpa [S, and_assoc, and_left_comm, and_comm] using huS'
              simpa only [Subsingleton.elim huS'' huS] using huC'
            have hvC : (⟨v, hvS⟩ : S) ∈ Cz.supp :=
              Cz.mem_supp_of_adj_mem_supp huC huv
            have hvK' :=
              (separatedThirdNeighborComponentCarrier_mem_iff G D x y Cz v).2 ⟨hvS, hvC⟩
            exact (hvK hvK').elim
      · have hvr : v = r := hboundary u huD v hvD huv
        have hur : G.Adj u r := hvr ▸ huv
        rcases (hexact u huD).mp hur with hux' | huy'
        · exact (hKnotxy u huK).1 hux' |>.elim
        · exact (hKnotxy u huK).2 huy' |>.elim
    refine ⟨K, hzK, hKsub, ?_, hwK, hxK, hyK, hKconn, hboundaryK⟩
    refine ⟨hKsub, ?_⟩
    intro hDK
    exact hwK (hDK hw.1)
